The only thing that was just a tad bit disappointing is that there wasn't much selection when I was there. It seemed that they were in the midst of changing out their display. I appreciated when the cashier also told us about the free water cups instead of immediately charging us for a bottle of water. Overall, the brownie was very good and the small raspberry cup was delicious as well. The prices were reasonable and the entire dining area/lounge rooms were very clean.

What can I say but the Donuts are always fresh and awesome! That's not the only reason I'm giving them 5 stars .... it's the customer service , always on point. Today especially I came in with my dog and as I was going out to the patio I spilled my cold brew on the floor. Immediately the staff came over and replaced my coffee, and were super nice after the mess my dog and I made. It's these things that are the signs of a well run business. 5 stars All the Way. Thanks Donut Bar.

I've visited this establishment on February 8, 2020, along with my three family members. We ordered three small ice cream cups, a large milkshake, and a small milkshake. The small milkshake cup was only half-full as it was the left-over amount from the container from making the large milkshake. I didn't mind too much that I was charged full-price for half a cup, but then we sat down to eat. The milkshakes were so watery that they couldn't really pass for a milkshake, but the store had become busy, so it wasn't worth going back and have her add more ice cream. At age 66, I can't recall having such a poorly made milkshake in my life. It was just watery milk with an ice cream taste. It was so blatantly obvious, so the only reasonable explanation is that she simply didn't care. Likewise, she wasn't friendly, and I didn't want to make a scene. The price of the order was $26.87, which was markedly high for the subpar quality of the product and crappy service. In summary, I won't be visiting this establishment ever again, and if you're looking for a nice ice cream shop in this area, you may want to look around for alternate choice. Regards,

Some of the BEST cupcakes Ive had! The sprinkles and red velvet flavors are my fave as well as the salted caramel!!! I have had the dark choc marshmallow and vanilla which are also good but not my fave! But just as moist and soft! I come often :/ since I love right behind them. So bad for me but so good, lol.
Best boba in AZ! So yummy and tapioca is always fresh and chewy! I recommend the brown sugar milk tea or the strawberry matcha latte! Both are so delicious!

Homer Simpson has die and gone to Heaven! Man the best donuts in Las Vegas, in the world! I had the maple and Bacon bar, I just couldn't have one I had to have three and a cup of hot coffee. The best thing to do, first thing in the morning it to stop the Donut Bar and put up a cake donut and hot cup of coffee.. You want to be a hero at your job, pick up a dozen on the way to work and bam your staff will love you...... Great Donuts.... Las Vegas Best hidden secret.....

Love the macarons here! Since the one in Beverly Hills closed down, I always make a trip down here whenever I am in Vegas. The favorite is definitely the vanilla and pistachio macarons. This time around we also got the strawberry sesame which is super unique.

I'd give more than 5 stars if I could. I am married to a man who Lives for good ice cream, as avid travelers we have eaten ice cream all over the world and the best we've had to date? Mitchell's in Ohio City. While on a 30 hour visit to Cleveland we came here twice. We tried: (pls do not judge) Pistachio (hands down best pistachio EVAH!) Peach (fresh tasty super peach flavor!) Chocolate chocolate chip (rich with ample chunks of dk chocolate) Salted caramel (good but not my favorite) S'mores (chock full of homemade graham crackers) Banana cream (S U P E R B not even kidding try it) Rocky road (great balance of crunch salted almonds, chocolate and marshmallow) Key lime (SO F R E A K I N G GOOD- no joke if you are remotely a key lime person treat yo' self! ) Caramelized Chocolate - sophisticated taste There was a whole dressed up wedding party there doing wedding pics while we were there - I totally get it now. Cherish the gift of Mitchell's Cleveland.

Came here just for their macarons and they didn't disappoint. You can either get them for $3.50 each or $17.50 for a box of 6 so I opted for the box (which came out to be a little under $3 each). The macarons were huge!! (the size of my palm). It included orange, raspberry, vanilla, lemon, coffee and chocolate flavors. The cookie was chewy and crunchy on the outside and the flavors were pretty good as well. Overall, solid macarons.
Ordered a chocolate croissant it was just ok. The hot chocolate was awful! Tastes like a water.

So doughnuts are one of my favorite foods, and though I'm not vegan, I prefer it if it's available. This place does not disappoint and I struggle not to come here every week! Always a friendly staff, super cute but simple interior (take out only). All the focus on the doughnuts! Strawberry shortcake is one of my favorites, as well as the lemon lavender. It's really hard to get only two.. I also had the Boston cream
Outstanding Ice Cream. Very unique flavors, and a nice casual outdoor outdoor area to enjoy said ice cream. I'm guessing they are doing Noodles now. I can't wait to try those dishes!

I found this place recommended to me through a Facebook group, and I'm so happy I went!! The shop itself is small, and the seating area around it is more of a shared seating area between the other restaurants/snack places there. The line stretched out pretty far when I went there, so I was super excited. The cashier person taking the orders at the window was so friendly, he gave a spiel for everyone who said they were new to the place. I ordered the honey lavender flavour, and it was really good! I would recommend this place to others, especially when they're in the area.

Oh man... if you haven't been here before you are missing out! The ice cream is made in small batches and it is amazing! I was told that super creamy ice cream is their goal and boy did they succeeded in that. Brandon the owner is super friendly and very welcoming when you walk in. He is clearly super passionate about the ice cream he serves and is a huge advocate of "try every flavor you want"! I tried 4 flavors even though I already knew exactly which one I wanted before I came in. I tried cookie monster, honey lavender, fat elvis, and the maple bourbon one. The cookie monster is basically a cookies and cream dyed blue but tastes a million times better. Cookie monster tastes a lot fattier than your normal cookies and cream (this is a good thing), is super creamy (since they blend most of the cookie into the ice cream), and it will dye your mouth blue (my bf got it and his lips and mouth were blue LOL). Fat elvis had a good flavor to it. I honestly can't remember the flavor profile because I was a little distracted by the bacon in it. I love bacon but it was chew and that was off putting for me. I probably would have preferred if the bacon was added after on top so that it was still crunchy. Together, the flavors were great but if you don't like chew bacon this probably won't be for you. Maple bourbon sounded like it would be really sweet to me but it had a nice non-overpowering maple bourbon flavor that was just the right amount of sweetness. I kind of got that as the general theme for the sweetness level of all the ice cream here. Just right. The honey lavender was what I came here for. It's not often that I have been able to find lavender flavored ice cream on a menu and it's not often that I have been able to find it on a menu that won't charge me a ridiculous amount of money to have it. I was trying to not get really excited on my way here just in case the honey lavender ice cream was a huge let down... It seriously made this hot day perfect. The lavender flavor was present and floral but didn't taste like I was eating potpourri. There was very few pieces of actual lavender flowers in the ice cream. This flavor was so light and airy. It was nice and it paired really well with the gingerbread waffle cone cookie piece they put in the cup with the ice cream (nice signature touch by the way! I love it.) I plan to come back to try the donut melt, which is ice cream stuffed inside of a glazed donut. They heat the outside and cool the inside of the donut and then stuff it with ice cream. I didn't have enough room in my stomach to get that and I feel like I completely miss out.

I guess at this time or season that they don't serve breakfast/brunch meals. Unknown whether they will bring these options back just like before. Lines can be long, but the staff is fast in service. They are also very friendly and welcoming if you have any questions. Location: the one I visited is the bakery located close to the entrance of the Venetian theater and the Venetian Tower Suites guest entrance. There are no tables available. Price: It's decent for pastries. Range is from $2-5, depends what you get. Price for coffee is comparable to Starbucks and Coffee Bean Tea Leaf. Pastries and desserts: They are delicious. Some are very sweet. The cheese danish was very rich in flavor. The Macarons have the perfect texture but not overly sweet. The chocolate bouchon is definitely very sweet but it's worth a try for the first timer.
Anya and Jaz! Great customer service and the first person who knew where Moreno Valley was! Such a great lil shop

i was a macaroon virgin until i went to vegas and im SO glad that i got to try my first macaroon at Bouchon! albeit a bit pricey ($3.50) for a piece, id say that its good for a nice dessert or nibble while youre walking through the casinos. the exterior is a little crunchy and the inside is soo soft and chewy!! mmm! pistachio for the win!

Donuts & coffee, the forever couple. This place gets it right in a cute downtown location. I went early afternoon on a weekday and there was still a good selection of a variety of flavors. These are really aesthetic "crowd-pleasing" donuts, I tried three. They're lighter (yeast-raised) than fancy donuts elsewhere, not so much the "i had two and I don't need to eat again today" I've run into elsewhere. The prices are also surprisingly competitive. Discounts for a dozen, and there were some basic bar-shaped donuts for just a dollar when I was there. This place won't break the bank. There's curbside parking (metered), and a shared shady courtyard out back. Check it out.
The ice cream here is to die for. I sample something new but always end up with the Madagascar vanilla. It's simple but perfect. The staff is incredibly friendly.

Well I love Sprinkles cupcakes, but I love the artwork and convenience of the shop's cupcake ATM for a late night treat when cruising the strip. It was easy to use, quick, and convenient and fun! I recommend giving in to your late night craving and enjoying a cupcake treat! Of course, Sprinkles cupcakes are good anytime, but I love this unique feature. :)

Honestly came here cause I really wanted to try the birthday cake at least once in my life. I wouldn't say it's worth $14 for one slice but when in Vegas, ya know. It tasted like a normal funfetti cake but I actually quite liked it. A little to sweet for my liking but super flavorful! Probably wouldn't get it again though for the price.
Good donuts and friendly staff. The patio out back was good for chilling out and reading/working. We had the old fashioned style, chocolate cake with butterfinger and blueberry cake.

We had reservations for a party of 6. They sat us at a table too close to another table and they bumped my seat many times. The food was amazing but they could not get our drinks right. Maybe mishaps. Finally, we asked for separate checks but it was brought out together. Overall, food is worth it but bring your patience.

There are not many really great bakeries around here! But, this place is a gem! I don't live too close but it is certainly worth the drive! They have some really delicious pastries! I absolutely recommend this place to everyone who loves fresh, high quality, delicious baked goods!

There are a few things I like about this Bakery, the top reason has to be the balance of Bread and other bake goods it offers. I love bread, but most bakery I found is just pastry shops, cookies and cakes, etc. No bread. It is very hard to find good quality bread. This bakery has a good combination of bread, croissants, and other sweet stuff. The second reason is that it is a local shop, not a chain or a franchise, so that's worth an extra star. As far as the quality of the bread and pastries, it ranges from average to very good. I would not say anything is out of this world, but I do wish I had a bakery like that in my neighborhood.
Their ice-cream is so good. Coming with all kind of interesting flavors and keep updating!

Melt did not disappoint. I looks like a cute little beach house. Inside the most adorable decor and amazing ice cream flavors. I got the mangonada and my friend got the captain crunch one I think. Simply delicious and served in cute Chinese takeout containers with a fortune cookie. I totally regret not getting the chamoy gummy pack. I will be back soon to get it.

Ice cream was fantastic and customer service even better. They are very sensitive and respectful of gluten allergies. Assured measures taken to avoid cross contamination/ offered all of their alternatives. So happy I know I can come here

This is the cat's pajamas. If you're looking for some good desserts, go to Presti's. I come here after I get dinner in Little Italy with some friends. There is nothing better I think - at least in the Cleveland area. They have a wide variety of just desserts for you to choose from - my favorite is the cannoli. They also serve dinner/lunch foods such as pizza, pasta, gelato, espresso...But i come here mostly for deserts. Go try it - you won't regret it!

What incredibly friendly people work at Sweet Republic! I went in and waded through a sea of small children (ugh) to get to the counter, where my curiosity and indecision was completely approved of. I got to try chocolate rosemary, mint chip and honey yogurt, all of which I liked very much. I went ahead and got a double cup of the latter two and sat down in their patio seating area to enjoy the afternoon and my two scoops. I love that SR is an independent ice cream-otier in a society full of baskin robbins and stone cold creamery. plus you don't feel like you have to run a marathon to work off their treats, especially since the sorbets and yogurts are fat free and everything is made onsite with natural products.

Just visited a few minutes ago (on a Sunday around lunch) and ran to Yelp to write this review :) This is such a cute little shop right in the heart of uptown across from Bearden park. There was a line but we placed our orders after about 15 min of waiting. The cashier was very kind and was the only one working in the shop. Also the store was only making shakes today and no bowls which was a bummer. But the shakes were delicious ! We got Unicorn Breath and Mucha Lucha, price was reasonable about $8 per shake. Support local, black owned businesses and definitely stop by if you're in the area !
Toffee Banofi. The greatest sundae on earth. Can be split between three adults, easily. That's all you need to know. Go. You will not be disappointed. They also have fun board games to play.

This bakery is located outside in The Venetian. It's pretty small and can easily be missed. The two doors are seriously located within feet of each other - yes, that small. Once there I got 6 large macarons as well as a Red Velvet Cupcake. The macarons were BOMB, as usual. I've been to the Napa location. This location isn't busy AT ALL.
Best ice cream in Champaign! The banana chocolate chip snowstorm and the oatmeal cookie snowstorm are amazing!

Jarling's is definitely one of the major highlights of summer time in CU. although ownership has changed recently the custard recipes are still the same which means it is the best around. It isn't ice cream, but it is ice cream's older brother, custard. If you haven't been here yet and are looking to have a great summer snack, go to Jarling's! Oh, and while you're there try the Cold Fudge, it's to die for!
The best Pastries in Las Vegas hands down ( blueberry muffin, cheese danish, oh oh and chocolate chip cookie are my favorites)

I love weird food - combinations you woudn't ever think would go together but do, herb-flavored desserts, etc. Lavender is one of those flavors that a little too much and you feel like you're eating perfume. At Sweet Republic, they know this, because a spoonful of their lavender gelato proved exquisite. Their corn gelato, however, was all too packed with the familiar flavor of corn, which I now know beyond a shadow of a doubt, is not what I want in a dessert. But it was there, and for novelty's sake, I had to try it. Too many gelaterias serve gelato that is hard and icy - essentially rendering them ice cream at a higher price. SR's gelato is smooth and creamy, as gelato should be. And with their penchant for unusual flavors, Sweet Republic is IMHO one of the best in the area.
The ice cream is pretty good. Employees are friendly. My kids like to go for the Tuesday special.

We were so happy to find this wonderful place! My daughter is newly vegan, and our family has a tradition of scouring the cities we visit for the best donuts! These were it! The whole family enjoyed them... husband and kids loved the Cookies and Cream, but I really enjoyed the unique flavor of the Lemon Lavender. Cute, clean shop was a plus, too! I wish they had a place like this at home.

We are thrilled to have this ice cream parlor in Cleveland. I love that they use natural ingredients and the cherries are REAL. The ice cream is tasty and there are a wide variety of flavors, including vegan. It's a little pricey, but worth it for a treat. The staff is friendly and move quickly.

Sweet mercy for Sweet Republic. This is a must visit place for any ice cream lover or anyone else that just wants a cup of goodness. I got the peanut butter something shake mixed with a little nana. You can tell they make this locally. Definitely will be coming back.

I visited with a friend and ordered Pepperoni bread and a few pastries. The bread was a good savory quick bite. I really enjoyed the bread --even though simple, it was fluffy but also chewy. Remember to ask for the dipping sauce on the side. The mini fruit cheesecake was okay but nothing spectacular. The cannoli was also fine because I really like chocolate, but it was kind of difficult to bite into. The cream puff was the tastiest even though it was slightly messy to eat. I think I'm general my expectations were very high because a lot of people hyped it up for me.

I remember when Breyer's ice cream first hit our grocery store. Wow, what a treat. No more. Just another scoop of crap competing with other purveyors of crap for your extra cash. Enter Jeni's. Creamy, velvety and tasty it really is splendid. And pricey. So what? Something this good will cost you extra change. Pony up and enjoy the decadence. They say that creamy ice cream, like Jeni's, is due to more egg yolks (i.e. fat) and less air being whipped into the mix. Let us all clasp hands and pray that Jeni's will resist the temptation that has sidelined so many into mediocrity, e.g. Breyers, HÃ¤agen-Dazs, Edy's, and Dairy Queen (ok, they don't belong on the list). Jeni's Splendid Ice Cream. All the way up on my "Give 'em a whirl meter." Indulge here.
I was so disappointed with this bakery. All they have is brownie, cupcakes, biscottis and a few cannolis. A piece of brownie is $10??? Jean-Philippe is so much better!

While there's usually a line, this ice cream is worth the wait! My go-to is the South Side shake - a milkshake with a sundae on top! They have the most extensive ice cream menu, with something for every taste. They even have some dairy-free options, too, which my husband said was delicious. If you want to avoid a line, stop by on a rainy day.

Don't have a picture to share today but I just wanted to share a little compliment about Mason's. I have loved their ice cream (and winter-time ramen) ever since the first time I came to their cute little shop, BUT it wasn't until this spring that I really appreciated how involved in the community the owners are. On their opening day for the season, Mason's participated in a fun running event called "Run the land, eat the ice cream" with a lot of local running fanatics and there was such a warm camaraderie that collected in the shop once the run was over. My friend and I decided to buy two pints of ice cream to bring back and share with our other buddies. I was paying for everything and somehow there was a miscommunication in which I only ended up paying for one. I realized this after I had paid and went back up to the cashier (who I believe was the owner Helen...should have asked for her name) to pay for my other one, but so was so kind and was like, "Oh, don't worry about it!" So I ended up with one free pint of Mason's and I didn't get a chance to share that until now but I just wanted to say a huge thank you to that very sweet lady :)

Really wanted to like our trip, and might give it another try, today was probably their first really busy evening. Went with our kids and right out of the window our cones were melting all over our legs, sprinkles cascading on our shoes. We dug in anyway, and the kids liked the ice cream, but it was too frustrating to eat as an adult. I expected to feel satisfied but it was a miss for me this time.

Super creative flavors to choose from. If you're more plain Jane then this may not be the spot because they don't have the more traditional flavors on their menu.. Everything was pretty good and fast paced up until the guy cashier rang me up. No greeting, nothing.. Just 36 dollars and that was all I ever heard from him lol.

Such a huge selection-hard to make a decision because it is ALL good!!! Love that they partner with other local businesses to source items for their menus like Nancy B's and Pastries ala carte. Is highly recommend trying Page's!!!

This place symbolizes overrated businesses glamorized by the media for no justifiable reason: -The Lobster Tail people are "raving" about? = It was completely stale with tasteless cream. This is just a cream roll that you can get for cheaper and better in a Chinatown bakery. -Strawberry Shortcake - average. Cream could have used more flavor and tasted less commercial and fattening. -Cookies - we tried one of each and none of them were good. I literally took a bite and threw the rest away. How is it possible to make cookies that aren't good? At this point you might think I sound like a negative snob and I attribute that to the amazing bakeries of San Francisco - so I apologize for having standards. The icing to this cake was that we waited 1+ hour to order & receive and most of the shelves were empty because they were selling faster than they could bake. I'm still mad over the stale lobster tail - especially for the price we paid. Why would you come here?

FREE ICE CREAM ON JUNE 21! But also, Jeni's is delicious. I've been to my fair share of ice cream shops (you could call me an ice cream connoisseur), and Jeni's definitely ranks among the best. The bad news is that they stopped doing free samples as of June 2021, but the good news is that they all looked very good. I got a trio with FrosÃ© Sorbet, and other flavors. Needless to say, my favorite was the FrosÃ© Sorbet. Not too sweet, perfectly tangy, and an ideal cold treat for a hot day! I would skip the waffle bowl, though. Not quite worth the extra $1.25.
This place has one of the best cupcakes in the business. It was moist and fluffy. It was a bit sweet and a lot of frosting but other than, it was yummy. Staffs were always smiling and friendly

Really great tasting custom made icecream. Super impressed with how creative they are with their flavored that are switched out weekly and loved that the staff was friendly, welcoming, and well versed in their product so they could inform a new customer like me what's best to try.
Real good Italian pastry shop in Cleveland's Little Italy. Friendly staff and good coffee. Get a cannoli!!!!

Ice cream was good. Hot fudge was over cooked and stuck together in chunky globs instead of being soft and in liquid form. Also the mask policy on the front door references outdated CDC guidance from May. CDC updated their guidance three weeks ago on July 27. Since then 300 Arizona's have died and thousands of others have clogged up our hospitals and contracted long COVID. What will it take for you to update your sign and policy to align with the new CDC guidance?

Having been to Handel's on a number of occasions, I was looking forward to the new location opening in the area. I arrived around noon on their opening day. There are so many great flavors to choose from I decided to get a more conventional flavor, the chocolate raspberry truffle in a cake cone. Flavors were solid and I'm happy to have another dessert option on the Southwest side of town. I think adding some outdoor seating might be a nice next step for this location, to mirror others I have visited.

We were looking for a fun new dessert place, so naturally I turned to Yelp! The 5 stars certainly intrigued me so off we went! It's located in a little quiet strip mall, but don't let that fool you! It's super clean and colorful inside and has a very welcoming atmosphere. The owner was incredibly helpful and nice, along with his staff. They were truly excited to have us there and even more so, they were excited about their product which is huge! They have some of the most amazing flavors I've ever seen for ice cream (lucky charms, chocolate birthday cake, captain crunch to name a few)! My daughter and I each got their almost-famous (but-soon-to-be-actually-famous) cookie cup, which had two homemade macaroons (perfectly cooked) with three scoops of whatever ice cream you want, topped with a toasted marshmallow (ummm YUM). My daughter got fruity pebbles flavored macaroons with captain crunch ice cream. The ice cream tastes just like the milk from a bowl of captain crunch along with pieces of the cereal in it! I got vanilla macaroons with mint chocolate chip ice cream. Both creations were amazing!! My husband got a rocky road milkshake that he said was really good. He was a little disappointed they didn't have plain chocolate ice cream, but he admitted the rocky road was delicious! We will be heading here again! I love seeing new businesses succeed and excel at what they do!

This place is the best Ice Cream I've ever had! I saw it on Best Things I Ever Ate, recommended by Alton Brown. That was a year ago...I haven't had ice cream from anywhere else since. I've had sundaes, cookies, scoops, brittle and cones! My favorites are Bleu Cheese Honey and I Heart Bacon. The Sweet Corn one I had the other day is a close contender as well. The Bacon Brittle is an absolute must! I've bought a couple bags and it's always gone rather quickly. The homemade toasted marshmallows are to die for, I could eat them all day!

WOW WOW WOW. Amelie's, please come to Raleigh! This food joint is a dream come true! -It's open 24 hours! The first food joint in NC that I have heard of that does this. -You can get a quarter, half or full baguette warmed up and sliced with butter or spread. The quarter baguette makes for the PERFECT snack when you are feeling peckish. I really enjoyed the smoked gouda spread. -They have tons of delicious authentic french desserts on display that you just can't resist. We shared the large mousse cup and it was fantastic. -Tartines!!! -Baguettes!! (again) -Cute decor, nice staff and plenty of seating. -Plenty of breakfast/brunch items and standard coffee shop drinks. -Did I say fresh, warm baguettes??? :) I guess it is good that Amelie's is not in Raleigh, because I would literally be there every day.
In college this was my number one study spot. Beautiful atmosphere, great pastries and treats and friendly staff!
You wouldn't think that a walk up ice cream shop would work in Las Vegas because it's SO HOT people are trying to get out of the heat... but it does. Best ice cream in town.

Cold ice cream + Warm Waffle nothing short of amazing. Quality ice cream sandwiched inside a doughnut or waffle are things dreams are made of. Do your palette a favor and give this place a shot. You won't regret it.

We had a group of 11 looking for a place to hit after catching a show at the Orpheum. So, we needed a spot that could accommodate us all, that would make everyone in the group happy, and that was open late. We found that place in Melt. The ice cream choices were varied and everyone in the group thoroughly enjoyed their selections. I found the sorbets particularly good, especially the cucumber. The joint is in a quaint little house and is small, small, small with no seating inside. But, there's a seating area outside, and although most of the tables are pretty small (4-seaters), we were all still able to successfully congregate as a group. The service was a little slow -- we were a fairly large group and there was only one person working the shop. And, more people showed up while we were there. So, the server had her hands quite full. But she was friendly, nice, efficient and professional and we really just didn't mind the wait. I love that this is a local shop with locally-made goods.

Warning: This five-star review is bolstered by extreme nostalgia. Little me asked, no, demanded that we went here after every zoo trip. Now that not-as-little me can drive, I'm shocked that I don't go here more. Honey Hut is the most consistently delicious ice cream in Cleveland. A hot take for some, but I stand by it. Not once have I gone here and not been pleased with the flavor I picked, the price, and welcoming atmosphere of this little stand. This time around, I got the featured flavor - banana chocolate chip. Just banana-y enough and tasted impressively fresh. My mom went for the classic honey pecan flavor. This flavor is always a winner in my book. While it is incredibly sweet, the nut pieces balance it out and make you take your time rather than consuming it in two seconds flat. My sister got chocolate peanut butter. While I'm not a chocolate-based ice cream fan, she still left with a smile on her face.

Venetian is dangerous. I hardly walked pass the slot machines without stopping at the Chinese Queen machine because of the lights. I was on my way to the Phantom Theater to pick up my tickets for the night, and I passed by Bouchon Bakery. I was suckered into their macarons. They sell them individually and in a pack. I couldn't resist and I couldn't decide on which to get. My love told me I could get whichever one I wanted, while he orders a turkey cranberry sandwich. So I ended up getting that pack. Yes, fat girls' problems, but it's worth it. They were of six different colors, There's a vanilla, chocolate, coffee, pistachio, raspberry, and caramel flavored. I posted a picture of it, colors do get to me. They're not too sweet, which I liked. My favorite ones were the pistachio and the coffee ones. I find the jam inside the raspberry one to be a little too overwhelming. The size is enough to split with someone else, especially if you want a bit of everything at once. Their sandwiches are pretty good too, especially for a quick lunch. The baguette bread was crunchy on the outside and quite soft in the insides. Too bad I devoured it too soon (I wanted to spend more time with my macarons). The bad part is that you have nowhere to sit and eat. It's like a grab and go cafe.

Best donuts I've ever had. They sell out of glazed at around 2 everyday so get there as early as possible to reserve yours! All of them are delicious, but I recommend you also try the apricot jelly as well if they have any left.
Cutest ice cream place! Came for the first tonight and definitely will reccomend and be back! Owner is super nice as well :)
So disappointed. Had the crack pie. It was like a pie slice of hard cookie. Didn't see what the idea of this item was suppose to be. $6. Not worth it! Get some gelato instead.

Great homemade tasting ice cream - a bunch of locations around the Cleveland area. If you just want some honestly good ice cream - vanilla that tastes like vanilla, honey pecan where the pecans are still crispy, strawberry that takes like real strawberries - this is the place to go. So hard to find naturally good ice cream ... we wait all winter after downing overly processed and engineered ice cream for Honey Hut to open!

Today was the first time my family and I have been to this great place. And we loved it!!! The kids for the free donuts which were Inside Out themed, I had the Butter Beer donut, and my other half had the French Toast Donut (made to order). To drink we had 2 small drips (self service), and the kids had strawberry milk. The staff was super helpful and friendly, Chef Jeff gave the kiddos balloons and interacted with them. We will definitely be coming back!!
Oreo cheesecake and macaroons were delish! Must try it for yourself! Staff is lovely as well. will definitely be coming back!
These donuts are great and taste as good as they look. They're not too sweet and not greasy at all. I brought these to a party and no one knew it was vegan until I told them.

Ventured out to the Grand Canal Shops to eat here at Carlos. This bakery is top notch when it comes to pastries. I had a lobster and cream craving that came over me. I was able to soothe it here with a lobster tail pastry. The bakery is so cute with an old world type feel, I believe that the store having red brick delivers this to the guest. The ambiance of the bakery is a positive excitement but fast paced. The guest specialist that assisted me was very welcoming and so upbeat. This most excellent specialist was named Jasmine. She wrapped both of the pastries that I purchased in a cute little box and with a red and white ribbon on it. The gift wrapping is extra and did not even have to pay extra for it. The cashier that rang my order was Aleena. She was also pleasant and professional. The process was smooth and painless. I order as I said before the Lobster Tail which was so great. The lobster flavor was perfect and oh so good. This Mousse Puff with Chocolate was talking to me through the glass to so I decided to try that as well. The puff was great but the chocolate was so creamy. I decided to mix the chocolate cream and the lobster tails creme together and it was a delicious black and white delight.

I had a cold brew coffee with cereal milk. It was good! Similar to Starbucks sweet cream Cold brew as far as Sweetness is concerned. I also tried an everything bagel bomb. Tasty! Good for when your tummy can't handle a full breakfast or the line at Eggslut (next door) is too long.

Support Black Owned Business! Perfect dessert cereal bar right in the French Quarter!! I ordered the Cosmo and Wanda Shake and it was perfect!! I was able to use Oat milk which was perfect!! I did not have an upset stomach with having this as a milk option!! I highly recommend!! I will be back! Visited: 6/29/21 8:10pm

Went here a couple of days ago with a group of friends and some of their kids and I have to tell you this place is unbelievably great. The ice cream is out-of-this-world amazing the cookie toppings and the waffle cones are just incredible and it's a really nice comfortable atmosphere and everybody felt good. Apparently most of everything that they have is made from scratch which is really unusual and of course everybody appreciates that as well. The kids were in heaven and even my friends could not get enough of this wonderful ice cream spot. We'll be coming back every chance I get. This place is an absolute must go to.

LITERALLY SO AMAZING! I love this place. If I am feeling like treating myself i will get a donut but usually just a coffee. Let me tell you when I say the coffee is seriously some of the best I have ever had, like EVER. I HIGHLY recommend stopping by this cute local place, the earlier you go the better because once they sell out they are done for the day! The earlier you go the better flavors they have-just saying.

Waited 3 years to try the S'more Brownie from The Batch Maker/The Batch House and it didn't disappoint. Dulce de leche brownie also deserves a shoutout. The caramel was decadent and I honestly preferred it over the s'more brownie. Oat milk cookies were almost as big as my face and apparently are a top seller along with the chocolate puddle cookies. #bergerknowsbest

This is basically an ice cream stand in a strip mall. They have a million flavors and it's hard to decide which is my favorite. There are a few benches outside for seating but nothing inside. You order at the window and stay outside. Ice cream was good and from what I gather from my Ohio people, it's a staple back there.

My hubby and I visited for the first time this past Vegas trip, and we were a little disappointed. Everything looks so good on the display case but the items we ordered and tried were just eh. We got the Oreo cake tower, cannoli, lobster tail, regular cream puff, and chocolate cream puff. The cake stack looks good but tasted like something you might buy at the grocery store, and the cannoli was okay, kind of bland. I haven't tried the other items we picked up yet, but I think Carlo's in Vegas might be hype. I'm hoping the original is better. The bake shop however was very clean and organized, and smelled very yummy. Also the cashiers and employees were fast and very organized.

This is seriously one of the best bakeries in Cleveland. I am in love with the cappuccino brownie and think they have one of the best cappuccinos in the world. I kid you not, I made a special trip here when I was in town for a business trip. When I used to live here I loved doing work at the cafe seating!

I ordered a dozen Triple Chocolate Cup Cakes as a co-worker was leaving us and she absolutely loves chocolate. Now let me tell you about these cupcakes. If you are a chocolate fan, these will be the best thing in the world. The cake itself was moist and filled with chocolate and the frosting, oh the frosting that is something that should be illegal because it is so good. Needless to say, the Cupcakes were gone in a blink of an eye. So, if you like chocolate and are like what can I have? Order these cupcakes and you will literally conquer that craving for quite some time.

Since they have vegan options, I got donuts to go for my family. My husband devoured the strawberry shortcake one and said it was amazing. My kids loved the apple fritter and were in heaven with this treat. Unfortunately there was nothing gluten-free so I couldn't have them. The service was GREAT (night and day from Vege-Nation next door). Definitely a place to go if you want a sweet treat.

Amelie's has the best pastries in Charlotte. It is always on my itinerary when I have to be in the uptown area! My husband will drive from Matthews for their eclairs and I will for the Salted Caramel brownie!! What's more is that is doesn't matter when I need an Amelie's fix, because they are open 24x7 and every day of the year, including Christmas!!! And the owners are lovely people who actually care about the community!
I love this spot! My personal faves are the cheesecake, apricot linzers, and stromboli. Yum!

Awesome new place!! The ice cream is delicious, full of flavor, and creamy. Fun toppings including your favorite sugar cereals from childhood. The donut melt is out of this world! Hot donut filled with cold ice cream - wow!!! Owner Brandon is charming and super nice!

Stopped in after the Dbacks shellacked the Rockies last night (12-3) and celebrated with a toffee banofi. It was totally awesome. We had seen it featured on the Best Thing I Ever Ate and wanted to try it since it was in our state! My husband had scoops of salted caramel, peanut butter and vanilla. He enjoyed all of them. We'll be going back again and again...loved it and can't wait to try more things.

everything here is yummy (at least the sweets). the tarts were awesome (chocolate, lemon) and so were the croissants, chocolate eclair, cookies, chocolate mousse cake, and on and on... Some of the desserts are the same (simplified) from the restaurant, so if you want to save a couple of bucks, get them here. it's not to be missed.

I've tried two things here. Cereal Milk ice cream and Latte. Both are amazing!!! Cereal milk ice cream was good. Very unique taste and very addicting! omg. I'm in LOVE with latte with cereal milk. I loved it so much I had two a day for 4 days straight (my entire stay at Cosmopolitan).

This place has changed and the portions are much much smaller. Instead of getting a a top and bottom to the macaroon cookie in the cookie cups, you get one on top of the very very small single scoop of ice cream with a toasted marshmallow. This is completely not worth $6.95. Also the single scoop is the smallest single scoop I have ever gotten. I would recommend Melt over this place any day.
This place is AMAZING! I brought my friend from Nashville here and we both loved it! The workers were so friendly and the doughnut sandwich was delicious

Okay, so you are downtown and you just had an excellent meal at (blank). You either thought you were too full or did not want to drop $10 for ChocoDeath w/ a Side of FudgeFest, and yet you do not want to head home yet. Then, drop in for a scoop or two. (Do you really need to be hungry for ice cream?) Or grab a malt made from Stout beer ice cream. Or a make-your-own ice cream sandwich. And if you must have chocolate, they have a sundae that will rock your world. Whatever your sweet tooth, get out of the heat and get some scratch-made goodness. Yum.

The worst "milkshake" I've ever had, I took a single sip and that was enough. Too much milk and not enough ice cream resulted in a really watery consistency. The shake was so thin that after 5 minutes of sitting, the blended cookie pieces all floated up to the top. The flavor is okay to mediocre, but I wanted a milkshake and not a milkslush.
I love Jack Frost! Ever since a friend had them at their wedding, I've been addicted. Would recommend any of their donuts, mmmmm delicious.

Scrumptious and rich. Recommend the strawberry shortcake crunch, black/white and GOT. Would recommend the cupcake ATM due to the staff being super slow, like turtle slow, like they stayed up all night gaming and only had an hour of sleep kinda slow.
owners are super friendly and upbeat! very unique delicious flavors and awesome toppings. so glad they moved into third space, definitely my new favorite pit stop :)

We happened to park behind Mitchell's on our cross country roadtrip! We were so happy. Hands down one of the best ice cream I've had. Their handmade ice cream is so creamy and smooth. The vanilla bean was so good. They use quality ingredients, give huge scoops, and are pretty cheap ( though I'm biased being from nyc). Even after a massive scoop you don't feel nasty or lethargic because it tastes so fresh! I also love how you can overlook the ice cream being made. The location is so clean and full of art.

Fantastic!!! Went in on a Weekend and it was busy but the line went really quick! We ordered the French toast donut, cremebrulee, strawberries and cream, and blueberry lemon meyer, all were delicious!!! I cant wait to go back and try them all!! They even have a little courtyard we sat in and were able to bring our dogs to sit with us while we enjoyed breakfast!!

A group of us stayed at the Venetian, so we had to try this bakery out. I had the Valrhona Chocolate Cupcake and it was so good! First of all,the cupcake was pretty big. It's like twice the size of a normal cupcake, but not as big as the Costco muffins. The best part? It cost only $3.50. What a deal! The actual cupcake was super moist and there was just a little frosting, not sure what it was, but after reading a couple of reviews, apparently it's marshmallow. It was just a light coating of it. To my surprise as I was getting towards the middle, there was the Valrhona chocolate mousse. What a pleasant surprise! I I wasn't expecting that, but I guess if I actually read the description that the bakery provided for their customers, I would have have expecting it, but all I say when I was looking in the bakery case was CUPCAKE! They didn't need to sell me with the mousse, even though it tasted better with it. Next time I come here, I will definitely get another cupcake, even if I'm not staying at the Venetian. It's worth the walk down the strip.

HOLY CRAP THE MACARONS ARE AMAZING. My friends recently visited and brought back a whole bag full of sweets and Amelie's was one of their stops. Usually, I'm not a macaron fan because most places make them overly sweet with the sugary shells AND the even more sugary filling; not this place. The balance is equal between not sweet enough and sweet and it results in fireworks... in my mouth, lol!
Cupcakes very dry...disappointing. Was really looking forward to some good cake on my birthday!!!
Yummy! Took the kids here for some soft serve. The ice cream was soft and creamy and the fish waffles was crispy on the outside and gooey soft on the inside. Check them out if you havent.
We loved this place! I had a shake (you can select 3 scoops of your choice. I selected 2 espresso and 1 milk+cookies). So creamy, so soft! Absolutely would recommend. Also, very friendly staff.

If you're looking for the best croissants in town, look no further! They have a great selection of bakery items and savory treats. The quiches are also very creamy and delicious. Finally, the homemade caramel and chocolate sauces make the lattes unforgettable.

This place not only has a unique take on ice cream and donuts , but has outstanding customer service! When I informed the owner that I had a severe nut allergy, he stopped what he was doing and informed me that he was going to change his gloves and use a new scooper. As I waited for me dessert to be prepared, I observed him greeting everyone and learning their names, followed with a notion of gratitude for them coming to his business. I left there with a delicious treat and the amazement of customer service I had just experienced and witnessed.

I really like this place. The only thing that kept me from giving it five stars is that I feel the taiyaki could be cooked just a little longer. I've bought it many times and every time I buy it the inside is still just a bit underdone. Still, I will continue to come here because the flavors are great and the service is great too.

Definitely the most delicious breads to crave for and enjoy all season long. Fresh breads all day long is a bonus. I'm looking forward to trying their mango cakes on my next visit. Super excited that I can finally buy a cake in Vegas without driving hours long all the way from California. Staff are welcoming and friendly as well.

Space: This dessert spot is grab and go, there is a line and you order what you want and eat It in the nearby lobby by there is not an open seating. Service: The staff here is super friendly and allow you to taste test items. They always have a bright smile on their faces and answer all your questions. Price: The items are here very pricy. Cookies: $3 Crack Pie: $6.50 Bday Cake Truffle: $6.75 Milkshakes: $9-$10 Food: The items are pretty sweet, they have soft serve, pies, cookies, milkshakes and other sweets. The portions aren't huge but because of how sweet everything is, It is hard to finish. I personally LOVE the birthday cake truffle, It has confetti cake in the center but the outside is a crumble that melts in your mouth. The crack pie is pretty good as well but again, It is sweet and It is hard to finish on your own. Notes: I have never encountered a line here but the cookies can be frozen up to a month or you can let It sit for 5-7 days and they'll still be good!

I've been here before a few times but this was the first time I ordered their cookie with ice cream. Let me first say that their serving is HUGE. I wish I had shared it with my friend with how big it was! The cookie complimented the ice cream perfectly and it was warm too which is a plus! I got the salted caramel ice cream with oreo crumbs and chocolate drizzle. It was super delicious but I will definitely share it next time I get it!
Delicious doughnuts, great menu that changes all the time. Better than most donuts I've tried. Friendly staff too.

Omg! This place is seriously addictive! The shakes are amazing. You have plenty of options to customize your shake or you can choose from the menu. Cereal pieces on shake give it nice crunchiness. The guys working there are very nice and helpful. The line can get long but it is well worth waiting.

I visited this place this past Sunday night with my roommate because we were craving something sweet. It was a little hard to find at first because the area isn't well lit, but it's behind Church's chicken. The place was pretty cute and had a lot customers, in my opinion, for a Sunday night ~8 pm. The lady was really nice and let us have samples to try. I decided to get the sweet cream and passion fruit because of the sample. When I got a cup it tasted more sweet cream than passion fruit. It was still hit the spot. I got a kids scoop, and I thought the portion was generous. My roommate got the Cookie Cup which is what the place is known for and she loved it. The lady toasted the marshmallow in front of us. I'm not sure if I'll get it. It seemed a little overpriced to me. The place had lot of unique flavors that I would be willing to come back for though.
Oh man need I say more.... Salted caramel cupcake and red velvet cream ice cream oh get in my belly!!

I crave Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream, thankfully they sell it in liters. The location is perfect with such a cute vibe. Best ice cream place in Cleveland. I always get new favors and they never disappoint.

I lve these donuts. They are small so you can eat a couple of them. The filling is generous and flavorful. The maple donut is my favorite. I live in Wisconsin and I stop here every time I'm in Ohio. The shop, itself, is nothing to write home about but do not judge a book by its cover...

The donuts are awesome. Great selection of specialty donuts and regular. The service staff greeted me immediately and then the manager came over and had a conversation with us before we left. I will definitely be back!

This little bakery had a lot of options from cake slices, cupcakes, cookies, cookie sandwiches, and unique authentic pastries. The place is bright and clean and the staff was friendly. Unfortunately, everything we sampled (two cookies and a cupcake) were lacking in flavor and were just lack luster. Because it's Vegas, we spent much more on these items than we would back home, and that was salt in the wound. There has got to be better dessert/pastry shops in Vegas!

When I was a little kid I had no problem eating a pint of ice cream in thinking nothing of it. But as an adult, with a waistline, I've pretty much given all sugary delicious dairy products the boot. This is turned into a distaste for mass-produced ice cream for me. Pretty much of you can buy it at the supermarket and it says ice cream I won't even bother reading it it's not worth the calories. We are in the west side of Cleveland and had just finished up a dinner with the kids and decided to stop in to Mitchell's ice cream. I have a co-worker who does nothing but Rave about this place at any given opportunity so we figured we would give it a try. This particular Mitchell is built inside an old theater or movie theater I'm not sure which one it was from the early nineteen-hundreds and they did their best to preserve as much as they could in there which is pretty cool. The counter with all the ice cream has what I thought was mirrors behind it turns out it was a glass wall that you can see into the bakery and kitchen where they manufacture all their ice cream and Cones which is super cool. That and you can go up stairs to the second floor look down on the kitchen and this is all open to the public. I got an ice cream sundae and I can't remember which one it was but they had peanuts and hot fudge and also so delicious goodness. This was the case where my eyes did not deceive me it was as large as I thought it was for 499 and I was able to share this with my wife and neither of us were able to finish all of it. If I'm going to bother wasting calories and ice cream I will definitely do it only one place Mitchell's.
BEST gluten free chocolate chip cookie I've ever tried!!! And love the ATM-like machine out front

The food at Amelie's is always amazing. I went here for a small treat-binge for my cheat day, and ended up eating two macarons and a tart with a double shot espresso. The macarons are great, as per usual. The tart left a little to be desired, and felt a bit over-sugared. The espresso, however, was burnt. I will not assume what the issue was, but I was unhappy with it. Owning my own espresso machine, I know the difference between a fresh espresso versus a burnt one. I saw them make it on the spot however, so I believe the problem lies within the beans themselves, not Amelie's. Amelie's is almost always packed from front to back, usually with people who may have gotten something but have been there for hours on end. I do like the casual effect, but it does become difficult when you just want to sit and eat for twenty minutes and someone has sprawled all of their bags, book, and laptop across a four top. Definitely think there should be a section designated for more of that nature, so customers that are staying a shorter time can rotate tables out more quickly. All in all, will go back from time to time for a little treat, but probably only to-go unless there are already open tables.

The ice cream and chocolates here put the Vegas Buffet Desert fare to shame. Ghirardelli is my all time favorite and a must stop. This location is no exception. Great customer service here and true to all Ghirardelli shops, they gave us a free chocolate to eat while we browsed the menu. Don't let the caloric number listed on the menu deter you. I actually took 1 star off because they put the nutritional info on the menu - way to ruin ice cream & chocolate bliss! Because the numbers listed for calories scared me, I ended up just getting one scoop of ice cream and a topping. But it was still delicious. Butterscotch. Mmm. Next time I'll just have lunch here and have the one with the brownie, whip cream, ice cream and cherry on top...
Grate place love there ice cream.. best in the valley.. every body needs to try there ice cream.. and the staff is grate and nice service can't go wrong with this place..

Their ice cream is unique and full of flavor. I enjoyed each flavor I tasted and ended up ordering the salted caramel. I literally cannot wait to go back, the only thing that stinks is it is so far away! I wish there was one close, except that might ruin my figure?

There was a line to get ice cream but I can understand why. The smell alone was so appetizing, I went with the dairy free options. Cold brew with coconut cream and Texas sheet cake on a sugar cone. The cold brew was my favorite but gosh it was delicious!
Love the cereal milk soft serve with cereal bits. So good. Also ate way too many of their birthday cake truffles. Give them away to friends before you eat them all!

Great ice cream at a cute shop! This ice cream store is located in a small wooden house as a part of a group of other small houses surrounding a small patio-like area. The area has an overall kitschy vibe to it, as the decorations on the patio are eclectic and each house is painted a different color. You order your ice cream at a windowfront with the menu posted next to the window. The workers are very sweet, friendly, and ready to explain the menu for any first-timers. My personal favorite here is the honey lavender, as I'm a sucker for floral flavors and it's sweet and light! You can order a pint to take home for the classic flavors, which is perfect when you don't want to make the drive over to just get ice cream. Your order also comes with a mini stroopwafel, which is a nice addition of texture and sweetness to the ice cream. As a heads up, parking can be kind of difficult, as there's only residential and some sparse meter parking. I once came here in the nighttime and there happened to be a car show going on, and it was near impossible to find any parking! Nevertheless, if I ever get the chance, I always stop by to have their ice cream!

What a fun spot. It's so artsy, lots of comfy spots to sit, the pastries and coffee is amazing. The people that work here are all super nice. It's enjoyable just walking through, looking at everything.

Nothing tasted better after a hot day than one of their shaved ice concoctions. If you're debating getting the coconut cream added, just do it. It was so good!!!! I will be back. The girls behind the counter were also so sweet and just good energy!

Super excited to try their pastries cause cake boss! Line wasn't too bad at 3 pm on a Saturday. About 15 min wait. They had cool displays of fondant cake that you can see as you wait in line. You can also watch bakers bake through the window next to the storefront. A bit pricey, around $4-5 for one pastry. I tried the cookies and cream lobster tail. Expected the lobster tail to be light and flaky but tasted stale and hard to bite into. My friends' lobster tails were also stale tasting. Hope I have a better experience next time.

I went back in June on a Sunday afternoon to Carlo's bake shop and no lines at all. I waited with my brother and sister in line for a few minutes until someone helped us. Too much to choose from cannoli cupcakes, and cookies. Next, we lined up at the cashier to pay our items and the line wasn't long at all. They make the best Italian cookies and cannoli with fresh cream and good crunch. Lots of people linger to looky loo or just waiting for their orders. Its fun to watch the bakers frost the tray of cupcakes or making cookies. I will definitely go back again.

The only negative thing i have to say about this place is that the lines are confusing and i had no idea if i need to stand in a particular line based off what i wanted to order or if i could just jump in wherever. That being said, this place is awesome and very fairly priced. To say they have a shit ton of options would be something like saying The Beatles had a few fans. I will definitely be back here if i am ever passing through the Champaign region. Get out there, check it and yelp it!

I get donuts for my brother here. He loves them! The variety is huge and the staff is very friendly. We especially like the "Elvis" donut we saw today! I wish they would have gluten free donuts! I haven't had one in 10 years! The coffee is quite delicious. I had an iced latte and enjoyed the flavor quite a bit!

Love, love, love Batch. I usually end up buying way too much because I want to taste everything. They do savory bakery really well, especially ham and cheese croissants. It's fortunate for my waistline that I don't live closer. It is a little pricey, but worth the splurge.

What they had was good. Unfortunately they were out of three of the four Loli Cakes I specifically wanted to buy. A disappointment. A Loli Cake is tricky to eat, and likely to fall off of the stick after the first bite...so be careful where you eat! Overall, a nice experience. Top-quality taste; interesting products. I would visit again and support this new business. Off to a nice start!
This place is amazing the food to walk a mile for. Very people friendly reminds me of Greenwich Village. I wish is was closer to where I live in Kannapolis, NC.

LOVE this bakery...they have it spot on when it comes to desserts of any kind!!!! My favorite is the salted caramel brownie and the macaroons. PLUS, this place is open all night, so lots of people go to study there and hang out. Sometimes they have live music or events.

I came to the Linq for something else, but saw the Ghirardelli Ice Cream & Chocolate Shop and decided to stop in. As soon as I got near the entrance, a friendly employee offered me a free Ghirardelli chocolate square, dark & sea salt caramel flavor. I took it and thanked them as I walked inside. There were plenty of chocolates everywhere, but that was not what caught my attention. There were a bunch of sundaes you could choose and my sweet tooth couldn't say no. I especially couldn't say no when, after I checked in on my Yelp app, there was an offer of $1 off any ice cream sundae. Done deal. I ordered a sea salt caramel sundae (Ocean Beach) and the employees were quick to get it made for me. Ocean Breeze is "vanilla ice cream smothered with creamy caramel, freshly homemade hot fudge and sea salt. Perfectly topped with whipped cream, creamy caramel, sea salt, and a Ghirardelli SQUARES Milk Chocolate." After I took a picture of it since it looked so good, I dipped my spoon into the ice cream and took a bite. It was just as yummy as it looked. Ghirardelli is a little pricey for my tastes, but I wouldn't mind coming back here every so often for a sundae. The free chocolate doesn't hurt any either.

TOTALLY GONE DOWNHILL BIG TIME! Couldn't wait to get to Vegas so I could go to Ghirardelli. The only other one I know of is in San Fran. I don't know what the hell was going on and I should have said something to the employees but I didn't. My hot fudge sundae came in a plastic to go cup, not a pretty glass dish (I did not ask for it to go) and my hot fudge was not hot AT ALL. I felt like I was getting a pre-made sundae that had been sitting in a fridge for a few hours. The fudge was ice cold and had already hardened up. I am pretty pissed off about it. I didn't eat the whole thing. The last time I went to Ghirardelli in Vegas it was still at the Hawaiian Marketplace. It was excellent then. I don't know if this is the way it is now or if it was just a jerk off employee. BAD! BAD! BAD! Just so you know it was Sunday 06/22/14 around noon. So whoever was on staff that day needs to find a new job. Had to pay a cabby just to get there.

Busy and a bit pricy, but worth the wait. I've only been here once and remembered liking the one in San Diego more, but it could just be the donuts I got. Favorite donut was the Bourbon Maple in San Diego
This is the creamiest ice cream I've ever tasted.. The taste is simply unique. Wish they had an actual done in area, it was pretty windy trying to eat our ice cream. But otherwise it was D'lish!!!

Ah, Bouchon Bakery, always a bright spot in my Vegas trips. Multiple times I drag myself here to buy a set of assorted Macarons for my airplane trip back to the bay, and each time the Macarons hit the spot. Soft and perfectly sweet (fabulous with an Americano), the macarons are perfectly sized and chewy, not too soft, not too hard. No matter what it is, you can be sure that the pastries are fresh and as tasty as you remember them. I've had the brownies, gingersnaps, and Chocolate Croissants and as well, and they were all pretty awesome. I mean, what negative things can you really say about chocolate, sugar, and butter? :) See you next time, Bouchon! :)

I was visiting my hometown for my Dad's 70th birthday. This bakery was recommended to me because they have vegan options. The cake was fabulous! Vanilla with coconut buttercream. So yummy! Everyone loved it. Highly recommended.
Ordered carrot cake tasted like a box cake you get off the shelf at the supermarket really bad you could tell it had been sitting around for a while. Very dissatisfied.

"Sweet dreams are made of this..." Yes, this was one of the songs I hear playing while I was at Sweet Republic. Very appropriate, don't you think? Moving on to the review.... When Bon Appetit names this place one of the ten best ice cream places in the country and I don't find it that impressing, I don't think that says much of the establishment. Instead, it pretty much shows how spoiled I am. Or maybe I'm more of a gelato person. I don't know. Their product is pretty damn good though. Very natural and homemade tasting. They also have very interesting flavors. I really loved my blue cheese and honey ice cream. It had the perfect amount of sweetness and the blue cheese flavor was not too overpowering. I love the cheese-honey combo and it's a combination that is not used often. I topped my ice cream with their super delicious bacon brittle. A treat with great addiction potential. The salted caramel ice cream was also pretty okay. Same with the peanut butter (?) ice cream. Good but not quite drinking the punch on this one. I don't feel too bad about the 3 stars though since it's not like they need my 4 or 5 star review.

Let me start with the positives. This shop has a great vibe to it, and the family seems passionate about it. The young employees always bust their behinds, running in such a small space so fluently, tackling the long lines. They also have an endless menu board of various food and treats. The prices are reasonable. Now for the reason for two stars. The ice cream is absolutely terrible. I have had three very different items off the menu, over a three year period, desperately trying to figure out the hype and find something good. I'm sorry, but everything was downright awful. The third, and final attempt, I had such high hopes, but despite how great my sundae looked, half of it ended up in the trash. My bf also tossed his. Not only was it tasteless and disappointing (even the brownie and cookie were terrible), 3/3 times I've been there, it upset my stomach. Mind you, I eat ice cream almost every single day, and have been to over 30 shops, and never had a problem. In fact, my bf, myself, and even my dog all had audibly gurgling stomachs soon after consumption. I'm sorry, but the hype is just unreal to me. This ranks 33 of 33 places I've gotten ice cream. I believe the hype is pure nostalgia from people that grew up going there, addicted to the memories and passing tradition on, not because it's actually fantastic. There are reasons to love it, but if you're going to an ice cream shop for the ice cream, you may be greatly disappointed. (If you care about covid, I drove past twice a week, and there was never any social distancing last year/giant crowds all bundled together in line, and not many customers wore masks. It's as if a pandemic wasn't going on)
Still the best ice cream shop in Ohio City! Loving their ramen nites and their new flavors! Black Sesame, Flan, Marzipan and Key Lime Pie!

Dear God, everything on the menu sounds like my personal heaven. Shakes, sundea's, splits, soft server... Give. It. All. To. Me! My friend and I were driving through Homestead past Nancy B's Bakery when she said "You know Page Diary Mart makes an ice cream sundae with her homemade chocolate chip cookies?" No more words needed to be said between us. The decision was silently made that we'd head down Carson Street and there as no stopping us! The only child in me wanted to order the entire chocolate chip cookie sundae for myself. The calorie counting adult in me knew the right decision would be to split it. I mean, let's get real... this thing is monster size! You can easily split it BUT... I could EASILY gobble that whole thing down in one sitting! It was amazing! We watched them heat up the cookies and toss them into the soft serve vanilla ice cream that melted it just enough that it mixed in perfectly with the warm chocolate chip cookie. Add hot fudge and it was ice cream overload to the max. But in the best way possible. Me thinks I'll be stopping here a lot this summer... it cannot be avoided!
I can't say enough about this place! Definitely stop in if your in downtown Vegas...you will not regret it!

They have lots of employees but service is too slow. They need to improve efficiency. Didn't like the way the phone customers we instantly put on hold. "Carlos Bakery, please hold". You ASK your customers to hold, not tell them. Got 2 cannolis - they were alright.

I reviewed several ice cream parlors in the area and heard nothing but great things Scooptopia. The ice cream was amazing and one of the best I've eaten. The owners were very nice. Will definitely come back.

Love me some Amelie's! Great coffee and delicious bites. The salted caramel browine is a staple here, but don't forget to try the other goodies. This place is open 24/7 and is packed 22/7. So be prepared to wait unless you get lucky!

My sister had scoops of coconut and honey pecan. I had junior banana split. The ice cream was a good deal at $3 for two scoops. The pecans were salty in a good way - it made the treat very sweet&salty. My junior banana split was nothing special, I should have gotten ice cream scoops instead really. It didn't even have strawberry ice cream.... I was jealous of my sister!!! I will be back, weather permitting.

I wasn't that happy about the customer service this time. The lady who works there was looking at me from the window the whole time while I was trying to figure out where I can park. So I get down and ask if I can park there. She says no you have to move forward and pay for parking. Even though I was going to be in and out. She was kind of pushy when it came to me ordering. First she says she will help me then she tells me to go to the other lady. They didn't have the French toast donut. We spent 4 dollars on 2 small donuts. They're good but I was not pleased with the service this time. I didn't feel like they were friendly like the people I met before.

Super good! Had to try this place, who doesn't love cupcakes?! Plus the cupcake arm is awesome! I had the vanilla and the black and white (vanilla frosting and chocolate cake) Cupcakes were moist and delicious! They are a decent size so we split them between three of us. They also have mini cupcakes if you don't want a full size! Such a cute shop too!

This is a NEW HOT SPOT to visit. The vibe is AMAZING and the owner is super sweet, just like her baked goods. My first experience here today, was very pleasant. I walked in the front door and was immediately greeted by the owner in one of the baristas. The vibe is very eclectic. Cool wallpaper on the walls and decorative plates are on display. The bathroom has a golden girls theme, how unique. I ordered a vanilla latte iced but they currently only have caramel. The caramel was amazing. Luckily, they also have oat milk. The owner let me snap a few photos around the shop for all yelpers to enjoy. The actual parking lot is small, but there is street parking nearby.Today was their soft opening. This Saturday will be their grand opening, and I can't wait to see what they have in store.
worst cannoli I've ever eaten. The lobster tale creme reminded me of watery and bland.

* M a C a R O n S * + : macarons. .. ;)) raspberry is addictive like candy {actually just the right touch of sweetness, perfectly delectable} esp after cooled in the fridge. .. chocolate could definitely use more cacao but good nonetheless. .. -- : much less pastries compared to its other locations. .. spendy visit as costs add up quick. .. my favorite is still the * ;pistachio * mM. ..

Well, it was 46F when I decided I needed to have ice cream!!!!! Can't let the opportunity pass and went in to get me some espresso oreo!! The shop was practically empty. I wasn't surprised because it was freezing then. The ice cream was really good. I especially like coffee flavored ice cream and this one didn't disappoint. I failed to take a pic of it just because I was hurrying to go back to my hotel. I will definitely come back and get the other coffee flavored ice cream they have.

My first visit today after wanting to go. The place is very cute. The cake looked dense, but was so light and moist--I was pleasantly surprised. I had a lavender piece (small) and a slice of a blueberry cake (large) with hot chocolate. These three items cost close to $20...AND, I must say--the lavender piece, the small one, was enough, small yet filling. So, my eyes were bigger than my stomach, and I brought the blueberry piece home (after trying a small bite in the shop). Because of the prices (and no free coffee refills as someone in our group learned), this place is more of a special treat...or share one slice with a friend.

Things to do while in the long line: update your linked-in profile, check e-mails, check in to yelp of course, and so on until you've exhausted all manner of social networks, you finally arrive at the end of the line and wait as crepe goodness is created. Finally, you end up with crepe in hand nestled on a cardboard box that can enable you to it eat this large thing as if it was an ice cream on a cone. On first bite, the texture of the pancake is warm, soft and nutty, although firm enough to hold the thing together, definitely not paper thin. All worth the wait. Most people head up to the mezzanine to finish off this thing that could fill you up enough to qualitfy as lunch. I'd recommend sharing, but the only downside is that it is very hard to do so unless one had a place to sit. Overall, very delicious and another legendary food item to try in the famed westside market.

Ice cream service has been a bit slow the two times I've been here due to the employees' undivided attention to detail with each group. They make sure each customer is offered ice cream samples and they answer questions to the best of their ability. Be prepared to wait longer than usual for ice cream. Not all flavors are offered everyday. Daily flavors do include vanilla bean, red velvet, cap'n crunch, the flavor of the month, which is bubblegum right now, and a few others. Pistachio and mint chip are available Monday, Wednesday, Friday, and Saturday. Check the flavor schedule online or at the front counter. Red velvet on a red velvet waffle cone is one of my favorites! I once tried a sprinkles sundae with the bottom half of a vanilla milk chocolate cupcake layered first in a cup, topped with a scoop of mint chip, and adorned with the top of the cupcake. Pretty good, but the ice cream scoop could've been bigger. My first encounter with their ice cream and the ATM was at this location last year and I remember anticipating my cupcake sundae. It's quite the experience standing outside the glass door waiting for a friendly employee to let you in, at least it was in the evening so the warm weather wasn't so bad. You will love this place if you're a fan of the cupcakes. Note: They need to fix the ATM-- it doesn't show the start to finish mechanical process of bringing the cupcake behind the pink door on the screen as you wait.

Got the cookie cup with cookies and cream ice cream, red velvet macaron, and the toasted marshmallow! Knew from the first look at the ice cream, it wasn't going to be great and was unfortunately right. It wasn't cookies and cream in the traditional sense and was fairly terrible to be short. The ice cream tasted more creamy and had that freezer burn taste as if it was left out and then had been refroze. We did try the strawberry guava and that was actually great and disappointed we hadn't gone with that. Needless to say, we won't be returning. Not sure how this place got such high yelp reviews but it's probably due to the fad of the cookie cup and it is definitely not worth it.

This place used to be my favorite Donut place to go to. Came here on Sunday only to be disappointed. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e used to be my go to donut and the flavor I'm used to is lacking. The sugar on top also used to cover the whole top of the donut. The other donuts were also mediocre.

Came here and was very impressed. They have a lot of flavors to choose from. I can't have dairy anymore and there were a few options to choose from. I have the two vegan flavors with peanut butter syrup and it was heaven in my mouth. My other half had the banana something and it smelt so good. He said it was so good. Pretty cool that they have a train running from the ceiling. Staff was very friendly and happy.

I get to Vegas about once each year and we always stay downtown. I had seen Donut Bar on Instagram one day when I was getting excited about my trip. I decided to follow them for a while, and after dreaming about their donuts for months, we mad it in. This place does not disappoint! The service was helpful and friendly. Come hungry. The donuts are massive! My hubby got the CrÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e, a yeast donut and I had a cake donut called, a buttermilk it was covered with some type of chocolate ganache. My husband decided to order. Nitro cold brew coffee. Everything was delicious! It's not cheap food at all but, everything was so well made and delicious it's worth the expense. My donut was crispy on the outside, light and cakey on the inside and the chocolate was the exact right amount of sweet. My husband's was just like CrÃ¨me brÃ»lÃ©e. It had s nice crack on the outside and delicious vanilla custard inside. You could even see the Vanilla bean speckles. There is a small sitting area outside with adirondack chairs. This is a must visit and lives up to the Instagram photos. Totally worth the check in.

Obsessed with the cereal milk soft serve with cornflake crunch. Every time I am in Vegas I hit this place up for dessert (sometimes twice or three times during a weekend trip to Vegas). $6 is a kind of pricy for a small soft serve but the flavor is so unique I think it is definitely worth it. They offer samples of the soft serve. Take advantage before forking out the $6. I've tried a few of their cookies... not great. I've never waited more than 15 minutes between standing in line and getting the soft serve. Seating is sometimes an issue but I could easily stand and eat.
Not only are the donuts amazing, but the people have such a great attitude. The flavors are awesome and unique which pairs well with the cold brew they have. I had such a great time there!

Parisian 24 hour bakery and cafe - who woulda thunk?! Easy access to Amelie's with a giant parking and plenty of seating inside the cafe. I simply got a double baked chocolate croissant and chocolate tart. The baked goods were just okay for me. There is a larger menu for sandwiches and salads and drinks which I didn't partake in. The atmosphere is whimsical and super cute. Sideway chandeliers, Paris themed art work decorated a la Alice in Wonderland. Fun place to spend some time in day or night!

This is the second time going to a Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream, I think there is another branch of this shop in Lake Geneva. I have to say this location is crowded and seems always busy. The flavors of ice cream are very good, with unique titles like "Fat Elvis, Bourbon Pecan Pie" I have been pleasantly surprised by most flavors. The service is also decent given that there is no line or organized way of ordering. Everyone just stands at the counter and fights to get the attention of the employees. Once you get someone, they are very friendly and follow through until they complete your order. Another beef with this location is the bathrooms. The men's bathroom was out of order and the women's bathroom was GROSS. They have keys to use the facilities, but after looking at how dirty it was, we opted to just hold it.

I've been to the one in California and was happy to see them come to Vegas. They have great service and great cupcakes. I get the salty caramel and regular vanilla.
