My favorite ever is the salty caramel. I've had many salted caramel cupcakes/cakes and thus one by far is the MOST moist and flavorful. The sweet to salty balance is perfect. The frosting to cupcake ratio is perfect. They just melt in your mouth, they are so soft and delicious. They are open late which is great!

The staff is UH MAZING! The ice cream is tremendous and the cookies are good (a little too salty) but overall my experience was GREAT! Props to the tall staff member with the semi dreads, he seriously has the best customer service E

I've only been here twice so far and it's already one of my favorite local ice cream shops! Doughnuts and ice cream are already a match made in heaven - it's even more amazing with Novel's freshly baked donuts and artisan ice cream flavors! Add a cute little pink house in downtown Phoenix and you're set! Choosing a flavor is honestly so hard for me, and they always have so many to choose from. The honey lavender flavor is amazing, but I'll always have a special place in my heart for chai. Luckily, you can put two flavors in your donut!! Every other flavor I've sampled has been delicious as well. You just really can't go wrong with ice cream and a glazed donut! The only real downside is that the ice cream melts so quickly, especially if you go during the day in the summer! Brandon and his wife are SO sweet and enthusiastic about the business and I'm so, so glad they brought Novel and donut ice cream sandwiches to Phoenix!! Definitely bringing friends here anytime we're craving ice cream (which is always!) Fresh ice cream, delicious donuts, and some amazing people behind the olace, what more could you want?! Support a local business!! Highly, highly recommend this place!!

First off if you never had a cannoli this is the place to go! I probably got one of each dessert! I was not disappointed I knew buddy was something else! Mr. Cake Boss should be happy how this store runs the employees were very customer friendly:)

I went for a soft opening and omg their crepes were so good. I've had the mango-raspberry and mixed berry crepes as well as the avocado kani rice ball. The rice ball isn't worth the price ($2.50) but the crepes are amazing. They come out nice and crispy with a slight sweetness from the yogurt cream. There are also crunchy chocolate rice balls at the bottom of the crepe to make up for the lack of crispiness there which is so nice!! I definitely recommend this place for their crepes. I've yet to eat the other things like the lightbulb drinks and ice cream, so I'll update once I try those.
Very keen to visit the store after watching the show. But was neither impressed by the visual appeal of the desserts nor the taste. Not worth the money. Our local bakeries do a better job.

It smells good as you walk by. The pastries are good, but there are two lines you have to stand in. The first is to place your order, and the other is wait to pick up your order. It would be helpful to have to more cashiers ringing people out.
Super over rated, after 40 minutes in line I was expecting something way better, the food is average and pricey

Creamiest ice cream I've ever had! So delicious and so many flavors! The team of employees is huge, always with a smile and always ready to give you a sample scoop to get an idea of which flavored are the best. I went with coffee and fudge this time and just a junior size scoop was enough for me. The place is large enough to accommodate any size group with upstairs and downstairs seating. My group of five loved it. The line moved so fast even though it started out the door! Perfect for a family treat or to satisfy a late night craving. Some flavors rotate so I'll be returning for sure now that the weather is getting warmer. Although I can't lie I love it in the winter too. The back of the shop looks like a Willy wonka factory where you can get a glimpse into how the ice cream is made. Very cool setting and it always looks so clean. I want some more right now haha
I got the buttercup milkshake and my boyfriend got the Mucha Lucha and both were incredible. Perfect on a hot summer day!
Donuts mmmm. So freaking good. French toast donut and mud pie wonderful. I've brew coffee was great.

What's not to love? Great, classic breads and also some creative ones with local cheeses, seasonal produce, and herbs baked in. Flaky pastries, amazing monkey bread. And they love dogs, too. They put a water bowl outside the door so while you step inside and have to tie your dog up, Fido can have a drink.

Donuts may look and taste good but if you are looking for employment here, look away. The management is horrible & do not pay their staff for the amount of work they do especially the bakers. They have also had incidents where they did not pay their staff at all for all the overtime hours they were forced to work. Ridiculous working environment. And a tip from a fellow past worker, get your donuts in the morning or else they will taste old and stale by the end of the day.

I had heard there was a "hidden" Bouchon, so I was happy to find this one on my last day in Las Vegas, if anything because I was jonesing for some coffee. They have all the baked goods that the other locations have. I was surprised, though, that I did not find the coffee as good as when I went to their main sit-down location two days prior. It tasted a little burnt, maybe? It was certainly drinkable but not as divine. Either way, I would not hesitate to come back to this location, as it was fast and more central to the casino happenings. It doesn't have the same ambiance as the other locations, of course, but it's great if you're on the go.

This is the second time I've been to churn, this time on a first date. He loves strawberry ice cream so we decided on sharing the strawberry shortcake ice cream, and he got some candy-which they also have a lot of-for his two kids at home. I forgot that this place is known for its highly enthusiastic staff who were very amusing and entertaining. Since it was packed at 9 pm on a Saturday night with all outdoor seating taken, we had it in his car, which he was gonna go get it washed and cleaned anyway. The cake itself was a bit hard to cut into pieces with a spoon without two hands holding the container or having it sit on our knees. Would've been better with a fork, but it was good anyway. Great place to bring a date. And good made from scratch ice cream they make in store.

I just realized that I have not reviewed Amelie's - one of my favorite-est bakeries around. Let me just tell you about my love affair with this French bakery. 1) They have salted caramel brownies. Yup, you read it correctly. Absolutely delectable salty/sweet/chocolately goodness. It will certainly give you a toothache and you'll appreciate it. 2) This place is open 24 hours. Holla! 3) The croissants. Oh momma likes. My personal fave is the strawberry cream cheese, but the chocolate will do in a pinch, too. 4) Great coffee. The kind of coffee that you enjoy outside the states,. No Folgers, here, friends. 5) Free WiFi! Woot! 6) The all around lovely atmosphere. Amelie's is just a cozy, breath of fresh air for me. The perfect spot to park with a laptop or stuff my face with umpteen pastries. On a side note, I haven't tried Amelie's lunchy food yet, but I'm looking forward to it. Amelie's makes me (almost) love the French - it's THAT good.

Fun colorful shop. Pretty pricey for what you get, nothing really that amazing. Tried banana which was very good and the raspberry ice cream which was mediocre at best. Tried a couple samples of their most popular nothing really stood out. Definitely not in the top one hundred ice cream places we've been to.

The name says it all. Sinfully good. Sinfully addictive. Sinfully sinful. The chocolate. Let me just say, I'm not a chocoholic. I like chocolate, don't get me wrong, but I wouldn't scarf down whole chocolate bars by the gallon. But mix chocolate with something and I'm game. Mix Sinful Sweets chocolate with anything and I'm really really game! For realz! Every. Single. Thing I've had from here is scrumptious. I've tried a platter of treats at Allegheny Wine Mixer and I stopped in and had a chocolate covered s'more. I want a thousand chocolate s'mores in my life. Stat! I can't wait to try everything they sell. The cake pops, the truffles, the caramels. I want it all!!! But let's get real for a second. The chocolate is amazing! Apparently it's from an old family recipe. The family's got it down, yo! I cannot walk past and NOT go in anymore. Actually, writing this review right now makes me want to get in my car and go there. Too bad it's not 24 hours. Actually, it's probably best for me. But come tomorrow, I'll be there!
I love ice cream. Correction...I love good ice cream. And this stuff is the good stuff. It was well worth our 20 min drive across town. I recommend this place to anyone who likes ice cream.

Long lines. Slow service. Overpriced. Not impressed with pastries taste& presentation. Packaging is cute but unnecessary and time consuming. Do not order a latte unless you want to add extra 10 mins to your already long wait (cashier makes ur coffee). Employees have zero sense of urgency.
I really don't care for this place. The cookies are ok, the Crack Pie is pretty good. The soft ice cream is pretty good, but nothing is great. But it's kind of expensive so I've gotta give it a two.

They have good ice cream but I m really worried about the hygiene there. Even during pandemic they were not wearing mask all the time not to mention they touch money and than they don't put on gloves when they make your ice cream or if they do they don't change them. Also there were some employees in the past that were super rude and try to over charge me. Too bad
Best bakery anywhere. Amanda and Paul are wonderful people. They have a special blend coffee that is the best. Do yourself a favor and go see these folks. You won't regret it

Very racist if your black do not go here ! My number was called and I was skipped numerous time they had genuine courtesy for the Caucasian people but when I was skipped I was told to take another number. I tried to explain the guy cut me off in mid conversation and called the next number.

So yummy! My 2 favorites that I have tried are pumpkin and banana! I'm staying at the Flamingo and this is dangerously close to our room! Came almost every day of our trip because once we discovered them, nothing sounded better! $3.75 each isn't ideal but we are on vacation!
Was in the area and kids wanted some late night treats. Location was kind of hidden with hard to find parking. Ice cream was very good and friendly staffs. Will come back again.

Ok.. it is getting very cold outside. I am wearing a heavy jacket and the queue extends into the parking lot... I think this says it all. Simply the best. Nothing gets you through a tough time of staying at home as a rewarding bucket of Handel's ice cream. More than recommended.

This was my first time here, we are visiting the Cleveland area for a mini vacation. We went on a Saturday and when we passed it for dinner, there was a line out the door and when we came back from dinner, there was still a line out the door. The line moved quickly, they had laminated menus near the door, which helped moved things along. My kids have allergies and were so excited to try their vegan options! They got chocolate and the other one got the salted caramel pecan. I tried a bit of both and the salted caramel pecan was delicious, the chocolate one was on the darker side and great too! I got the roasted pistachio and praline and both were amazing! They had a summer favor of banana cream pie I really wanted to try, but they had run out. The factory was behind the serving line and there was actual seating back towards that area, but we didn't know about it until we were leaving. You can tell they use the best ingredients and I would highly recommend!!!
BEST ice cream parlor - EVER! My favorite flavor is the peanut butter. Today I mixed peanut butter with Trefoil Swirl and it was AWESOME!

Love Amelies! This is a must-see for any of my family or friends that come into town. Not only for the treats but during the fall, they have some of the best soups around. And lately, I've been a sucker for soups. On my first trip, I did the have the famed salty brownie, but I probably had too much excitement built up because I just didn't "get it". But, nonetheless, I encourage you to venture out and try a variety of things on the menu. It's a 24 hour party in your mouth!

Not the best location, but we were happy with the service, selection and taste. My teenager, who eats healthier than me and tries to direct me away from sweets, was even happy with this place. Unlike his recent experience at Baskin Robins, he was happy with the service here and how they explain and suggest menu items and also clearly point to cookie flavor options on the board (he hates big or unclear menus and staff who assume you know options, like at Baskin Robins). He even said he'd like to go back again, which is very rare for him to say about a sweets place.

I had no idea what I was missing out on. This isn't just ice cream, it's flavor. Packed full of flavor! Apparently, after reading the story of the company while waiting for our ice cream, it's much closer to custard than the normal ice cream you get anywhere else. It's very creamy, smooth. I was surprised how busy it was on a Wednesday at 7:30. We had to wait about 20 mins because there was such a long line. But now I know why! It's soooooo good. I got a scoop of the black cherry and the monkey trail. Hard to say which one was better! Definitely coming back.

Without a doubt my favorite coffee shop in Charlotte, even if they do not have the best coffee. The place is huge with plenty of seating be it tables, sofas or awesome air chairs. They also usually have great music playing which earns extra points in my heart. When I go I always get the french press because I have gone a few times in the past where the drip coffee had been cold, so annoying. The pastry selection is overwhelming in a good way because everything seems to be good, at least from what I have had with the macaroons being my favorite. They also serve real food, the soups are great as are the sandwiches. On the weekends they serve quiche which is among some of the best I have eaten.

I looooved the mint chocolate ice cream! Expected a lot coming here because of the reviews on yelp and the fact that it's supposedly one of the best in the US. Usually, when this happens, I tend to find the product not so up to parr and am extremely disappointed. However, this place is definitely an exception! The owner was very accommodating to our group. We wanted to take a small pint home but didn't want the ice cream to melt during an hour drive. She willingly put the pint in an ice filled brown bag and kept it in their freezer while we enjoyed our cups "for here" My favorites were the mint chocolate and strawberry. You can taste the freshness of the ingredients. Next time I will splurge and get one of their other delicacies!

This place without exaggeration is the best! The inside is beautiful, patio adorable, staff friendly and fun, extra little trinkets to shop for are unique and nostalgic, prices cheaper than I am used to, and EVERYTHING is delicious! Aside from ice cream to satisfy your sweet tooth the brownie assortment and lemon bars are incredible.
This place is a landmark in CU. Not too expensive, great variety, comforting ambiance. If you're not a local, you will still get those nostalgic feelings when you stop by here. A+

So many choices of ice cream, scoops are big. The Salted Carmel Cashew Crunch is my go too. The spot is open late so it actually really feels like dessert. Will return again and definitely recommend to my friends.

I just saw this on Cooking Channel The Best Thing I Ever Ate Creamy. Alton Brown ate the Toffee Banofi and loved it. I am keeping this in my wish list collection. I have a folder of wish list when I hear about restaurants or see them on TV. I will do my rating when I try it. Per Alton Brown currently I give it a 5 stars

Stopped by for an afternoon treat and tried the 4 scoop sampler. What a bargain $4 for 4 scoops. This would've set you back $12 at Baskin Robbins. My favorite flavor of the 4 was Salted Caramel Truffle.

After a long - great - night of hanging out (read: drinking), I still somehow managed to wake up at a decent hour before everyone else in the suite. I got myself a regular Coffee & a Chocolate almond croissant. The coffee was run-of-the-mill but it was what I needed after the night I had. The croissant was really flaky & I loved that it was not too sweet. I also got my Honey a box of macarons which he thought was too sweet even though there wasn't a lot of filling.
Disappointed. I was ecstatic to try the pastries here but was let down. Had a 8$ lobster tail and it was mediocre. Wouldn't come back again. I'm sure there are better places to get pasties in Vegas.

There is nothing for satisfying than the experience of eating ice cream on a hot spring day. Certainly I was not disappointed by this place. I tried chocolate and mint chocolate ice cream on a waffle cone. Seriously delicious! A couple things to add: - line was quite long so dress yourself with patience - there is a limited amount of flavors but the traditional ones are there - my cone broke half the way through and as a consequence I made a huge mess (highly recommend getting tons of napkins or getting a cup ;) )
Good vegan selection, and so good. Friendly staff especially the owner.

All I can say is the salted carmel brownie. Everything I've ordered has been good. From the croque monsieur to the chicken salad and my daughter loved the onion soup. They also have a great coffee section.

Defenitly a places to be if you have the munchies :) their ice cream is amazing it's really weird once you hear the flavors but they can give you samples if you ask nice enough --fruity pebbles was great !

So I have never had macaroons before and it might have remained so if not for my friend, Heather, who found out I was in Vegas for the day & asked for these babies. So I made the special pit stop for her and got a couple for me to see what the hype is about. Man, now I know. These suckers are goooood. I'm in Vegas once a month for business so I'll be sure to come by for a treat

We went tonight not expecting much! We were blown away with how good our ice cream was! The staff was extremely friendly and the ice cream tastes like it was made with love! We can't wait to go back and bring our dog with! We're going to spread the word about how amazing the ice cream was!

When we walked in we were greeted by super friendly and excited staff who told us we could try every flavor if we wanted. All their ice cream is homemade and they get their macaroons special made from a local bakery (deliveries come on Thursdays). We decided on a macaroon cookie bowl, which I HIGHLY recommend getting. The ice cream was probably the best I have ever had; you can definitely tell it is homemade. We decided on their Lucky Charm ice cream was crazy good and got the fruity pebble macaroon, which was gooey and perfect in every way. This would have been enough for me to be thrilled, but then they put it over the top with a toasted marshmallow! LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this place.
We got there at around 9:30 am just as they were bringing out freshly baked goods. We've tried several of their pastries and they were all good, we especially love the guava pastry.
Finally, it's near our home. A great place for a late night sweet and coffee. Bravo

The best brownies I have ever had in my entire life are found at Carlo's Bakery! I was in Morrisville, NJ on a business trip and visited Carlo's there. I bought one brownie and took it on the airplane with me. Mid-flight, I decided to eat it. I couldn't believe how perfectly delicious it was -- the right balance of walnuts to the brownie and frosted. I love all of those combinations. The brownie was so good that I wished I had bought a couple more to take home. So -- when I was driving from Southern California to Utah recently, I stopped at the Venetian -- walked all over that place to find Carlo's. Stood in line for half an hour and bought 6 brownies for the rest of my trip. I will never miss the opportunity to stop into Carlo's for a brownie. Next time, I have to try an eclair.

Very cute designs and decors on both the outside and interior of the shop. Unlike the local Sprinkles in Houston, TX that serves only cupcakes, this location in the fabulous Las Vegas serves ice cream as well! WOW this is the very first time I have ever tried the Sprinkles ice cream wheeeeeeeee! The boyfriend and I have sampled the red velvet, coffee and pistachio flavors and settled on sharing a Pistachio ice cream float. All three flavors that we have sampled are rich and delicious but the Pistachio is not too sweet and wins the game! The staff is friendly and helpful.
Very rich and delicious ice cream! Actually the best in clt. Surprisingly the match is not my favorite even though I am not a big fan of match.

A small shop tucked inside The LINQ shopping plaza leading to the High Roller Ferris wheel that I chanced upon when staying next door at the Flamingos. I've been to OG Ghirardelli location in San Francisco as well as the one on Hollywood Blvd in Los Angeles and am a big fan of their sundaes so had to indulge. As the shop is small it seemed pretty crowded even though there weren't too many people inside. Like the location in San Francisco there was a cutie at the door passing out one Ghirardelli chocolate square free to each person who walked in so that was a nice touch. During this visit I got the Warm Brownie Sundae ($9.45; most of their sundaes are priced around $10) and managed to get a high chair facing the outside window. As usual the sundae was excellent. Yes, it was pricy but entirely justified as they provide a healthy portion without compromising on product quality. Yelp check-in get's you a dollar off, so do use that. Surprisingly I've never bought any chocolates from Ghirardelli outlets just sundaes, so apart from the standard Ghirardelli chocolates that one can buy in any supermarket I don't have much to contribute. Goes without saying that this Ghirardelli location also gets two thumbs up from me.

Does not live up to its hype to be honest. I get the cool names etc and the founder is a cool lady. I would love to do a dessert bake off with her. One I would learn and two it would be fun. I am just really under impressed with the offerings here.
Cookie Monster No option for one scoop so slightly overpriced. Ice cream was really great quality and taste

Ughhhh butter pecan ice cream is the best ice cream I have ever eaten. I don't think I've ever ordered butter pecan in my life but one sample spoon bite changed my life. I got a single scoop of it, which was surprisingly big. Halfway through eating it I started getting nauseous because I was already really full from dinner. But I kept eating and now I'm laying in bed dealing with the consequences of my gluttony. Worth. Every. Bite. Butter pecan: salty, sweet, creamy. Lots of pecans. They had a slight popcorn taste which was cool. Salted chocolate chunk cookie: chewy with crispy edges and a really nice salted taste. Also one of the best cookies I've gotten at an ice cream shop. Please go.

Back in the Ninety's? I had a doughnut from here. Went to the store all they had was a jelly doughnut. People were buying dozens of these. Not kidding, & who only sells one kind a doughnut !?! 1-2-3 dozen at a time in fact. As fast as they were being made they were sold. It was good ,like Krispy Creme (smaller- not icing covered). Now they have regular size doughnuts with fancy toppings. Memmh, they're decent but not as good as the hype. These are good don't get my wrong it's the hype over them that's over blown. That's just my opinion so try'em for yourself .

I have always wanted a birthday cake from the famous carlos bakery. We moved her just before my 40th bday. I was so excited, I told my mom and husband that is the cake i wanted, a carlos bakery cake. I showed him a picture from a visit before that I wanted. He got me the beach cake. I was so excited. When he got home, half the top of the decorations had slid off the top and down the side. It looked horrible and my husband felt horrible. But who cares, lets dive into to the yummy cake. Not!! The fondant peeled off the cake rather than through it when cut. Tasted nasty and plain and hard. The cake was barely tasteful to eat. Never saw 1 part of the rave of carlos bakery cakes I have heard about forever. We didn't even want to finish it, we threw half of it away. I would have rather had a $10 cake from the store rather than this nasty little runny cake for $50. I never want a cake or anything from carlos again.

Cupcake from an ATM... what more can I say? I rush we had more of these everywhere. Surprisingly the cupcakes are moist and taste great. I wasn't sure if they would be as good as the ones from the bakery. We got a chocolate cupcake and chocolate chip cookie. Both were fabulous.

We heard about Novel from reviews of the grand avenue festival and decided to give it a try. Wow! I don't ever think I've tasted chocolate ice cream that was as smoooth and rich and creamy as that ever. I really want to try the doughnut "cone".

Classic ice cream flavors and Classic Candies!!! I got the cashew caramel and chocolate sorbet. The sorbet was more like a dark chocolate ice cream. The cashew caramel was new but man it worked. It was sooo good, I highly recommend a scoop of that and top anything you get with toasted marshmallow!

The soft serve here is very tasty. They do the chocolate chip cookie sundaes really well. They also pack in the flavor in the birthday cake soft serve. It is always very busy despite a run down makeshift parking area, not much curb appeal, and being cash only.
Cute shop with amazing donuts! Great tasting Mochas and friendly staff. We'll be back again when we visit Las Vegas.
Had to go for my standbys - red velvet cupcake and pistachio macaron. Unfortunately, although flavorful, both were a little drier this time than at other locations (and at other places).

The world's best bakery! OMG! The pound cake is addictive. The only place in Charlotte I can find pure lavender (without lemon) macaroons. I'm afraid to taste anything other than what I've already had because Lord knows I don't need to find some other dessert to get addicted to. The only constructive criticism I have is they should not have food they are selling to folks be uncovered, in the open air, right at sneeze level in front of other nasty customers.

This review is for the little Bouchon located under the escalator near the theatre. I stopped by here 3 times during the course of my stay at the Venetian. Five stars for the pastries, but one star for the poor service. Pastries: I tried the macaroons in salted caramel, coffee and pistachio and all were excellent. These are large, about 3x the size o a normal macaroon, and we're perfectly gooey in the center and crunchy on the outside. I also trie a croissant, which was flaky and light. Service: poor, sloppy, rude. My latte came out too hot and I could taste the burnt milk (I used to be a barista so I know they steamed it way over 140 degrees). When I asked them to redo it, the guy rolled his eyes, didn't acknowledge me and handed it back to the barista. No apologies that my overly expensive $6 latte tasted shitty. Also, they got my macaroon order wrong and I didn't find out till I flew home. Bouchon is a prestigious brand, and I'm surprised they'd hire bratty little teenagers or people with the service level of a McDonald's to represent their brand. No matter if it's the flagship restaurant or a little express location like this one, Bouchon should ensure consistency and quality in the experience of their brand.

This place is simply delicious. While in Vegas my husband woke up early and was making line at 630 am and there was already a long line. He brought back cheese danishes, macaroons and an oatmeal Cookie. We ate them before we had a chance to take a photo. The oatmeal cookie is simply Devine. It's soft and smells amazing. The macaroons my Children gobbled up but I tasted them and they were delicious as well. They were vanilla and dulce de leche. So good. Now the cheese Danish. It was absolutely delicious and the cream cheese wasn't overly sweet and it was just too good. I wish I had bought more to bring back home to California. The coffee was a bit strong for me but then again my husband forgot to put sugar lol this place is a must when in Vegas.

Once again, The Venetian offers the best of the best! Right next to Black Tap, Bouchon Bakery offers a cozy coffee spot with delicious pastry assortments and breakfasts to take on the go. They had limited seating and were quite busy, so we ordered a breve latte and a few pastries to go. We sat on the steps of The VENETIAN and watched the gondoliers prepare for their day. It was a gorgeous view. The latte was smooth and delicious! The pastries were heavenly. We were leaving back home that day so we got a few extra pastries to take to the folks, and they loved them too! We wish we had more time in Vegas to check out Bouchon Bistro as well, but we will be sure to visit on the next trip. :) I still dream of my bouchon cinnamon roll... get it warmed up. It's sensational!
I love to order donuts in the morning when I don't feel like getting out of bed! Never messes up an order!

Loved it in 2014, purchased $72 worth of treats, loved the lobster tails best so wasted no time getting that this time with my 6 month old at the time I July of 2016. Buddy your lobster tail creme was the first thing other than milk that I let my son taste ever! You can be his Godfatha.

Maybe it was the PreHYPE...but the ice cream was merely OKAY to me. I heard about the 20,30,45 minute waits so my expectations were super high!!! Standing in line at 5:30ish on a Friday was not bad. We started outside about about 10-15 minutes later we were inside and ordering. I will say, the flow of customer service was pretty good. There was alot of employees working(approximately 5-7) and they were all extremely friendly and helpful. I went with the Sun Popped corn, 2 half scoops and afterwards i somewhat regretted it. The ice cream tasted like popcorn and it was good but not to the point like I've heard everyone speaking of. I definitely have a better ice cream spot over this one. The ice cream was good but not to the point of standing in line for more than 10 minutes for. It was nothing special about the flavoring. It was good but no better than any other ice cream spot in Charlotte. The Atlantic Beach Pie ice cream was way better than the popcorn, as well as the Strawberry Buttermilk. The Strawberry Buttermilk was good, minus the sprinkles.

Cute ice cream shop! The ice cream options were typical but yummy. I was most impressed by the service....the guy working was very friendly, on top of everything, and went through a long line very quickly

Simple and quick stop to Bouchon bakery is a great way to start your day in Vegas. Tips: - Quality coffee. Dark roasted and rich! - Pastries are reasonably good. If I were not in the area, I wouldn't travel for it. - Single purchase macarons are larger than usual but we didn't try them. The boxed ones look like normal sized. - They do not accept casino credits. If you are staying at The Palazzo or The Venetian, check it out!

Yes they have Vegan donuts BUT their staff act like they don't know which ones are vegan or like I'm from mars bc I'm vegan. I rather not have anything and drive 25 min back home than to give a place with bad service my hard earned money.

This place is great. We were greeted by the owners who were SO friendly and really knew their stuff! Donut sandwich was amazing and any flavor you try is a win for sure. Will definitely be back, especially bc of the great customer service.

I've been coming here since this place opened, i'm a local and i work on the strip so this place is usually where i go to get my dessert fix. I went in, ordered cannolis and other cookies. The guy helping me didn't move around to grab my stuff this time, so i was wondering when he was going to put my desserts in the box. Then he said to go to the register and they would have my goodies in a bit. I went over to the register and the cashier said the order back to me and it was completely wrong. So i told her my actual order and she looked confused, then she rang my card. Almost 70 bucks. Later the guy comes back with my bag and one box and a horrible attitude and i said thank you and left. I get to my car, open the box and see half the items i ordered are missing. So i walk all the way back, go to the register, talk to the lady that rang me, and she once again looks super confused. She gets who seems to be her supervisor and he brings me my receipt and tells me he isn't going to charge me extra because the computer didn't charge me tax?? Then i told him that i was up there because i was missing half the stuff in my order so he goes and talks to the dude that took my order. They start gathering my stuff and then get handed my stuff with a less than pleasant attitude, he likely thought i was lying even though the first box was already full and i never got my second box for my other stuff. Anyway, I get in my car and its still the WRONG COOKIES!! I was so mad lol...So i just went home. Sorry for the rant everyone but i'm so tired of dealing with their nasty attitudes. They always look so annoyed when people order. So I won't be back, if you're looking for a good place, try Freed's Bakery :)
BEST ICECREAM EVER!!! Last time I was there the owner told me Novels vanilla ice cream won a national aware... and ya know what... I believe it! My go to is the Cookie Monster ice cream. :)

Was soo soo excited to try the anticipated Milk Bar with the opening of Momofuku! After dinner at Momofuku we decided to take some Milk Bar treats back to our house for dessert. Ordered two compost cookies, a blueberry & cream cookie, a cornflake-chocolate-chip-marshmallow cookie, a crack shake, two MilkBar totes (so cute!) & a full crack pie for my work office. Ate the conrnflake-chocolate-chip-marshmallow cookie & compost cookie right away. Both sooo delicious, unique, not too sweet & cooked perfectly. They had a great deal for buying three cookies vs. one and was informed they stay fresh room temp 3-5 days & in the fridge for a whole week. The crack shake was soo sweet but sinfully delicious, and the crack pie was a huge huge hit at my work. I forgot to order the famous cereal milk & crunchy cereal shake! The sweet potato pie soft serve looks so fun! We will be back soon to try more goodies. The cakes looked so good online but none were left (limited availability). Will order one online next event! Would definitely recommend for unique, delicious desserts.
Very good! Fruity Peebles ice cream was great! The worker was a bit over zealous about the three samples rule!

3.5 stars only because of the line. I hate lines. That's one of my gripes with Las Vegas. Lines. Uggh. Line aside, good coffee - better than Starbucks, maybe even CBTL. Outstanding pastries. Sticky buns are almost Jersey-Shore-Sunday-morning terrific. They're that good. Macaroons the size of Texas. Under the escalators adjacent to the Venetian guest elevators. Having been to other Bouchon locations I think of this as Bouchon-on-a-budget.

This bakery is really excellent. I last came with my family for a mid-afternoon snack. We ordered a meat Stromboli and an assortment of desserts- a slice of sorrentina cake, a classic cannoli, and a creme brÃ»lÃ©e. I have always loved the cannolis and creme brÃ»lÃ©e here, so those were fantastic as always! The sorrentina was tasty, but there was a layer in it that I didn't really enjoy, so I probably wouldn't order that again. The stromboli was pretty solid as well. Also, even when this place is super busy, everyone behind the counter is always super nice and helpful, and their ticket system for getting through orders is really efficient. Overall, a great little gem in little Italy that I'll definitely come back to whenever I'm in Cleveland!

Don't skip out on this place for a quick breakfast bite to eat! Super quick and moving lines. And their croissants were so buttery and delicious it reminded me of when I was actually in Italy. Can't say anything about the coffee as I'm kind of a Starbucks junkie but everyone else was ordering it to go along with they're morning pastry. A for sure 5 stars from me.

I walk by here (ironically to get to the gym!) and have been curious to check out the spot. It looks charming from the window. We were down that way for an errand with the pup, so hubs waited with pupster, while I went in. Hubs asked for something of his own or forewarned me that he would eat whatever I got. Noted. The cafe has an old world feel. Think a dark Viennese cafe. I made my way to the counter and saw so many beautiful cakes. Alas, cakes aren't practical for grab and go errand type. The brownies were huge and would fit the size criteria of a shared treat. Then I looked up and saw what I thought were whoopie pies (gobs for Western Pennsylvanians). I read closer and they're cookies with peanut buttercream filling. Done! We sat on the bench outside and shared the tasty treat. The buttercream was light and greatly paired well with the chocolate chip cookie. It was a bit messy to eat, but so good. Pupster enjoyed hanging on the bench, too!
Either here in Las Vegas or Yountville Ca no morning is complete without a shortbread cookie and a Bouchon.

Decided to stop buy while I was in the Scottsdale area. BEST DECISION EVER! They ice cream is delicious and the toasted marshmallow on top makes it's that much more worth it! It's also cheap! 100% recommend trying this place out!

Ok, it must get better over time. (I hope)! Grand opening, and the place wasn't too packed. Got my red velvet, chai latte, lemon meringue, triple cinnamon, and vanilla. All were way too dry, and lacked flavor with the exception of the lemon. But still way to dry! They must've baked way too many and had them sit out way too long. That's what I get for going to their grand opening. I just pray this isn't what to expect in the future, as I will just stick to their ice cream.

In the area from out of town and came in for a visit given the great advice of my fellow Yelp friends. The great reviews are so right. The location is on a corner and looks a bit dated on the outside - don't let this keep you away. They are cash only - so make sure you're prepared. Approx. $11 for a dozen which is a great deal for fresh homemade donuts. We got a dozen of assorted varieties. The glazed chocolate cake were great with a little crisp on the outside. The chocolate frosted cake donuts are super flavorful and love the thick chocolate coating and the wonderful piled high buttercream. The maple bacon was a wonderful mix of salty and sweet with fresh bacon bits and maple frosting on a yeast donut. The yeast donuts are not your ordinary yeast donuts - they are glazed perfect with almost a creamy mouth feel - stick in the microwave for 10 seconds - you will thank me later. German Chocolate donut is a glazed chocolate cake with pecan/coconut frosting and the wonderful piled high chocolate buttercream. My only concern is that there are no labels on any of the donuts which is fine for locals who may visit more often - but makes it difficult to decide without feeling really annoying to the staff and the line behind you. This shouldn't deter you at all though - The donuts are an absolute must try!
Very upset that they didn't let's us know ahead of Time that they where out of cannoli !

A-freaking-mazing!!!! Vegan options galore. I can not recommend this bakery enough. Beautiful to the eye and oh so delicious. The whole family craves the offerings here. Adorable inside. Visit as soon as humanly possible, you will not be disappointed.

It was my first time going and it was amazing! The ice cream and drinks were the BEST you will not be disappointed! They gave me and my hubby some cards to stamp for the next time we go so we can eventually get a free one and we will definitely be going back again and again!

You walk up to the door and place your order. There was a great variety of flavors and different types of ice cream sandwiches. It was fall so if you like pumpkin there were about five different types of pumpkin flavors. I had a scoop of the salted caramel truffle and a scoop of the graham cracker ice creams. They put it in a cup but will top it with a cone if you want. You can then take your goody out to the boardwalk and sit outside and watch the ducks. It was great!

Mitchell's is the place to be whether it is the winter or summer! This ice cream chain in Cleveland is so special. It's homemade batches are filled with flavors you'll cherish long after they melt in your mouth. The cost is a little high, but not terrible considering all the ingredients are fresh and most local! Support this gem and enjoy some ice cream :)

Yummy! I had the Jobot Coffee ice cream and hubby had the salted caramel. He said it wasn't the most delicious waffle cone he'd ever had but it was still good. The ice cream is creamy with good flavor-worth the cost!
They have really tasty, rich, cakes. Great decor. Very chill, laid back atmosphere. Glad that it's open late. Would definitely recommend for a late night dessert.

I have been following this place on Instagram since before they opened and finallyyyyyyy got across town to try it out! I got the oatmeal pies and Oreo truffle cookie and let me just say it was the best cookie I've ever had in my life. No exaggeration! It taste exactly how the pictures look lol only minor minor complaint is that, it was obvious I had never been there and the cashier wasn't any help at all I asked was there a menu (I was aware that they don't always have the same desserts) and the cashier stated there wasn't one because it changes daily.. then I asked for prices and she told me between $2-$4 then kinda walked away. just would've like to had known details on what were in the treats and specific prices. I would've bought more if she was a tad bit more attentive. The treats made up for it!!!!
When they didn't have something my daughter could have they gave us directions to a place that did. I personally love the ice cream here, and my daughter wishes she could as well. haha
The fudge is amazing !!!! Definitely get that if you go. Good price cute place! I come here a lot

Mason's Creamery is amazing. Awesome place. I try to go here if I am randomly in the mood for ice cream. This time I had a chance to try the French Toast flavor with a scoop of strawberry and it was absolutely delightful! I amazed by how smooth the French Toast ice cream was. Very nice. Very nice, indeed.

So this place is bomb. I've always wanted to go when I heard of it so I'm glad a went. I ordered the crack pie latte and the cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie. Both were recommended by the cashier I was with and it was the best idea. The latte was coffee but just had great flavors brown sugar and caramel which is what I like when the coffee doesn't taste like coffee haha. The cookie I had it like 4 days later. Warmed it up, and it was still really good. The cornflake was salty with the sweet chocolate chip was amazing I love that flavor combo. So the people working are really nice. I've never been there before and the cashier answered a lot of my questions. First I thought their cereal latte was like pick you out the cereal milk, but it's just the cornflake milk is the cereal part and then regular latte. So I'm glad I got the crack pie latte. Also she told me that their best selling is the compost cookie the recommended the other one and again I was so pleased. They were really patient with me and I liked it. Had to wait a bit for the coffee but it was still in good time. So this place is inside the cosmo hotel. On the same floor as marquee's front door. Would I come here again? There is one in LA so I will probably visit that one more often but yes I love the milk bar

Awesome sweets! I have always liked their sign out front (Skinny People Are Easier To Kidnap). I purchased both cake pops and a cup cakes. The cupcake was amazing. Salted Caramel Chocolate cupcake was delicious. The cake was moist and the icing was just the right contrast of salty and sweet.

Very cute cafe and who knew, you can have a shop with a varied selection focused on one flavor?! The shop is brightly lit on the inside and had cute little tables inside and out for dining in. The menu had so many options from matcha tea, to tea lattes, matcha latte floats, soft serve ice cream, pastries, etc. We ordered a matcha latte float with black sesame soft serve and a matcha lemonade float with matcha soft serve. The matcha flavors were very distinct, not weak at all. I really enjoyed my black sesame soft serve ice cream, it was creamy and nutty, surprisingly wonderful! COVID precautions: Staff wore face coverings and requires patrons as well. Hand sanitizer was provided as well. We came during the slow hours of evening so I'm unsure about socially distancing precautions. They have little signs on their tables that when they're busy, you have a certain time limit dining in until a staff asks you to leave for them to disinfect, I assume to get people in and out the establishment and prevent longtime exposure. The inside of the shop is cute, the decor cute enough for an IG photo op. I will be back to try more matcha options the next time I'm in Charlotte!
I wrote a review for Mary Coyle's in the past, but it was removed. I didn't feel like it was a special place and the staff wasn't that friendly in my experience.

I've been going to this little ice cream shop since I was in high school and it has been one of my favorite spots to go visit with my friends. I'm never disappointed with any of their ice cream selections they offer and the staff is fantastic! I always recommend their strawberry ice cream, it's legitimately the best I've ever had.

I stumbled upon Momofuku & Milk Bar side-by-side at the Cosmo & thought I'd hit my head & woken up on the other coast. This is the furthest west I've ever seen these New York staples. For old times sake & because I love giving into unhealthy habits, I ordered a slice of Crack Pie. Served cold, the tiny, flat triangle flavored of butterscotch (& other sweet flavors I can't pinpoint) packs a sweet wallop for its size. If you can stomach parting with $7 for a few bites of dessert, Milk Bar's Crack Pie is a pretty good one to throw your money at.

Epic cannoli- the filling has a creme fraiche consistency, isn't overly sweet, and the texture is perfectly contrasted with the flaky pastry casing. The stromboli, pizza, and prepared foods here are also excellent. Presti's is one of the best places in Cleveland, and the reason the Little Italy in this city is among the best and most authentic Italian Villages in the country.

Thank you for coming to CLT! I moved here from Columbus, OH, 3 years ago and Jeni's is one of the absolute favorite things I've missed the most! So glad to have Goat Cheese and Red Cherries back in my life!

OhhhhhEmmmmGeeee!!! I totally heart this place!!!! My friends and I came here for the very first time and...it's just...so...heavenly! I just had to try a scoop of the pineapple sorbet and coconut sorbet. It was pleasant. After my friends and I ate our 2 scoops we discovered that this place was actually featured on Best Thing I Ever Ate. First off, vanilla ice cream just sounds so plain and simple. Second, I am so-not into salted sweet stuff (salted butter caramel just doesn't sound pleasing to my taste buds). But we went ahead and ordered the Toffee Banofi Sundae which is consisted of double scoop vanilla bean with fresh bananas, toffee butter crunch, salted butter caramel and whipped cream (Alton Brown's recommendation - Food Network). You've got to put each little pieces of heaven in each spoon and savor the flavor! The combination of all these goodness is so perfectly put together. It's going to be hard to imagine eating ice cream else where. This place totally rocks! I have to also admit that sometime it may seem that Yelpers might bring too much of a hype on some places, but you really never know unless you try. Even though some recommendations don't necessarily sound pleasing to your senses, you should have an open taste bud to try new things because you can discover something quite heavenly (it may shock you). Try this place if you haven't...it's seriously delicious!!!

This is an amazing bakery and late night dessert spot. We were visiting Pittsburgh from Orlando for a wedding and I found Butterwood via Yelp. It is located in Lawrenceville and has an adjacent public parking lot. The dessert case was full of great looking cakes, pies and bar cookies. We had the Chocolate Beet Fig Cake and the Blood Orange Honey Cream Cake. The genoise cake layers were super moist and the creams and soaks were flavorful and on point. Open sides cakes like these can sometime be dry. These were perfect. The cake styling reminds me of Christina Tosi of Momofuko Milk Bar. This is a beautiful space with a Victorian decor, people coming for coffee and tea with leashes dogs. I definitely will visit again if I am back in Pittsburgh.

Presti's. We've been coming here for for over 25 years. Kathy has been coming here even longer than that (I think add at least another 20 years, shh). I think they do a very good job with lunch items and their prices are reasonable. Coffee is decent and the baked goods are worth the calories and the price point is fair. I have other places in the area that I like more for baked goods, deli food, and coffee. However, no one has a combination of quality in all three off those categories, plus price, and pretty fast friendly service. And the clincher for Presti's is atmosphere. There's an ambiance I can only describe as a little worn, a little chic, a little hint of Cleveland attitude (in a good "it is what it is" kind of way), along with a dash of theatre. Or maybe that's the espresso kickin' in.
Spiced pear sorbet is amazing! You'd never guess it's dairy free: rich and creamy! We're happy to find this gem on the first night of our Phoenix trip, we'll be back!

We kept passing by Jeni's when in the area and wanted to give them a try, and finally did one evening after a meal at Barcelona. If you go during prime time, there will be a line, but it moves pretty fast. Jeni's has a simple menu, with one scoop, two half scoops, or three half scoops. They don't offer sundaes, hence the reason why the line moves pretty fast. A butter waffle cone or bowl is $1.25 extra. GET ONE OF THESE. They have a lot of ice cream flavors, some more unique than others, and they even have few dairy-free varieties. I got the "standard" in a waffle bowl with two half scoops of coffee with cream and sugar, and darkest chocolate. The half scoops were more like full scoops, in my opinion. Both were good, but the chocolate somewhat edged out the coffee. But oh my, the waffle bowl was the best I've ever had. They really do put butter in it, and you can taste the difference. My husband had the triple with three half scoops of milkiest milk chocolate, salted caramel, and dark chocolate truffle. Again, they were all good, but the milkiest chocolate was his favorite. We'll definitely return!

Sooooo many different flavors to choose from. Did the standard two half scoops and it felt like two full scoops of ice cream !!! Such a wonderful and knowledgeable staff going through the details of every ice cream. I love they reuse the sample spoons. Save the planet ya know.

We bought a variety of desserts to share & taste. Everything was delicious! A couple favorites were the lobster tails filled with Irish cream & the rainbow cake. The chocolate covered cannoli was kinda heavy on the chocolate & if we were to order one again we would buy a plain one, not dipped. Just a personal preference, not that it was bad it was just a lot of chocolate overwhelming the cannoli flavor for us. It's not a cheap dessert place but their desserts are to die for & we will return to Carlos' on a future trip to Vegas for a decadent treat. It would be nice if they had any kind of seating available. The few chairs we saw were roped off not to be used. After walking a ton in Vegas it would be nice to be able to sit somewhere & enjoy these desserts, not just have to take them to go. If they had some kind of seating to sit & enjoy the desserts I would give this place a full 5 star rating.

Very disappointing. The "Fig, Bacon and Brie Tartine" was made with fig jam - that's not the same as figs. Our quiche was undercooked. The coffee was luke warm and bitter. We asked for hot coffee and the server quipped, "It was made 20 minutes ago." We tried to improve it with cream and the server was defensive and rude about it. We dumped the lousy brew and went to Starbucks - not my favorite place but their coffee was hot, they're consistent in their product offering and Starbucks cares about their customers. There are plenty of other places that appreciate our dining dollars.

The food and coffee are always delish. Some favorites .... Cafe Marcotter, Chicken Salad Sandwich, Any of the Soups, and all of the Pastries. The negative aspect is the counter service and checkout. This is a wildly popular place, and when the line snakes around into other rooms, it makes sense to have more than one or two people working the line. We've been there multiple times where this is the case, and it is very frustrating. But we keep going back, so that should speak to the quality of the food. :)
We stopped here for the first time today. I purchased 3 cannoli and 3 coffees. It was $20. That's sort of steep. I'm not sure I will be back.
Wow amazing ice cream get the cookie cup worth every dollar... will definately come back delish............................ .. .. . ..
Very instagram-able interior, and the menu is easy to understand. I looove cereal but this takes it to a whole new level! My favorite is the Cap'n Crunch milkshake.

So i called 24 hrs before i realized i needed an emergency cake due to the fact that the cake i had order was not gonna be delivered what i had asked for so i needed a cake as soon as possible i called on a Saturday at 730 am and i was able to talk to elizabeth such nice girl completely caring then i had the pleasure to speak to Joanna the supervisor such nice lady was able to get the custom cake order inn for me for that same day at 2 pm this place is amazing super understanding and caring i don't know any other bakery that would do that for you in such short notice u guys are awesome thank youuuu so muchhhhh btw my cake was only 50 bucks n i got exactly what i wanted sooooooo happy u made my daughters bday that much better and the kids demolished the cake soooo bomb
This is my go to spot when I stay at The Venetian Resort. Coffee and Bakery is amazing highly recommended.

If you are looking for a place with good customer service or reasonable prices, this is NOT it. I waited more than 10 mins for a yogurt cup while 4 employees stood behind the counter chatting in the nearly empty shop. When the yogurt finally came, it was 4oz for $4.50. Tasted good, but definitely not worth the cost, especially considering the wait. I keep wanting to like this place...

Been dying to try this place. Def worth the hype! Thank you Brandon for not letting me bust my head over picking just one topping. Will definitely put this place down on my calendar for my next cheat meal

I loooovvee this place. I'm so glad they finally made it to Las Vegas! The team is still trying to figure out their groove so the lines are a little long but they have the same long lines in California, too so I'm used to it. They do have a quick check out station at the entrance, so maybe use that. My favourites are the egg custard, taro marble, fruit tart, and the berry tales. Honestly, anything you choose here is going to be scrumptious. If you need a jolt to wake up, I highly recommend the sea salt Carmel coffee. It is beyond words, and cheaper than Starbucks!

It was an awfully long line for something that was good, but not amazing. I was really expecting something spectacular with how busy this place is all of the time. We tried 4-5 different items and again good, but not worth a return visit for me. Really long lines, no parking.
Birthday cake truffles!!! Delicious!!!!! So soft, sweet and perfect bite size. I want to try the crack Pie next....can't wait to go back!

If you love ice cream, you'll love Handel's. They have an array for flavors that are all homemade! They are a take out only restaurant. The line is always so long but so worth the wait. We always get the sampler which's includes 4 scoops for $5! So far, their banana foster is my all time fave but I've also never had anything I didn't like there.

Today I took my boyfriend to Jarling's because he'd never been. It took about 15 minutes in line before we got to order. I am used to waiting there so that wasn't a problem. Still tastes delicious as always and I still haven't tried the cold fudge. I always go with 2 dips in a cone. My boyfriend had a brownie snowstorm. We enjoyed our dessert and will be back. ;)

yum!! Affordable at $3 a scope! I had the salted butter caramel and also tried the crunch ice cream that had toffee so good! I will be back! **BEST ICE CREAM in ARIZONA hands down!! so good I love one of kind family owned shops :) they also sell pints at your local wholefoods. The place is near scottsdale shea hospital and behind bank of america. saw it on yahoo news and I had to try it and I totally agree with what the editor wrote. travel.yahoo.com/ideas/a¦ 5. Sweet Republic Scottsdale, Ariz. Favorite Flavor: Salted Butter Caramel (Cost: $2.95) Since 2008, Sweet Republic owners Jan Wichayanuparp and Helen Yung have attracted ice cream connoisseurs with their homemade batches. The milk and creams used are provided by local dairy farms, while tasty toppings, including marshmallows, brownies, and waffles, are all made by hand. And that's not all: From its birchwood ice cream sticks to its recycled glass bottles, this shop prides itself on its eco-friendliness. To indulge your taste buds with an extra burst of flavor, try the zesty Honey Blue Cheese or decadent Mayan Chocolate flavors. You'll find Sweet Republic headquartered on Scottsdale's Shea Boulevard. Sweet Republic products are also sold at select grocery stores throughout the state.

Best spot in AZ for a cold treat! I reside in Chandler and will make it a point to drive to scottsdale when dessert is desired. Staff and crew are amazing and they always stay current with updated flavors, macaroons, and toppings! Family friendly but a fun night out on the town with an edge inspired! Thanks for fixing my sweet tooth at times Fatty Daddy's! I will continue stopping by!!

Some of the best ice cream we've ever had nationwide and at prices that we hadn't seen in years! After a trip to the West Side Market, my wife and I swung by Mitchell's on a warm summer Saturday afternoon at 12pm, which seemed like the perfect timing. The ice cream shop had just opened 30 minutes prior and there weren't many people inside, so we took our time exploring the menu and flavors. From the moment people spot Mitchell's you can tell it's just different. For one, the outside looks like the entrance to a movie theater. Once customers make their way in, they're greeted by a huge glass window straight ahead where you can see into their ice cream making facility. However, what customers really need to focus on is the writing and menu on the glass window, which is not only written in a light white, but incredibly hard to see. I won't dock them any stars for that snafu, but maybe making it a bit darker would have helped, however I get that they want to showcase the factory behind the glass. Anyway, we surveyed the flavors at the ordering counter and the options. We tend to make the mistake of over-ordering, but also what to try as much as we can, so what better option than the Taster's Duo, which is supposed to be a single scoop of 2 different flavors. After being enlightened by the very helpful employees there about their most popular and favorite flavors, my wife ordered the Strawberry Rhubard and Fresh Peach on a sugar cone, while I ordered the Toasted Pistachio and Caramel Fudge Brownie, with the latter supposedly being their most in demand flavor. The verdict? EXCELLENT. The ice cream wasn't too soft and had very good texture to it. The flavors were really good and we loved each and every bite. The Strawberry Rhubard and Fresh Peach were fruity, but savory. The Toasted Pistachio and Caramel Fudge Brownie were sweet, but not overpowering. The Caramel Fudge Brownie had large chunks of brownie inside of the ice cream, which I loved. Overall, the ice cream was delicious and perfect. What was even better was how generous the scoops were. We ordered the Taster's Duo, which was supposed to be 2 half scoops, but when we received our cones, the ice cream was overloaded. It looked like they had given us 2 gigantic single scoops of each flavor we ordered. In addition, the Taster's Duo was just $3.95, which is unheard of these days for ice cream from a shop. I guess we felt we really got our money's worth too because we basically got 2 scoops instead of one. We loved the price point here, but we loved the flavors, serving size and delicious ice cream even more.

Saw the reviews of this place on Yelp so decided to try it. It is well deserved 4-5 star. The ice cream was terrific and well worth going to. If you are planning to go to Westside Market this place is right up street. Parking is only negative - on street only.

**Vegan Friendly** Who doesn't love local homemade ice cream?! This specific location has a viewing side of the factory, and it's a great highlight for your inner child, or children! The line was out the door on a Saturday afternoon, and was worth every single penny. They have a variety of ice cream, sorbet, and yogurt. They also have seasonal flavors, and a handful of vegan options! You truly cannot go wrong with any flavor. They also have to-go pints, and when you purchase a pint, you get free cones to take with you!

Stopped in here a couple of days ago. I'm glad I was here mid-afternoon because the parking looks tough during the busy times. I had the butter pecan and strawberry flavors. Butter pecan was delicious. Rich, smooth and creamy. Not as wild about the strawberry. Too sweet for my taste. I'll keep this place in mind when I'm in the area and looking for some good ice cream.
Definitely pass by here when you get a chance. Do not pass this place. The ice cream was delicious. My kids who are picky eaters really enjoyed their ice cream.

Simple, honest ice-cream. Had the butter pecan with salted caramel. Not too sweet, not insecure in its culinary proximity to frozen yoghurt, and sensibly portioned. Like the outdoor patio seating; wish it was set up less as a quick stop and go and more as a place you can get a cup of ice-cream with a friend and chat for a while.
Just had the best boozy milkshake ever. Bought a cookie too, but just a fun and tasty stop if you are at the Cosmopolitan!

Cute little spot with a great atmosphere. I got the Cookie Monster dough melt. The ice cream was amazing and the donut was amazing. But they're amazing separate if that makes sense. Together in a sandwich just didn't taste right. So I recommend just getting one or the other. Very good ice cream flavors. Check this place out!

When I found out Las Vegas was home to a new Sprinkles store WITH ice cream I HAD to try it! But sadly I wasn't super impressed. First, let's start with the store itself. It is in a great location, The LinQ, a new area between the Flamingo and The Quad. This place has stores, restaurants, live music, a bowling alley (The Brooklyn Bowl) and the new ferris wheel (The High Roller), having a late night dessert place here is perfect (even though it's competing with Ghirardelli). But due to its location, it can get really crowded at night and especially during the weekends (Friday and Saturday nights). A friend and I went on a Thursday night (after our ride on The High Roller) thinking it would be relatively empty due to the late time and day of the week, but boy were we wrong! It was 11:00pm (place closes at midnight) and the line was redic (at least 20+ people in line)! Then I realized it was the Thursday before Good Friday (not Sprinkles fault), so I kinda forgave the long line. We were given a menu while waiting in line. The problem is, they don't have the weekly menu of the cupcakes available, just the ice cream and cookie menu (kinda Sprinkles fault). How the heck am I supposed to know what cupcake I want for my cupcake sundae?!? So once we're finally able to order I ask the young gentleman what cupcakes they have... he has to yell across half the store what cupcakes they still have, I could barely hear him because of the surrounding noise, so I just chose a common cupcake (red velvet). Then I told him I wanted the coffee almond ice cream, he then said they were all out... LAME (TOTALLY Sprinkles fault)! To make things go faster I just said give me whatever you have, which ended up being vanilla... BORING! My friend wanted a cookie sandwich and they didn't have her flavor of ice cream either... I guess that's what we get for going an hour before closing. Though my friend and I didn't get what we originally ordered, I have to say I was content with the cupcake sundae. Though the cupcake had a little too much frosting for me, the combination was good and there was lots of vanilla flavor. I think though I would prefer if I shared one next time because it is a little too rich for my liking. So pretty much I went to Sprinkles excited to try their ice cream flavors and left pretty bummed that I just got vanilla, but I say gotta try everything at least once! Here are the things I have learned from visiting here: 1) Go on weekdays (not ones that come before holidays). 2) Go earlier than an hour before closing (or they won't have any flavors you want). 3) They need to come up with a better system to serve their ice cream (store is backwards, workers have to glance across the room to see what cupcakes they have left. If they switched it around customers would be able to at least see what cupcakes they still have available). 4) Must add what cupcakes are available on a given day for their ice cream menu.

I CAN GET CORN COOKIES ON THIS SIDE OF THE COUNTRY NOW!! Milk Bar, the famed bakery by the makers of Momofuku used to only be on the eastern side of the continent (NYC, DC, and Toronto) but now they have a location in Vegas. And inside the Cosmo, which is the perfect casino/hotel for it - a trendy match! Much like the one in the East Village, it's essentially a booth and offers the same stuff, cereal milk soft serve, crack pie, and COOKIES! After a weekend of overeating and overindulging, I sadly did not have room for soft serve (even though it was hot enough to have some). I ended up buying my favorite cookies to go - CORN COOKIE and the compost cookie. They have baskets full of them on the counter. Next time, I will come here first and get soft serve. And maybe some pie. And more cookies.

I would pay premium for homemade ice-cream any day. The salted butter caramel was to die for. It was milky but not too sweet. Sometimes I go to popular ice cream chains and feel like I need to chug two glasses of water after I am done eating a cup. Not here. It's the perfect after taste.

I always love coming to Jeni's but you just have to come here during non peak times if you don't wanna wait in line for 30 mins. They also ran out of waffle cones last night but I've been here many other times and that's never happened. The workers are super friendly, let you try flavors without feeling too rushed and it's always some bomb ass ice cream. I will probably forever be a two scoops fan but that won't take away that the ice cream here is delicious and their waffle cones are legit
Best shaved shaved ice in the valley that I have found thus far. Lots of flavors to choose from and they also have ice cream and other treats.

I don't get the hype. Came in after walking by a few other places Bc people rave about this ice cream. My gf had a chocolate cone and I had the berry crumble something or other. She didn't even finish hers, and mine was good but not great...And $13 for 2 single scoops of ice cream? Thanks, but no.

Please go here and taste some of the most creamy delicious soft serve ever. After a long hot day of work you deserve a reward a decadence. The medium is ginormous and only in the 3.50 range. It was so good I almost went back for another. Almost.

Sooo, I love icecream. But dripps has put two of my most favorite things together so I can enjoy cereal and soft serve! So creamy and crunchy! Glad they brought this icecream that is a must try! Friendly knowledgeable staff! Definitely worth the wait! Have already gone 3 times in a week!
The ice cream was sooooo good! Will definitely be back and this time will get something smaller. The portions are huge.
Great ice-cream at a reasonable price. I love their chocolate banana milkshake.

First time here over this past weekend. Surprised at how busy it was in the middle of a Saturday afternoon - line was at least a dozen people deep. Moved quickly but felt rushed to make decisions in order not to hold up those behind us. Menu boards jammed, difficult to read. Display cases attractive. Enjoyed the salted caramel brownie (very nice but very small), croissant (not as fluffy as expected, perhaps to serve as a sandwich roll), almond cake (lovely) and coconut macaroon (best of the bunch). The salted caramel apple cider was over the top sweet and I wouldn't do it again. The french press espresso was so good it may have converted the non-coffee drinker in our group. Parking is convenient in the lot out front (nice plus is NoDa). Looking forward to the Carmel Commons location opening as that is a lot closer for me.

I love how they immediately welcome you as you walk in. To my surprise, you have the option of a cereal bowl or an infused cereal milkshake. I went with the Mucha Lucha {cinnamon toast crunch cereal, whipped cream topped with churro cereal & buttery cinnamon roll sprinkle with almond milk}. There are three milk options if I remember correctly: whole, skim, almond. I really didn't know what to expect but after my first sip "I said hmmmm this is good!" So I can only imagine the other options are just as great. My only con is that it's not really set up as a bar with ample seating. There are about 4 stools inside and then seating immediately outside. So just don't go in with the impression of a wide open space. Overall, a nice addition to the CLT area. Welcome to the community Day & Night!!!

Was so excited to see this place for the first time ! Easy access coming from the Grande Shoppes at the Venetian/Palazzo. Also, thought this place was bigger before seeing it, so it's so easy to say the lines were "out the door". I love baked goods, so rating goes toward the edibles. I honestly over hyped myself for this place.

So, first things first... I like coffee-flavored coffee. So, that's what I drink. I've only had the drip coffee and pastries, but their drip is out of this world! I am certain the rest of their coffee drinks are just as good. The pastries are the rockstar of the show. I strongly recommend the pop tarts. They decadent AF and incredibly delicious! I work literally 10 steps from here, so it quickly became a daily stop. Not much else to say. If you've not been, you're totally missing out on this little gem.

I read about the cupcake ATM online and had to check it out. Sooo cool! I put in my credit card; got a cupcake ... Genius! Not only was this fun but it's available 24/7 and the cupcake (salted caramel) was superb. Love this idea.
Was so excited to see that they had Taiwanese sausages here! We also got the rolled ice cream and light bulb drinks. Both fun and delicious!
It's clean and beautiful atmosphere. Pastries are scrumptious and deliciously fresh and yummy.
Hands down the best scotcharoo cookie I've ever had. The German chocolate cupcake was delicious. I will definitely will be back. They are open 7 days a week with great hours.

I hardly ever splurge on dessert or buy cupcakes, but we saved room for dessert after dinner to stop by Sprinkles. We were so disappointed when both of our cupcakes were on the stale side, like they had been sitting out too long. I had the pumkpin one and it was sadly bland. My husband had the black and white, which was not much better. The service was great and everyone was very friendly, I just wish we would have visited when some of the cupcakes were fresh out of the oven.
Cereal milk shake! I was surprised that it actually tasted like real cereal milk ! Delicious! Must try

After dinner we were looking for something to satisfy that sweet craving ordered- milk bar pie, cereal milk soft serve, and the compost cookie. The cereal milk soft serve has got to be my favorite, the taste brings you back to being young and waking up early on Saturday mornings for cartoons and cereal. The milk bar pie was also delicious, buttery and super rich. We couldn't finish this one because of it. The compost cookie was great, a wonderful mix of salty and sweet. Taking one bite ultimately leads you to wanting another. Until "poof!" It's all gone. If only able to get one I would recommend the cereal milk soft serve!
There's nothing better than a hot cup of coffee with some good ole 5 degree burns on the hand. Coffee tastes great but would prefer it if the lids actually fit the cups.

This place is either heaven or hell for chocoholics. Great ice cream. Awesome chocolate squares and quite possibly the best sipping chocolate anywhere. I liked so much that I ordered another one for indulgence. It was cold in LV so the sipping chocolate served another purpose, other then to get me high. It's possible!! The staff is friendly and we were given a free sample of their latest mini squares, chocolate and caramel. OMG. All this talk of chocolate is getting me aroused.... For more chocolate! Get your mind outta the gutter.

I think this was the best tasting ice cream I've ever had. The 2 scoop is really 4 scoops, the almonds, the fudge the flavor of it all was incredible. Went here by accident looking for late night desert. Creamy decadent ice cream! Yum!
Best ice cream in the Valley! Must visit. The cookie cups are to die for!! Give it a try!

COME TO THIS PLACE. Eat some ice cream and before you're done, your life will be forever better.* You'll also have an opportunity to meet some really great people who put their heart into this heaven...and it shows! *Not an exaggeration

This place is by far the best ! Their ice cream is insane! The Brown Butter Pecan is my fave along with the Lavender My boyfriend and I moved into the area and we will walk here for a delicious treat!

Cute store, variety of flavors, cute concept with the Chinese to-go boxes & fortune cookie on top. But poor customer service! The chubby white girl with the septum piercing was really rude. She didn't smile at us, barely responded to our questions, and just looked really bored. The cashier was unhelpful, and walked away when more people behind us came. And finally, the ice cream wasn't that good (birthday cake & Nutella) & melted once she scooped it onto the box container.

If you looking to have some delicious baked goods than look no further ! When you walk in there is a place to grab a tray and tongs and then you go to work. They carry a variety of breads from sweet to savory. They range in price from $1-3 a piece. We got a variety of different breads such as chocolate cookie bread and salted butter bread. Some of the breads have sweet fillings and some are just savory delightful plain breads. This place was very packed when we came but, the line moves very fast. Once you get about half way through the line there is someone that will individually bag your breads for you. They also sell a variety of cheesecakes, cakes and drinks. Each case of bread has a label saying what it is and if it contains eggs or milk. We bought about 7 different breads and 1 mini souffle cheesecake and the total was about $20. This place has so many different varieties of breads,sweets and drinks. This place is a must try when in Las Vegas!!
People with Sweet tooth , be careful! ;) My favorites are breakfast sandwich, macaroons, coffee, and their herbal tea. Best part is about sitting there working or reading.

Many Gluten free, vegan options for pastries. The succulent cupcake was very pretty but mild in flavor - which would be good with tea. They also have a very interesting Coffee menu with new combos of coffee I've never heard of.

I came in for a cannoli but when I saw all of the choices, I opted for raspberry mousse. So light and airy. I also bought an iced coffee. It's a busy place. Make sure you grab a number as soon as you walk in and start making your decision so you can keep things moving.
Tried going to melt first, but they were closed. Their loss, our gain. Sweet young lady at counter was amazing and had great produxt knowledge. The waffle knope was delicious!

Cute little ice cream shop! We came here for July 7th's National Strawberry Sundae Day and it didn't disappoint! Mary Coyle's was one of the few places that popped up that wasn't a chain and we were eager to get our Strawberry Sundae on! Parking is located just behind the building and there was some street parking nearby as well. Located near the Downtown ASU campus.
Hands down the best ice cream in Vegas!!! Definitely suggest getting the 4 scoop sampler since there is tons of great flavors.

Thanks to their online ordering option I was able to order a few breakfast items this morning and then swing by to pick them up, which was very convenient. Ordered the pear bostock, a cinnamon roll, a ham and cheese croissant, and an egg in a croissant. Glad to see them still open and able to serve customers safely and conveniently during COVID.

Love this place! People who work here seem like they love their jobs lol. Everyone is super nice and friendly. Awesome selection of ice cream, all types of interesting flavors. You can try samples of every flavor if you want before you make the tough decision on which to order. The adults and kids alike enjoyed watching the workers in the back made the ice cream just as much as eating it! Mitchell's has a glass wall so you can see whats happening behind the scenes. They have tables where you can sit and hang while you eat ice cream upstairs and down. The place will always be busy if you're there on the weekend, but it's large enough to sit comfortably. If your in the neighborhood it's a must try!

I have ordered the soft serve in matcha flavors. They once had two matcha flavors: one creamier and one more tea flavor. Both were great depending on your preference. My hubby preferred the creamier and I preferred the more tea flavor. We both were happy. I have also tried the hojicha flavor soft serve. Very good too. Most recently, I had the matcha and sesame twist soft serve. Wonderful! The sesame flavor is just as expected, not overly sweet but sweet enough.
