But what makes this place two stars for me is that as I got to the bottom of the crepe, this thing was COVERED in oil/grease. It was disgusting! I didn't even watch the associate put any grease anywhere as she was making it, but it was completely soaked at the bottom. It made me feel so gross and it was dripping everywhere, even on my new Lululemon shorts (insert eyeroll). I would just much rather have a regular crepe served to me on a plate instead of this greaseball meal. Unfortunately, I do not think I would go back because all I think about is my hands and everything else covered in grease. It was just gross. If they could get that figured out, then I'd be open to trying it again. All in all, not worth the wait.

This bakery has everything you need for a quick fresh breakfast. Their egg & cheese croissants are fantastic and filling. They have fresh brewed coffee and a wide variety of pastries. Prices are higher than average but you're in the Venetian so it's expected. Lines can be long but the employees were very efficiently. It is located on the casino floor. If coming from the canal shoppes you need to take the escalator down. Very convenient location.
I loved the vegan red velvet cupcakes!! That's the only flavor I tried. I thought it was moist and they used coconut frosting instead on cream cheese...gotta love it.

Took a day trip to Charlotte and wanted to explore the NODA area. We had plans for dinner in downtown but decided to stop by Amelie's bakery for a sweet treat first. So glad we did!! It was the highlight of our day trip to Charlotte! It is the most adorable bakery, super cool atmosphere, lots of seating, neat/eclectic decor. Then there are all the delicious baked goods! Where to even begin?! My husband and I decided to try a few of the mini treats-none of which disappointed! We tried the mini hazelnut tart, a peanut butter and chocolate pettifor, a cinnamon and chocolate macaroon, and a pecan sticky bun. They were all delicious! My favorite was the hazelnut tart and my husband's favorite was the sticky bun. Amelie's is a must stop any time we go to Charlotte from now on! If you haven't been, you're missing out! They also serve soups, salads, and sandwiches--we'll have to try the savory side of Amelie's next time!

Phenomenal!! If you had not stopped into this little 600sq ft. of a wonderland of dreaminess, creamiest, indulgence perfection.......STOP what your doing, put down whatever you're eating and head to Novel ASAP! Seriously, you're welcome for passing on the most positive ice cream experience ever! Here's the down-low it took this owner 2 years, to find the perfect ice cream maker, and a year to perfect his doughnuts! So bottom line; the PERFECT doughnut is stuffed with perfect ice cream! Here's the scoop, there's 12 flavors of ice cream, handfuls of toppings, and cereal, if you choose, to top off your ice cream. I tried all flavors before deciding on what I think is the best combination in the world! Strawberry balsamic and a scoop of honey lavender! I kid you not, it's the best! My son got Cookie Monster stuffed in a warm doughnut, hubby got bourbon toffee with cinnamon crunch cereal stuffed in a warm delicious doughnut! This may sound over sweet, and stomach churning with sugar overload, on the contrary....it's not too sweet! It's perfected to be balanced, leaving you wanting more! It's magic, I don't understand it? The owner and staff were outstanding providing exceptional service, and products!! I'm bowing down, as I finish this review! See you tomorrow!
Sooooo good! Taiyaki is hot, soft, crispy, chewy, and mildly sweet all at the same time.

The ice creams here are wonderful. I'll be honest, the last time I was here I can't remember what I got, but we stopped here after eating brunch at Windsor, and it was a great way to cool down. They also have tons of cool little baked-right-there treats, and those are awesome. Splurge for the waffle cone. So worth it!!

I've been coming to Page's since I was a kid and at 25 I still get that "YAY ICE CREAM!" feeling when I go here. Their soft serve ice cream is great and their Hawaiian Ice/Slushes come in several different flavors. The dips on their ice cream cones are very good and very popular as well. However, my favorite thing to get their is their Artic Swirls which also come in distinct and fun flavors (I really enjoy the Banana Cream Pie). Did I mention the great prices and friendly staff? This place has been a staple of the South Hills and it never fails to attract a large crowd of people. You can't go wrong with Page's!

Very nice location on the 2nd floor of the Cosmopolitan hotel. I was so happy to see the ad while at the Cosmo pool and even more so because I was actually contemplating paying $63 for a small cake to get shipped to me from New York. I opted for the slice of confetti cake and boy was I disappointed! $16 for a small slice of dry, crumbly cake with no flavor! I expected it to be stellar based on all the hype but maybe this was an old cake and I got a bad slice. I would not go back but glad I got to experience milk in Vegas.

I've been a huge fan of Mason's since they only had a food cart at Walnut Wednesdays. Now that their store is open, I love going to see what flavors they are featuring. Mason's make their own custom flavors for ice cream and sorbet including vegan options, cones, and churros for ice cream sandwiches. Today I ordered the Vegan Shirley Temple Sorbet, my sister had the Honey Cornbread (drizzled with fresh local honey), and my father had the Banana Pudding. Yum! Even our dog got a little treat, the Sweet Cream ice cream made just for dogs (and on the house, so thank you!!). This little gem is located in Hingetown, and even does special events such as Ramen Nights and Movie Nights when the weather is good. The owners and staff are genuinely friendly. Mason's is a must for Clevelanders and visitors alike.
Love Mary Coyle! Great place for the kids and best ice cream flavors in town. Highly recommended!

I wish this place was closer to me because I would be a regular for sure! Came here to support Gabi K. because she was raising money for CF and for my support I got ice cream... yay:). The owners of Sweet Republic are yelpers too and they were so wonderful for donating a 100% of the proceeds for Gabi's cause. I tried the honey yogurt and I think it was a Mayan chocolate... they both were spectacular! I also brought home some cookies for my sweetie which he loved also. When I am in the neighborhood I will definitely stop by again.

Located inside the cosmopolitan casino. No dine area but their is a separate seating area a walk away. We got 2 birthday cake shakes and coffee shake. The coffee shake was about $11. Wished they either filled the cup more or added whip. They have some shakes with alcohol too.

I don't know where to begin. HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. The worker who scooped my ice cream was one of the rudest people I have ever met. She gave my sister and I SO much attitude when trying to explain how we can have two scoops and not one. She handed the ice cream cone to me with the second scoop practically falling off the cone. When I asked her if I can have a cup since the ice cream was FALLING OFF she said no. I had to ask another worker, the cashier, for a cup. Even the cashier was giving me attitude about handing an empty cup to me. Stay away from this place! Extremely disappointed!
Love everything they make! The best bakery in Madison by far. Delicious, local, and worth every penny. Such a great treat for holidays too!

Holy moley, super good REAL ice cream. I've been here lots of times and it never disappoints. Sometimes the line is long but it usually moves pretty quick and is worth it. My favorite is butter pecan with pecans as a topping.

The donuts are amazing! It's no wonder why they go quick. Whatever Jeff and his staff are doing behind the scenes they definitely should not stop. I had ordered an assortment for a birthday party donut wall and Donut Bar LV did not disappoint, it was a total hit!

A must try in Charlotte! A friend recommended this cafe to me and I went there literally every day that I spent in Charlotte. A huge variety of pastries and sweets, as well as savory options. Different kinds of tea, coffee, etc. This is a perfect breakfast/brunch place! I was introduced to my currently favorite tea here and I actually was able to buy a tin from the cafe! Definitely will return if I'm ever back in Charlotte.

Lovely and amazing desserts! I adore the salted carmel brownie for true chocolate lovers. The macarons are light and sugary fluffy bits of dessert heaven. I like their sandwiches, croissants, quiches, salads, teas with flavor of the day, coffee (and they have almond milk for us lactose intolerant peeps). I cannot think of one thing I do not love to eat on their menu. I enjoy the quirky decorations too. And after visiting Paris, I can say their desserts definitely live up to the inspiration!

They are open 24/7 365 days ... @ this location --open every day .all year long! That is not a typo. All the pastries and desserts tasted very fresh as we witnessed them coming out regularly. Obviously depending on what your tastes are ... I don't think you can go wrong All the fruits were fresh and the custards and creams appeared creamy and recently made You can get coffee tea and drinks and lunch sandwiches also. It is worth another trip and apparently other locations are in NC, Rock hill, SC and Atlanta

I was pretty pumped to go try this Cafe out. The decor and inside area was pretty cool set up. What really took me away was the all of the macaroons and pastries on display that you can choose from. I couldn't make a choice so I got one of every flavor macaroon and didn't disappoint. My favorite was the birthday cake!

I tried a couple items here, and they were pretty good. There are a lot of yummy looking pastries; I will have to come back to try more. I had the Peanut Butter and Jelly Macaron and a chocolate peanut butter cookie. They were tasty, but didn't wow me.

rasberry linzer, raspberry linzer, rasberry linzer! peanut butter cookies - oh yeah! I'm in heaven. Cream puff, I liked it, but maybe it's just me, I wan't impressed, but was impressed with its size. it's freaking huge. quantity over quality? maybe I'm just not a cream puff person. I dunno. The food is quick and pretty good - being in little italy, there are some bigger contenders here, but for take out you get great portions and it's good. Had the gnocchi and lasagna. Lasagna wasn't cooked all the way through, but it was gigantic, so I can understand why. simply had them heat it up more. it was good. again, not the best in little italy, but in a pinch - it'll satisfy. The outdoor seating and ambience make it very casual and relaxing.

PROS...Large variety of creamy flavors and ways to have your ice cream. Vegan options. CONS....It's a service window you walk up to, with outside seating only. Depending on the time of day, you could be standing in a line with 15 people in front of you. That's especially not fun in the sun with Vegas summers. Prices are high. Staff are sometimes not so friendly, seem pretty stressed, so maybe there's not enough staff.
Recently enjoyed gelato in Rome. But MITCHELLS is the better! Great cleveland experience! Highly recommend to anyone visiting. And if you have kids... they have a train to watch!!!

Hands down best cheesecake I've ever had. I've had the red velvet cake which was also excellent, but the cheesecake was out of this world. I can't wait to go back and try the funfetti cheese cake and some of their breakfast items! Great service and help from the staff as well.

The customer service we got was amazing! The cashier walked us through the ordering process. We got the Ahboong with Ube flavored soft serve. It was amazing! It's not too sweet and you can taste the Ube flavor. The fish waffle went well with it. It was soft and warm. I definitely will be back for more!

When ice cream falls in love with a donut and waffles swim in sweet cold buttercream. Specialty ice cream done right! Flavors like Fat Elvis made up of maple and bacon or bourbon with toffee ice cream. Awesome blue Cookie Monster Cookies & Cream. Come visit Novel Ice Cream and beat the heat folks. This place is really cool with lots of places to seat and eat. Tremendous neighborhood vibes that will keep you smiling!
I had the chocolate and the strawberry ice cream, and it was ok. Nothing to write mom home about but worth a try for sure.

When I came to get some sweets here there was no line at all. The workers were friendly and they neatly boxed up my order. I ordered a rainbow cookie and a raspberry linzer cookie. My total came to $5 and some change. I thought the prices for what I ordered were fair and that the cookies were tasty. Some of the other items I found to be overpriced (such as the cupcakes and tiny cakes).

I think I had high expectations for this place due to the hype. I was really looking forward to trying their cereal ice cream. I had a sample before committing to buying and it didn't taste good. They use corn flakes when I think they should use Frosted Flakes. Usually ice cream is sweet but this one was not. The cookies I felt were good but not great, my favorite was the blueberry one. Overall, I say try this place once if you can't make it to New York to try the original.

I really loved this little ice cream spot. Tucked away in a cool art area of Phoenix. Great artisan ice cream made in small batches. They are open late which is really nice when you get a late night craving for high quality ice cream. I had the fat elvis flavor with the dounghnut. The combination was outrageously delicious. I would definitely go back. The list of flavors had at least six I wanted to try. Highly recommended!!!!
My friend has recently been to France. She vouched for the authenticity of the pain au chocolate. The eclair was as light and dreamy as any I have ever had. I expect to return.
Just came in from Long Island, decided to stop by for a quick bite. From the coffee to the sandwiches to the pastries you can tell everything was made fresh and with love. Can't wait to visit again.

Wish this place weren't so close to my house. Pastries are to die for, sandwiches, salads and soups are fresh and good. Servers are very helpful as to what to order and why. Cute atmosphere for a fun lunch or after dinner dessert. Great for take out dessert as well!
I'm so happy that 85°C Bakery is now in Vegas! Can't wait to come back and buy more Taro bread

I have been to Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream multiple times now, and it has never disappointed me. The quality and selection of the ice cream is unmatched. I tend to order more unique flavors, such as green tea, because I like to try new things. Of course, the shop also has classics like vanilla, chocolate, and cookie dough available. My wife's favorite is Zanzibar chocolate with bananas and is worth checking out. The portion size given is fairly large. I usually struggle to finish my single scoop. Depending, I would considering sharing a serving. Ice cream is also available for purchase in pints to take home with you if you feel the need to take your new favorite frozen treat home with you. Every single time I have gone to the ice cream shop, it has been absolutely packed. Sometimes the counter is understaffed but the wait is worth it, and the workers are friendly. Despite the crowd, most customers tend to walk around with the ice cream since all of the containers/spoons are disposable. As a result there will usually be plenty of seating available. A bathroom is available, but you will have to ask for a key.

Macaron review only. Comes in small and large sizes, individual and boxed assorted flavors. The crust is light with a thin crisp, the inside is moist, chewy, creamy, and a little gritty from the ground almonds. I tried the coffee (no joke, it had a little after taste that reminded me of soy sauce/Maggi - a-ok), caramel (a-ok), and pistachio (a-ok). A 6-count small macaron box is $12, 6-count large box is $17.50, individual large is $3.50, and the small (which is really regular size macarons you find everywhere) is ~$2. Other important info: cafe is small and is located underneath escalators and directly across the Phantom Theatre entrance, open at 6AM, inside Venetian, no seating area, cafe is literally a small counter w/ a refrigerated cake/food display case, many barristas on hand to create signature java/beverage.

Been waiting 10 minutes for a coffee and an egg sandwich. There are 5 very confused and hideously inefficient people behind the counter and even fewer customers. I've never seen anything like this in my life.
Best cupcake ever... beats out Georgetown cupcakes hands down!!! Red Velvet, Vanilla and chocolate! I just wish I had bought more.

The kindest, friendliest, and most welcoming service! The owners were so patient with us as we tried multiple flavors, and he described each one's ingredients to us in detail. They really care about their customers and we left feeling happy! Not to mention the ice cream is beyond creamy and delicious. Will definitely come back! MUST TRY!!!

Worth the drive to charlotte ! Strawberry shortcake milkshake ...I also had a macaroon icecream sandwich but I ate it too quickly and didn't get a picture .. the flavor was birthday cake and the macaroon had the right amount of chewy and crunchy

I've always wanted to try Macarons (not to be confused with macarOOns), so luckily I got an assortment of macarons from Bouchon as a gift.. I can't begin to describe how delicious they are.. The flavors were light, but exquisite.. My favorite was the vanilla, but not by much.. They have a bunch of other tasty stuff there, but the macarons are definitely a must try!!

Friendly service. The pretzel cookie was exactly how you'd expect it to taste - salty, crunchy, and pleasant to eat. For the service and cookie, this place gets a couple stars. The triple cinnamon cupcake was anemic and lacking flavor. Barely a hint of cinnamon, and it would be difficult to even call it cinnamon flavored. The cake itself was dry and the frosting tasted of sugar and diabetes. For a cinnamon cupcake I'd expect more zing.

Hands down the best donuts in Cleveland. Their flavors change every month and are always very creative and fun. The Choco Taco donut was my favorite. All the donuts had great texture and all the toppings weren't too sweet and went very well the donuts.

Unbelievable. I'm a huge fan of the shop in BH, was even at the opening a decade ago. Tonight for the THIRD time in the past 4 months, I've gotten the wrong variety of cupcakes. This is 3 times, already. And for $4.00 a cupcake, I expect I'm getting what I ask for. If I go in there repeating myself and rechecking everything- I'm perceived as rude to the employees, correct??? I can't believe what a disappointment this LV shop has been for me

Tried this place on Saturday with the family and it was amazing! My daughter went with the waffle cone sandwich and Nutella ice cream and my son of course had to try the Cookie Monster. I tried the donut with the tiki ice cream and it was everything. The hubs just went with the Madagascar vanilla but everything was so great. One of the owners we spoke with was was super sweet and nice. You can tell he loves what he is doing, and they are open late! We will definitely be back soon!

When you're in NODA, you neeeed to stop by Amelie's for dessert; it's mandatory! Had one our local relatives in N.C. Treat us to this place and we loved it so much we come back as much as possible. Why? Cuz the pastries are so *expletive* delicious! Amelie's is a beautiful cafe/pastry joint that'll satisfy just about anyone's sweet tooth. They have eclairs, a variety of croissants, pies, cakes, a full service coffee menu, tartes, and my favorites: Macrons of all flavors! The ambience is super cool as well; just loads of interesting decor, paints, sideways chandeliers... it's lots of fun to look at! The only thing keeping me from giving a perfect 5: from what I've noticed it seems like a majority of the seating is taken up by "study-ers." You know those people that take up an entire table for themselves and have their books and laptops laying everywhere while they've been babysitting whatever the cheapest item is on the menu?! Yeah those people hang out here too. JUST GO TO A LIBRARY!!! So good luck scrounging for seating! If it's a nice day/night, there's usually a few seats outside. We mostly end up eating in our car or take it to go. I'm not claiming to have ever visited Paris but if I had to dream of what Parisian pastries/sweets taste like, this is it. Matter of fact, I'll probably be disappointed if one day I go to Paris and things don't taste like what Amelie's serves haha. Okay, that comes across a bit ignorant but, you get the picture. Come here, enjoy the sweets and leave happy!
Had a great desert after eating At Midwood Smokehouse. Cannot imagine how great it is to have Carmel Salted brownies within walking distance !

Fabulous flavors offered! So many new and inventive combinations were offered so I tasted 3-4 varieties before I chose. I chose two, the black sesame and the brown butter. (A small is $4.50 and allows for 2 flavors) While it's not as creamy as other small-batch ice creams I've tasted, it's packed with flavor. Workers were friendly and helpful. I'd love to return and taste the other seasonal flavors.

i was very pleased with the decoration it was someones living room. The dessert looked really pretty but,it was not that great at all. The caramel salted brownie was grainy and the caramel was very thick . i did however have a brae and turkey sandwich and that was the best part of my meal it was very plain just how i like it. i could see my self here again mostly because i think this is the only 24 hour place in town.

We stopped for ice cream last Friday evening. The variety here is excellent with flavors you don't find elsewhere. I shared two scoops with my wife: strawberry rhubarb crisp, and pralines and cream. These were both exceptionally good. This is an institution in the Cleveland area, and there are a couple of other locations. This is definitely worth a stop when you are in the mood for a treat.

Our new favorite ice cream shop in all of Cleveland and believe me I have tasted almost all of them. Incredible inventive flavors, super staff who really want you to get what you would like best and aloe you to taste as many flavors as you please. Our favorites so far have been, captain crunch, marzipan, oatmeal cream pie and banana pudding!
Crazy good simple homemade ice cream. Really friendly staff and honestly the top three homemade ice cream's I've ever had. Salted caramel cashew was delicious.
Found this place by chance, so glad I did. Small shop, so you will need to find a place to eat the donuts. I would recommend you find a way to stop here if you're in the area, you will not regret it.

I dont understand what the attraction is. It's definitely cute, but my cappuccino was cold and the cake was dense and not very good. My husband had chocolate cream pie that was literally pie crust with a very thin layer of chocolate. Not good.

I am a super fan of Bouchon in Yountville....I like the NY location ...this is my least favorite of the 3. The pastries are delicious at all 3....no complaints there so i know that I will always come back again and again. Why is it my least favorite? it's tiny inside...like really tiny it's way too warm inside (when it's 100 plus degrees outside..would be nice to walk into a cold room) it doesn't feel super clean...i'm sure it is...and i think the filth of vegas itself just puts that in my head....but it just feels subpar to the quality of the desserts. service is blah...they do their job ...just not the extra love i get at the Yountville location. yum yum croissants and macaroons!!! and the coffee is yummy

Move on to something better and lighter. I tried the birthday cake shake since the server told it's the most popular item they sell and it was not remotely good. The $10 price tag for the shake also didn't help its cause.
Got the 3 scoops flight. So good and refreshing! Line will probably be out the door but it's worth the short wait.

I went to Carlo's in Vegas and I was looking forward to it. I waited in line for quite a while, maybe 20 or 30 minutes. The boy who was ushering people in through the velvet rope was busy chatting and a couple who were never in line walked right up to the counter and were waited on! I got the California cheesecake. It was okay, I've had better. It was $10.00. I also bought a mug for $10.00. They put them both in a white plastic bag that said Thank You like you get from Stop and Shop. Very embarrassing having to walk around a beautiful hotel like the Venetian with a Stop and Shop bag. When I met up again with my other family who went on the Gondola ride, one of my couisins said "Gee, you would think they would want to give you at a bag with their logo on it." Very,very disappointing.

I always come to Amelie's whenever I'm in town or whenever I meet up to catch up with someone. The aroma and ambience of the cafe are great and accommodate the food so well. I love the chai latte and the turkey sandwich on baguette bread. I've also tried a variety of their pastries and have yet to be disappointed! Amelie's is a must when coming to Charlotte.

I continue to awe at the amazing flavor quality of Jeni's ice creams! You can tell so much detail and care goes into each flavor. I'm so happy Charlotte has three locations (with this one and NoDa being a bit bigger than Park Rd Shopping Center)! Literally any flavor you get is amazing. I don't have a favorite because I love getting different flavors each visit -- and that's easy to do because there's always new seasonal flavors coming out. And can we talk about the drool worthy aroma that hits your nostrils as soon as you walk in?! I love the smell of freshly made waffle cones. I love that you can also see them roll fresh ones behind the counter. All of the locations are decorated with the same vibrancy -- it makes for a great atmosphere. This location has a good handful of seats inside and outside, so you can beat the heat if you're lucky. The fact that Jeni's is always so welcoming to Yelpers is also another reason why I adore them so much! They care about their customers and the products they offer them.

Literally the best ice cream I have ever eaten. Got the strawberry cheesecake chunk- definitely did not regret it. Real strawberries and real cheesecake (not the fake frozen chunks they serve at froyo places). So freaking good. Will return (probably more times than I should)!
Best ice cream in town. You might have to wait a minute but it's worth it. You can also call ahead for pints and quarts only and go right up to the window and pick it up

If you're like me and can't easily get to Hoboken, New Jersey for Buddy's original bakery, at the very least you must try his location in Las Vegas! You feel like a kid in a candy shop. Displays filled with all the sweet cakes, rolls & cookies you can imagine. Get at least 5 lobster tails because you're going to want at least 2 for now, 2 for later and 1 to share (if you're into that, otherwise it's all you)! There's no actual lobster in this pastry, the name comes from the lobster-tail shape. Paper-thin layers of dough with a satisfying crunch filled with gobs of sweet cream, topped with chocolatey hazelnut drizzle. Enjoy!

I hate that I love this place. Every time I come here I wonder why they haven't figured out a better system for everyone to line in an orderly manner, but then again they do have a drive thru to ease that annoyance. As popular as this place is, the employees never learned how to give service with a smile, but that's easily forgiven when I get my ice cream. This place is mediocre at best; other than their ice cream and the townies loyalty custard cup needs to start up-ing their game.

I'd read the reviews, and I'm all for trying the latest hype. This was just as good as the accolades it receives! We went for lunch so we could load up on ice cream, I had a sundae with burnt caramel and brownie swirl topped with dark chocolate. The perfect meal! My husband liked his apple pie and cherry ice creams too, but I forgot to ask for a taste in time, and his was gonee. I appreciated the local ingredients too, everything is made right in their kitchen in small batches. We were visiting central Phoenix and it was worth the drive to north Scottsdale!
Great family, great flavors, and great treats. My son is in love with their Cookie Monster ice cream and the mocha boba is on point.

AmÃ©lie's is one of the best places to spend time at. Be it with friends or just need some time for yourself. It has the right ambience to let us soak into what we want to do. I love their macaroons and keep coming back here often. Pastries and Macaroons are a must try!

I had high hopes for Milk Bar because I have watched and rewatched the Milk Bar/Christina Tosi episode of Chef's Table -- and the cereal milk soft serve and crack pie still totally exceeded my expectations. I actually went back for seconds on the soft serve. Be sure to get it WITH cornflake crunchies. The drip coffee was also really good and the service was exceptional. Everyone working here seems to have that Christina Tosi brand of joyful energy. Can't wait to come back in the future!

Love ice cream? Love cereal? Love sweets in general? This is the place for you. Love a little booze with your milk shake? Even better. We came here mid-day, and it was just the right time for something sweet - and something boozy. I had the fancy birthday cake shake. It was made perfectly so the Kahlua wasn't overpowering and you had plenty of sweet birthday cake flavor. At $12, I thought it was fairly priced since I've had other boozy shakes in Vegas for $15 and over. They had other sweet treats, and I bough pumpkin pie cake truffles (only available in November). They were definitely sweet, but they came packaged so that was a little odd. I expected something freshly made. They were still plenty yummy. If you have time, or even have kids, this is a fun place to stop for some sweet treats.

Had high expectations of this place from all the hype it was given during our stay at the cosmopolitan but the treats we had were average at best. Maybe we caught them on a bad day but for the prices they charge I expected much more. Step out on to the strip and there are numerous, better options. Don't get me started on the child size servings.

Wow!!! These are some freaking great pastries. The jams are way good as well. We stopped in here for breakfast knowing it was a Thomas Kellar establishment and we weren't disappointed. By far the best danish and best blueberry muffin I have had in my life. The basket was fairly priced too. I would go back for just the muffins. Other food was good too. Well cooked and tastey. You can't go wrong coming here for breakfast. My only complaint was the sticky bun was overdone. Like way overcooked and crunchy. Too bad

Yum. You can totally tell the difference between home-made fair versus 'other' ice cream parlors. It's definitely high grade stuff. Sure, it's not all out on display. But the fact that it's bought out in those deep freeze nuclear material looking containers let's you know where your money is going! Totally tasty, and loved the 50's vibe. Customer service was great too.

I went in the morning and there was only one customer in front of me and the 2 ladies helping the front of the store were very nice and quick! The pastries, were amazing!! I tried the eclair, cream puff, canolis (obviously), tiramisu and the chocolate mousse tart! All were great! They did charge me for one tart that didn't end up in my box, but accidents happen! Would definitely go there again!!

Ice cream here is slightly above average, but every other aspect of this experience isn't. There could be one person in front of you in line ordering a scoop and you will still wait 20 minutes. This place is always understaffed and the service is unfriendly. I would suggest putting a larger menu in front of the glass so those in line could make their decision while they wait. Not worth it.

YUM! Excellent customer service and even BETTER ice cream?? Also ice cream DONUT sandwiches. Say what?! Count me in! Novel ice cream is a little gem kind of hidden away on a small side street (or it may have appeared that way since we stopped by late at night). Street parking is the way to go. Walk on in and you'll be greeted by some of the nicest people in town. The man behind the counter (I think the owner) was really great, and explained the different flavors and encouraged us to try whatever we wanted. I settled on Thai tea and the honey lavender but didn't want two whole scoops so they kindly did a half and half combo in a cup for me. Since I was debating getting a cone, they put a small stroopwafel in the cup for me :) Thai tea flavor was strong and delicious, as was the honey lavender. I inhaled the ice cream like it was nothing, after having had a massive meal for dinner. I personally felt like the ice cream was kind of sweet and think it would be even better if it was made with less sugar, to enhance the flavors already in it. My friend got the ice cream donut sandwich, which looked bomb. We destroyed our ice cream and donut pretty quickly and would definitely recommend that anyone passing through Phoenix make a detour to stop at Novel. You won't regret it!

I made my first visit to Fatty Daddy's on January 8th with my two best friends just after the Phoenix Bridal Show. I heard heard numerous good things about this place and was so eager to try and see what that was all about. Unfortunately my experience was negative and I will not be returning. The afternoon my three friends and I walked into amazing customer service from a young boy who was so kind in serving our sweet treats, which were quite delicious. We sat inside the establishment that day because it was a little chilly. What unfolded afterwards blew my mind. It seems that the mother of the employee came in to speak to the (new) owner about a few issues so my company and I paid no attention. Shortly (and I mean very shortly) there after the management took the conversation to an altercation type level with raised voice and all. WE WERE SHOCKED. Owner was shouting, blaming the young boy aloud for a broken mug, saying he would not receive tips. I could NOT believe my eyes and ears. I felt awful for this boy and as customers, we were put in such an awkward position sitting there while this was taking place. Our sweet trip turned sour VERY quickly. It's a shame. We will not be returning and truly hope for the best of the employees that remain under the example of management we witnessed that afternoon.
Brownie milkshake is very tasty. The ice cream sandwiches are good too. On the less creamy side, the sorbet is a great option
I drive from Gilbert infrequently to go here. One of my favorite ice cream places in the valley, hands down.
Their macarons are fantastic - I highly recommend the raspberry. These were the best macaroons I had in Vegas (and I tried them at about four places).

Stopped by here for my favorite item at Bouchon their take on the Nutter Butter. So rich and peanut buttery, it is such a simple but decadent treat, I get cravings for them. This is a tiny shop, not much selection, but everything we had was fantastic. Prices are high, but given the area and quality that gets put into these lovely desserts, it is worth every penny.

We bought cupcakes from the bakery in Vegas twice and both times they where stale and old no freshness at all . Every time I have come to Vegas and bought a cupcake it's been like that . Not worth the price for old cupcakes .

Stopped in before a ride on the High Roller and had a lemon coconut cupcake. It was good, but all the flavor seemed to be in the frosting. I would have liked to have more coconut in the cupcake and maybe lemon filling. That said, it was delicious. I love the outdoor seating by the fountain. And while I was there in the morning, I absolutely love the idea of the late night cupcake ATM. I can see it being the perfect late night snack.

Mason's is one of my favorite places in town! The staff is always so friendly, the owners are the best as well! I don't have anything bad to say about this place! The ice cream is always amazing, they change flavors like weekly or twice a week. They started serving soft serve as well that is just as good! If you ever make it in, get an egg waffle or the banana bread split if they bring it back! They even do a pop up ramen night and it's definitely worth it and legit! But always get there early or as soon as they post something on their Instagram because it will will out before your eyes lol but in a good way. They even have vegan options!!!

"You have a Milk Bar in Las Vegas?!?!" says my friend. "You HAVE to get their funfetti birthday cake for the very next person you are buying a birthday cake for." Well I did. I paid $68 (tax & tip included) for their sort of itty bitty looking Funfetti birthday cake. And felt thoroughly underwhelmed. As did the 3 other people who shared the cake with me. I don't know if expectations were just too high, but the cake just tasted dry and mediocre. For an itty bitty 6"(?) cake, it felt heavy enough, but after tasting the cake, I felt like it was more of a $20 cake, not $68. The only positive to the whole experience was that the staff were super nice, and that birthday candles were included. I may go back again to see if anything else is better, but judging by the reviews of others' experiences...maybe not.

I had the campfire smore and my husband had the toffee banofi. He had his exactly as it was on the menu and i replaced my chocolate ice cream scoops with vanilla and the best salted caramel ice cream ive ever had! We were both blown away. New favorite ice cream place for sure. Pleasant even during Covid.

I found this place on Instagram and was in awe. It was closer to my boyfriends house than it was mine so I took a screen shot of the name and knew when I went down there we'd have to try it. Yesterday we so happened to pass it on our way home. Although it was a gloomy raining cold day I said I HAVE TO TRY IT. I was impressed. I did mix in fruit loops and he even told me that was a bad idea, yet somehow couldn't keep his spoon out of my cup. It was absolutely phenomenal, and I love soft serve. This is better because you get to mix in what you want and the soft serve is very creamy and thicker than others I've had. Only downside is it's a bit pricey for (~$7) for a small (cup) of ice cream. Worth it and will go back!

Doesn't the sweet smell of buttery waffles greeting you as you walk into an ice cream parlor just make your mouth drool? Should I say any more?? Sweet Republic has won "my most favorite ice cream stop" award. This overly delicious sweet and creative ice cream parlor of a place will satisfy sweet needs. (Speaking from a person that should have diabetes by now) ON TOP OF THAT!! Their waffle cones are absolutely, D-E-L-I-C-I-O-U-S. If you have ever had those butter cookies... that is the BEST way to describe their waffle cone. And ANYTHING with BUTTER is FAB-U-LOUS. Who wouldn't want that topped with your favorite ice cream flavor? And if making the trip is not worth enough. They do sell containers of their ice cream so you can indulge at home. I don not know how long that it will last for me. OK my mouth is drooling just remembering it. Ya'll gotta try it. I'm so dead serious.
Best ice cream I've had in quite some time. Just found my favorite desert spot! I recommend the Mint Chip!
Meh. Park Road location. Not sure how a bunch of bored teens can still manage to forget to include my side item. Pro- best croissant. Con- worst napoleon and unmotivated staff.

We absolutely love this place! I would drive across town for them! I adore the idea of my favorite cereal in a soft served! The concept is very unique for a dessert shop in Arizona! When it comes to their drinks... their Butterfly Lemonade is my favorite! Very refreshing and light! Honestly, I don't know what some of these people are talking about when they say their customer service is bad. I never had a bad experience here and the staff have all been very friendly to us.

After a long day, and a healthy fish and veggie dinner, I deserved a treat. We drove over to Amelie's, and words cannot express the fact that I will be back. What a quaint, unique, funky atmosphere. However, that was nothing! The coffee and desserts were amazing!! My favorite, the Carmel chocolate brownie, that salty sweet treat everyone craves! The macaroons were delist! I will be back to enjoy this unique place and their amazing treats!!!

This little shop is run by the most amazing, lovely couple Brandon and Jennifer. They always remember me and ask about how I'm doing! The customer service is EXCEPTIONAL. You meet a lot of people in your everyday life, but you will feel a strong sense of community with the staff here that you don't feel much elsewhere. I never knew getting ice cream would become such an uplifting experience for me. ANYWAYS, the ice cream is AMAZING! Best ice cream I've ever had. I personally always get two scoops of the Bourbon in a waffle cone, but I know their vanilla is award winning and amazing too!!!

Overhyped and underwhelming. Unlike other yelpers, the line wasn't terribly long and moved quickly. They had a plethora of options to choose from, all of which looked good. However, the cupcakes themselves were disappointing. The cake was relatively dry and lacked flavor. At nearly $5 a piece, I've experienced better at most other bakeries selling for the same price. This place is busy and popular due to the TV show. Otherwise, this place would be a bakery to skip over when looking for dessert on the strip.

I don't know who was smiling harder, me or the gal who greeted me as I walked in! I have a real sweet tooth and seeing an ice cream shop with 5 stars?! HAD TO GO! And I was not disappointed! Immediately as we walked in, I was greeted enthusiastically and asked if I've ever been here. And sold on their doughnut of course. The cool thing is you get to try every single flavor, and they are SUPER knowledgeable with what's in each one and how it'a made. What I appreciated most was there wasn't a lot of asking questions or waiting around for me to pick, both gals took the time to really conversate and intertwine every flavor profile into the conversation. Literally, my favorite ice cream place so far - tastes great but the people make the experience even BETTER!

Some of my friends are OBSESSED with Milk bar, going as far as to order an entire cake for special occasions, so I knew I had to try this when in Vegas. I ordered a slice of the classic birthday cake and it was good but not "best thing I ever ate" good. And certainly not worth the $15 for one slice of cake. The cake was a little dry and crumbly and the icing was good but, again, not anything to write home about.
The bubble tea is really good. Comfy chairs and very nice decor. Lots of windows. Friendly staff.

Just moved back to Cleveland have been CRAVING these donuts. Drove all the way and the donuts were SO stale. This was around 4. I get it, end of the day. But I mean these were inedible. And $9 for 3 of them should at least be quality.

I absolutely love Jack Frost Donuts. It's a cute little donut shop located in Cleveland. I used to live right at the other end of the street so we make sure to stop whenever we are in the area. My mom was speaking with the owner on Facebook messenger about ordering so we wouldn't have to go in and wait. They told her to call the morning we needed them and they had them ready for us to pickup. My mom did have trouble getting through on the phone but they finally called back. She was able to pay over the phone, as well. They are just so good, I had to eat one right away! I love how there are so many unique flavors. I had the salted caramel and I can't wait to try the s'mores one next. I didn't go in to pick them up, but what I saw through the window is the employees were wearing masks.
We loved it, it's a great experience and all their breads are so fluffy and soft inside and is textural on the outsidez

If you like coffee ice cream, then allow me to insist that you try their Vietnamese Coffee ice cream. It is absolutely heavenly and you won't be disappointed. In addition to their decadent ice creams, I also grab a few cookies to go. Fresh, soft, chewy and amazing.

Amelie's French Bakery is, perhaps, the loveliest place in Charlotte to have a European coffee and pastry experience. I would say it is the best in Charlotte, but not the best it could be. It is worth visiting just for the atmosphere of the place even though the pastries could definitely be improved.
not really a fan of the other donuts they have. I love the pop tart donut. But my all time favorite ? are the French toast donut and the grilled cheese donut. Very unique tasting donuts. I love it.

So disappointed by this place. The donuts were just sad. They look amazing but taste like disappointment. We got there in the afternoon time so they were doing $10 boxes (as many donuts you can fit in a box for $10), we were so excited to get to try a variety. Smores on fire - eh & cake donut was sad Triple chocolate - more like 1 chocolate Blueberry & Meyer lemon - decent Creme brulee - eh, cream was gross Chai - okay Chocolate covered old fashioned - gross Poptart - okay but so overly sweet Nutella - the only one where the donut dough was good Chocolate milk - don't get it, not worth it 2 stars cause we would eat 2 donuts again (blueberry & Meyer lemon & nutella) and the staff was really nice
Not bad. Was a little underwhelmed with their sweets selection. I expected to have more selections. The inside was really nice and unique.
Had the toffee banofi. It was great. There are several other items on the menu I want to try, so I will be back next time I'm in town!

These pastries are amazing! I got half a dozen of a variety and honestly all of them where sooo good! Out of all I think my favorite one was the brownie and to second that the pop tart. We took these on a road trip and these were gonna within seconds! I also got a tres leches coffee and I have to say this was amazing. I normally drink black coffee with no sugar and I was surprised of how good this coffee was. I can't wait to go back and try different things. I keep on looking at the lemon bars on their Instagram account so hopefully next time I go those are up for grabs!

This place was delicious! They had lots of vegan options. I didn't know vegan ice cream could taste like the real deal. They also had lots of options of non vegan ice cream as well. You can taste test them if you'd like. It's a little pricier but worth it!

Did you know that Ghirardelli chocolate is just as good melted and on top of ice cream and on the bottom of a sundae cup as it is in a decadent candy bar? If you've never experienced how wonderful hot Ghirardelli chocolate is, you absolutely need to. I make a point to take my kids to any Ghirardelli Ice cream location. The ice cream is creamy and delicious and just adds to whatever toppings you decide to enjoy. The service is professional and the serving proportions equal the cost. Always happy to increase my calorie intake for Ghirardelli!

I found this gem via yelp. Down the street from my place and next to the lost leaf so I figured I'd give it a shot. I walked in and met Nicholas whom works there. He gave me some suggestions and history about this place. Had me sample some different types of ice cream. He was super helpful and the ice cream was amazing. Apparently everything is made locally and the building itself is very quant, painted pink with neon signs at night and a sweet wooden patio area. They serve their ice cream in a couple cones or a oriental rice/to go box in 2 different sizes. Very cool idea! This is in the art district of downtown phoenix. I support local but even more importantly I support quality. This place is both. :-)

Simply the best strawberry ice cream around! I'm usually a mint chocolate kind of guy, but at this place I always go for the strawberry! I've had a few other flavors here but they just don't compare. The strawberry ice cream is unbelievably smooth and creamy. It has just the right amount of sweetness and tartness from the frozen bits of strawberry. Best of all, this place is very reasonably priced compared to Sweet Moses or Mitchell's. I recently found out that they offer an even smaller portion than the junior, dubbed the "golf ball" for only $1! Great for days where you want dessert but still full from dinner/lunch/breakfast.

What a surprising, pseudo-swanky fall-into-the-rabbit-hole coffee and dessert place. Grant L took us for a taste of Charlotte. The coffee was pretty tasty, and I'm not a dessert eater but the Napoleon looked too decadent to pass up. It was huge, probably 5-6" long, flaky fresh and stuffed with delicious pastry cream. I couldn't finish half of it. Heaven! The star of the show is really the whimsical interior, with a mismatched Alice in Wonderland meets the Mad Hatter meets the Queen of Hearts and Mona Lisa at the pseudo-Versailles kind of vibe. It's bigger than it appears from the outside. Really for adults of all ages, but it's quiet, cozy, eclectic... full of collegiate and twenty-something hipsters on their laptops and iPads. I guess I fit right in! ?!? =p

My all-time favorite! It makes me so happy coming here and eating the birthday cake truffles. As someone who eats cereal daily and nightly, I was excited to try the crunchy cereal milk milkshake along with my truffles, and I was definitely impressed. Love Milk Bar, they couldn't do anything better!

Truly excited to welcome the first matcha cafe in town. I ordered the matcha parfait with matcha and hojicha swirl soft serve. The matcha is rather mild. I personally would like a stronger matcha. The hojicha is perfect. The parfait is filled with red beans, corn flakes, soft mochi, and delicious chestnut. I surely love the different texture in my parfait, crunchiness from the corn flakes abs softness from the mochi. My future order the matcha float. It has so much ice cube (half a cup is literally ice cubes)!. Not only you get mostly ice cube instead of matcha drink, it's also hard to eat the soft serve with that much ice cubes. I'd avoid order this one or I'd request for less ice cubes. The cafe has a nice atmosphere to hang out. It's clean and airy.

I am a drug addict and Amelies is my supplier. My favorites are the fruit tarts, lemon macaron oh and the rose water macaron if you are lucky enough to find them! The pumpkin cream puff is delish IF you love pumpkin. As far as drinks, hot chocolate is my thing but the green powder green tea is pretty good IF you enjoy a good strong kick with a little bitterness I looove it! Oh try the grapefruit soda drink just ask, all the employees are friendly with a capital F. Super busy Friday, Saturday nights with maybe 20 to 25 min wait line. Yes, I wait... Go there Meow!

Their pastries are to die for and we were just there a little over a week ago and they were just as tasty as always although they didn't have a full window shopping area full because their air conditioning was out and they looked short staffed. But what they had was amazing as always. Look forward to going back again really soon.
Very good custard. Recommed the Georgia Peach. Nice to see them making the ice cream from scratch using big metal pails of milk.

Klossis review - I tried the 5boro which is chocolate fudge cookie with chocolate chips and is gluten free and dairy free which is my jam! This cookie is almost paleo except for small amounts of corn starch. It's got a flourless brownie texture and taste which I absolutely loved. Calling this a cookie is just wrong so I think it's misplaced into that but if you want a flattened brownie which gives you that decadent fix - get it! They had two other gluten free and dairy free options which sound interesting with one being more of a energy bar style cookie and the other a simple oats and maple cookie which sounded meh. Any place that has great cookies for the allergy friendly and doesn't taste like cardboard is a win in my book!

The good: the pastries and coffee is amazing. The bad: you can never find a seat. I used to come here to study but it's really not somewhere to concentrate. The baristas are sometimes more interested in anything but you're drink (and keep in mind I don't mind waiting for a good drink). Other than that I will say they have the best decor of anyone else.

Hi guys! I am a phx local and let me tell you.... THIS PLACE IS INCREDIBLE. Their ice cream is delicious, creamy, hand made, and just overall literally the greatest ice cream I've ever had. The owner served us himself and with his lovely staff they made this ice cream and our experience one that we will never forget and one we will soon repeat! AND THEYRE OPEN UNTIL 1am FRIDAY AND SATURDAY !!

This is my favorite bakery. The cakes are so original, and I always order something new every time I come and continue to be impressed. I love the coconut cakes and the lavender cakes. The cakes are not too sweet or creamy, just about right. The desserts are on the expensive side, but the portions are huge. The staff are super friendly, and I love the Victorian theme. This place is quiet, and even when lines form, I never get frustrated because I know that Butterwood is worth the wait.

Good donuts for the price. The salted caramel donut was big and fluffy for 3 dollars. The crepe brÃ»lÃ©e was creek filled and had a crunchy top coating. Friendly service and nice place to pick up unusual donuts.
Amazing bakery. I gave gift cards to Amelie's to my employees, many are from europe and decry the quality of desserts in America. They LOVED Amelie's. Said it was like a taste of home.

I Love AmÃ©lie's!! A small taste of Paris in Charlotte! Tarts: I go for the fruit tarts which are Always AMAZING! I highly recommend. Chicken Salad: Good, The chicken pieces are larger than expected but the taste was just basic. Missing relish for the pop! The wait was not worth the taste. Strawberry Rose lemonade: My friend LOVED it! Me not so much... very acquired taste. Outdoor seating: picnic tables with umbrellas Once again I love AmÃ©lie's and if you have never been I highly recommend you give them a try! You'll love them too! 4/30/21
I got a small chocolate shake, which was good. The chocolate ice cream is very rich. It was $7.00 for a small and I find that to be a bit pricey. The place it very cute and clean. Staff was friendly.

Hands down best ice cream sandwich I've ever had. I ordered there fresh waffle ice cream sandwich which was unreal, the customer service was awesome, really cool place, I will definitely be back again!

I love this place! It's the one bakery on the strip where nothing was too sweet. The wait can be a bit hectic depending on the time of day and the staff will surely mess up your order, but if it's sweet, I'll eat it. I did not detect any artificial flavors here and everything tasted fresh. Came here around noon on 5/9/14 to get my tickets to Buddy's Vegas Uncork'd event, which was awesome btw. Line wasn't too bad, I waited maybe 20 minutes. Staff is young and can be unprofessional... something you would attribute to new college students or graduating high school students. They weren't rude, but it'd be nice to get my order right. Lobster tail - remained crispy for two days! Filling is decadent but not heavy, not too sweet, and absolutely delicious. Cannoli - shell is lightly spiced complementing the ricotta filling. This will soften if you leave it overnight, so eat it soon (like you will have any trouble eating it right away). Rainbow cookies - moist and dense just like I like it. Not too sweet as is often the case with this type of cookie. Cream puff - this was okay, I like the asian cream puffs more. Hazelnut Biscottis - These were perfectly sized, crunchy, and heavy on the hazelnut flavor and nuts. I really liked these and will probably buy a big bag to take home next time. Vanilla hazelnut meringue cookie - strong hazelnut flavor and fun to eat! These were generous with the hazelnuts and definitely crunchy. It satisfies when I need a crunch. Wedding cookies - typical pecan butter cookies, nothing special, but good. Chocolate hazelnut tart - I think I wished it had more nutella flavor, but it was good nonetheless. It was light on the hazelnut aroma. Red velvet cake - this comes with cream cheese frosting filling. It's stronger on the cream cheese flavor and I prefer the roux buttercream with red velvet. The cake was very moist and light, I killed it. Star item: GET THE LOBSTER TAIL! You can even get some to take home as they remain crispy for awhile... at least in the dry dessert heat anyway.

It was alright. I too went in with high expectations and I wish I hadn't. It wasn't bad ice cream, it just didn't live up to all the hype. They are a little skimpy on the hot fudge and very heavy handed with the whip cream. I won't be going back.

Ice cream in a donut... you have to try it. They also have waffle ice cream sandwiches. Did I mention they were heated? You get a wonderful mix of warmth and cold. My favorite flavor was cookie monster. I just love the colors and it adds more to the experience. You can also get two flavors in a dough melt so if you can't choose between two flavors, you can get both. The owners and staff were very friendly and knowledgable. If you're craving sugar, you know where to go.

If you want some good Chinese pastries, I recommend 85° Degrees! This place here has many pastries like: - Pork Sung Bun - Giant Pork Sung Bun - Coconut Buns - Sponge Cake - Garlic Bread - Black Forest Cake - Mango Cake - Almond Cake - Chocolate Cookies And much more! Everytime when me and my cousin go visit this bakery after dinner during the weekend, there's always a long line! We always buy a whole lot of pastries to eat for our family to share. Their pastries are very soft and they don't hardened for a few days, Yay! If you are looking for a special treat for a special someone or wanting to get some pastries, visit here! But I recommend to come during the day time because if you go during night time, their items are gone quick! From my recent visit, I actually got the last sponge cake! Oh, I felt lucky!

Donut mind if I eat all the donuts here- I've been here a handful of times and each a 5 star experience. Their creative donuts like the Big Poppa Tart- the size of yo face- it's a donut w a pop tart in it. S'mores flavor is delish! I love the large backyard- a rarity for downtown businesses where I relax w my Vesta coffee or milk. Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and strawberry split are also inventive and vegan too. On this trip I visited with Chef Jeff- whom owns the place along w his brother. His passion for great service and community involvement has made it a must visit !! Open til sold out and sells out quickly on the weekend so get there in the AM!

Dear Churn, I love you. Peanut butter ice cream. Seriously? You had me at pretzel cone but peanut butter ice cream? How can a girl say no to that? Super cute shop, friendly staff, and a speedy service line makes getting your ice cream craving cured pain free and fun. Love all the knick knacks although the toys right at kid level were pretty devious of you. But...peanut butter ice cream. Yeah. That makes it all better.

A funny thing happened: I had a dream, Of a tiny little building, That made delicious ice cream. Then the guy behind the counter, In that little hut, Took the ice cream and placed it, Between a glazed dough-nut. As I ate the ice cream sandwich, Unlike any other, I had a crazy realization, This was no dream, brother! The place is Novel Ice Cream, It will rock your world. The perfect place to end the night, Get dat chocolate-swirl.
The only place I go to to get my matcha ice cream fix I freaking love this place! So good! And it's such a cute atmosphere! I love the matcha, hojicha, and the earl grey
Amazing ice cream, DEFINITELY recommend! ! And that customer service greatttt. Also during this COVID-19 thing going on they managed to stay open and provide a walk thru window which is soo nice

This place is wonderful!! They always have amazing new ice cream flavors every time I come in. They even have some dairy free vegan options. My favorite seasonal flavor so far was birthday cake but they aren't offering it anymore, at least for now. I've never been disappointed in what I've gotten though! They allow you to sample before you order so that's perfect for picky eaters. And everyone that works there is so nice and friendly!! Overall, excellent experience every single time.

YESSSSS, love macarons... I noticed the sizes aren't so uniform, but that's just me being picky. I think the flavors I enjoyed most were: raspberry, pistachio, vanilla, and chocolate. Oops, is that almost all of them? I think my friend and I bought 12 in the span of two days, yup! If you enjoy a good iced americano, look no further. It is $5, but you do get 4 shots of espresso over ice and very little water. Will definitely stop by on subsequent visits!

Awesome ambience and one of the best places to have Thai ice cream and crepe! Couldn't try the crepe but it looked delicious for sure. Also planning on trying the takoyaki they serve here the next time I go!

I've watched sooo many baking shows and have dreamed about these well known sprinkle cupcakes... what a disappointment today was... cake wasn't dry but had a weird texture to it... I definitely was not wowed by any means... I'd say skip it.

OK. where do i start! I don't have any pictures to post bc it was THAT good! We stopped by this little bakery because the line of people outside caught our eye. WORTH THE WAIT, the napoleon pastry dessert is out of this world!! The cream is the best part Do yourself a favor and grab this dessert, you won't be disappointed! We grabbed a variety of desserts and they were all good as well!

Such wonderful ice cream!! The texture is joyously creamy and the flavors are rich and encompass the standards and many creative ones -- like orange blossom (outstanding!) and honey graham -- all at excellent prices. The staff is patient and friendly. There's plenty of outdoor seating; there's no indoor seating as this is a large ice cream stand, but much of the seating is under an awning. My only complaint is that oddly -- although like other places I've seen around Cleveland -- it looks like only a few flavors can be used for milkshakes (and I keep forgetting to ask why that is), which is too bad as many of the other flavors would make incredible milkshakes.

They are perfection! I wanted to have some really special and interesting flavors of hand cakes for my cousin's bridal shower and Butterwood MORE than delivered! I was planning the event from another state so I had to do everything via email. They were so easy to work with! They had great flavor suggestions. I also asked if they could put just a few fresh flowers on a few of the cakes to be pretty. When it was finally the day to pick them up, pick up was a breeze. I didn't open the box until we got home and CHILLS!!! I literally got chills for how gorgeous the cakes were! Each one was a perfect little masterpiece. I ordered 5 flavors, 3 for the shower and 2 for the bachelorette part to follow. They were too gorgeous, so all 5 went to the shower! All of the ladies oohed and ahhed over them. But that wasn't even the best part: they tasted AMAZING!! I couldn't be happier with Butterwood!! They really added a special touch to a special day! I just wished I still lived in Pittsburgh so I could visit there all of the time and try all of their amazing treats and interesting flavors! Also, side note, though I just stopped in to pick up the cakes, the shop is also amazing! Great decor and atmosphere! I'd die to be on a date with my man or my mum here! PERFECTION all around!! THANK YOU BUTTERWOOD!!

I scrolled through Google to find the closest Boba place and found Rewind. It was so worth the 15 minutes! I LOVED EVERYTHING I ORDERED. The staff was so kind and friendly, the atmosphere was so calming. A good place to sit down and enjoy your boba. The decor is so aesthetically pleasing. It was so delicious, I almost cried it was gone. The rose milk latte was so fresh and sweet which is how I love my boba. I also tried the house coffee with rose cream (not pictured) was so good and refreshing. It was Literal perfection! I cannot wait to come back!

I should never have tried this place...it's all I can think about now! The worst part is that it's near my gym, so I am tempted to go every time I workout, thus defeating the purpose of actually working out. Oh well, I can't help it... I love you Sweet Republic. I love that cinnamon ice cream I can't remember the name of and the honey blue cheese ice cream is really unique. You have ruined me, I no longer care for anything else and now I have to workout twice as hard because I know there is no way that I can resist. You have melted my will power!

Had heard a lot about this place and was excited to try it. Real French bakeries are few and far between. Sadly this one does not live up to the hype. The baking side of the business is, frankly poor. The croissants an derivatives are dry an bready not flaky. Under cooked with very little color and flat tasting. They remind me do the industrial ones at Costco or Starbucks. In fact Starbucks new breakfast fare now rolling out across the country's is better than the croissants at this bakery. The bakers are cutting corners, but there is vey little butter in these croissants and no flavor or texture. So if you are looking for a good French croissant keep driving. Coffee is brewed weak and the blend has little character. The pastries are better and the macaroons quite good. But again nothing special. But clearly I'm in a minority. The place is a gold mine always busy and the environment is pleasant enough. I'd go to Central Coffee instead. Their pastries are also made on site and are quite good. And the coffee there is superior.

I've been here a few times and for some reason always hope it will improve. I love Cake Boss and admire Buddy and his team's attention to detail and love for baking, but this bakery is a huge disappointment. I'm sure the original in Hoboken is incredible but don't waste your time here. The cakes on display aren't impressive and look like anyone made them at home. The cupcakes are extremely dry and none of the pastries look fresh. There are two lines: one to order and one to pay and both are extremely unorganized. I just went yesterday for the first time in two years and realized it hadn't gotten any better. Hopefully they will eventually improve to the standard of what viewers expect when coming to this renowned bakery. Until then, I won't be back.
Everyone I'm in AZ I stop here. Fantastic small batch ice cream. Campfire S'mores today. Creamy, sweet, perfect finish to the evening! Support this gem!

There are few experiences comparable to being handed a warm, sliced doughnut with artisan ice cream packed in between the two sides. The warmth that spreads from the doughnut to your hand and up your arm is surpassed when you begin to devour the treat and you are granted a dawning realization that this is how doughnuts and ice cream were meant to be consumed all along. Customer service is absolutely fantastic--pretty sure they somehow recognized me and my spouse even though it had been over 10 months since we were last there and we were wearing masks--or at least they're really good at reading body language and they knew we'd been there before. They greeted us like old friends. It's obvious they love what they do and we love them for it. Anytime we find ourselves in the downtown area for a date night, we try to cap off our evening by hitting up Novel. Do yourself a favor and try them! Finally, Grand gets pretty busy on Saturday nights because the car crowd has started to parade around and check each other's heavily modified rides. We parked on Polk and made the short walk along Grand. I'd say you're probably better off finding a similar close side street instead of trying to drive along Grand and park right at Novel.

Cute place, delish treats. They even have old school candy. "Oh My, Razzles." We were just talking about them and how we could not find them anywhere. I love their Salted Caramels, yum. I also had a scoop of pretty darn good coconut ice cream. I love this darling little shop. By the way, the girl who works there is delightful. The only negative is that a lady came in with a Non- Service dog. That is a big no no for me.

Wow! The perfect combination of creamy, sweet and flavorful ice creams with a beautiful melt. Not a lot of frilly flavors, just the basics, but done so very well. Vanilla bean and double chocolate in a cup: total yum! Best ice cream in Phoenix, no doubt.

Chocolate crossant is ok, mix berry tart is cold and too sweet. Limited choices, ok envirinment. Syrange way to pay bills, that cashier have to open each box to see what is inside and then put in the price.

*March 2018 Update* The location inside the house in the arts district is closed. According to the girl working, the lease was up. They are now located in Jobot coffee shop on 3rd and Roosevelt. When we arrived, there was just a small set up outside with few flavors and no toppings, same price though. I do love Melt, so I am hoping the service and quality to return after they are settled inside Jobot. Fingers crossed Great little ice cream shop in the Roosevelt Arts district. The flavors are unique and the prices are average for a mom/pop type place in this area. The serve the ice cream in a Chinese to-go box with a fortune cookie, which is both creative and Instagram worthy. Some of the flavors are poorly named, leaving you to ask what 'Arizona Sunset' is. If he place is empty, it's fine, but when you have a line out the door, it's time consuming.

We went during happy hour!! (About 12.30pm) you can fit as many donuts as you can in their big rectangle box for $10. Or they have buy 1 get 1. The donuts were absolutely delicious. There didn't seem to be the full selection that's written on the daily board, but that could be due to the time of day we went. I love this area and it's a refreshing little dessert place to try when you are in the area or are going for a specific treat!
I just had a hot fudge sundae here, and I enjoyed it very much. Ice creams and chocolates also available. Price was reasonable given the good quality.

Good flaky, airy, croissant but i've had better. The almond chocolate croissant was good too but have to eat right away otherwise the outside get hard, the almond paste inside is a litte soggy for me, but still nice flavor, not too sweet.

The kids here were extremely friendly and even encouraged us to try each flavor! What a nice change of service service opposed to the typical ice cream parlor attitude!! Ice Cream was good and is average price! We will be back!!

Vegas has a reputation for being up all night but try to grab a snack after 11 PM and you will be out of luck - EXCEPT for MILK which I walked for a mile down the Strip to try and was completely satisfied with the sweet treats I got for my me and my sweetheart. I was so focused on making sure my lover had her sweet-tooth satisfied that I walked away with the moonpies, shakes and cookies and forgot my change - the super honest cashiers hollered for me to come get it - hey it was change for a hundred, we are talking big Vegas bucks here. Honesty like that should net MILK six stars here but you will not go wrong snacking here.
Delicious ice cream, cookies, macarons, waffle cones...everything. Our new favorite ice cream spot
Today had a Bourbon Caramel toffee ice cream with Donut, it was amazing.. staff are so friendly..

Had heard great things about this place and with the temperatures around 110 degrees, decided to cool off with strawberry ice cream in a waffle cone. Really friendly staff and super quick with the order. Ice cream was very good and they have a nice outdoor seating area with lots of shade and good music.

I was very impressed with the cake I ordered from Kaya Tate at Hopscotch for the Mother's Day holiday. Kaya has a very creative approach to pastry cooking, and I love her design aesthetic and presentation. I would highly recommend Kaya's services for a wedding, holiday or other special occasion. Her small business recently moved into a new space on John Street in Champaign, and I'm excited to see Hopscotch continue to grow in the future.

Came by for the Strawberry Split. Last time we came at almost closing time and they were pretty much out of everything. I walked in and was so happy to see the Strawberry Split! It was huge! My husband got the Expresso Chocolate and my chocoholic friend went for the Triple Chocolate Threat after being disappointed that they didn't have the Chocolate Euphoria today. Theirs were both cake donuts and we felt they weren't anything too special. My friend commented the Chocolate Threat was not even Chocolatey enough and I agree. I came here for the Strawberry and I was not disappointed. The donut is bit crusty like a croissant. I would prefer like a soft donut but my husband and friend enjoyed the "crust" the way it was. My husband also commented that it reminded him of a Chinese birthday cake. I felt satisfied with what I had been waiting for....months or years...

Was scrambling to look for a bakery in the area and this popped up. Been driving pass this place so many times and never knew that they existed. This place has a very unique selection (in terms of flavors) of cupcakes, cakes, parfait, baked pastries and brownies. I adore their modern and rustic buttercream designs. I also appreciate that they offer gluten free options. I gotta say, if you're looking for plain vanilla, this place is not for you. I got 6/7 items from here. They're a good mix of cupcakes, pies and brownies. The buttercream on the cupcakes are delicious! Not overly sweet yet very light. If you're a fan of blueberries, try their blueberry oatmeal crumble. Otherwise, you won't go wrong with their chocolate brownies. It's one of the best brownies I've tasted!

Such a great concept!! My friends and I stopped by on opening day and stood in the rain to get the milkshakes (order the milkshakes)!! Between the 3 of us we got the Fresh Prince'ess of Bel'Air, Strawberry Shortcake, & the Buttercup. Talk about good and the shakes didn't last 10 mins. The options for non milk options have a good range, whole, 2%, skim, almond and Oat. They offer regular whip cream for all the shakes and you can build your own with any of the cereals on the wall. This will def be a good Birthday treat alternative & quick date spot. The straws make it easy to drink your shake fast, so take it slow. Enjoy every bite & make sure to ask for a cute golden spoon so you can munch on your cereal at the end. Will definitely be back!

They only had one soft serve flavor as an option. Soft serve was good. But with the lack of variety only one of my kids consumed and I was running around looking for an alternative option for my other son.

11 months I've been on a very good diet and I've been eating junkie as of this month if I start my diet seriously again, I better come to this place before I start LOL My friend Kristopher brought me to this place he warned me that this was not just a donut place. Once upon a Time before I was serious on a diet. I tried every donut place in town. I can compare other donut places and other cities. None can compare to this! This place is off the hook!! This is like a little Hangout you can get your awesome coffee, make it anyway you want and chill with your buddies or on the go. I was looking on the wall display of literatures that this place has a lot of recognition. It's been in couple magazines and I could see why. Just a heads up where I'm trying to explain. These are not just ordinary donuts. They're probably pricey. But rest assure it's worth buying. The Mastermind of this company has design a style and crafted with passion into these donuts. Seriously I'm not kidding I wouldn't be writing this. And my buddy Kristopher was not kidding when he was trying to tell me about this place. I had to see for myself. The ladies that was working behind the counter is pretty awesome too, They know how to move a long line fast with rhythm, they have good personality and the company's lucky to have them. And even if I did start my serious diet again. I may not be able to eat these, but I have friends that does : ) I'm pretty positive I'll be buying here for my friends and family. If you love donuts or have company with you. This is the place to take them if you want to explore or have fun or to hang out. There it is! Maybe I don't have to eat sweets. Just because this place is awesome I can buy my tea here and have my buddies eat these delicious gourmet donuts! Anyway I got to get one more donut : )

Staff is incredibly rude. I got there at 5pm, there were like 5 customers in the store, two employees were standing at the door, one looks like manager held the door for customers. When I tried to enter the manager simply said "we closed", and directly shut the door on my face. I almost hit the door. I was shocked. Then she reopened and explained "grand opening is dec", close the door again. No sorry or anything. I didn't even get a chance to talk. Why are you so rush?? I'm not try to break into the store, and your open sign was on. I know you had a busy day but that's not how you serve people.
The salted caramel brownie might be the best sweet I've ever had! Wasn't terribly impressed with their croissants, which is what kept me from giving 5 stars.

The weekend I moved to Charlotte, my buddy and I decided to get some brunch and were pleasantly surprised by the quality and deliciousness of what is on offer here. It was early but there was already a line forming which is a testament to how popular the place is. We ordered a few sandwiches, some coffee and some pastries and all of them were fantastic and the decor positively compliments the food. Would highly recommend this place!

I like Amelie's. I will take any out-of-town visitor there just for the experience and a look-see at some of Charlotte's most bizarre interior design ever. Great place for people watching and gathering with a group. I definitely don't understand the cult-like following this place seems to have gathered, though. Incredible selection of pastries and all things sweet. But it's almost too much for someone like me- I tend to stick to croissants and baguettes with yummy toppings and cheeses rather than tarts with glazes or macaroons the size of cheeseburgers. I think my main thing with Amelie's is that it is sensory overload on every level possible and I'm just not that kind of customer. But will I keep returning? Definitely. Nothing else like it. And besides- once you've tasted the caramel salted brownie you're basically hooked for life, even if you never order one again. The very idea keeps luring you back....

Dessert crepes!!! What more can I say. I couldn't believe that while walking around aimlessly in Cleveland that I would find my little "crepe" of heaven. They make the crepes while you wait.
