Don't understand all the hype and outrageous prices! Was highly disappointed, soft serve was disgusting, my children didn't even like it. And their kids, what kids would say no thanks? Got myself a slice of cake, over priced, it was dry, we will not stop here again.

Ummmm...don't really understand the hype. The flavors are good, minus the sweet cream which is oddly bitter, and the folks are super nice...but every time I go there, the ice cream is too cold. Like I stuck my tongue on frozen steel cold. Weird. But try for yourself, it's becoming a Scottsdale/Phoenix institution I guess.

This place was fantastic!! Well okay I haven't actually EATEN there, but my boyfriend picked up a slice of pumpkin cheesecake and double chocolate cheesecake from Presti's for my birthday. It was FANTASTIC! Especially the pumpkin. I made him go back and get another slice of pumpkin the following weekend! Probably some of the best cheesecake I've had in my life. And I've had a lot of cheesecake...

I love love love chocolate, and when I visited Ghirardelli, it was like a chocolate heaven! When I walked in, I saw several lines of different flavors of chocolate and caramels aligned on the walls. There was a cute area for the seating and an area for the ice cream making. My friends and I ordered cocoa floats. A cocoa float is a cup filled completely with vanilla bean ice cream with chilled hot chocolate poured over the top. DELICIOUS. I wish I had taken a picture, but it was too good that I completely forgot. Overall, Ghirardelli was a success. And I will definitely be coming back for more.
Best ice cream we've had in a long long time. Great flavor selection, lots of servers and decent prices. Wish we lived closer to come back!
Good locally sourced ice cream and delicious homemade cones. Why don't they have malt to make shakes better? I'm not entirely sure. Even still, it's a pretty awesome little funky ice cream shop.

Went there for an inexpensive afternoon snack. Outside seating is nice - although it is right by a bus stop and the main street. Previous reviews indicated that it was a little gem within expensive restaurants. I couldn't disagree more. The ham and cheese baguette I had was probably one of the worst I have ever had. It was old, dry and rubbery/chewy. They did however offer to toast my bitten into sandwich. Bouchon quality for me means freshly made to order sandwiches and not pre-made old ones from the morning. Very disappointed.

On a recent trip to Vegas, I was so excited to take my mother to Carlo's Bakery. I must say, we were underwhelmed, to say the least. Of the five employees working, we noted not a single smile. At best, they seemed bored and uninterested. That was disappointing. Then, there was the food. We ordered a brownie, red velvet cupcake and a cannoli. They didn't even have regular cannoli, so we got a chocolate chip cannoli. Not a single dessert impressed. They were all just average. We bought cupcakes from the grocery store bakery a few days later that we all agreed were better. Sad, sad experience. Maybe the Cake Boss has over-extended himself. . . .Is quantity having a negative impact on quality?

What an awesome addition to the neighborhood. Delicious desserts, great coffee, friendly staff, and open late. We've made our way to Butterwood a few times post-dinner and have been so pleased. Great selection even late into the night. Hope to try some savory quiche sometime soon.

Updated 6/13/22: After writing my review below about the cracked ice cream cone, the team at Churn reached out to me wanting to hear more about my experience. I sent them an email and they were generous enough to send me a $15 gift card in the mail. I have now been back twice and can truly say that this is the best ice cream in the Valley (of all the places I've tried so far!). I am absolutely obsessed with the Double Chocolate and Peanut Butter combo. It is so incredibly creamy and flavorful. It reminds me a lot of the consistency of Jeni's ice cream (of which I am a big fan!). I am fortunate enough that I get my nails done at Prose nearby, so you can bet you'll see me at Churn every few weeks. And in between, I'll make any excuse to get there. For sure the best scoop shop to take out-of-towners (just wish they had more indoor/outdoor seating!).

Talk about Instagram-worthy desserts! We stumbled upon this location in a hidden strip mall after a day out of shopping. So glad we did! We both ordered milkshakes and they were SO TASTY. I can't wait to come back and try their sandwiches and other unique desserts.
If you like donuts this place is a must. Just get there early as they will sell out of the choice donuts.

DELISH! This place is great! Atmosphere - 10 Ice Cream - 9 Price - 4 My husband and I split a peanut butter/chocolate lover dream sundae there and it was so so good! The place is setup as a old fashion soda fountain/candy/ice cream shop and it is done up perfectly. My only complaint is that it is bit pricey for what you get - so it is a bit of a splurge.

The pistachio macaron was THE BEST thing I ate in Vegas. And I was eating quite a bit. Unbelievably intense in flavor. You will not forget the taste. I also had the eclaire and croissant, both good but average. The macaroon was far better.
Line too long & the staff too slow. Such a bummer!
YOU MELT MY HEART! But seriously, that chocolate rose pistachio ice cream blew me away. Please bring it back! Best ice cream ever!

The pastries are a little stale. Had the chocolate eclair. The filling seemed a little too cold and the pastry lacked flavor. A bit of a line and wait to get the pastry unless you go early in the morning or in the afternoon. I would say not worth the money nor time required.

I can't even remember how long it has been since I have daydreamed of sinking my teeth into the infamous Milk Bar birthday cake. I've lost count of the number of times I have considered visiting NYC just so I can try the compost cookie and crack pie. When Milk Bar opened in Vegas, I finally had my chance! The bakery is right next to Momofuku restaurant. It's just a little walk-up booth where you can order your sweets to go. We had a birthday cake delivered to our table when we were eating at Momofuku. It tasted like a really good funfetti cake. It was a little dry, and had crunchy balls throughout which added a nice texture. Overall, it wasn't the best birthday cake I have had (susiecakes is much better). I also purchased 3 cookies which were also underwhelming. They aren't fresh baked at the store, instead they are shipped in prepackaged from NYC. They tasted a little stale and artificial. I would pass on coming back here again.

I love the atmosphere of Amelies. It's nice to have a 24 hour spot in CLT. The coffee is fantastic and love getting the French Press. The only item I don't like are there croissants. They don't seem to have the puff pastry layered very well and there is no Almond croissant available. There is a very hard overcooked double-baked croissant with an Almond filling, but won't be ordering that again. The macaroons are wonderful, the Ecalir was perfect and of course the famous Salted Caramel brownie is the best.
Great service, pretty atmosphere & delicious boba drinks. They're hardworking here and make amazing drinks! Totally recommend :)

Parking: I arrived at this location around 9PM at night and the parking was FULL. Very hard to find parking and when I did find parking, customers had their cars overlapped into the adjacent spot. So yeah, it aggravated me just a little. Inside the Cafe: First impression? Wow. This is a small place. It was genuinely busy. The line stretched all the way to the backroom. My friends and I waited about 10 minutes just to get to see the actual sweets and food. Menu: It's a cute menu. Hard to read when you're all the way in the back. Food: Expensive. Almost $2 per macaron & not a very wide selection of macarons either. I bought some sort of chocolate cake while my friends decided to get the macarons. My cake was $6-ish. It was very sweet. I didn't finish it because it was just too sweet for me to finish. The macarons that my friends bought were slightly stale. They weren't too impressed with the visit either. It might have been just that night. I'll try again when I'm in the area.

Right when you happily find Sprinkles you have an important choice to make. Ice cream or cupcakes So we did both! Two kids had cupcakes, the other 4 had ice cream! They don't have tons to pick from, here it's quality over quantity! Both kids went for the red velvet cupcake, the only complaint was too sweet Now let's go to the ice cream side. You can sample what you'd like and they have different flavored waffle cones. I have an allergy and they were informative and also Knowledgeable. For 4 ice creams 3 double scoops in waffle cones it was around $26 which to me that was good! The two cupcakes and a 3 pack of mini cupcakes it was $18. Everyone one on both sides are nice and helpful! We signed up for rewards and walked out earning One. Incentive to go back sooner than later.

Amazing lemon basil sorbet!! It was super tangy, not too sweet and just a hint of basil. My bf had bourbon caramel ice cream and said it was over the top delicious. The shop is located next to a few other unique shops that share a common courtyard with plenty of seating. The customer service is outstanding, too. The owner kept offering sample after sample without tire. I'm hoping next time we return they have a different vegan offering, but if not, I don't mind as that lemon -basil was delicious.

One of the things I appreciate about Novel Ice Cream is that even though there's a super long line, the employees don't rush you and encourage you to sample flavors, whether it's your first time or not! That makes it so it's not just delicious ice cream between doughnuts, but you get that priceless feeling of being a valued customer! Only complaint is that it's fairly small and you'll want more, for sure

It was just ok for me, I come from Chicago and we have a lot of old school ice cream parlors there so im kinda biased. As for Vegas ice cream parlors it does the job...their ice cream is very creamy and they have variety of flavors. My disappointment was when I ordered a shake and asked for it extra thick only because there on the sign you can get it extra thick with a $.75 charge. Upon getting the shake I found it to be really liquidy, maybe that's what they considered thick... my definitions of extra thick is when you need to eat with a spoon. The prices are a tad high for the amount of ice cream you receive and the best day to go is $2 Tuesday. Wish they had more seating areas as well. Overall, this place is not bad but nothing more than 2 stars from me. Its good for those hot summer nights and you want to bring the fams out for a treat. I guess for family bonding time. Check it out... you might like it!!

Amazing Pastries and the BEST gluten free Breakfast sandwich that I have ever had. I would highly recommend this. It's a good spot if you need to study, want to have coffee with a friend, are in a hurry but want a good breakfast to go, and it will fulfill your sweet tooth and exceed your expectations. I LOVE the gluten free options. It is so nice to have a place that offers not only gluten free, but delicious gluten free options.

I'll start off by saying that I'm completely biased toward Handel's. I'm from Youngstown, Ohio where this ice cream chain originated not 10-20 years ago, but 70 years ago. Because I've been eating this ice cream since the 80s, this ice cream is my standard and what I use to compare everything else. As far as their service procedure, one person is at the window and he/she takes your order, makes it, and cashes you out. Everything is made when ordered, including hand packing the pints and quarts. There are no seating areas aside from a few benches. This is the way it's done at the original Handel's on Market and Midlothian in which you go and wait at least 15-20 minutes in line and you eat ice cream inside or outside your car. Should they continue this procedure like it's 1945? Absolutely not and hopefully they'll make some changes. For now, just be prepared for the wait and to enjoy your ice cream somewhere else beside a table or bench. We shared the banana split this last visit and it was the same delicious ice cream as it always is. Some may think the sweetness and creaminess factors are high, but they are just right to me. 70 years worth of satisfied customers will also agree with me.

OK, this is my first visit here and to be honest I was not really impressed. First the area around the bakery is a scary area of town. it is absolutely horrible with train tracks and worn down buildings and homes. I have been told that NODA is a hipster central but I really do not see it that way. it is not swanky at all and its pretty close to central avenue in appearance. As far as the bakery goes we had Chesse croissonts, apple turnovers and regular croissants and it was just OK. There was nothing out of the ordinary with regards to the food we ordered. we had a major problem with the lady at the counter as she was giving our order just cold and when I asked her " Are you not going to warm it for us" she retorted "Oh you want this warmed up" as if a cold Croissaont tastes so much better than a warm one.. Duh.. Also all our food was served by the server in 1 plate when the order taker knew it was for two and a second empty plate had to be requested.. The seating here is also limited and it feels very congested as one of the tables next to the ordering counter are in the way of people standing in line to order their food. Overall not a pleasant expereince from all the congestion, lack of good service from the questions etc and we were not at all impressed.. Since we live in the North side of town we would certainly not return to this worn down area of town to eat in this not so impressive bakery..

Vegan review: 5/5 Stars, recommend. Soy Black Cherry is fantastic! The vegan options are great, the selection is wide for the standard fare, and there's room enough to eat your ice cream indoors when it's too cold out. (You don't want the ice cream to freeze solid!)

Tons of flavors to choose from! My favorites were probably the creme brÃ»lÃ©e! The outer crust of the donut was nice and hard just like the top of creme brÃ»lÃ©e! Some other good ones we had were Boston cream, very chocolate, and the apple bacon fritter. They had a steady flow of traffic coming through the doors. The staff was super friendly, patient, and helpful. They also serve coffee. I had an Americano. It was light years ahead of anything I've had from Starbucks. Overall wonderful and pleasant experience.

Although slightly expensive, Bouchon has the best chocolate and chocolate almond croissants on the strip. I have tried these croissants at many other places (Aria, Caesar's, etc.), and Bouchon has the best. Crispy, airy croissants with a ton of filling. It's not greasy and it's so delicate. The macarons are delicious. The blueberry croissants were interesting, but not as good. Very tart and too much filling so it made it mushy. The Kouign Amann is good too. I was at the Palazzo at the Venetian, so I was lucky enough to stop by Bouchon every morning. Delicious!

I called on Thursday 4/14/2016 business was closed for day. But, manager Joe answer phone called. I was excited was able to speak to someone.. I placed a order for a birthday party of 23rd of April. I was told I would get a call back to confirm. .Well I've been calling them myself for 4 days straight. Seeing if order was place and will be ready for pick up on 23rd.. sent business emails.. all i have to say is Don't bother with this place!! Not reliable. . Rather take business else where..

Get ready to get ice cream wasted because one scoop is going to be what it takes to fill your stomach! The portions are huge it's crazy! Went with my family (7 people) each ordered something different from single scoops to hurricanes to 4 scoop sampler and paid $30 which is great! And we still couldn't finish all of it! There's a huge selection of ice cream nothing too unique but most likely going to find a flavor you at least would want. For the prices and servings it's great. Not sure if I'd return for a particular craving but definitely a good place to experience.

I went to jeni's for the grand opening in south end where they were giving our FREE ice cream. I was in line for like 1hr 30mins but it was sooo worth it. The employees let me try as many flavors as I wanted even with the huge crowd & when I say free ice cream I don't mean like a little cone with barley any ice cream. They actually let us get anything we wanted on the menu which I thought was pretty neat. They are about to open a 2nd location in NODa which I'm really happy about & they also sell pints in Harris teeter & Publix now.

Love this place! Cute retro feel, super friendly and helpful staff and amazing ice cream. My favorite is cookies and mint, but they change out their flavors pretty frequently. Last time I was in, they had buttermilk grapefruit which was awesome. Totally reminds me of one of the crazy flavor combos at Allegro (Tucson gelato place).

Love this place! Open 24/7 They have a great assortment of decedent desserts as well as sandwiches, soups, coffee, tea and more. Their asparagus soup is to die for! Their salted caramel brownie is amazing too!! Definitely make a trip here, it's well worth it!!

This place had tasty ice cream milkshakes and among other items. I tried the strawberry shortcake cheesecake milkshake and was impressed. The milkshake wasn't overprices, they had variety, and the ability to customize. I would recommend Ninety's Ice Cream to anyone looking for a good place with sweet treats.

Seen a video about this donut shop on YouTube and was intrigued to try it out. Got there a little late and yes they sell out fast. Was able to get a blue berry big daddy and a jelly filled donut. Pop tart donut was definitely a must try. Its taste was as unique as its look. The other donut was ok. Nothing cray to jump about. However I will definitely come back but allot earlier in the morning.

Decided to take the kids out since they haven't been anywhere much since the pandemic. Wasn't sure what to expect, was under the impression of just eating various cereals in a bowl. The thought to turn cereal into a dessert is pretty neat. They have a variety of options from bowls to shakes as well as milk alternatives. The kids as well as myself enjoyed it and can't wait to visit again.
Huge delicious macaroons! I have tried like 5 other macaroon places in LA and still have not found any macaroons as big or as delicious as Bouchon Bakery.

I tried this place after reading great reviews on social media sites. I have to say that the reviews were spot on; this place is fantastic. The staff was quite helpful when I went to place my order. I bought a variety of their donuts, and they were all excellent. Definitely call before going because the shop tends to sell out. I cannot wait to go again.
Love their sticky pecan buns and cotton candy macaroons, mousse cups are delicious I love this place

Love Amelie's! Great coffee and terrific sweet treats. Went here with my daughter and she loves the croissants and italian soda. I love the coffee. The new location on Hwy 51 in Pineville is outstanding.
A great little French bakery in NoDa. Love it to death. I'm often found there after my usual stops at a neighboring hookah bar.

We stopped by their location at Ross Park Mall to pickup some sweets. They have so many options to choose from, it's so hard to pick! They have chocolate covered strawberries, edible cookie dough, cupcakes, truffles, cookies, and so much more! The cupcakes are big and so cute!

this a great little place to get doughnuts, and they are really really good. THE HELP ARE ALWAYS FRIENDLY., and very helpful. If you are around that area make sure to stop and give them a try you will be glad you did!
wasn't a personal fan i thought it was a little over priced.can find better donuts elsewhere

We all remember that famous line from the movie Jerry McGuire " You had me at Hello " Okay the second most famous line after " Show me the Money " Well it's exactly how I felt when I saw the pink cupcake dispenser. Sprinkles had me there. My heart literally melted. I'm just a sucker for cuteness, what can I say? Instead of going inside the Sprinkles store, I decided to bypass it and go straight for the ATM. At this point, I'm happy beyond words and even get more excited when I go to the screen that has the cupcake flavors listed. Menu: Which cupcake do I get?! - Red Velvet - Triple Cinnamon - Salted oatmeal cornflake - Cinnamon Sugar - Double chocolate - Dark chocolate - Black and White - Vanilla milk chocolate - Vanilla Price: For $4.25 each cupcake, I wanted to get greedy and order one of each flavor but instead ended up ordering just one, my absolute favorite, Red Velvet. Once I swiped the card, the little pink door slowly opened and like magic, my small brown box with the delicious treat inside was waiting for me. The red velvet cupcake was everything a cupcake should be moist, sweet and was perfectly made for my mouth. It was oh so good! After literally devouring this tasty dessert, I walked inside the Sprinkles stores. It all looked so tempting, the variety of cupcakes, red waffles cones and ice cream. Tip: The red velvet cupcake is the best. No need for me to say more. Located: The Link Promenade, directly across from Caesars Palace and next door the Flamingos. Experience: Sprinkles Cupcakes is so good and proves the best things come in the smallest packages.

Amazing ice cream! I had a dough melt with cookie monster ice cream and both the ice cream and the donut were top notch. Awesome, cozy location. The owner was super nice and informative. Will recommend to anyone!
If you're in Chambana in the warm season, this is the local flavor. Pick the shortest of three lines. Its old school. Made fresh daily. Worth the wait.

Excited to come here & wanted to try everything but I opted for the famous crack pie, it was way smaller than I thought & wasn't fresh it was prepackaged. The cookie was good but not mind blowing. The soft serves were ok but honestly they were way TOO SWEET for our liking. My daughter did not even want to finish it because it was too sweet & that is a big deal since kids love all things sweet. All in all I think my $30 could have been spent elsewhere!
Love this place !! I tried the 4 scoop sample.. You cannot go wrong with any type of ice cream you choose.

After having a great time at the Brooklyn Bowl we where headed home and decided to give sprinkles a shot. We are not cupcake fans and I really don't like sweets. So we split one cupcake just for the hell of it. I can't remember which cupcake we had but it was extremely sweet I couldn't t finish my half and wifey wasn't impressed either. I could imagine if I had a whole one I would be bouncing off the walls.
I love this bakery! The salted caramel brownie is amazing. Macaroons are delicious! Leek soup was good
Who doesn't love a great donut! I couldn't decide so I got the Homer and the Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e and both are delicious. I love fresh and soft and they are both.
Yum! Great tasting ice cream. I have been here twice. Love $2 Tuesday even though the line is very long.

I would wait an eternity or drive a thousand miles for this stuff!!!! Crack on a cone! It was nice to see families getting together to enjoy some ice cream on a hot night and standing in line talking to each other about what to choose while they waited for their time at the old fashioned outside window. So far I've tried Bananas Foster, Butter Pecan, Salted Carmel Pretzel and Graham Central Station-Holy Cow! Not a bad one in the bunch!!!! ***Bonus***next door is Anna's Italian Bistro which is excellent!!!! Save room for dessert and step next door to Handels-truly a perfect evening!

Recently came here with my wife. The place seemed very disorganized and chaotic. The ice cream and everything just okay. My wife got a sundae and by the time she received it the ice cream was already melted.

Ice cream is amazing! We had the indecisive and was able to try 5 scoops! Honey lavender was aaamazing. Loved the cookie monster. Such good flavor. FYI limited parking. Small venue with outdoor seating, so plan accordingly in 104 degree heat! Great service!
Great donuts and cute atmosphere. Frequently service and such a selection. Go check it out.

Highly recommend! They have great flavors if you want to try something new, or if you just want the classics. Most importantly it is family owned by very sweet and nice people. They will make sure you're happy with your purchase.

Visited here with a friend today- it was our first time trying matcha as a flavor and had heard great things so we were excited to try it out! The store had a very cute aesthetic- amazing decorations inside, very clean and a good amount of seating The individuals working the register were all very kind and allowed me to sample to matcha and toasted matcha flavor! I ordered a matcha and ube swirl cone and my friend ordered the Maiko special. Both came out quick and aesthetically were very pleasing A tip for anyone wanting to try something new: a few of the toppings in the Maiko special (jelly, mochi, etc) are not sweet/have no distinct flavor so keep this in mind!! I would recommend this location to others :)

Matcha Cafe Maiko is a must-visit! The store itself is beautifully designed and decorated; creating a warm and relaxed, trendy atmosphere. The menu is vast with matcha ice cream, iced matcha, hot matcha, matcha lattes, shaved ice matcha and more. I had the strong matcha ice cream and it was the real deal, strong matcha taste and beautiful color. The staff and owner are all so friendly and helpful. I absolutely recommend Matcha Cafe Maiko and it is one of my new favorite places!

Fudge creation was a dream, best I ever Tasted. Was tucked in almost missed it. Could use a small billboard sign that you take in at night, to let passerby's know that you are there. We almost passed it up but we're determined to have a treat. Great ice cream !!

Wow. This place was awesome. Came across it when I was walking around downtown with a friend... We couldn't resist the signs for milkshakes and chocolate outside. We immediately went over to the ice cream. The man who was working was super friendly and when I mentioned yelp (considering when you check in there you get a free chocolate pretzel with your purchase) he told me to mention him by full name, so Nolan Anthony Sanders- thanks for being so helpful and overall awesome! Anyway, back to the sweets. I got a scoop of blackberry cheesecake ice cream on a sugar cone. My friend ordered the salted caramel pretzel ice cream with a sugar cone. With every lick of this ice cream I couldn't believe how amazing it was. Real blackberry purÃ©e, and creamy cheesecake ice cream-- oh my gosh. I want some right now. My friend loved her ice cream as well. I also got a cinnamon sugar white chocolate covered graham cracker- which was amazing as well. The chocolate was so creamy! For my free pretzel, I got a milk chocolate covered pretzel. It was good, but it didn't impress me too much. I like a thick coating of chocolate on mine and this one was quite thin. It wasn't bad though. I would love to try their awesome unique flavored chocolate covered pretzels! I then noticed they have Red Ribbon soda- locally made soda with out of this world flavors. I was so excited! The almond creme soda is amazing! (Thank you yelp for introducing me to the soda at the burgh bash!) I had to buy two bottles! I will return ASAP! I need more blackberry cheesecake ice cream in my life. Now.

Super cute place. I'm still new to matcha so it takes some time to pick an item. But take a peek at the menu before you go in. And they have ice cream!!! Try the ube flavor! I'm definitely going back!

VERY Yummy! I was so happy to see Bouchon Bakery as soon as I hoped off the elevator this morning. I paid them a visit, twice :) The bread pudding was SO good and the chocolate Bouchon amazing! What a nice treat this morning, accompanied by a non fat latte. Later in the day I had another and tried a double chocolate cookie, everything looked amazing. This is the perfect place for breakfast or a tasty treat. I can't wait to try Bouchon next time I'm in town. I wanted to order one of everything to bring home with me. Fabulous!

I got the cookie cup pictured here. My husband got two scoops of ice cream with crushed Oreo topping because he's not a fan of marshmallow. Together our order was over $16! Personally I think the ice cream was mediocre and very over priced. I don't know if I'll return.

We got word of this place from my cousin. We drove up and thought 'uh oh. Did we come to the right place.' Short answer. Yes. I had the cookie cup with a double dose of fruity pebbles. Both the gelato and the macaroon. But the marshmallow was a total surprise. Don't turn away because it's in a crazy strip mall in the middle of a neighborhood. Go in and indulge. Everything is home made and made to order.

We go to Handel's a lot for their amazing ice cream. However this past visit, we felt that the service was appalling. We went for Father's Day because my husband wanted one of the amazing monster milkshakes. He ordered and I ordered a cone with 2 flavors. The server said that I would have to order a double which is 4 1/2 scoops of ice cream if I wanted two flavors. A single is 2 1/2 scoops. He insisted that he could not do 1 scoop of one flavor and 1 1/2 scoops of another. Which seems crazy to me. And I know they have done it before. Then my friends ordered and paid the whole bill. After they paid they saw that we were double charged the milkshake and my cone. When we brought it to their attention, the server was curt and handed her $6.50, the cost of the milkshake. My friend pointed out that she was still owed for the cone and tax. So the manager came over and was just as curt. He finally gave her the cash back and then slammed the window shut. I was shocked. It is too bad because every other time the women who served us were friendly and accommodating. These two gentlemen, the server and manager, need to up their game.

I mean obviously not as good as going to France but I will say I got the same pastry here that I ordered in Paris and it was a very good local option. Also a positive that they are open 24 hours so whenever the craving hits you can go get a coffee or a tasty pastry. Never had a sandwich there but will definitely have to try that next time.

Won like $11 from the penny slots in the Cosmo casino so decided to treat myself and my girls to a few cookies. We ended up getting all 6 flavors and a birthday cake shake. Pretty expensive for cookies. The Corn one was not impressive, but oddly enough, I really liked the birthday cake one, which I thought would be my least favorite cuz I'm not a big fan of sprinkles. The cornflake marshmallow cookie was aight. I'm kinda proud to say that I do a better version at home that's like crack and people will throw down and smack a b--ch to get the last one. Overall, average for me. For $4 a cookie, I'd expect better ingredients. If you check the label on the package, there's artificial flavors and food coloring, dextrose, you name it. There's a whole laundry list of stuff in it.

My wife would say "this is delicious and we better than she imagined it could be". Long line, brief wait, but way worth it. We got the lobster tails and they are the best I've ever had. The price was a little more than anticipated however that's just because I didn't even know how much it would cost. Flavor wise it was worth it. You did good, Buddy. You did good.

YUMMY! After having lunch at another spot in Eataly, I was craving something sweet, so we ventured over to La Pastcceria. As an Italian girl myself, I had to try a cannoli, as it's my most favorite dessert. Now be warned, my Mom makes the BEST cannolis, so I am always skeptical when I try one at a restaurant or Italian style bakery, but these cannolis are delicious! I would've had another one, but I was already stuffed from lunch...lol! My husband who is not a cannoli fan had mini cream puffs, and he said they were super yummy too! La Pastcceria has several other sweet treats to try too, and they are all so pretty and look yummy!

Generally speaking, I don't get cravings for sweets and desserts like how I do with pho and ramen. If I were to ever get the urge though, there's a pretty good chance it would be for a delicious, French macaron. Well, other than ice cream of course. Or a fresh, homemade chocolate chip cookie. A thin one, with slightly crisp edges, a golden brown bottom, and a soft, chewy center with plenty of melted chocolate chips. Yeaaaaahhhhh, that'd be good....wait, what was I talking about? While most French bakeries offer up smaller, near bite-sized macarons, I love how Bouchon's are almost the size of your palm. Even though that means you pay a little more for each cookie, it also means you have that much more to enjoy. And enjoy you will, with a light, crisp exterior sandwiching a sweet and chewy filling. Although I've yet to try the Pistacio flavor myself, I've heard plenty of good things about it from friends. For me, my favorite has been their Espresso Macaron - loaded with a rich, coffee flavor, it won me over after just one bite. Since this Bouchon Bakery is really more of an outlet/coffee stand in the Venetian (by the theater), the selection is smaller compared to what their actual "bakery" locations can offer. However, it still tastes just as good, and that's what matters most, right? After all, if you start to crave a macaron, it's better to be stuck choosing from just a few varieties than to not have any to choose from at all!

Not only does this place have delicious pastries galore but the gentlemen working there are so friendly and helpful. The place has great parking, and I feel safe going in. They only allow 2 people at a time. Mask are required. Thank you for that. We had numerous bakery items and everything was delicious. The brownies and cake were so delicious, moist, and had such delicious flavors. Will be back to taste more.

Visited Bouchon bakery because I happen to be around the Venetian area. I was happy that I did. I had the chocolate macaron. It was my first time trying macaron and it was quite delightful. I also tried the bouchon chocolate double chocolate cake. Came in bite size and very chocolaty. I was a bit disappointed that we showed up around 6 pm and the bakery had very limited selection. My tip is to show up around the afternoon time to have a larger selection of baked goods to choose from. I will have to go back just to try some of the other baked goods on the menu. All in all a positive experience and looking forward to my future visit. Bon Apettit!

LOVE their ice cream and toppings. I absolutely adored every flavor I tried, so much so that I had to get a triple scoop! And their marshmallows looked so good that I had to get a torched one on the side. The rose vanilla? Flavor is to die for and the malt chocolate chip is my new favorite. So glad I live close by and can satisfy my ice cream cravings at any time!!!!
The line was semi-long so we knew it had to be good, and it definitely was. The shop smells like fresh waffles, and the staff were extremely nice. Brambleberry crisp was my favorite.
Cool place. Get the salted caramel brownie! Best I've had.

I'm only giving it 4 stars because of the lines they get. You would think if they get a lot of people, they would get just a tad bit more staff. The bakery is very small, so I guess I understand why the long lines. The cannoli was soooo worth the wait! That, and the chocolate dipped cookie (it's half white, half milk chocolate). Yum yum yum!

Now when I'm in old town this doughnut shoo will be one of my stops.. I had the best Chai lattes and doughnut. I haven't been able to find another Chai latte as good as theirs. I had my first creme Brule doughnut here and it was good, but wish it was a tad bit bigger to get that crunch.

I tried the raspberry cake and the cream cheese puffs. I was very underwhelmed. The cake lacked flavor and was very bland. The cheese puffs while ok were not like "omg I have to have!" I actually drove quite a ways to get to this place because I read that it was open 24hrs. Maybe the desserts taste better when you are drunk or you are a college student who typically lives off ramen. This seemed to be the type of crowd attracted to the place. It is a very eclectic-urban type place. Very artsy. While that does not bother me, I did not like how the location is right next to a club. Not at all a place that I will come back to. Le Madeleine is 100 times better sadly.

I love Christina Tosi, and I love cereal milk just as much, so I knew I just HAD to go here. For $8 (a pretty steep price!) I got a small cereal milk soft serve with their signature cereal crunch. Overall, I thought it was just a-ok. The concept is pretty cool, and I will admit it does taste just like cereal milk, it's just not as desirable as you would expect. I don't think I would ever go out of my way to eat here again, but it was decent. My fiancÃ© HATED it. After one bite he begged me for a stick of gum and kept making faces. Overall, worth a try to say you've been here, but know that's it's probably one and done. :)
Wide variety of good stuff. Ice cream, pastries, coffee and other drinks. Had the coffee, it was excellent, and friendly service. Will definitely visit again if I'm in the area

After a long night of drinking, you are grateful for your friends who decided to call it an early night and NOT go out. One of my friends, did just that. So he woke up early and took the rental car exploring. He came back with 5 boxes of donuts for our group to sample. My favorites were the creme brulee. But every single donut was heaven!

Everything at Villani's is always absolutely amazing. It's very reasonably priced. Today I got a cream puff, piece of cheesecake, lobster tail, s'mores bar and a hot chocolate for $20. It's my favorite bakery in Charlotte by far and they are always so friendly!

Well well well so this is how the cake boss rolls...with a huge bank roll because his prices are outrageous! Ok so I'm on the fence about this one. I mean don't get me wrong most of their desserts are pretty good but I'm not sure if it's worth paying an arm and a leg just for everyday sweet treats. The whole cakes are priced not bad for a whole cake at a specialty bakery will cost you about $35 plus and theirs were about that price which is fair but stuff like their mini cakes that's like 2 bites costing almost $10 bucks is a bit crazy to me. The cannoli cake was ok but nothing to jump up and down for. Their tarts are good but again $4 bucks for one small bite is kindda cray cray. So if you want to buy these bake goods for their name then just expect to pay the high dollars. Otherwise I think if it wasn't for the name I would find a better bakery!

It's ice cream, I mean, how can you give ice cream a bad review?!? Ok, I know, there are other things to consider, and I have considered them and still give this place five stars. So many flavors, so little time. I've been here more times than I'll admit (although my waistline shows it), and always try something different and have never been disappointed. Because we usually stop here after dinner, I usually get a single in a dish and still can't finish it, but then I'm all, 'leave no ice cream behind...' and then I force myself and get a stomach ache. This is my problem, not Mitchell's. All this to say that the portions are generous. Decor is cool. It fits in perfectly with the whole W. 25th vibe, and I love the train overhead. Also, thank you for putting in a water dispenser with cups. This is so much better than other places that have a skeezy looking clouded pitcher of water that's been setting out for who-knows how long! I shouldn't have written this review, now I want ice cream.

We came here around 1:30pm on a Sunday and they were closing up and wanted to get rid of the last couple of donuts they had. We had 2 options: BOGO or one box for $10. The box deal was so much more worth it so we ended up getting 16 donuts for $10!!! WHAT A STEAL. Plus if you check in on Yelp you can get either a free Americano or drip coffee. #win Blueberry Lemon - Just okay, but I liked how it wasn't as sweet as I thought it would be. Strawberry Split - Meh. I wouldn't get this again. The donut was just cinnamon and dry (probably because it had been sitting out all day) and the whipped cream inside was dry and tasted like it came from a can. The strawberries were also very plain and it would've been better if they were glazed. CrÃ¨me Brulee - My favorite out of everything I tried. The crunchy glaze on top was cool, and I love filled donuts. After eating half though, the cream inside started tasting artificial like cheap cake frosting so I had to come back to it. Buttermilk Bar - I really liked the consistency of this! Moist and cake-like on the inside and nice and crunchy on the outside. The other donuts look bomb so I'm definitely going to come try some other flavors. I agree that I've had better donuts elsewhere, but this location just opened 3 months ago so maybe their quality will go up. Street parking was easy to find.

Y'all... what even is this magical place?!? My husband and I decided to do a unique date and have a 3 course meal, but all at different locations. I came across Novel Ice Cream by chance when I was sitting here for 20 mins trying to find the best place to go and have dessert...well.... I found it. We shared (again a 3-course meal) a "Dough Melt" we did the vanilla ice cream (Won 1st place for a reason) with cookie crisps (childhood anyone?!?). This mixture of the warm doughnut on the outside and the cold ice cream on the inside was the perfect combo of magic. Literally magic in my mouth. Do yourself a favor... park on the street if you have to and walk your way on to Novel.

While in Phoenix for a business meeting some coworkers and I decided to stop in for some ice cream and to try the Fatty Daddy. The ice cream flavors were far from ordinary. I ordered the sweet vanilla which sounds boring but tasted almost like mascarpone (delicious!). My co-workers got the Fatty Daddy where you get almost 3 scoops of ice cream and 2 macaroons topped with a toasted marshmallow. The employees were very friendly and cheerful even when we asked to get a taste of almost every flavor :) My team is returning to Phoenix in December so we'll have to stop by again!

If you love fresh made Italian pastries, I know who doesn't, then you MUST take the time to check this place out. AH-MA-ZING Cheesecake is to die for. Chocolate custard puff was perfection. The cannoli was better than anything I have tried in New York Worth the trip to Little Italy Cleveland just to eat at Pesti's

Not what I would expect from a French bakery... Have been there several times and it's always slammed, line around the corner and takes forever and can't find a table or a chair. Very hectic and chaotic atmosphere, definitely not welcoming or relaxing ...

Went here for the first time about a week ago and LOVED the Peanut Butter ice cream, truly hit the spot. The girl behind the counter was super nice about the fact that we swooped in about 3 minutes before closing and made sure to tip her for putting up with my indecision as it was my first time there. She was great with giving samples and answering questions. Ive never been a big ice cream on a cone guy, but I gave the pretzel cone a try and it didnt work well with the Peanut Butter ice cream but might work well with another flavor. Should have stuck with my gut and had her make it into a shake. Will definitely go back to take more of a look around as its also kind of a toy store too and to really see (and taste of course) all the different flavors.
Beautiful bakery with tasty food! But expect a wait on the weekends because it's pretty popular

I love how the bakery is convenient. The products are so good. I especially go here for the macarons!! They are huge and all the flavors are delicious. If you buy 5 macarons you get 1 free!! We also tried their eclairs which was also so good.

I was craving something sweet during my weekend Vegas trip and decided to give this place try. As a first timer, I decided to get a red velvet soft serve (just to play it safe). The worker who took my order told me that it would have a rich and creamy chocolate taste to it which it indeed did. I topped it off with sprinkles since it was such a small serving but it was enough for me since it was super sweet. Only giving it 4 stars since it was a little pricey for such a small serving (paid $8 plus tip). Hoping to try their other flavors during my next Vegas trip!

Next to the last stop on our self guided food tour celebrity chef vegas version. This place is just alright. I really didn't have any expectations since its not like I watch cake boss and think to myself, oh how I wish I could taste the moving Ferris wheel on the top of that cake???? So, going into the bakery I didn't have these high expectations was the point of that digression. So, we ordered a lobster roll, cannoli, sprinkles sugar cookie, brownie, and two doughnuts. The lobster roll was okay. The pastry cream was the best part. The pastry itself was flakey but slightly dry and the end when the cream ran out. The cannoli was good, the second best thing we ordered. It's nice and crisp, good balance of creamy filling to crisp exterior, the chocolate chips were just hints, not overpowering which is sometimes hard to do with chocolate. My daughter ate the cookie. I didn't taste it But she said, "nothing special." She's 12. The brownie I was not a of.... I HATE brownies with frosting on the top! This one had gobs and gobs of frosted crap on the top. Yuck! But, that's just my preference. Now, the doughnuts are awesome. Totally delicious, would order them again a hundred times. They are the saving grace of the whole bakery in my opinion and the best thing I ordered.

I went to visit after reading the reviews that the milk cereal was the best. I was greatly disappointed. It tasted like sour milk. It was a big let down because it looked so good. Will not be coming again.

This was a disappointing bowl of ramen, especially for the price. The soup lacked flavor, but the toppings didn't--unfortunately they weren't flavors worth tasting (shoutout to the saltiest mushrooms in the Midwest). To top it off, everything was cold. If you're going to come here, I hope it's for ice cream, not soup.
It was ok... only a couple of toppings to choose from and the flavors were nothing to write home about. Not worth the 15 minute drive. Staff were nice though!
Best croissant I have ever had!!! My friend had the cheese danish and he was so impressed. Great little spot, not over priced, and just great quality pastries.

I was so excited to try this place out. Big fan of Buddy V. I had the famous Cannoli. I also had the butter cream rainbow cake & the chocolate fudge cake. The rainbow cake was very pretty but dry. The chocolate cake was super tasty and rich.

Worst rip off ever! I came from WASHINGTON DC just to get a cake made for my wedding! Unfortunately the wedding got called off! But I paid a $50 deposit for my cake tasting which is supposed to go towards the cake! Well being that the wedding was called off I didn't need the cake but was told that the could get a refund when I originally agreed to even do the tasting! After visiting today I am being told that my deposit is non refundable! Thats is such a scam!

Great selection of French baked goods Had the Cream Puff and Fruit Tart. Some of the best cream ever. This stuff was delicious and went everywhere. They have a lot of tea and coffee options. Really wanted to get a coffee but it was late in the day and I didn't want to jeopardize my beauty sleep.
Got ramen from here and it was great. I don't know how they get the eggs to be so flavorful. Would definitely recommend.
Yummy!! So many things to choose from. We tried a cookie, brownie, cannoli and a cupcake and all were fresh and delicious!

Had really high expectations from this brand name being a die hard fan of Buddy Valastro....but was so heartbroken and disappointed not once but twice with their products. Cannoli had a grainy cream filling with soggy pastry. Lobster tails were chewy and almost took 1 min to eat one bite, and also the filling was stinky. Hazelnut puff had a nice filling but yet again the pastry was horribly wet n soggy. Lemon puffs were nice with a good amount of filling and decent pastry. Cupcakes were dry and frosting was like the storebought sugar creams.

Any season, any time - the staff are genuinely friendly and helpful. The entire location is always clean. The bathrooms are always clean and well stocked - again, any season, any time! I love watching the ice cream being made from the 2nd floor! We always bring friends from out of town here - everyone always gets a kick out of it, and we never seem to tire! The cherry on top - the staff and clientele are very diverse. This is so very appreciated. Many other Mitchell's are in affluent predominantly white communities, and the staff and clientele are a mirror reflection. Let's just say not all our experiences have been warm and fuzzy experiences at other Mitchell's locations. But this one - on point! Oh yeah - the ice cream is WONDERFUL! (ha!)
Small shop but the ice cream was awesome. I had the chop suey and will probably go back again today.

My favorite ice cream shop of all time. It's a quick 5 minute drive from my house and I've been coming here since I was a kid. My family and I come pretty much every week. Their ice cream is so creamy and not overly sugary. I get the banana ice cream 98% of the time, It's unlike any other. The other 2% of the time I get their seasonal flavors my favorite are banana peanut butter (shocker), triple berry, lemon meringue pie, and pumpkin caramel ginger snap in the fall! Also their orange blossom is perfect for the summertime it tastes like a light creamsicle and I've never seen this flavor anywhere else. My mom loves the red raspberry sundae. The have locations all over the Cleveland area but I've grown up coming to this one.

I bought a cake pre artmart location and it was phenomenal, I told everyone and anyone about how amazing the cake was. I recently got one for my children's birthday and it didn't taste as fresh and had so much filling in between the layers it was not much of a cake. It also didn't look as appealing as other cakes I have seen of hers. I asked for something simple but it looked like a cake from Schnuck's. For the price I paid I was not impressed or a happy customer the second time. Its very sad the quality has declined with such amazing ingredients and talent.
I think this place is cute but there isn't much for me so outside of social meetup with friends, I have no real need to come back.

I had been to the Donut bar in San Diego when I was in town for a conference. When I was planning my Vegas trip, I found out that there was a donut bar and it was immediately on my "must eat" list. We were driving down from Vegas to LA the day we visited so we bought lots of donuts for the ride and every one of them was amazing! I really wish we had one close by!

Creative donut and flavor combinations. Located on Carson St downtown but are only opened to 1:00 or until they sell out, so get here early if you want to try some of their favorites such as maple bacon (long donut with maple glaze and glazed bacon), cake batter (a festive frosting laden donut with sprinkles and white icing), blood orange (a sweet tangy glazed donut with tart sweet blood orange glaze and filling), birthday cake (cake donut, festive frosting and toppings), red velvet, Homer, Mexican Chocolate and so much more....they have coffee offerings, small seating area, street parking.

These treats have been very popular on Instagram and made me really want to try them! I finally made it one Saturday to try the cookie I've been dying to have: the caramel apple cookie. I also picked up an oatmeal cream pie since my husband loves them. These sweets are incredible! I loved the caramel apple cookie. I really wanted more caramel and apple. Surprisingly, I think I liked the oatmeal cream pie even more. I don't know how she makes that cream but it's to die for. I definitely want to come back to try the poptarts and some of the other tasty treats she's making!

This place was top notch! The homemade artisan ice cream was by far one of my favorite ice creams to date. If you are traveling through Phoenix like us it's a MUST stop. We enjoyed the honey lavender and bourbon pecan. The honey lavender is calm, yet sweet. The lavender shines through with a touch of honey. It's like walking through a lavender field in sunshine. The bourbon pecan was sweet, very creamy. The owner was very kind, spoke to us like we were part of his ice cream society. We enjoyed chatting with him while checking out. As my teenage kids put it "some of the best ice cream I have had in my life. I'm glad I don't live here I would be poor from coming here everyday!" The cost is price pointed well. It's what I would expect to spend on a single scoop. The setting where the ice cream shop is located is cozy, a great courtyard to eat ice cream and share the happiness of ice cream with friends and family! Thanks for creating such a wonderful local ice cream shop! You're welcome to come and open one in Greensboro, NC for us!! We hope to travel back through and eat this again!
Came here with some folks after dinner, the place wasn't too crowded and the banana split was delicious. Good spot to beat the Vegas heat

This place is like bakery you can fine in Europe. The pastries are light and crispy. Not too sweet which turn me off at most American bakeries. I had the blueberry and strawberry danish. Fresh fruit and delicious. The eclair and lemon tart were are heavenly too.
Not really a sweets person. The variety was great. Service was great. Our donut was great!
Ordered several pastries, breads, sliced and whole cakes. Never disappointed . I am returning on Saturday for a family dinner party and yes dessert time! They want a Choco mousse cake. Yummy

Welp; I'm embarrassed to say this was my first time hearing about or going to this bakery even though I was born and raised in California :-( but as they say better late than never, right!! So we definitely went twice in the 3 days we were here and I definitely took home 3 boxes so I could bring pastries for everyone and know what it feels like to be Opera. You get a pastry and you get a pastry! Haha No but in all honestly I think for like the 3 boxes and a coffee it was like maybe $50! There is such variety here and everything was so stinking good! The spicy sausage bread, the egg tart, the chocolate chip bread, there were so many pastries that were so amazingly delicious. They were fresh, and squishy, and airy, and light... I wish there was one in denver because I would go there all the time. Guess I'll have to wait until next time I go back to LV or CA!!

Mitchell's Ice Cream is the best ice cream shop in Cleveland. The staff is always friendly, the samples are always generous, and the flavors are to die for. I always look forward to the seasonal flavors, but love the classics like caramel fudge brownie as well! I have friends who are vegan and lactose intolerant and their favorite flavors are the vegan (coconut-based) chocolate and vegan salted caramel. Even if you're not vegan, these flavors pair super well with other chunkier, non-vegan flavors in a double scoop or taster's duo. As for the ingredients, they are locally sourced from farms near Cleveland and the owners actually know the producers on a first-name basis and visit their farms! Some insider tips: -Sprinkles, chocolate shavings, and pretzel rods are free to add to any ice cream dish!! -There is a comments box where you can suggest new ice cream flavors! -If you can't decide on a flavor, get the taster's duo! 2 scoops for a better price than the double.

It was good but quite frankly, too expensive. I think every ice cream and gelato shop is overpriced anymore. I'm tired of paying the price of a gallon of ice cream for a scoop or two. Doesn't make sense in this economic disaster we are just touching the tip of. Did it because my GD was with me.

First time trying out this bakery shop from recommendations from friends!! Not bad actually! Their pastries were delicious but of course I didn't get to try all of their pastries! The only downside to my experience was that they were only accepting cash. No wonder there was no line because earlier that morning the line was around the corner and we didn't want to stand in that long line.

cereal milk is so good, especially with the corn flake cereal topping! the fruity cereal milk is alright. cute place overall, with the neon signs and i love that it's in the beautiful cosmo next to other restaurants.

Probably the best donuts in Cleveland, and incredible that they're vegan too! They always have the classics and fun new flavors - I got the glazed, citrus and cardamom, lavender lemon, tiramisu. All were great and they're always changing up the menu! Be sure to get in on the earlier side, because they do sell out of flavor later in the afternoon. Definitely going back next time I'm craving a donut.

I went in for the memories. I used to love their bakery while I was studying in China. The one in Las Vegas was impressive. I could find the familiarity in taste. Wide selection of buns and rolls and pastries. I enjoyed their rose cheese bun best.

A "Have to" visit location every time we visit the Vegas Strip. It is easily located on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan! Just curious though about one thing: When did they change the name of the famous "Crack Pie" to "Milk Bar Pie?"

We stopped in here after having dinner across the street at Great Lakes Brewery. It was a nice night and a fair number of people were in the store, but there was plenty of seating, both indoors and outdoors. We got the taster's duo - one scoop of the Strawberry Rhubarb Crisp and one scoop of the S'mores, both seasonal flavors. We LOVED the Strawberry Rhubarb! The S'mores was good, too, but in comparison, the Strawberry Rhubarb wins. I'd come back just for that. The taster's duo is around $4, about the same price as the smaller waffle cones. It looks like you might get a bit more ice cream if you go for the cone, but I'm not complaining. What we got was super tasty!

As soon as you walk in everyone welcomes you. Employees have smiles on their faces. Ive been here a couple of times. Ive had the red velvet cupcake! Its so good omg! I cant wait to try more! Its a bit pricey but hey its pretty good quality, i don't mind it. I always come to sprinkles when I am visiting the LINQ. Must hit this spot if you are visiting Vegas! They even have a cup cake ATM! Pretty cool if you ask me.

Always an enjoyable experience. I do believe that putting all those delicious goodies in the cases just before the registers is an unfair business practice ;-). Set your expectations for sandwich's and the like properly. It is NOT a fast food restaurant so if you want your food fast, go to McDonalds and don't take it out on the counter folks. I believe the food is worth the wait.

Personally after having Lola's for dinner I couldn't find more room in my stomach for dessert, but my sister insisted in checking this place out. It looked like a freaking factory. You order your ice cream on one side of the glass and the other side you see workers toiling away making your ice cream. I couldn't decide if I liked the feeling of this place because it felt very industrial and kinda cold. The ice cream was good and the portions were generous. However, I've had better ice cream and I didn't feel like this really hit the spot. We tried a good number of flavors and nothing really stood out. I vote Jeni's and because I'm not really from Columbus you can't say its Columbus pride. But I knew it was a bad sign because my sister, who loves loves loves ice cream, didn't even finish hers! Instead she left it in the cup holder next to my phone, waiting for me to dip my fingers in the slurry. Yuck.

Y'all ninety's is a dessert lovers paradise! We went for the first time yesterday after reading tons of great reviews on yelp and seeing the cool pics of the tasty treats. It for sure lived up to the hype. The guy taking our order was super helpful and when he found out it was our first time he pulled out an iPad and walked us through the menu with pictures of all the treats. They have freshly fried donuts and stuff them with ice cream and toppings, they have cereal milkshakes, cookie dough pops and macaroon ice cream sandwiches. We both got milkshakes- I can't remember the name of mine but it was like a samoa cookie and my husband got the Reese's puff shake. It was SO GOOD!!! My shake tasted just like the samoa Girl Scout cookie. The Reese's puff one was really good as well. I wish I didn't live so far away because I'd be there at least weekly but I guess it's a good thing for my waistline
Delicious and creative. Friendly service. Wide variety of cupcakes, ice cream, edible cookie dough, and other treats. I had 2 cupcakes - cookie dough & toffee. Mouthwatering!

Their Crack Pie Milkquake is the best thing I have eaten in a long time, so five stars just for that! I've had their soft serve and crack pie separately - to me they taste better together than separately. (That's pretty much what their Crack Pie Milkquake is btw, soft serve with chunks of crack pie.) It's very, very sweet, toothachingly sweet, but I'll deal with it because my tastebuds find it so, so delicious! One serving can easily be split between two people, if you're willing to share :p You get to eat it with a wooden spoon too - how fun is that?! Brings me back to my childhood :) I've tasted a few other Milk Bar treats as well, like their cookies and Bday Cake Truffles. I can pass on their cookies, but their Bday Cake Truffles were also just some sweet, sweet goodness! FYI there was no line the times I went in the afternoon. As for seating, there is a bench in front, but you can find more comfortable seating if you go up the escalators to the floor with all the restaurants. But back to the treats :p I can't wait to have a Crack Pie Milkquake (Milkquake = Las Vegas exclusive) and some Bday Cake Truffles again!

Was in Sloans about a week ago. Laura was very patient, she talked to me about every single ice cream, spoke about the fudge like it was her passion. She knows her stuff and has a lot of positive energy. Her attitude was so amazing I wanted to let her manager know, I asked Laura if she could get her manager, and when she went to check if she was there she said her manager said that "she was not clocked in and busy." As a former business owner/manager I see that as a lack in work ethic on the managers end. I felt a little more than disappointed when the manager refused to talk to me about a great employee. However, I will not give this post less than 5 stars because of the managers unwillingness to talk to a customer. Laura was a great help, I don't really use yelp, but figured she deserves the recognition!

Stopped in here after a bit of night time sightseeing of Pittsburgh. My sister and brother-in-law, who are the ones who live in Pitt, had never been here before, so we were all newbies! Huge plus that it's open until 11pm on weekdays. This little place is great. You walk up to the order window, pick from a handful of different soft serve favors and cone choices, and are given your fresh ice cream in no time! I ordered the strawberry soft serve in a waffle cone. HUGE portion, and less than $3! Obviously shocking to me as a native New Yorker, since nothing around here is ever that cheap. My sister had cheesecake soft serve, my other sister had blueberry soft serve, both also in waffle cones. My brother-in-law had key lime soft serve in a pretzel cone! So unique and actually really delicious, having that savory/sweet thing going on. 4 cones of ice cream for less than $12. Fresh, homemade ice cream, with really nice staff. I look forward to my next visit to pittsburgh, so I can enjoy this place again!

Ok this place was a treat! We are talking the best macaroons I have had, like ever and I go out of my way to try them when I find a place that sells them. If you go here try a couple of their crazy flavors like captain crunch or the popcorn ice cream then order a cookie cup, they will let use a couple flavors in it.
Visited bakery while in Vegas. It was a nice treat! Also- flew back home with bakery goods. Perfect packages for traveling.

My daughter takes me here every Mother's Day. Sort of like a tradition with us. It can be very busy on the weekends but it's worth the wait. The prices are reasonable n the salted caramel brownie is AWESOME!!! The decor is funky n cute I love the chandeliers made out of utensils n things I almost bought at shirt with the place on it to advertise for them lol. You won't be disappointed.

Hi! I was excited to try this place given its high reviews. However, I find this bakery to be mediocre, and their pastries were alright. I enjoyed the crumb cake and the flaky pastry I got (lobster tail I believe). The Sfingi was okay, and they got my latte order wrong. I also had the Cinnamon Toast Crunch macaron and the texture was rough. I would return only to consider buying the crumb cake or lobster tail. I am hesitant to try anything else. The customer service was very nice. The gentlemen was very nice to explain and describe the pastries to me, and was very patient!

Um, WOW. Charming French bakery heaven in the South! Whoa! Uh, lets see, what don't they have?!!! - Chocolates, pastries, sweets galore. Check! - Coffees, teas, and other pallet satisfying drinks. Check! - Awesome Impressionist pastel colors decor. Check! - Board games. Check! - Parking lot. Check! - Open 24 hours. Check! - Takes credit cards. Check! - Uber comfy chairs. Check! If I lived in the neighborhood, I'd be at this place ALL THE TIME.

I was pointed in the direction of Amelie's by a classmate who seemed to be a fan of the breakfast sandwiches, which he said were usually sold out if you don't get there early enough. I figured this was a sign that it was a good cafe/bakery. The first couple times I went, I bought an assortment of pastries to try - most were pretty great. I had given some to my parents to taste and my mother insisted her birthday cake come from there (I live 90 minutes away so this wasn't exactly easy planning.) On my next trip I purchased several french macarons and after getting them home, discovered a small hair sandwiched into 1 of them. I emailed Amelie's through facebook to explain what happened just to let them know someone needed to be a little more careful. I received an email back from Lynn profusely apologizing (including the same formatted apologies I've seen from her in response to some reviews on here) and offering to make up for the mishap. She gave me a separate email address to contact her with additional information. I emailed her back at the address she provided and told her I didn't want anything for free (I assumed the apology and promise to check their procedures was sincere) - and only wanted some help picking out a birthday cake for my mom as I was short on time. I never received any response. I followed up a few days later on facebook to see if she got my email and again, no response. I sent a 3rd and final email December 26th (3 months after the fact) and finally got a response 8 days later apologizing for dropping the ball and offering a gift card to make up for it. I received another email this morning because she forgot to copy the gift card person on what happened. Really? This is a comedy of errors that just isn't all that funny so I won't be back.

Came here twice during our stay in Phoenix. For those unfamiliar with the area like me, you should expect to pull up to a neighborhood looking area with a bunch of houses. Well Melt is located in a house, and it has a tiny sign in the window. Outside of the house are a couple of tables with lights strung above for a cute, hip vibe. They have a bunch of interesting, cool flavors. Their honey lavender was light but I got all the notes from it. I got the nutella flavor, which was rich and flavorful. The next time I tried their Horchata flavor which tasted exactly like it.. so good! My one wish is that their ice cream was a bit more thick so it wouldn't melt as quickly.. but maybe that's why they named the place..? Or it's just ridiculously hot in phx? The service was awesome. We ended up having a full conversation with the guy at the cash register as we were remarking how incredibly hot it was in Phoenix. Even though a line was starting to form to pay, the guy at the register still talked to us, took his time, and was so genuine. This was such a breath of fresh air, as this would never happen in LA...

I'm very glad that batch opened. It's definitely my favorite bakery in madison. The staff is always very friendly and helpful there. The cheddar garlic rolls & ham gruyere croissants are amazing! I'm also a fan of the baguettes. I love how everything is fresh and the ingredients are from the farmer's market. The prices are reasonable, but get there early so you don't miss the good stuff!

Good to come by for a quick bite and pastries. The original location is in Yountville, CA (near napa) so I was glad I didn't need to travel too far to try the famous Thomas Keller bakery! Had the Egg, Ham and Cheese Croissant. They heated it up (if you'd like). The croissant was a perfect softness and flakiness. I even ate it cold and it was still good! I'd definitely come back when I'm back in Vegas for the future. Just keep in mind the lines can be gnarly but they move quickly!

Had a meeting in the area and someone recommended this place for coffee. The bakery is located in downtown Concord. I love this area because is quaint, walkable and it appears as if most of the businesses are small, local business owners. This bakery is located inside a sort of mall area. Upon entering a business the first thing I look for is to be greeted immediately with a smile and an appreciation of me coming into your business. The owners were in the back and didn't notice me at first but as soon as they did I was greeted with a smile. I ordered a vanilla latte and a slice of freshly baked banana bread. It was SO good! Another female completed my transaction and she was very friendly. I'm not in this area often but I'll return to this spot when I am.

On a journey to revisit my mom's college town, an Illinois graduate of 1957-1958, we stopped for custard at this location. It was VERY good and we loved every bite. She had vanilla and I had chocolate, single scoops. YUMMY!

Imma subpoena the yelp powers that be and have them add another star to this wonderful ice cream shop. Thanks to my son for finding it on his prom night. We stopped in after running some errands down town for a nice treat. Little did I know I was about to embark on an ice cream dream. This little shop is kind of tucked away amongst other shops like a hair salon, tattoo parlor, and a restaurant. See pic. After drooling over the ice cream selection, getting odd looks from the nice lady behind the counter, I settled on a bourbon salted toffee and butter pecan waffle cone. Hello!!!! You had me at bourbon!! WOW!!! The flavors were spot on and had a nice balance of sweet creaminess and texture. The Mrs. had a single scoop in a bowl of the Bourbon salted toffee, it she was very impressed. My son had a double scoop bowl of fresh strawberry and Madagascar vanilla bean. Oh my goodness. The lady behind the counter said the strawberry was made from fresh berries, not the standard frozen variety. And the vanilla was actually imported from Madagascar, you got to move it move it! Yeah, that place. They had flavors like chai tea, honey lavender, and taro, amongst others. They give samples and I urge you to take them up on it. You can thank me later.

We grabbed treats from here twice. The first time from the Cupcake ATM and the second, from in-store. We preferred the ones from in-store. The cupcakes we got from the vending machine were sticky, warm and a little googly. The ones from in-store seemed a bit fresher; the cake portion was soft and the frosting wasn't overly sweet. This may have been because we chose more "basic" flavors (chocolate/vanilla vs. pecan pie and white chocolate raspberry) the second time around, but consistency across all levels would be nice. There are Sprinkles locations near me back home, but I'll probably stick to my local mom and pop spots.

I love Mitchell's. Probably some of the best ice cream in the CLE. They have seasonal flavors & try to do local providers. I love this aspect of Mitchell's. The servers are ALWAYS happy to give you samples. (My beau hates this though because I feel the need to try, and try, and try.) Honesty, if you like Ice Cream and you're in CLE hit up Mitchell's. Their new location in Ohio City is nice and has gorgeous windows to look out onto W. 25th!
This lemon blueberry cheese cake was absolutely perfect. If you're in the bakery and you see it, get it.

The macarons are huge! They're also some of the best on the Strip. I also tried the Better Nutter (peanut butter buttercream between peanut butter cookies), which was fantastic, and the TKO (their take on an Oreo), which was just okay.

I wanted to pick up a hostess gift for the person we're staying with on vacation. I purchased a Groupon, 30 truffles for $30. I called Sinful Sweets to ask questions; the guy was polite but had no idea how to help me. I emailed them, but I didn't receive a response. Then I went to the store to purchase the truffles. I NEVER go downtown, but I figured I'd use the Groupon and then meet my husband after he got off work. When I talked to the young lady, she said they need 24 hours notice to use the Groupon. We're standing next to a full display of truffles while I asked a few questions. The lady said the Groupon says they need 24 hours notice, but there is literally nothing about that on the Groupon or when I purchased it! I told the young lady I was leaving for vacation tomorrow and didn't have time for this. I asked for a manager, but there was none available, so I left. Not only do I have a Groupon for $30 I can't use, but I decided not to purchase the other items I was going to get in addition to that. While Sinful Sweets has delicious chocolate, their customer service is horrible. I'm very disappointed they made using the Groupon so difficult. Needless to say, I will not be purchasing from them again, and I will not reccomend them to anyone else.

What is up with all the frigging Macaroons? Wasn't impressed. Big stale overpriced cookie. Plus side is I always like a bakery in my hotel when traveling and this one generally didn't have much of a line. The people behind the counter weren't too quick to offer service or too friendly. Maybe they sensed I wasn't succumbing to the Macaroon spell they were attempting to cast.

Friendly staff, if you go there often enough they will remember you. I think my favorite thing besides the raspberry lemon babies would be their carrot cupcakes! They use to use soy as their spray for pans but they have recently switched which is awesome.

If you have not tried the regular 85 degrees coffee, try it! It's so good! I get it with half the sugar and it tastes similar to Vietnamese coffee. It's rich but not bitter. We've also been doing the $2 caramel milk tea and caramel sea salt coffee from the promo in the app. They've been good each time. Regularly, it would be too sweet for my taste but just know you can adjust the sugar to 1/2 or 1/3 sugar. As far as the bakery goes, they are delicious and have a wide variety. The garlic cheese one is really good!
Had to stop to see what all the fuss was about since there was a long line. The pastries looked deliciously decorated. We sample 3 and they were pleasant but not sure if I'd wait in line again.

The guy who "took care of us" was the most unfriendliest and rude person I've come into contact with for a long time. My wife and I stopped in to get some pastries for Father's Day. He acted bothered to get anything and also muttered something under his breath about my wife asking for too many items. He made us feel extremely unwelcome and we wondered what we could have done to make someone act so fucking rude to us. Honestly, I will probably never come back here, and it's a shame because we live down the road. Hire some better customer service oriented staff - at least people who don't make you feel bad for ordering the stuff the establishment provides.

Everything I have tried has been melt-in-your-mouth tender and delicious. But ask the counter help to identify a pastry at your own risk. Some of their staff is patient and sweet - others not so much. Here's a thought - label your pastries and I won't have to ruin your day by asking you what something is. I spend lots of money when I am there. I am friendly - I am actually excited to be getting what I'm getting - but often leave there wondering if I have spinach in my teeth. To the owners: please take a closer look at the people you've hired to greet your customers.

Great ice cream. I had the goat cheese and cherry ice cream which had a nice sweet and tart flavor to it. Others in my party had the Texas Chocolate Cake ice cream. They didn't even notice it was dairy free and loved it just the same. In fact they didn't believe me when I said the sign said that flavor was dairy free. That's when you know they've got the flavor profile right! There weren't any tables out because of CoVid and parking is limited so plan accordingly. Some people were eating their ice cream on the steps outside the building but not the most comfortable option. We just ate as we walked back to our car. Still fun given their unique flavors!

We have been coming here for years and always enjoy the delicious ice cream, amazing cookies and nostalgic gift shop. Tonight changed everything for us. We brought our two small children with us and the employee was a male dressed in complete drag...fake eyelashes, heavy makeup, etc. For a family-friendly environment children should NOT be exposed to this. We will not be back. How disappointing Upward Projects.

I'm really not a dessert person but when I tried the cereal milk soft serve I couldn't get enough of it! If you like plain ice cream or want to pick a safe bet, definitely get the cereal milk soft serve. It is pretty expensive though which is the downside, and wouldn't be a place where I can stop by everyday. And they close at 1AM which is also a plus compared to other ice cream/dessert shops.

Alton Brown, host of Good Eats, was featured on "Best Thing I Ever Ate" and said three words..."Toffee Banofi Sundae". When I had a chance to visit the store, I already knew what I was getting. However, I just wanted to sample a few of their other flavors since they all sounded good. They blew me away with how the delicious and creamy the ice cream was. I cannot remember the flavors that I tried since it's been a couple of weeks, but I would have gotten a double of scoop of any of them easily.
