When I was done tasting the majority of the different flavors (apologies to the worker, but you were awesome for putting up with us), I ordered the main attraction. Alton Brown was not wrong when this made it to "Best Thing I Ever Ate". This was definitely the best sundae I ever ate
I had such a great experience here! The workers aka "the dream team" were so passionate about their business and the ice cream was so unique! They have so many delicious flavors. 10/10 recommend!!

We tried the macarons, turkey cheese on a croissant, and a banana walnut muffin. I think we were there a little too early, about 7 a.m. that they didn't have a lot of items. I'll just review the macarons, since the other stuff was good, but nothing special. They are 3.50 a piece, but are a lot bigger than the average macaron. The cookie part is utter perfection, a nice outer shell with chewiness when you bite into it. The filling however, was too soft and buttery for me, especially the pistachio. I prefer my fillings to be a lot more thick and rich. My favorite was the caramel, didn't care for the chocolate at all. I'm glad to have tried it, but don't know if I would go back again - maybe if I stopped by and saw that they had a bigger selection, like more savory items.

Have been to a few other locations & always love the pastries. Kind of sucks that they were out of the fall flavors I wanted to try this time though. Knowing they are a 24/7 shop I think they should be prepared with plenty of inventory. Coffee was pretty good though.
Great pastry shop in Little Italy. We loved the raspberry mouse. They had a generous selection of pastries and food items. Reasonably priced. Worth the trip to little italy.

I love this spot! It's a perfect place to go and get some work done! I am obsessed with their coffee and the quiche they have on the weekend is the best around. The only complaint I have is many of the outlets are very old, understandably, and my macbook charger falls out of the outlet each time I plug it in.

My wife and I had breakfast here twice while in town for a wedding.The breakfast sandwich was very good and the pecan sticky bun lived up to it's name!You also get a show with your meal as the large windows allow you to watch the bakers do their thing!

Typically I am nervous trying out new restaurants but once i stepped foot into AmÃ©lies I instantly fell in love. The environment was adorable and the ladies behind the counter guided us through which pastries we would enjoy best. They were outstanding and so was the coffee. Definitely returning again!

It was such a cute late night spot! I had the Ron Swanson with graham crackers it was AH-MAY-ZING! All their ice cream is hand made and they switch up flavors. (Idk how often) They are super patient with you when asking for samples, they want to ensure you love what you get. Definitely recommend!

I heard many reviews on this place. Not much of a pastry person, especially for breakfast, so didn't try that. I came across this right after I won a few bucks on a slot machine, and thought I deserved a treat! I grabbed a carmel macaroon... OMG!!!! Was perfect! I've never had a macaroon before, but so glad I did. Dont know what I'll do now, since I won't be able to get my fix at home... I should had bought a dozen!

I gotta admit this place has grown on me. Now that I know to avoid the cold food items (all entirely unremarkable and lacking in hearty flavor e.g. caprese salad just hard small tomatoes, bland mozzarella balls, and small shreds of basil which may as well not exist thus leading to a spectacularly bland caprese salad), I've come to appreciate the deliciousness of their tender rum soaked Rum Baba cake ball thing and their tiramisu and absolutely chocolatey decadent mousse. Basically order from the case on the far left with the top shelf bakery items and skip the other stuff and you'll come away satisfied! Also the employees are always upbeat and never rude despite having multiple very busy jam packed times throughout the day where people must take numbers with standing room only to wait.

We moved to this side of town 3 months ago and I'm almost embarrassed of how many times we have visited this place! I haven't tried a flavor I didn't like. My favorite is Graham Central Station and a close second is Buckeye. All of the ice cream is made fresh and is amazingly delicious!

So because of COVID, the actual storefront bakery is closed, BUT they have a small bakery set up right by the guest elevators at Venetian tower. We were able to get the frontline worker's discount for their macarons (unfortunately not for the larger ones), but either way the macarons are absolutely yummy. Soft and flavorful and made perfectly. I highly recommend it if you like any sweets.

I've been coming to page's since I was about 5, literally. I love it. It's a local favorite for sure and for many reasons. 1) the history behind page's... Literally if you walk behind page's there are old photos of what the building used to look like and some south side history :P. 2) their ice cream is incredibleeee. They have a ton of unique flavors and combinations. My favorite item on the menu is their strawberry sundae with twist ice cream, with an Esther's chocolate covered pretzel on the side. Pure heaven. 3) their food is amazing as well. I love their south side hot dog! It's unique and amazing.. Toast bun, grilled dog and chilli sauce.. So good. Their fries are awesome as well. I also adore their lemonade, both regular and freckled. Keep in mind they are cash only though!
Bakery items are all exceptional but one of the workers should really be a little more friendly. Second time I have been there and she isn't very pleasant.

Mmmmm. I was so excited to see Bouchon Bakery on the way up to my room at the Venetian. I didn't think the prices were all that bad, considering it was in a toursity area in a toursity city and had high quality, authentic French pastries and food. I saw much crappier food for similar prices in Vegas. During my stay, I tried the chocolate pudding (3 layers of different flavors, creamy and heavenly and just the right size for a snack), a (huge) raspberry macaron (a bit too sweet but lovely smooth consistency), pain au chocolat (flaky and delicious, with the perfect amount of smooth chocolate chunks inside), and a carrot cake cookie (2 huge cookies, very soft and cake-like, with amazing cream cheese frosting inside). Service was fine, pretty fast and not at all snotty - if anything, it was the opposite (one woman who helped me pronounced everything incorrectly - it's macaRON NOT macaROON). Also, bonus points for the fake disposable silverware that looks exactly like the real thing. Very classy, Thomas Keller.

"anatomy of a perfect croissant" crisp and light crust, golden brown color, a bit of shine in crinkly edges. layers and layers of soft buttery goodness. enjoy plain or with gruyere. pair with your favorite morning coffee. I died and it was bread heaven. of course there's a lot more mouthwatering goodies that keeps me going back to this friendly neighborhood spot. morning buns are another favorite. their specialty pies are must tries (we got the yummy chocolate bourbon pecan). coffee here is pretty good too (they offer kin kin, another local product). cracked wheat loaf and ficelle are pretty solid. can't wait to try something different on my next visit!
World class. It topped off our side-trip to Cleveland's Little Italy. Coffee is excellent. Parking is tight in the general area. We were there for dinner, so we did a valet. I would Uber.

Let's be honest-- I love sprinkles. I used to get their cupcakes every time we would go to SoCal, and was so happy that they decided to open up a location here in Vegas. We've been to their location at the linq quite a couple of times, but yesterday's visit was just disappointing. I dragged a couple of friends with me to satisfy my cupcake craving, but what I got instead were two very dry and crumbly cupcakes. I got the seasonal chocolate chip cookie cupcake and my favorite, the dark chocolate cupcake. As soon as I bit into the chocolate chip cookie one, the whole cake practically crumbled in my hand. I had to use a fork just so I wouldn't make a mess. Whatever, I thought it was just that cupcake, but when I came home to eat the dark chocolate cupcake the same thing happened. The cake fell apart, and broke off into tiny little pieces. I mean, the flavors were still there, frosting was still great, but it was just not enjoyable to eat. It just didn't feel nor did it taste fresh. I know I'll be back anyway since, as I've mentioned, I love sprinkles, but hopefully next time will be a better experience.

Amazing little place in a quirky neighborhood serving unique ice cream and out of this world donuts. I could go on and on about Novel. Definitely the best glazed donut I've had in a long time. I love how light and not to sweet these are and they make the perfect "bun" to sandwich a scoop of creamy ice cream between. The owner is super hospitable and sincere, and makes you feel welcomed. My family and I can't wait to go back!

Orange chocolate chip is the best from Babcock and brought to the Union.. One of the few treats left in life! As far as outside the Union--Beautiful landscaping and inside great updates for the ice cream area. Impressive was the beautiful Bucky by the lake! You can now buy your ice cream outside also. Very cool. I especially was impressed by the Star Wars bar band music being played far away at the hoofer's club!

You have to try the cookie cup! Ice cream selection is small but very tasty. Staff is always friendly and helpful. The whole place is very clean and bright, great atmosphere to sit and enjoy your treat. A bit of advice for first timers coming here: It can be difficult to find. It is in the small building on Miller directly north of the Church's chicken. Fatty Daddy's is on the north side of the building, turn in where you see the barbershop/tattoo parlor.
I've probably been here 5 times since I moved to Charlotte and this place never disappoints the shakes are to die for and you can pick any ice cream on the menu and I guarantee you'll love it !

I'm all over that crack pie. I've tried their cookies and while they are tasty, nothing beats the crack pie when I need a sugar rush in Vegas. It's one of those addicting flavors that I have to have when ever I visit. Oh, that's why it's called crack pie! I get it now. Anyway, if you go, get me some ok? Please? Pretty please?

If you find yourself in this plaza running errands, then notice a long line of folks eagerly awaiting ice cream, you've found Handel's. Handel's only does window orders, so there's no building to enter. The order window closing on you as the employee grabs your order is a bit off-putting at first, but you get used to it, it's basically a "walk-thru" instead of a drive-thru experience. There are a few benches outside if you'd like to sit down and enjoy your treat, or you could always pick up a pint to take home. Our first visit was a bit of a revelation that we had been missing out. I got a single waffle cone of mint chocolate chip and my husband got the graham central station. When they say "single", they really mean way more than one scoop. The waffle cone was delicious, and I ended up leaving a scoop of ice cream in a bowl and popping it in the freezer for safe keeping. My husband has already been craving his graham central station selection. The girl helping us was very friendly and happily let us sample a few items since it was our first time. She told us their most popular flavors are the graham central station and the butter pecan. I did eventually go back and try the butter pecan, but found it way too buttery, while my mom thought it wasn't buttery enough (she's crazy lol). There are a lot more things for us to try here so it'll be nice to pop in here over the summer when it's hot outside. Pro Tip - expect long lines for their 2 Buck Tuesday specials

I loooooooooove ice cream, it's my weakness and the most important on my cheat days. I had somi in Cali a few years back when it first started so I was thrilled when it made its way here! The ice cream is so creamy and the fishy has the best crispy gooey texture to it. It's probably more dangerous for me because I live down the street, eek!! The plus side is this location is a little slower than China town so I don't have to turn myself away from long lines.
Such a refreshing change. The ice cream is homemade and ingredients are fresh. Staff is pleasant and very helpful. This will be a regular stop!! So glad we found such a wonderful place.
I mean my daughter loved it. I thought it was good but nothing super over the top. Just a typical fany ice cream place. Any time places do something different with ice cream kids go crazy over it.

I love the atmosphere. The decor is cute! They are open 24/7 and it is a great location to study, hold a meeting, or kill time. I had their Napoleon and it was one of the best desserts I have ever had.

I used to love this place, the people serving the ice cream were fun, the art was interesting and the music was good. Now, not so much. It seems like the ownership changed because none of the people that I recognize are working any more and the vibe is a little different. Luckily that doesn't affect the ice cream. However, I've noticed the portions are a little bit smaller than what they previously were for the same price. The cashier didn't know the difference between a dozen and half a dozen macarons which ended up in a very long and awkward exchange when trying to figure out why we were overcharged. Outside of that ice cream is still good and they offer plenty of flavors you will only find there. The macarons are baked fresh and taste delicious. The melted marshmallow on top offers a really yummy extra flavor. If you're looking for a late night unique snack and live in the area then this place if perfect.
Great donuts... friendly staff... just get there early or those Donuts will be gone...

A great bakery in the heart of Little Italy. It was the only place open semi-late (9pm) on a weeknight in the area where we could grab dessert. I ended up with the cappuccino brownie and it was fantastic. Some of the staples like cassata cake were already sold out but they had quite the selection of desserts still available. Staff was very friendly and made each customer feel like they were at home.

This is my absolute favorite ice cream shop in Charlotte. In the summertime it becomes an obsession, because warm weather warrants ice cream right? I'm pretty much here on a weekly basis when the weather is nice, don't tell my waistline. I have tried a couple of shakes and I love them, but 99% of the time I visit, it's for a macaron I've cream sandwich. They have daily macaron specials that you can choose from, or you can create your own with 1 ice cream flavor and 1 topping. It's like a 2-for-1 special : macarons AND ice cream. This is really genius. Take all of my money. If you haven't been here you are missing out. If you go in for a visit, I'm pretty sure you will find something you love too.
AMAZING!!! A must try place when in Cleveland! Donuts are so fresh and their Maple Bacon is INCREDIBLE!!! Love this place!!!
It's the best ice cream in Arizona and they do a phenomenal job of packaging it up for delivery through the delivery applications

I was back in town from college excited to order my usual, cinnamon - chocolate french macaroon and almond tea cake. I also decided tried their salted caramel brownie macaroon to be disappointed by both macaroons. Not only did they increase the prices for both the macaroons and the tea cakes but the macaroons weren't very good and stale. The place is way too crowded which makes it difficult to see what pastries they have. I use to go 2-3 times a month but will probably only go back 2-3 times a year for serious cravings.
Mitchell's was incredible! Cookies and cream ice cream was delicious and only set me back $3.75. Prompt service and ability to sample multiple flavors.

Disappointed. I had visited Carlo's Bakery on a previous trip to Las Vegas and had a good experience. So good in fact, I knew it was a must stop on my recent trip there. However, I was not impressed and neither were my friends. We each got a cupcake though there weren't many flavors to choose from but you could never go wrong with chocolate or vanilla right?! Mind you, we went at 9:30 at night but Vegas is the city that never sleeps! Our cupcakes were dry and hard! If you're a Cakeboss fan and must stop here in Vegas, plan to stop early when the desserts are likely more fresh.

Ooo buddy let me tell ya. This some good ice cream right here. Definitely worth going to try. Only negative I have of this place is it is a bit expensive in my opinion. They give you options for toppings on ice cream which I think is dope but you have to pay per topping so it can add up.

I've never had frozen custard until I lived in Champaign. Let me just say that this stuff is amazing!! Prior to this I was a huge fan of Dairy Queen. Jarling's Custard Cup has changed me forever and I miss it greatly now that I'm back in Virginia. I'll never look at DQ the same way again.

Counter service great. Daughter loves the show - so why we came. But register service was very slow. Orders piled up. Register was unmanned for 4 minutes and orders were stacked. Traffic flow in store bad too. To get out you have to cross the line.

We were referred to this place for a great place to have ice cream after our meal at Joyride Taco's. Not only was it great - it was AMAZING! it was by far the best homemade ice cream I have had, BY FAR! although most wouldn't pay as much for ice cream as some sundaes do cost, every bite was well worth it and more. They have very hearty servings and fun to share. Everything looks like a miniature work of art. It is very clear the owners have really though out the detail in everything they serve, as well as some of the friendliest people they have staffed to serve. I'm afraid if I wasn't from out of town, I would be there for sure every weekend, if not every night. Highest of recommendations!

Stopped here yesterday for a frozen treat. Wasn't disappointed by the toasted marshmallow on red velvet macaron on ice cream. It was very good. 5 stars would have been granted if it wasn't for the oddly tasting waffle cup at the bottom of my tower of deliciousness.

I was in literal heaven eating the birthday cake here. It was so good. We have a bag of six cookies that I will eat on the plane ride home today that I'm sure will be absolutely delicious. Can't say enough good things. And it was quick which didn't hurt.

Where do I begin?! I've been devouring these desserts for so long, even before their Concord store front. That's right folks: they've been making desserts for local restaurants before you even knew they existed. I have fought through a day-before-thanksgiving bar crowd to order one of their chocolate peanut butter cake slices togo from Whiskey Warehouse. Their macaroons are made in house and the flavors change daily. The bialys (my favs are the everything and the jalapeÃ±o cheddar) are a great, cheap morning snack on the go. Locally sourced nitro'd coffee on draft. Oh and then there's the owners! They're Plaza Midwoodians and have been from some time. They pour their New York/ Italian souls into their food, however, and it's evident. These folks care so much about everyone who walks into their door and are happy to share their story and their love for their product with you, so don't be afraid to chat them up. I've never met such kind people before and am so glad they're just a hop away from me now! Seriously go here. You won't regret it!
The manager was working on a Friday night and he was so friendly, let us try anyflavors and gave us extra sized portions above what we ordered! I love the old fashioned real ice cream!

Welcoming friendly staff. Not as busy as I would expect for a bakery in the morning, but steady flow of customers were seen coming and going while I enjoyed my croissant and latte outside. Chocolate croissant is amazing. My latte wasn't hot enough so next time I will ask for extra hot Will definitely return. Appreciate the clean restroom.

A 24/7 French bakery is just a genius concept in general. Have been coming here since the first weekend I've moved in Charlotte 4 years ago and it's been a staple place for me to take out-of-towners ever since. Everyone says it, but they say it for a reason. You have to try the salted caramel brownie. Even if it's just a few bites since it's so rich.. but it's worth every bite. Their lattes are also great and ambiance in this place is fun, eclectic and stands out to the other local bakeries in town. Perfect spot for meeting friends/or catching up on work-- you'll see both here. **Rumor has it--they're opening a new 11,000 sq. foot location in Uptown replacing the College Plaza cafeteria at Wells Fargo Two. Uptown needs more local coffee shops (especially ones open on weekends).. so very excited about this!

I used to sell Honey on the black market, and I got a good share of the profits (that was my Honey Cut), but I got sick of it (I was in a Honey Rut), so I opened a Crazy Golf course (named Honey Putt). One of my customers became the love of my life... we had nicknames for each other (she was Honey Butt) (I was Honey Nuts), and all was going well until we went bankrupt (Honey Kaput). So we started making adult movies together, and opened our own production company (Honey Smut), and it went so well that we were able to use the earnings to tour the country in search of the best Honey Pecan Ice Cream imaginable. And we found it. And it's in Cleveland. (drops mic) What to get: Honey Pecan Ice Cream Why: Because Honey Butt agrees, it's the best in the country Your dog won't like this ice cream, unless it's a Pecanese. If you close you're eyes, I'll hide your ice cream and we can see if you find it. Count to 40! No Pecan! The funny thing is, I don't even like Honey Pecan ice cream, mainly because I'm not crazy about nuts, but this thing is so good that I don't care - and you won't either. It's always busy here and the Honey Pecan is the reason why. There are several other locations in the area too, but this one is my favourite because it seems like all the cute customers hang out here, not to mention the girl that served me was a total flirt and while I am completely immune to such things... OK fine I'm not immune at all and I loved it. I need to pee and the only thing around is a can. I guess now it's a Peecan. Cleveland has a lot of wonderful places to eat main meals and snacks, but when it comes to dessert treats, you come here for ice cream, and then you go to Biagio's at 4am and get hot-out-of-the-fryer Crulers. And if the cute people here aren't enough for you and you're looking more for Playboy types, go to "Bunny Hut." If you want to date a comedian (like myself) try "Funny Hut." If Cleveland is too dreary for you, try the sister location in San Diego, "Sunny Hut." Or the Bank attached to it "Money Hut." Or the 2 places named after my jokes, "Crummy Hut" and "Corny Hut." And if all this has got you a little worked up and hot under the collar, then I'll meet you at "Horny Hut."

I always make it a must do every time I come to Vegas to stop by here. There's so many different things on the menu I want to try. Creme brule donut is a must! I decided this time I would try the French toast to share with my husband. SO MUCH REGRET....agreeing to share with him... one bite and I wanted it all to myself ! LOLOLOLOL.
The donut was amazing I had the strawberry with whip cream one it was light and airy.
Yeah,I'm going to have to agree with everyone that this place is all hype...only good thing was that I didn't have to wait in line..the first time I tried it was more than an hour wait so I left...

It's ok, we've been going a lot since opening. Main complaint is the efficiency even when there isn't a line around the door. Takes a long time to get coffee or tea. Definitely go and check it out. But make sure you're not in a hurry. You'll be here a while

I had crack pie! It was delicious. I wish it had been a freshly sliced pie, instead it was pre sliced in a cardboard container. It was teeny tiny. I was surprised at how small the slice was for the price. I probably would not go again, but I can now say I had crack pie.
I love this place and ambiance. Peace of Mind...

I found this place looking up "ice cream" here on Yelp. The Cookie Daddy was what drew my friend and I in so we headed over! The location was hard to find at first but we realized it was hidden in the building behind Chruch's. I ordered the Cookie Daddy with chocolate hazelnut ice cream, a vanilla macaroon, and of course, the marshmallow. The ice cream and macaroon were unbelievably delicious and the genuine flavor was the best part. As for the marshmallow, it (obviously) tasted artificially toasted which I didn't entirely enjoy, but overall the ice cream was incredible (hence why I ate it so fast and forgot to take a picture). Also, I believe all their ice cream (besides the cereal ones) are egg and soy free and organic which you can't beat. Check this place out if you can!

Breads were all good, rose milk tea was good, tiger boba latte did not taste like coffee instead tasted like milk tea. The cashier stuff 12 pieces of bread in the box, lid kept popping open and bread was a little out of shape when we got to it.
Big fan of their vegan soft served!! The staff is very friendly, and the outdoor seating area is a very quaint place to sit and enjoy your treats :)

I've been coming here since I was in high school and it's like time doesn't change. I love their cases of cookies, both large and small in size. My favorites are the small, tea cookies- chocolate ganache and raspberry and apricot lindzers. The tiramisu and other pastries do not disappoint- I'm just usually too full for them after a large meal at one of the nearby restaurants. It's also a great spot to grab some prepared food too. Don't forget to grab a number upon entering! And if you can snag a table outside with a coffee, then you'll feel like you've stepped into an Italian sidewalk cafe.

This is in the heart of the downtown area of Phoenix so be prepared to search for parking. We parked behind the place and walked around the block. We actually missed it the first time by. We ordered two kinds of ice cream-horchata and Mexican hot chocolate. With tip, it came to $17. That's very pricey for ice cream, but let's face it, it came with a fortune cookie in a to-go Chinese take out container! The ice cream was delicious. I can't say that I'd be a regular here, but it was a good experience.

Ok, I love ice cream. Yes, but not all ice cream is created equal. Having grown up with the crappy ice milk you get at certain locations that shall remain nameless, but use two letters as their name, you develop certain flawed expectations of what is good ice cream. Then the $6 tiny cup of average crap with a mix in named after the cold rock they mix your stuff on. Yes, you remember with nostalgia the hand cranked ice cream at grandma's house, as long as you were young enough to not have to take a turn, and getting to lick the paddle, but as soon as you were old enough you realized what an absolute pain in the nether regions that was and how grandpa and dad always fought against it, since its not 1885 anymore. So, when you get a little bit of nostalgia with really good ice cream that you got to buy, not recreating a turn of the century sweatshop for fun, and see candy from your childhood for sale, you jump on it right! RIGHT! So the wife and I hit churn on our stay-cation away from the kids last year, and it was amazing! Madagascar vanilla, orangecicle ice cream and the secret ingredient, a delicious apricot cranberry oatmeal cookie. HA HA HA HA, it was so good, not too sweet with tons of flavor! Wife got some combination of death by chocolate that she loved and i hardly paid attention to because mine was so good. I manage on most days to avoid driving over unless i am really stressed. I swear my therapist must be a part owner of the place. The sweets shop nature of the place with the nice shaded patio in back really is quite fun, and they also sell some jars of cool syrups and such. If you like ice cream, go and have fun, but heaven help you if you take the last apricot cranberry oatmeal cookie before I get there, some things cannot be overlooked.
Best donuts I've ever had. I'm not even a big fan of donuts, but whatever they do here...from the variety, to the frostings and glaze, to the texture...it all works oh so well.

THE BEST!! I love the flavors and the cute aspect of this place. You just have to try it for yourself - so unique and delicious, how does this sound....LAVENDER HONEY ice cream topped with Cinnamon Toast Crunch cereal -- you will be at a loss for words, orgasmic. The sweet person at the register named a character on the wall after me, it's probably common but it made me feel special. LOVE-LOVE this place.
Not sure what all the hype was it's in a sketchy area and I paid $6 for a kid size ice cream prob won't come back.

Love this bakery! Amelie has 3 locations in Charlotte but this is the only one that's open 24/7. Here's several highlights about this bakery: The salted caramel brownies are delicious! This is one of their best sellers... and I'd say that it lives up to the hype. I had the rose eclair on my last visit and while it was good, it didn't beat the brownies. I've been to this location multiple times and there's always a line to place an order. My last visit was on a Saturday around 8:30PM. There were probably about 15 people ahead of me. So if you're looking for a grab and go experience, this is not the place. The ambiance is very whimsical and cute. I love it! They have plenty of seating. Lots of people seem to come here to work. I've never done it so can't testify to the quality of their wifi or number of power outlets... however judging by the crowd, I can safely assume they do pretty good job on both.

Wow! This place was freaking amazing. Not only is the vibe in the place really cool, the staff are super nice, the place is clean, the ice cream was absolutely delicious!! I got the butter pecan and I was in heaven on earth. It was seriously that good. My family and I ordered around 5 things and everybody devoured everything. I don't think my family's ever been so quiet on drive the home. Everybody finished their ice cream before we even pulled into our neighborhood. Y'all have got to go try out this place! P.s: I wish I would have grabbed a picture to show but it was so good that I forgot to stop eating to take a picture lol

Always lovely getting ramen here for their pop-up events. A bowl is ~ twelve dollars. But totally worth it. Two flavors pork and veggie. I've tried both. First time saying that I love the veggie ramen more than pork. The broth is rich and delicious. I here they are gonna be serving ramen starting December 12th. I can't wait.

I expected this place to be amazing. Got the drumstick milkshake with the edible rim. The flavor didn't really pop, presentation was nice but I felt like this place doesn't live up to the hype, especially not for an $8 milkshake. So 3 stars for being average.

Stopped by here for a snack after making a deposit into the Megabucks machine. Figured that I deserved something after winning absolutely nothing. Anyways took me a minute to finally find the place and it is true that they do not any places to sit. Scanned the display case and everything looked pretty good. Decided on a carrot cake cookie sandwich and a chocolate macaroon. I am not a big macaroon fan, but decided to try one of these because everyone says it's the thing to get here. Well...yeah, still not a macaroon fan but it was alrite. Carrot cake cookie sandwich on the other hand was mighty fine. Next time I make another deposit into one of those one arm bandits, I will make sure I have a lil something left to try out one of those Oreo looking things.

Milk Bar has really good cake and the slices are enough for two people. They were really moist and fresh. I didn't have to wait in line long it took about 5 minutes. All the employees were really nice and it's in a great location.

When in Little Italy, Presti's is a MUST! The meatballs are handmade and yummy. The sides are delish. And there are so many fresh baked goods to mention. You may have to take a number due to the crowds but it is truly worth the wait. Try their coffees and cocoas also!

It was ok... After seeing the reviews I figured it would be love at first lick, but it wasn't. My husband and I got the cereal themed ice creams, and while they were ok, they were nothing special. It all seemed much harder than gelato or ice cream I'm used to. The woman and young girl were very pleasant. Also, when you put this in navigation is isn't incredibly easy to find unless you're driving southbound. The parlor is small as well as the parking lot. We don't live in the area, but I'm glad we tried it while we were in town.

This is not an ice cream shop. I went this afternoon and got Nutella with hazelnut chocolate in a waffle cone with rainbow sprinkles. The ice cream had no taste and there were about 5 sprinkles on the cone even after I asked for more. Unacceptable for paying over $8.

Oh my, oh my, the croissants are so delicious. warm, soft, and buttery. Almost as good as the ones I would buy in Paris. There seems to always be a line here weekend mornings, but I don't mind waiting. My parents really enjoy their macaroons. I tried this fruit tart that was to die for. It was overloaded with fruits and just the right amount of sweetness. I haven't tried their cupcakes, and I think I'll be keeping it that way. Its supposed to be a french bakery, so I'll stick to the specialties.
My girlfriend bought me a surprise birthday cake from here, and it was absolutely delicious. It tasted very good and was nicely decorated. I will come back again despite the crowds and wait

One word: Delicious Two words: Great atmosphere My Two cents: Yummy in my tummy! Everyone should check out Amelie's Bakery located in NoDa. It's really more than a bakery and once you check it out you will understand why I say this. It's almost like hanging out at your cool (but eclectic) aunt's house who likes to whip up tarts, bear claws, breakfast sandwiches and more to tempt your tastebuds. I'm telling you about this place because you can treat it as an experience and swing by anytime to have an almost 9 1/2 weeks (remember that movie...HOT!) moment with a date or pick up treats for an everyday or special occasion. By now your mouth should be watering. Just remember these delicious items could be picked up at anytime since its open 24 hours a day (winning!!).

Stopped by to try their famous pastries and grabbed a quick sandwich while on the go. Ended up ordering their pork sandwich (panini style) perfectly pressed on a dutch crunch roll. We tried the coffee cake and the cheese danish. WOW oh WOW on the pastries!!! The Coffee cake is like no other I have had. Buttery and just the right amount of crisp on the top. The Cheese danish should have its own twitter page..That croissant was the lightest, buttery, creamy cheesy goodness one could ever have. Wow, I think I'm drueling alittle..Seriously try their pastries..You will not regret the $ or the calories! Its not in the most conspicuous location, but walk towards the Phantom area and its right by the escalator.

I was so excited to try this place because I love Buddy but I think some of his staff need a little lesson in being nice because the cashier almost had a heart attack when I asked for a fork. Like sorry lady I didn't know it came out of your paycheck, or a least she acted like it... So that ruined it for me
Great food! I definitely recommend this establishment. They definitely have great customer service that matches the food.

My friend and I both ordered the cereal milk soft serve with the cornflake crunch. The soft serve was good but nothing remarkable. The cornflake crunch was very salty. It might have been an off-batch but we found ourselves eating around it... I wouldn't find myself venturing here again.

Seriously? People in AZ must be hard up for good ice cream. Just because they put unique combinations together doesn't mean that it's good ice cream. Maybe I'm biased because I'm from San Francisco and have been spoiled with Bi-Rite ice cream. I do know good ice cream when I eat it and sweet republic is all hype. The salted caramel started out good but then just tasted like flavored whipped cream. It left a rotten milk after taste in my mouth that made me keep saying ew. I tried the honey blue cheese. Very strong flavor but nothing special. I get what they were trying to do and it's a good thing they're in Arizona because in California they wouldn't be as successful. Not to mention the staff was rude. We were the only ones in there on a hot Saturday afternoon (which should tell you something), and there were three people behind the counter but it still took a few minutes before we were acknowledged. Then the lady was simply cold and annoyed. Ok point taken we won't be back. Not a loss. Well at least not for us.

This is the place to go to enjoy delicious custard in the Champaign-Urbana area. Personally, I find the custard to be a bit on the sweet side and think that the toppings and mix-ins are really the secret to what makes this so addictive. However, you're really not going to find anything better in this area. The actual shop is somewhat small and can get quite busy during the summer months. While not the cheapest, prices are reasonable (and with prices of other frozen shoppes increasing, this is becoming more of a value). Parking isn't too bad and there's a generous amount of outdoor seating (which fills easily during the summer). Overall, if you're visiting Champaign -- this is worth a visit for the flavor and the experience. It's hard to pinpoint what exactly makes their product addictive, but it's hard to resist rich, creamy custard.

This place is so cute! The cupcakes are really delicious and you have so many to choose from. I had the chocolate and hubby had lemon and we both loved it. Moist, not to sweet goodness. ...I'm going back before I leave Vegas

It's not bad...but it can be a lot better. I was recommended to this place for some French bakery and small snacks. I don't think I will comeback...their service is really night though, but if i want true French snacks for this price, I can go somewhere else. Setup and staff are very friendly though
Love!! We ordered 2 Mini Daddy's and it was perfect!! Everything was fresh and delicious. Will definitely be a repeat customer.
There aren't enough good words about the great eats here.. TRUST ME!! go there.. you will not be disappointed

Love the cake boss so had to seek out this bakery that is in the middle of the Palazzo/Venetian. The shelves are lined with pretty pastries but they don't have note cards to explain what's what. The helper was a little short when customers before me asked what was what. So when it was my turn I kept it simple with a Nutella lobster tail and a cannoli (supposed to be top sellers here). I also had a sample of their sugar cookies that were out for tasting. The two pastries were both delicious! But they tasted similar to other bakeries pastries that are much less expensive. Each pastry runs close to $6 each. Still a great place to stop if you're a fan of the cake boss! There's also a cake boss restaurant right across the bakery. Gotta try the next time we're in town.
I got the cheesecake. Not only was it not worth the money-nearly $12 for a small cheesecake, it was so dry. I couldn't get past the third bite. I was so bummed!
The peanut butter and chocolate ice was amazing!!! Fresh and warm waffle cones to go with it!!!
Amazing ice cream with flavors you won't get anywhere else. Can't wait to try the ramen! Staff is awesome. It's a great spot to bring the community together.

I've been here a few times because my girlfriend absolutely loves it. I guess I'm just not a fan of french baked goods or whatever because I've yet to be blown away by anything I've tried so far. I have ordered a variety of things and haven't been impressed with any of it. I seriously think that maybe I just don't like french cuisine due to the ENORMOUS amount of people that love this place. It's always packed to the gills and that's saying a lot because the establishment is huge. I do enjoy the way it's laid out and decorated. Very artistic and mellow. It reminds me of an on-campus college eatery of sorts. It also attracts a lot of early twenty somethings and of course when that happens, I think it's pretentious and overrated because I hate conformity. Maybe that's why I'm lonely. I go here to sip a cup of coffee and glance from behind my teacup at the potential friendships I may develop, only to realize I'm a disappointment in everything I do and that no one will ever truly understand or love me. So I choke down the sandwiches of hard bread. I apathetically chew the crescent roll pastries until I grow bored with it, half eaten, growing more and more stale by the second. Stale like this life I've sluggishly and lethargically meandered along, awaiting for my hope and faith in humanity to renew. Envious of all those smiling and content faces that reflect success and happiness. They get what they want and they love it here, but it makes me depressed. Won't someone give me a hug? I mean, is it the beard? Should I shave it off? I like my beard though. I guess I'll have to settle on me liking the little things about myself since no one else like anything about me. Even my girlfriend settled on me. It's becoming more obvious every time she just nods at my attempt at humor, unsmiling, eyes screaming out for help too, in hopes that some 24 year old Vespa driving French man, or woman even, thanks to me, will come rescue her from this life with me that she never in a hundred years would have envisioned when our romance was still fresh. It too has grown stale. So yeah, that sums up how I feel about this place. UPDATE: Since the customer service woman of AmÃ©lie's gave me an internet hug, I feel the need to update my rating from two stars to three. This place, and my life, are A-OK now. I see the sun shining through the clouds and my girlfriend set up a mÃ©nage Ã trois with her new French girlfriend and I, which by the way has been surprisingly nice so far... she's a real sweetheart... so all is well.

Kinda a bit of a sellout. Pre-package. And $6.50 for a piece on crack pie in a box like you would get it at McDonald's. No impressed at all. And $52 for the whole pie. WTF !!! Not impressed at all. Seems almost like a get rich quick scheme. Was so excited to try this place and was a total let down
This is one of our favorite ice cream places in Pittsburgh! Everything is delicious! EVERYTHING!!!! Only downside is that they only accept cash, oh and they aren't open year round!

Wow. Do you love macaroons? Do you love ice cream? Well I'm here to tell you they are amazing together!!! It's not just hype- their products are good quality and the guy who helped me made me something that wasn't on the menu that I saw on yelp. It was sooooooo good. There's so many things to choose from so do your homework a little bit before you go if it takes you a little while to make your mind up.

My first time here and we tried 3 pastries. A pistachio macaron, a kouign amann, and a chocolate almond croissant. We went in the early afternoon and did not feel like there was a huge selection to choose from. The kougin amann was my favorite out of the 3 pastries. It was dense, flakey, with that caramelized exterior I love. The chocolate almond croissant was more dense than any almond croissant I've had experience with but my boyfriend said this is how a proper almond croissant should be so be prepared for something a little different. There were 3 flavors available for the macarons. The pistachio had good flavor and a slightly chewy texture with a light crispy exterior. These macarons are on the large end but they were baked perfectly. The pastries here are certainly a step above your standard French bakery and if you love pastries this is a must eat while in Vegas!

this place was on my list..read about this place on fb newsfeeds..tried the cereal milk soft serve ice cream...crushed cornflakes sprinkled around vanilla soft serve in a cup..yummy! and i tried a slice of the crack pie..omg it was damn delicious! wish i bought more to take back home...i will definitely be back!!!
If you can't decide the 4-scoop sampler is the way to go. Have yet to have a flavor we didn't like!!

Milk- It does a body good. Now when it's combined with flour, sugar and eggs... I still count it as good! If you happen to be in or around the Cosmopolitan Hotel, stop in Milk Bar for a tasty treat we all deserve. Their infamous Bday Cake is now being served by the slice. There seems to be a slight citrus flavor which I couldn't quite nail down but really gave it a unique flavor. The cake itself was moist even for a slice. We were there when they opened up for the day so that might play a factor in how moist the slices will be. It was the perfect treat for us to share. Milk Bar is located on the second floor near their other restaurants. The staff were friendly and quick to serve. Thank you for the treat and I hope to return soon.

Our 1st visit to Villani's Bakery was as excellent as multiple visits after. Variety of items assures you will find something yummy, no matter your preference. Customer service is shockingly consistent and always delightful. Italian Cream birthday cake for my husband was delightful to look at and eat, amazing! I've found non better in Charlotte! Thank You Villani's and Welcome to Plaza Midwood. Ron Wright

Vegan coffee and oreo soy ice cream. I'm pretty sure that's all I have to say. Just let that image sink into your brains and get yourself to State Street if you want to enjoy some refreshing, creamy, dairy-free yumminess this summer.

Amazing ice cream!!! I had the Cookie Monster and it was so damn good. The owner is a kind man and the staff is super nice. Awesome place to go with friends or fam. I'm absolutely coming don't pass this place up!!!!!!

Everything sunshine and sparkles over here until I didn't get what I ordered despite pointing out the item and no one picks up their phone. I recommend Whole Foods for fresh fruit tart. Service in daytime at AmÃ©lie's is significantly better than evening.

Strike 1- The dry confetti cake. Strike 2- The desecration of an already perfect classic, chess pie. Gummy and one note (served ice cold). Strike 3-The prices. I should have known better when I saw everything being mass produced in a commissary on Netflix's Chef's Table. Frosting the outside of a cake does serve a purpose- to keep it from drying out.

Delicious-looking selections of pastries and desserts. Unfortunately I haven't tried any of them, as they are not vegan. However the few vegan soups I have had here have been absolutely delicious. Kind of pricey though, so it isn't an every week kind of treat. Usually seating is available if you avoid peak times.

This is my first time to visit this Bakeshop bcoz one of my girlfriends raved about this place. Well, as a family who is always on the lookout for " good pastries" this place is very disappointing. First, it's overpriced ( it's Vegas, duh) . We ordered the cannoli,-- taste is bland, nothing special & the cream even tasted " grainy"! We also ordered 3 different flavored croissants & I really think we were ripped off. We left it overnight for the next morning & the croissants became really hard to eat. Lastly, we also bought the apple crumble pie & tasted like we bought it from Vons/ Ralph's ! We Won't come back, not worth the money at all. But the staff is really nice-- that's for the star I gave.
Hands down best ice cream in town. My family has been visiting this establishment for over 50 years. You won't be disappointed! Amazing ice cream by a dedicated family run business.
Yes Sir!!!! This is the place! The best ice cream in the Valley all tucked into a donut. Wow. You gotta go

This is definitely the best of the best ice cream I ever had in my life. I'm not a ice cream person but man!!! The silky smooth texture with just perfect amount of sweetness makes this place a MUST for ice cream craving!! And they really really NOT Skimping you! Big portions!

Nothing special about the icecream. Flavor was ordinary. Not much parking available. Had to park at Boston Market and walk five minutes to get here. Place inside is really small. It's smaller than regular bathroom and I'm not kidding! Not coming back. Wife rating -2.5/5 I'm starting to doubt the genuineness of the reviews. There is no way, this place should have over 3.5. There is a Dairy Queen close to this place that we decided to go next if in the area.

With Blue Bell off the shelf, Sweet Republic is a good fallback for creamy rich ice cream. The more you care about the quality of ice cream the more you will like this place. They don't have an outrageous selection of flavors and have only a few toppings, but I would scream for this ice cream.

WOW! This place is something else. The flavors are on point and the cookies are unreal! I used to have a favorite ice cream shop until I stopped in to check this place out. I recommend stopping in and checking it out for yourself. You will not be disappointed! I had the red velvet cookie cup with grandma's cookies, gram cracker topping, and a toasted marshmallow on top. WOW!

Omg the tarts are amazing! They also have mini tarts so you can enjoy more flavors without getting too full! I brought some to several friends and they all love them!! Basically all favors of tarts are great and I cannot lick my fav!
Flavors are interesting and tasty. And there are good vegan options. You can't go wrong!

Dear Readers, It was a slightly breezy night during COVID-19. Our group stood in line outside Churn (at a safe distance) for less than 10 min as they were letting in one group at a time. The staff was very friendly and knowledgeable about their products. More importantly, they were all wearing masks. The flavors were unique and intriguing but we settled on mint chip ice cream + mint chip cookie and goat cheese pistachio topped with strawberries (per the recommend of the masked associate). The flavors were fresh and authentic. We sat in the back patio with friends and enjoyed the night. Sincerely, Hillary and Andrew

Not really sure what all the hype is about. We had the double trouble sundae - two scoops of ice cream and hot fudge for $7. Ice cream flavors were pretty bland. Had the peanut chip and brownie flavors. Honestly would not come back here. Go to sugar bowl or sprinkles for better dessert in the area - this place is pretty sub par.

I really enjoyed the pastries that we tried but I agree with other reviews that there is NO sense of urgency from the employees! Wait in line to order your pastries then go get in another line to pay for them! Both times we went, the paying line took forever. The cashier seemed to always be M.I.A
Everything I've tried from here hit's the spot. I wish they'd stay open year round.
Just North of Church's and the fitness place, tucked away in a tiny strip mall. We got gluten-free brownies with ice cream. So delicious! The place is bright and friendly. So glad we found it!

Dear Red Velvet cupcake, GET IN MY MOUTH. My favorite cupcake to date. I love the ATM that's available to satisfy your cravings after hours - though I still prefer to get one through the store... Would rate 5/5 if lower priced

Been there a couple times now. Have tried the cereal milk with the crunchy topping, slice of birthday cake, and the crack pie. All are incredibly delicious. I usually hate birthday cake but their version is so unique. Perfect amount of sweetness which makes you wanting more without feeling like diabetes is right around the corner. Probably still has the same high amount of sugar as other cakes but the taste and mouthfeel makes it a much better experience. Most items are pretty pricey but it's a nice indulgent treat.

These folks can get it right when it comes to Italian delights. It's not a cheap date but how does one value the heavenly tastes of freshly made Sfogliatella, aka 'lobster tail' filled with Crema Pasticcera?

The ice cream flavors were so fun and unique! I loved the Ube and tried rosemary olive oil and it was so good! Will say the portions are a little small for our liking, but overall fun spot in Ohio city!

I tried to love it, had a chocolate chip cookie and milk once, and was satisfied.. took my date here after lunch next door and went all out on a vietnamese iced coffee ice cream and red velvet cookie sandwich.. the cookie was too hard and made it not enjoyable for me =( But the ice cream was delicious !
What a find! Try the blueberry ice cream. Just like a blueberry muffin yummy also had the mocha Java yaya and it was wonderful.

UPDATE: Thank you to the shop owner for clarifying... their dairy free creamer is not Vegan. I'm curious to know how that works. Looks like I have some research to do. If there's no dairy in it, shouldn't it be vegan? Hmmm. This place is wonderful! I can't wait to come back! This was my first time in, I arrived later in the afternoon on a Saturday, and they were fully stocked! And it was NOT due to lack of sales. People were buying the pastries by the dozens and the employees were restocking crazy fast! The lobby is super clean, employees were walking around cleaning as we chose our breads, AND THEY HAVE BOBA TEAS!!! :-) Prices of the pastries are very reasonable and the boba tea prices/sized are comparable to most boba shops. I picked up a caramel boba tea and a hot dog bun. Hot dog bun was so good it didn't last the walk to the car, haha! The caramel boba tea was delicious as well. All their milk teas are made dairy free so drink up my vegan and lactose intolerant friends!
Cute French cafe with outstanding homemade soups and sandwiches. I enjoyed the spinach asparagus leek soup and turkey brie raspberry sandwich. A great lunch combo for a rainy December day!

Cannot seem to figure out the best flavor. I am a Chocolate flavor person by heart. The banana split is waaÃ aaaaa6yyyyyyyyyytyty too big. But the ice cream itself is nice and creamy and full of flavor. I like this joint but it gets busy and when you have kids just hanging all over you while you wait it is almost too much to wait for. Anyhow, this ice cream is worth it once it's your turn.

Some of the best ice cream in town. Weekends and after work hours this place is always packed. Best time to go is weekdays before 5 if you can. Texas sheet cake is their dairy freee Chocolate which sounds suspect but is actually delightful. It is my favorite flavor. For your first visit i recommend getting the trio for $6. It is 3 half scoops and a sample of the delish waffle cone. Yummy!

Shout out to the amazing manager working tonight who took hella good care of me and my family with a smile on her face. Give that woman a raise cause damn she embodies exceptional service with a great attitude.

My favorite ice cream place in Las Vegas. In fact it's the only place I go to for ice cream. Truly it's always fresh and delicious . Staff were always super friendly and prompt. Thank you Handel's for recognizing the Veterans every single year!!!

Only thing is ice cream is good for is pictures. If you care about taste I wouldn't come here. I don't know how this place has good reviews unless the people who tasted this ice cream came here during the pandemic and didn't realize they lost their taste yet. Drove 15 minutes here and was so disappointed. Ice cream taste like someone went to the dollar store bought the cheapest vanilla ice cream they could find, added a bunch of unnecessary food colorings which gave the ice cream a metal aftertaste and dumped a bunch of sugar in it. Taste like something I would give a bunch of two year olds at a kids birthday party but that's only if I didn't like the kids. But I love kids so I would never do that. I'm the type of person where even if I don't like my food I'll finish it so it won't go to waste but I happily threw it out after the second bite.

Let's preface this review to say that Donut Bar claims to have the best donuts anywhere. I'll say that they're right, after visiting them for the first time, trying their donuts (multiple kinds) and a shot of their Espresso. Better than Voodoo Donuts! Why do I say that? 1. The recipes are fresh and homemade. I can taste it. No pre-made dough, no dough conditioners. Just pure, tasty donuts. Yum. 2. Great customer service. I didn't catch the name of the person who assisted me, served my donuts and pulled my espresso shot, but she was so friendly and peppy and happy and that was such a good espresso shot. 3. That was a really good espresso shot. I'll be back. Five Stars.
Beautiful choices, a favorite place to go with my grandkids! And the new location is very convenient.

I've tried the boba tea here a couple times and it just isn't my favorite. The flavors sound like they'd be very good, but they didn't taste as good as they sounded. I have some friends who went and really enjoyed it, so it could just be me. Their desserts and drinks here are really pretty and make for nice photos, but the flavor wasn't there for me.
Very good sweets and treat. Very laid back place

The Neopolitan - simply phenomenal. A little surprised at the toughness of the top layer. Breaking through with a fork resulted in largely collapsing the structure, expelling the filling out all sides. The top layer is really the key to the flavor profile, but the filling provides a textural element that enhances the overall experience by contrasting with the crunch of the pastry. Also had the salty caramel brownie. It was quite good. The caramel had a soft texture

Stopped in here with my family on a Sunday around 2 pm and it was packed. We had to wait in line at least 25-30 minutes to order. There is a lot of seating but with the number of people who come here you will be hard to get one! The desserts however are delicious. We sampled the vanilla filled eclaire and it was wonderful. We also sampled a mini chocolate tart and a white chocolate pistachio bite. They were both amazing, especially the pistachio. I can't wait to go back here and try some other desserts as well as some of their coffee.

I am utterly in LOVE with Villani's. Their tiramisu, which I've had multiple times, is one of the best desserts I've ever tasted. So flavorful and decadent, but light enough that it's won't make you full after a few bites. Easy to say I'm obsessed with it. The lobster claw is just as delicious but also fun to eat. The GF chocolate cake is almost fudge like and extremely addicting, a great option for gluten sensitive individuals that will not disappoint! The chocolate PB cake is intensely delicious, could share one slice between two people. They always have a hugely diverse selection of delicious goodies, so don't be afraid to go in the afternoons as they will still be plenty stocked. The staff is always welcoming and friendly, and they've taken mask wearing and social distancing protocols very seriously to keep the community safe. I can't rave about this place enough. One of my favorite spots ever!!

Mehhh, nothing to write home about. Truly basic flavors with a great concept. It was reasonably priced and had seating outside, along with limited seat inside. My cupcake did not fast fresh and was a pretty heavy. I prefer light and moist cupcakes but that was not what I got. If I Sprinkles on my travels I will try again.

Yummy soft serve! Classic cones and a great destination spot after a bike ride! Lots of parking available, if you choose the pick up option you have to be in the parking lot at their curbside spots. When it's busy it can take up to 30 minutes for an order and you can't wait in their designated curbside pick up spots.

Over rated bakery do not let the hype fool you this place is trash I mean super duper trash. I got the cannolis bruh they taste like chalk and powder I mean it's super nasty and way over priced. Everything I mean everything is over priced and so trash. Do not go here please read the reviews first don't waste your money like me. This place is ass

I live for these donuts. I will never go to Krappy Kreme, Dunkin, or even some local places again. These are the best you will ever have. Period. They make them fresh each day and are open until they sell out. Get there early!!!
Soft opening today! Excited to see them finally arrive and open up in Vegas. Great pastries at reasonable prices. Want to grab some of their coffees later. Glad not having to drive to LA to visit.

I've been trying to make it here for years and today it finally happened! We arrived at 10 a.m and they still had plenty of delicious choices to choose from. We chose the famous Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e donut and a Harry Potter ButterBeer donut. Both were great, the ButterBeer donut was HUGE, I had to share it with my husband. Customer service was friendly and answered all our questions. Can't wait to come back next time we are in Las Vegas

Handel's ice cream is great. We love all the flavors we have tried and frequently go back for more. I gave this business a 1-star review today because the employee serving ice cream and taking payments was NOT WEARING A MASK. This is unacceptable and we, along with other customers in line, walked away without getting ice cream. Not sure if I will be back to this business which does not seem to be taking the necessary covid precautions. I do love their ice cream, but I'll just go to the store instead where the employees and customers are wearing masks.

After willing to try this place for a long time, I finally tried it, and decided that the long line wasn't really worth it at all. First of all, the food and customer service looked like a big joke. I ordered a crumb cake and a lobster tail which both looked dry. Second of all, the lack of organization in the tiny shop was ridiculous. The people behind me were paying in first and I was left for last. That immediately struck me as horrible customer service. But, it doesn't end there. When I got home I tried cutting the crumb cake, and it was stiff as a hockey puck. It just looked really old, and dry as I expected. Lastly, the lobster tail was soggy, mushy, and flavorless. In the end, I've saw Cake Boss and I expected that their pastries were going to be decadent and delicious, but it was not close to that. Try it at your own risk.

Beautiful cakes and delicious baked goods. They used to make an apple strudel which we loved but no more!?! Pastries and cakes are good when fresh. Apparently lots of people like the cannolis but i haven't tried yet. We got a slice of carrot cake--a must try! Cake is light and frosting was perfectly sweet and just the right amount. Going to try the one in Santa Monica which we didn't know was one there!!
The friendliest staff and seriously the best gelato. If you're craving something sweet, this is the place to come.

I started doing custom cakes as a part-time business partly thanks to Cake Boss, and I learned so much from watching Buddy's show. I was so looking forward to trying some of Carlo's pastries and wanted to get a hoodie as my Vegas souvenir. The cannolis were decent. We've been to Italy and we didn't think these were anywhere near as good. We also got a couple of lobster tails, and the both the French cream and Nutella cream were just okay, and the pastry itself was too hard. (They also didn't have any hoodies besides a 2XL in adult or kid sizes, so I didn't get my souvenir, but that's okay.) We were so bummed this fell short of expectations. :(

I stopped in the other day on a whim and was very pleasantly surprised with the large selection of items and the friendliness of those running the business. The chocolate shop not only carries milk, dark, and white chocolate candies, but has an awesome selection of cake pops. I tried the special one they had made for St. Patty's Day and it was phenomenal! I can't wait for my next trip back to try even more of their great candies!

Perfect date place. The atmosphere and the friendly staff. The Vietnamese coffee flavor was great too. I got it in a waffle cone and then we just chilled out back in the patio while eating it. There were also toppings you can add on there too. Great ice cream place! Sometimes, it's too great and the line is long but it's worth it.

Just left this shrine to awesome with peach tarts, salted caramel brownies, layered tortes, Napoleon, and zero thoughts given to my diet for today. I completely agree that this bakery is temptation made visceral. Love love love it! I'm going back for macaroons and creme brÃ»lÃ©e next. There was a good length line but they move it really well. I was in and out (take out) in less than 15 mins. Excellent prices, affordable to get an array of things to try and stay under $20. I love NoDa!

Hustle and bustle at this NY chain in Vegas. These people were workin hard on a busy day. They were quick, kind and acknowledged everyone in line. Great work! Soft serve cereal milk and those birthday cake truffles. Not too bad. The crack pie wasn't bad either just a bit too sweet. The desserts were all pretty sweet, actually, for me but that's me and my opinion doesn't change that this place is good on what they do. So, don't knock it 'til you try it. :D

Ohhhemmmmgeeeee! I'm seriously so in love with this place. The cake was so freakin good. Somehow she managed to serve it where the bread was slightly warm but the icing was still cold. Chefs kiss man. You can tell it was made with quality ingredients & a lot of thought was put into the flavors. The ambiance of this place is amazing. HIGHLY recommend. We visited Pittsburg for the first time this weekend & this was on my list of places to go- it surpassed all expectations.

Ok...what am I missing? All the 'rave' reviews and the local news papers' critic award for good ice cream, I was eager to go there. There were several weird-o flavors and a few of the basic. Perhaps I should have stayed with the basic. Instead, I chose the truffle...thinking I was getting the sweet treat truffle. One taste and YUCK! I asked what it was and was told that it was made with truffle...but the fungus truffle!!!! I was not aware ANYONE would make ice cream out that! I needed a palate cleanser right away..I could not get that nasty taste out of my mouth. The girl behind the counter thought it was very humorous. My cup went straight into to garbage. I just don't understand the buzz about that place. I like using fresh and local ingredients so give me Crave or Udder Delights ice cream any day.

The ONLY place in Charlotte to get a decent French pastry--seriously!! Chocolate eclairs (chocolate and vanilla custard options) are phenomenal. Salted caramel brownie--you will not want to share it! Great ambience with plenty of cute little seating areas to study or just hang with your buds. This is a place not to be missed. Haven't had serious food there yet, but I hear that is great too. Huge selection so you will need to stop back several times to try everything in the case.

This is it guys. This is the place where hopes and dreams come true. You'll never have a better donut or better ice cream, let alone both at the same time. I have no idea how they get the donut so hot and fresh and the ice cream so cold. If you get anything but a donut sandwich, like just a scoop of ice cream, may God have mercy on your soul.

Melt was yum. Legit ice cream spot in the middle of Roosevelt Row. The line was long but it went quickly. We all got scoops of ice cream served in Chinese takeout containers and adorned with fortune cookies. Careful not to get too excited and eat the entire fortune cookie, paper and all, like my buddy did. Oops. Ha. The ice cream was great--lots of flavor variety. I ordered a single scoop--half Brownie Points and half Cookie Wasted. My buddy ordered a triple scoop--nutter butter, salty caramel, and cookie wasted. Saw a guy before me order an ice cream flight. Good idea for a bigger group--6 scoops served in a cupcake pan tray. Enjoyed the local art on the walls and the outdoor seating. Great spot.

I had their red bean ice parfait & their strawberry honey bread! The red bean ice is sweet red beans over crushed ice, gelato, mochi, & almonds. The honey bread is this special bread that's lightly toasted so that it's slightly crispy on the outside & chewy soft on the inside. It's topped with sweetened strawberries & cheese. So good! While beautifully presented, the menu item are pricey. I spent $15 for the red bean ice & the honey bread. But the ambiance is lovely & inviting. It's a nice place to take a date or to treat yourself.

I've always wanted to try Milk Bar, at least the one in NY whenever I make my way there, but when I found out there was one in Vegas I had to stop by. I've tried their cookies when they've been mailed to me as a gift but I honestly should've tried the same cookies there to compare if it tasted even better from the source, next time I will! But I ended up ordering their Milk Bar Pie slice (i believe it was formerly known as their crack pie). I was sorta disappointed with how much smaller the slice was in what looked like a big enough container that definitely could've fit a much larger slice of pie, but ya know, it is Vegas. Therefore prices will be much higher for what you actually get. It was like close to $8 for the slice I got! However despite the price, their Milk Bar Pie was SO good. It had this flavor combo of sweetness and saltiness that I wished I had more of it. So I was at least impressed with what I got. My mom really wanted to try their red velvet soft serve but their soft serve machines were not working that day so that was another disappointment. But I'm sure next time we visit Vegas, I'd still give this location of Milk Bar another try.

Macarons was too chewy like a bubblegum. The best macarons are in San Diego. Though I really love their croissants. It was hard for me to find the bakery since it was behind an escalator. I was disappointed for all the walking around the macarons wasn't that good.
Awesome ice cream place in Ohio city. Its Mitchell's how could you not like it? The downside is this place has a line out the door on weekends so get here early.

I'll give it three stars because they were super nice and my kids loved it. I just personally found the ice cream to be way too overly sweet and not that flavorful. Felt like I was eating a spoon of sugar.

I live right down the street from here and it is dangerous! Such a fun place to bring out-of-town guests or if you're having a sweet craving. And they are always open! My favorite go-to items is their salted caramel brownie (to die for), chocolate croissant, napoleon or macaroons. They also have an amazing chicken salad croissant and spinach potato leek soup if you're in for lunch. Beware that this place can get VERY busy during peak hours. Like the line wraps all the way around through their dining area. Finding a seat can be hard. Also some pastries look more appealing than they taste. Overall such a fun and memorable place to visit.

Having visited the Original in Youngstown Ohio many years ago, I have to say the Vegas outpost stays true to the original. Super clean creamery, robust taste on all of the flavors. Super creamy. If this is your first time get the 4 flavor sampler pack and add a cone on top for the crunch. Service is quick at the window. Portions are generous, a multitude of flavors each day. Will definitely put this on dessert rotation even though we live in Southern Highlands and it's a bit of a drive. Highly recommend.

Bon Appetit named Sweet Republic a Top 10 Ice Cream Shop, so when I was in Phoenix, I went out of my way to pay them a visit. Thankfully, not too far out of my way. I had high expectations because of all the accolades bestowed on this shop by foodies in the know. My first impression was not good. It's located in a strip mall, with rickety outdoor tables and chairs situated in between two trash cans. The appearance does improve once you get in the front door. It's decorated nicely and there were a couple teenagers at a table playing board games they got from the stash of games at the back of the shop. It had a nice vibe. They rotate their flavors of ice cream and sorbet so you get what you get. Too bad the menu on the wall didn't match what was in the cases. I was disappointed they didn't have a chocolate peanut butter cup flavor. Instead, they had Peanut Butter Chip, which was churned peanuts with chocolate flakes. Nothing else looked appealing to me so that's what I ordered. The texture was weird- kind of icy, not creamy. There were little pieces of peanuts that didn't help matters and the teensy flakes of dark chocolate were not abundant enough to add to the flavor. It was altogether odd. My sister had lemon sorbet and her review was, "Meh." We couldn't really figure out what was so great about this place.
Big. Ass. Chewy. Lemon. Pistachio. Donut. Drool. Also they close when they sell out. We were very sad yesterday. Can you come back to California with me?
My cheese danish was light & fluffy. Friendly service. And a nice patio to enjoy my sweet while I waited for Vegas to wake up!

Their vanilla macaron was the best thing I ate in Vegas (which included Wynn Buffet, Aloha Kitchen, BLT, rm Seafood) $3.50 isn't so bad because they're larger than most macarons I've seen. They sell a 5 pack with all of their macaron flavors for $16.50. The carrot cake cookie sandwich ($3.50) was very big and I liked how it didn't have raisins. No complaints. I'd stay away from their red velvet cupcakes. They have a strange filling and the cake had too much cocoa. Tasted more like a chocolate cupcake more than anything.

Definitely NOT "the best donuts in the world" as they claim on their box. Get real. Office brought in a box of them and they were just okay, nothing special. Had the blueberry with lemon icing...gross. Won't be going there on my own. There are better donut options out there.

Sinful Sweets is making it easier than ever to give into temptation by opening a second location on Liberty Avenue. So whichever corner of downtown you're visiting, they more or less have you covered now! All of the things you like about the Penn Ave location apply to the new one, except that this place is much more of a "grab and go" spot (while the original shop has some limited seating available). Milkshakes? Got 'em. Cookies? Check. Chocolate covered cookies? Yep! Truffles? Roger. Cupcakes? Go ahead and order a boxful. And there is of course a whole host of other assorted sweet treats, too. I just left with a chocolate covered oatmeal creme pie and a chocolate chip whoopie pie. I suspect they will need some time to get into their grove, especially based on what I saw tonight: one lone staffer holding down the fort (and doing pretty well, actually) as Pirates fans flock into downtown. But like I said earlier: if you like the Penn Ave spot, what's not to like here?
Great eclairs, coffee and macaroons ( I'll admit thats all I get because I love it so much.) crowd is a little hippster-y but its ok. Love that they are open 24 hours.

A Champaign-Urbana institution. I've been going here since I was a kid and it's stayed consistent. Tough deciding whether to go with a Snowstorm or just some of the simple flavors in a waffle cone. The pies and ice cream sandwiches are great too.

Ok... First off thanks for the diabetes. Now that is out of the way... This place is unbelievable. The owner is a big tough looking guy with some awesome tattoos that you would envision owning a barbecue joint. Instead he spends his culinary expertise on creating the most incredible concoctions that combine chocolate and anything he dreams about the night before. Based on this I think he dreams of bacon quite a bit. This is a great place ran by a very cool guy. I'm from California and am contemplating of moving to Pittsburg just to go there again... Everyday.

Terrible. I got the milk quake and it is basically melted ice cream with chocolate and pretzel chunks. I wish I could return it and get the soft serve, I won't even think about it though because the guy at the register was definitely not about customer service. I feel like I just threw away ten dollars.

So this is our last day in Vegas and we decided to bring my sister here.this being my second time here I have to say I wouldn't order strawberries as for the chocolate dipped strawberries were made the day before and you could see the strawberries sweating and the strawberries soft I asked if they had new one, yes typical me I want fresh she goes and ask the back comes back says no and laughs while talking to another employee. Will I return maybe. And that's a big maybe

The ice cream looks great in pictures. That and the good reviews got us to choose this as our dessert spot for the night. The service was good, we got to try a few of the flavors before making a decision. We decided to share a cup with salted caramel and the cherry swirl (I think that's what it was called) flavors which were then topped with a coconut macaron and a toasted marshmallow. It looked really great! Eating the ice cream wasn't as great because the macaron was rock solid and hard to get through with our spoons. The ice creams were also very sweet, make sure you have a cup of water next to you!

If you're looking for a nice clean sanitized place this isn't the place for you. It feels like you're sitting in a dusty old cafe. The lamps have thick layer of dust and the ceilings look like their Rotting and falling off.

This place seems overrated to me... When I walked in, the employee just stared at me without saying anything... No exaggeration. It was strange to say the least. Well there were many many options, which is where they get positive points. You're bound to find something you like...while the employee stares at you from the other side of the freezer. I tried both the Zanzibar chocolate and the peanut butter cookie dough. The Zanzibar was very smooth, while the peanut butter cookie dough waa just too icey and hard for my liking. I opted for a chocolate dipped bowl, and I added cookie, and it came up to be $5.80. Okay, we are talking pretty expensive for one scoop of ice cream and cookie dough powder. Yeah, you read that right. Look at the photo below, they literally put the bottom of the barrel of cookie on my ice cream and asked me to pay six bucks for it. Not impressed at all. The employees sit on a chair behind the counter while there is grubby stuff all over the floor. Would not recommend to those that frequent good quality ice cream shops.
Much worth the ice cream. :) The team serving the ice cream is super friendly and give good vibes. I would recommend coming here anytime you're craving good ice cream!

Was very much looking forward to trying out Christina Tosi's Milk Bar! Social media has really bowed down to this place - it really is the best kind of advertisement for people who love sweets. It's right next to Momofuku, so you already have dessert next door when you walk out:). We got the milk and cereal soft serve (cornflake based) - I wanted to get that iconic cereal topping on top, but it was already so pricey that I opted out.
