In my opinion it was a bit too spendy for the quality ($3.50 for a small 2" diameter macaroon??)
Great place to get some boom donuts from when I found this place I hate eating donuts from anywhere else

Since the reviews were good and we were craving a banana split, we drove from 20 minutes away to enjoy some good desert. We arrived at 9:30, which seems like plenty of time to order and eat before the 10pm closing time. We waited for 20 minutes for them to make the split. After having served the 2 groups that had ordered after us, we started to watch the 3 workers behind the counter to see if they were making our split. This is when we noticed they were standing there chatting (not working) about their social lives. Not a huge deal to be served after but when they finally made our split, what they presented us with was a Banana Split in 4 different containers for us to take with us. WHAT???? When I inquired why it was package to go, I was informed that since they close at 10 and dont get paid to stay after. Keep in mind it was still 9:50. Since, we are in a hotel on vacation, I could not drive the 20 minutes back and eat it out of 4 containers in my room. I expressed that they should have told us when we ordering, it would be "To Go" so we could have decided if we wanted to continue with our order. NOT GOOD CUSTOMER SERVICE at all.... I am so sorry that, I, the customer, inconvienced them. Proceed with caution after 9:30!!!!

Finally got around to checking this place out after all of the hype and let me tell you, it did not disappoint one bit! When we got here there wasn't too long of a wait so decided to try to it out. I went with the two half scoops for five dollars on a waffle cone and it was amazing! The brambleberry crisp & gooey butter cake was SO GOOD! Definitely can't wait to go back and try more flavors! Love a place that lives up to the hype and makes waiting in a line worth it. Service was speedy but friendly. Five stars for sure!
Best ice cream/yogurt place in the entire city. If you have a sweet tooth this is place is for you.

Presti's best dessert is their custard fruit tart (weekends only). Cannoli is okay, but if you get it later in the day, it tends to be soggy and cold. The other desserts vary depending on freshness. But it's not above Presti's to still serve stale desserts well after their prime time. I came here a lot this semester because of the great atmosphere. It's my "happy place" in Cleveland. Their lunch foods, though appealing from behind the glass, NEED some improvement. It's not even big changes - little things, like actually adding salt, spices, not having the pasta soak in its own sauce for hours, or putting enough filling in the strombolis. When they have the sandwiches out, get them! They're possibly the only certain delicious item on the lunch menu! Personal favorite. Coffee is yucky! Bland, with little suspicious pools of oil floating on top. Tea is okay though, and they have a respectable selection. My little brother loves their hot chocolate topped with whip. To their credit, despite some questionable foods, Presti's service is TOPS. I love the older lady with blonde hair and a big smile. They are always happy to help, and that is enough to bring me back time and time again. I visit all the time, and have only met one exception to the rule: a younger, dark-haired male server with a very bad attitude (I once asked him to re-heat my ice-cold chicken pot pie, and he over-cooked it, forgot about it, and then tossed it at me when I asked for it back without an apology! Bad day for him, I guess, or he's just an ass. Have avoided him since.) If I'm honest with myself, though I love Presti's and come back often, I don't think it would survive if it had a little more competition. They have to rethink their lunch menu, or not offer lunch at all. And if the desserts are stale, don't sell them. It isn't worth damaging your reputation. The only viable competition for them is Corbo's up the street - not enough to catalyze any serious change.

There's a reason Joe Biden visited Honey Hut. And I'm pretty sure it's because of their orange blossom ice cream, which tastes exactly like a creamsicle, but has better texture. I was visiting my daughter, who lives in Old Brooklyn, and it was a pleasant fifteen minute walk to Honey Hut, which is the a corner of a main street and a residential street. If I lived on that residential street, I'd be at Honey Hut every day. Maybe twice a day. As it was, I went back a second time before my visit ended. So good!

If you're a fan of desserts, you have to stop by this place if you're in LV. My girlfriends and I went there on Saturday and I only got one vanilla because I usually don't like macarons; however, I loved it so much I had to go back the next day to try all of them. My favorites were the vanilla and chocolate but all of them were really good. (I got the pack of chocolate, coffee, vanilla, strawberry, pistachio, lemon) They were so light, a little crispy but the inside was really soft. OMG so good, especially when it was chilled; I want to go back now :[ FYI: It's inside the Venetian but it's kind of hard to find. It's actually under the escalators where Phantom is showing.

Very busy and unorganized! Grab a number, weave your way to the display case to look at the eye candy and wait about 20+ min in a small cramped shop for your number to be called. I ended up getting a lobster tail, California cheesecake, and crumb cake. Waited another 15+ min for my name to be called so I can pay. There isn't a line for anything, so you really need to pay attention what they're calling out. Ended up being around $25 for those three items. Lobster tail was eh, cream was bland and the pastry was crispy to the point where it was hard. California cheesecake was nothing special or unique. The crumb cake was the most disappointing, it tasted like a dry sponge with brown sugar lumps on top, not even kidding. Don't waste your time or money here.
These pastries aren't fresh. I'm from the Bay Area. I don't expect old soggy croissants from Bouchon.

Really excited they are open in Vegas!!! I love, love this place. They are still in thier soft opening so they are still ironing out all the kinks. When we went it was lets just say a rough experience. The pastry shelves were mostly empty but they were bringing out pastries just slowly. They ladies bringing them out were also bringing out the samethings so they had to keep going back. Not sure if they dont know whats on the shelves already or not but maybe an idea to figure out so they dont bring "fresh bread" out just to turn around and bring it back to the kitchen. The line to check out was extremely slow but you could tell the cashiers didnt really know what they were doing. We stood in line for almost 30 min just to check out. I will still be back, just might wait till the grand opening Dec 6!

The ice cream concoctions are pretty tasty and elaborate to say the least. You can tell that the quality of the ingredients are top notch. However, is it really worth the price? Or are we just paying a little extra for the name? I would say it's the ladder of the two. Good desserts, but I'd say give this guy who grew up around the CPT half his life some Thirty's ice cream and call it a day. Shazam!

Hands down the best ice cream you'll ever eat. It is made in small batches and a wide variety of flavors. Try a dough-melt. Their version of an ice cream sandwich is in a hot glazed donut. My favorite is honey lavender ice cream with fruity pebbles added.

I was excited to try this new ice cream shop since it's walking distance from my house. They mix cereals into their ice cream. I wasn't too interested in trying that but did have cookies and cream mixed in with a little chocolate syrup as a topping. The ice cream is sickening sweet - I couldn't finish it. Worst ice cream I've ever eaten. They are expensive also. They weren't busy on a Friday night - now I know why.

By Cristina Tosi, whose claim to fame was creating the entire dessert menu for David Chang's Momofuku in NY. It's fitting they are next to each other at the Cosmopolitan. Her desserts are not traditional, unashamedly inspired by American junk foods and breakfast cereals. There's something nostalgic and familiar for those who grew up eating frosted flakes, reeses peanut butter cups, and fruit loops. They are reimagined and combined in interesting ways in their cookies instead of just being thrown on top like trendy donut and ice cream places. My wife skipped breakfast just to get the cookies, they come pre-packaged in sealed clear bags and make for great gifts to friends and relatives instead of the typical Vegas magnets or gambling themed gifts. The one common feature is the cookies are soft yet have an interesting crunch. Below are some standouts: -Compost cookie, the name is trademarked and seems like something you would eat if you lost a bet: potato chips, pretzels, butterscotch, and coffee are combined into a delicious sweet and salty cookie. -Cornflake Chocolate Chip Marshmallow Cookie, a less sweet combination that feels a bit like a rice crispie treat mixed with a cookie, soft from the marshmallows and crunchy from the cornflakes.

Homemade ice cream? Yessirree, count me in! I sampled their pumpkin ice cream and it was quite rich, creamy, and overall scrumptious. Their green tea ice cream is to die for because it is sweet just enough and doesn't have bitterness that you'll find sometimes at Japanese restaurants. I was able to find myself a nice cushiony bench to sit on, enjoy my scoops, and read their extensive selection of local publications. Even though the guy behind the counter had looked like he had been on his feet for several hours, the service with a genuine smile was a definite bonus too.

One of my fav. Cupcake shop!!! I'm so glad they open one here.. But wish it's not on the strip, so inconvenient to drive and park just to get some cupcakes. I hope they open another location on the southwest..hehe(closer to home). Tried a lot of different flavors and the only one I and my kids love most is the banana. I haven't try the ice cream yet, one of these day I'll. Don't buy the bring home and bake, it's not the same and a Waste of money!! Taste nothing like the ones they make in the store.
Love the ice cream here would Recommend to any one who loves ice cream. It's a great date night snack or if your just out with friends

Well worth the stop at any of their locations! The smell as you approach the doors is intoxicating as you catch the scent of the delicious cones! The ice cream to follow does not disappoint. I used to think not much could compare to Graeters or Jeni's in Ohio or Salt & Straw in Portland, OR...but this may be sliding into the top spot. Creamy and delicious ice cream and fresh cones...I have not been disappointed in my five stops thus far. It is a must stop when in the area.

Last weekend (7/18/20) after dinner we decided to come to the Palazzo and Venetian hotel to walk off our dinner and explore on what was open during the pandemic. Walking through the grand canal shops at the Venetian I bumped into Sloan's and the bright pinkness of the shop caught my attention immediately. I felt like a little kid again to this adorable Ice Cream Parlor. My eyes could not be still for about 15 minutes. Once I calmed down I was able to comprehend what was around me. The whole ceiling was covered with clouds of baby angels. Pink, Yellow, and blue fun decorative chandelier across the parlor. The whole atmosphere felt like candy land and Care Bears altogether. Upon entering in the ice cream parlor you will see fake stuffed puppies which my boyfriend thought they were real. On the other side of the wall, they have all kinds of funny novelty gifts for adults, kids and a huge candy wall dispenser. On the register side of the ice cream parlor they sold baked goods, Caramel apple, and Chocolate M&M pretzels. For ice cream I got a cookie monster with a cake cone which is similar to your Cookies N Cream. My boyfriend got a hot fudge brownie with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream with whipped cream and a cherry on top. Ice cream was super yummy and they are know to be rBST free ( hormone free). I recommend bringing your kids here after dinner. They will love it.

This is my favorite I've cream place. Literally the best. They gave a number of great standard flavors and they keep coming up with new ones. The honey definitely makes the ice cream more delicious. Would highly recommend the banana split and the waffle cones. Amazing all around.

Upon arrival at Venetian, you'll find multiple small Bouchon bakeries spotting the area. After so many alcohol and cold drinks, my sweet tooth hasn't been quite satisfied. The pastries were quite eye catching and line wasn't too bad as I spent time contemplating what to get. Some of the cakes looked dried out, and was dubious how fresh they were. I settled on "Oh Oh" which is a chocolate cake with cream roll, a fancier version of Swiss Rolls. Just not as sweet, but sugar flavor was still bit over powering. Chocolate did not have the depth of bitterness to combat this, and it ended up being unimpressive. Looks pretty, but that's the extent.
Every time I'm at Milk Bar, I gotta grab the chocolate bday cake truffles! They're a cute little treat for myself but are a great addition to a birthday gift for anyone who has a sweet tooth!

The chocolate chip croissant from Bouchon will plague my dreams for months to come. Divine perfection... served warm and gooey, you must try one of these. The outrageous prices scared me away from trying more items. I'm too cheap to spend $3.50 on a single macaroon. Not with so many slot machines in visible sight. Service was professional, but a touch cold. Hope to try the actual restaurant some time in the near future.
Excellent service! The French onion soup, and chicken and waffles were delicious!!! Wished there was room in my tummy for dessert.
I am giving a five star review because I have been to their popcorn and cupcake stands quite a few times in past couple of years. Recently, they opened a store in Lakewood, right next to Melt.
Came here during a lunch break from work with coworker also doing in office training and I enjoyed the ice cream so much. Good quality tasting product and staff quick n friendly will be back soon.

Been here a couple times and really like it. It's a cute little ice cream shop. Fun and friendly staff and the price isn't terrible. Got a waffle cone and loved the strawberry ice cream I got. Great area of town.

I'm not a big chocolate fan but..... the strawberry hot fudge Sunday was fantastic!! We went twice in one weekend. The second time I went they were out of the chocolate covered strawberries so they put a giant hot chocolate chip cookie on top!!!!

This place is great. We got ramen on one of their ramen days (not always available check their instagram). This is not really an eat-in experience but that's totally ok. We ended up enjoying our ramen from the plastic takeaway containers so we could indulge in ice cream after. We had a "flight" and tried Marzipan, Halva, Baklava, Pineapple Upside Down and Taro. All fantastic and from what I hear the flavors are constantly changing. Staff is great too. They'll give you ice cream for your dog if you have one with you. We'll be back!
Always love it here! great service. cool place to sit. and just enjoy!
Salted Caramel Cafe Mocha was perfectly made and the blueberry cream cheese muffin was excellent. Long line but it moved very quickly. My wife and I were both very impressed!
Thunder buddies was delicious! Ice cream had a great consistency and was not overly sweet. Would love to come back and try others when I'm in the area.

The early bird gets the worm! This place only stays open until they sell out. Everytime I pass this place about noonish they always have written on the window SOLD OUT! And I'm like damn it! LoL. I finally caught them with a few donuts left. I got the Mexican chocolate donut with some milk. This thing was huge! Took one bite and understood why they sell out so fast. Best donuts ever! It reminds me of donuts you get at the bakery in Hawaii. Not too sweet and the donut is perfect not too heavy but just right. The chocolate was delicious and the hind of cinnamon on one side and marshmallows on the other side was super yum and cute. I need to make it here early to see what else they had. I was eyeing out their filled nutella donut. That is definitely on the list!

Wow this little bakery is definitely a must go to when you are at the Venetian! The macaroons are without a doubt the best we've had. I tried the pistachio, chocolate, and raspberry. These are not your normal macaroons. They are creamy and so flavorful. The texture is a perfect harmony between chewiness and filling. The pistachio was so creamy and the raspberry even had delicious white cream inside of it. The croissants were buttery and flaky- perfect with a coffee combo for only $5. A great way to start breakfast. The banana bread is great too and very moist. Sadly, I was only at the Venetian for two nights so I could not try every baked good here! I seriously would have if my stay was longer :)

Deelish! Had the Madagascar vanilla waffle bowl with bacon bits, buttered pecans, and homemade marshmallow -toasted in front of me. Great selection, you can sample ahead of your selection and water is free. I loved that the flavors were not artificial. Will absolutely be returning and telling all my friends.

As always, Mitchell's never disappoints when I want high-quality ice cream. What I love most about this location, in particular, is that customers can also purchase tickets to tour the facility, learn how ice cream is made, and discover the history behind Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream. The tour also comes with an ice cream tasting, as well as a voucher for a scoop of ice cream. (So essentially, you "get back" the money you spent purchasing the tour ticket.) All in all, no matter how interested you are in the ice cream tour offered at this location, do yourself a favor and GET MITCHELL'S ICE CREAM!

was here for the macarons. $3.50, and if you buy 5, the 6th is free. i got every flavour and my personal favourites were red velvet and blueberry. usually i love pistachio but at this bakery they made it too sweet for my liking :( great location, its right at the rtc deuce stop for the venetian

Walking in, I felt like I had been transported into one of those British bake shops where you can can hang out with your girlfriends for hours around cake and lattes. That's exactly what I did. I absolutely loved this quaint little place and they had plenty of comfortable seating. The only reason I'm giving this place 3 stars instead of 4 is the simple chocolate cake we ordered was a tad dry and the buttercream was hardened. It was as if the cake had been sitting out too long in the fridge and it was almost to the point of being stale. I've heard people rave about their delicious cakes so I'm going to assume we just got there on a day of a bad batch. The latte's we got were fine, nothing too special. I definitely loved the atmosphere and its a great little place to meet up with a few of your friends. Sure it was pricey for the subpar cake I had, but I want to come back and try it again to give this place a 2nd chance.

Oh dear Batch. It's such a good thing you are on the complete opposite side of town from me. Otherwise I would be one enormous unhealthy person. Everything here is ridiculously delicious. And I agree with the other reviewers-the various croissants are the closest thing I've come to outside of Paris (and I've tried my fair share across the USA!). Their latest creation, the cini-mini is absurdly good and I'm not even much of a cinnamon sugar treat fan. The Gruyere croissant is easily one of the best things I've ever eaten and while Batch may be far from the far west side, this delectable treat is available at the West Towne Metcalfe's (weekends only and you better go early!) as well as Willy Street West. Yummmmm. The olive fougasse (sp?) is also super delicious. But why bother saying that cuz everything here is super delicious. There is always a wide variety of sweet and savory, various fruit flavors (oh the mini sunny lemon, oh yes! The mini sunny lemon) as well as chocolate and non-chocolate delights. All this plus bread, filled rolls, great coffee and a small refrigerated case near the register with mini-key lime pies and the prettiest little cookie sandwiches I've ever seen. Oh yeah, and the people who work there are extremely patient as I stare and drool and try to decide what not to purchase this time. That's right, what NOT to buy. Cuz if left up to me and no one was looking, I'd eat one (or two) of everything in the case. And that's saying something cuz the selection is huge (as long as you go before 10ish on the weekends!). Just do yourself a favor and go.

This place is adorable, it's a small ice cream shop and the decor is so cute. The employees are very nice and welcoming. i enjoyed the "mangoneada" ice cream after sampling almost everything. It was really good!

The place has a feel I love but unfortunately I found out that they do not use real honeydew fruit in their smoothie and instead uses a powder which adds unnecessary and unhealthy ingredients. I won't be going back as a result.
if it was in chicago I would try everything there. they have sandwiches too. yes. good. uh huh. chocolate and various cakey goodness

Worst ice cream I've had in a while. Think warm very milky tasting ice cream. I thought considering its location it would have to be good, but it's so gross I want my money back. Don't know how it survives

I'm in love with the Linq promenade. It is just so cool - all the bars, restaurants, shops. I believe there is a Sprinkles in Chicago, but never checked it out. I'm not a huge cupcake fan. The fancy ones always look so good, but end up tasting dry. However, the ice cream at this place is off the chain! Seriously, huge portions and so damn good!
Tea is better than coffee. Sandwich is okay. Environment is great. Things look better than taste. A bit pricy. A good place to study or spend time with friends here.

Everything! This is our favorite spot to grab breakfast sandwiches from. I am not typically a big fan of bread, but I will swallow these buttery, flaky Croissants like water. They are so good! And when you mix that with ham and melted Brie on a sandwich. Oh Lala!

This place was really good, however i feel definitely over priced. Crack pie is literally the best thing ever but unfortunately the serving size they offer for what you pay is WAY too small. Even considering 'Vegas' prices.. still good though and worth a try!

Okay, but steeply priced ice cream. Ordered two sundaes and wasn't really impressed. Mainly because the items were advertised as certain things (i.e. brownie sundae), but the star/feature item was severely lacking. My brownie fudge sundae had a small chunk of brownie on the very top and then layers of bland (how is this possible!) vanilla ice cream and lukewarm hardening chocolate fudge. It was not enjoyable and I didn't even bother finishing the whole thing. This is how I knew it was not good since brownie sundaes are a favorite of mine. My husband got a chocolate strawberry sundae that he described as just okay. We would have been better off getting milkshakes from In-N-Out.
AmÃ©lie's has a great dessert case and an even better atmosphere. Whether early in the morning or late at night, this is the spot.

Huge fan of Mason's Creamery!!! I love that they have a variety of flavors that are unique and not your typical. I always love coming to try out new flavors they have. I really liked the ube ice cream and its subtly sweet and smooth flavor. Last time I got the salted caramel - it's not too out there but I couldn't resist the salty flavor against the sweetness of the caramel. It's one of my favorites. I also saw on facebook that they sometimes have a pop-up ramen shop! I haven't gone myself and I've heard mixed reviews from friends who have went, but I would really like to check it out at some point when they have it. The aesthetic of this place is cute and trendy. It's a small ice cream shop with lots of outdoor seating. I saw that they just opened up in area in the back with long tables under a tent with cute lights. I also really like the plastic spoons they serve the ice cream with - they change color depending on the temperature!!

This place is just amazing. They always have some fresh flavors that I am dying to try. My favorite is when they use fresh huckleberries, mmmmm. Freshness and no freezer burn. Next up on my list is the signature toffee. Been meaning to give it a shot.
We stopped by this little gem before heading to the airport. Very nice gals working and the best cookie sandwich I've ever had. Highly recommend!

This was my first time here and what a nice place with that old time nostalgia. It is sparkling clean with a great selection. I had the float with vanilla ice cream and 2 side dips of raspberry and coffee. It was mouth watering delicious and a nice respite from a several hour walk up Central from downtown. Manager Damien provided outstanding service and is one of the most well spoken store staff I ever met. I always appreciate great customer service. There is comfy booth seating and the area is nice near the light rail and Heard Museum. Highly recommended.

The LV Strip strikes again with yet another celebrity chef let down... I really enjoyed the chocolate dipped strawberries! However, my caramel cupcake and lemon (shortbread) tart? Left a lot to be desired. Can you say, " no flavor"! No butter, no moistness, no freshness... they could have come from a package on a store shelf! Nothing to make my belly smile.

About a year ago we stumbled across this place and went in. Several of us and we all got multiple doughnuts to share so we could try more than one. Then the donuts were AMAZING! Great flavor. Fresh. Not just a typical donut and they seemed set apart. We've been I think 3 or 4 times as we come back and visit vegas. This trip we made the haul all the way from the other end of the strip to get some donuts for our few days stay. We got 6 - yes 6 big donuts. Unfortunately this time we were pretty disappointed. It seems they've changed something and the donuts are more cakey like, seem less fresh and the flavors just aren't there. They have the options of flavors but the best part about the donuts this time was things they didn't make: Nutella inside, Oreos on top, etc. The donuts weren't bad they just didn't seem as set apart and special or worth the hike from the other end of the strip. Not sure if we'd go back or venture to other donut places on the strip next time.

Cutest place ever. I had the legendary salted caramel brownie which was amazing. Service was kinda slow but there was a lot of concerts that night and it was at 7 or 8 pm on a Saturday. The cashier made fun of my Avett brothers shirt but whatever haha... typical bakery prices and your average NoDa crowd. A must visit!

All I can say about this place is that its OK..there didn't seem to be anything about this place to make me want to come back. The food was alright but not big enough..pretty much the only thing I like about it is that its open 24/7
I love the macarons here! They are double the size and half the price of any macaron you get around LA. What a steal! On top of that, they're delicious! Talk about bang for your buck. Love it!

Is really like this place, it's always packed so It's hard to find a parking spot and the lines are very long, however their salted caramel coffee is the bomb, the decor is very unique and the vibe is amazing. It's a very good option because they're open 24 hours, it's a little pricey but worth it. I didn't like the macaroons I tried them in different occasions and never like them, the tarts are very good though. It's a nice place to Go with friends to sit down and enjoy some coffee and deserts, definitely a must try.

Came here during their soft opening and the ice cream is absolutely delicious. You choose a mix-in (various cereals) which gets blended into a vanilla ice cream base and then gets topped with your choice of toppings. The texture is soft and creamy and the blended mix-ins weren't too chunky or gritty. We chose cinnamon toast crunch, which added a lot of flavor to the ice cream itself. I tried a couple of my friends' drinks and they were all aesthetically pleasing (basically, Instagrammable). The teas were quite strong and floral, so if that's not your thing I would skip them. The inside is really well decorated and the ice cream and drinks came out pretty quickly given they're probably still learning some things on the fly. I'll definitely be back often as it's probably some of the best ice cream I've had in the East valley. Like their sister shop (Pokitrition), I can see this place maintaining their high quality and introducing some exciting things in the future.
Really cool spot for sweets! Highly recommend checking this place out, super nice staff and good snacks.

Terrible customer service. I don't want to fault her too much because I'm sure serving drunk tourists for a living is not fun, but the cashier had a really negative vibe and attitude. Lots of eye rolling, curt and terse dialogue, and she even threw down our order on the counter. I had the slice of crack pie which I'd say is overrated. It was good but not $7.00 good for an 1/8 slice of a maybe-6 inch pie. The store itself and the pie had a whimsical presentation. Glad I tried it but it's not something I'd crave.
100% naughty goodness!!! Yum meter is 11 out of 10!! Gourmet donuts done right. You can't go wrong here.
Toasted Pistachio and Banana Cream Pie tasting duo. Delicious! Service was fast and it's cool to go upstairs and watch the ice cream be made.

If you want the smoothest soft serve ice cream ever, then Page's is the place. It is located under an outrageously large and high concrete train trestle at the corner of Becks Run aka the blue belt and Carson. Its a cool spot especially on a warm night. I decided to try a Heath bar swirl which is actually like a blizzard and not a swirl. I got a small but would have preferred half the amount I got. I also would have preferred half the amount of Heath bar. Next time I will ask for half the amount they normally put in. The vanilla ice cream was very good, and had the smoothest texture of any ice cream I've ever had. I really liked it.

Tasty sandwiches and baked goods. I ate here three times during my last trip to Vegas because the show I was working was right near it. Great meal to keep me going all day. Chocolate croissant is awesome

First glance of their menu and I thought this place would be great. Ice cream and other desserts based on the flavors you get after eating a bowl of cereal. I was disappointed when I got my ice cream and it tasted less like a bowl of milk from a cinnamon cereal than it did a sickly sweet bowl of sugar. I think maybe in trying to make it taste a certain way, they overdid it. Also, how do you not give a spoon for ice cream? You get a little stick like those tiny ice creams you'd get in elementary school. It's one of those places that asks you to leave a tip with your order, even though nobody has actually did anything for you yet. I HATE that. For the price and the taste, I think I'd just pass on by next time.
Good desserts and nice cool, calm atmosphere!

The best bakery I've encountered... anywhere......ever. The croissants are amazing! The cheese danish with this perfectly sweetened icing like cheese inside is a breakfast I still have dreams about months later. Coffee also amazing.. the mocha with real chocolate with delicious! Kind of expensive.. but worth every penny!

LOVE page's, been coming here since i was a kid, same GREAT ice cream, shakes, etc, even BETTER burgers, dogs & fries, prices so low it's almost shocking, if you're in the south hills & want QUALITY soft serve this is the place, & believe me, it's worth the wait when the line is long, always has been

I've been waiting so long to come to Page's and already knew I'd order a Nancy B's chocolate chip cookie sundae. It didn't disappoint-- tons of hot fudge, whipped cream, creamy soft serve and warm cookie pieces. I love that they have so many types of milkshakes, sundaes and arctic swirls -- I'd love to come back and try the raspberry almond torte sundae or one of their pumpkin roll arctic blasts I've heard they have in the fall!
This place is my go to when I am looking for a snack. It is very high quality matcha. I enjoy their soft serve and Sunday options. It makes me feel like I am back in Japan.

Very friendly staff with lots of patience as we were overwhelmed with the selection of donuts that they had out. All of the donuts range from $2-5 and are definitely worth every penny. We decided to grab 4 big ones and a smaller one and we were already full after eating just one. This place does sell out fast so make sure you get there early! We got there around 9am and were able to get in and get out within 5 minutes. There's also paid parking right outside or if you go around the corner, there are 4 free 15 minute parking spots which is where we parked.

3 words...salted caramel brownie!!! This is one of the most delicious sweet treats in Charlotte. So yummy! If you have a craving for a sweet treat, this should do the trick. Sandwiches as just okay but the desserts are amazing and the soups are wonderful.

I finally decided to give Milkbar a try and realized why I was avoiding it in the first place. You are paying for a name and something that has trended on Instagram. Perhaps, at her original Bakery when she was making the products herself, they were balanced and delicious but here I have some person shoving a cold pie in my hand and my first bite was nothing but the taste of sugar and then my second bite was more sugar and then on the third I finally got hints of butter but for the most part it's fairly flavorless and for $7 that's just ridiculous. The overall texture is nice but feels like it's missing something. There's no contrast or balance at all. It tastes like something a two-year-old would make. Save your $7 and go buy a pack of gummy bears, that's what I ended up doing and the gummies were tastier.

Love love love every flavor! When I used to purchase online, I got so sad when I finished a pint. Now I have options and can stop by after work! The scoop shop is so cute and offers so much! I love that the flavors will rotate and that I can grab a pint for myself and a pup cup for my furkid. Highly recommend getting a flight for yourself or to share with a friend/family/partner! I love that the ice cream is also gluten free as are the waffle cones! Favorite flavor this visit: The Song of Fire & Ice - maple ice cream with spiced pecans from Nutkrack! Parking lot next door or plenty of street parking!
Excellent! The birthday cake is the best cake ever! Also yummy is the crack pie. It's open till 11am so it's the perfect place to get your dessert after that fancy meal.

On my road trip to Cleveland, my friend took me to this bakery in Little Italy for breakfast. I had a chocolate croissant and 2 raspberry thumbprints. The pastries were both very good and for the price of $3.5, I would definitely come here again if I visit the area again.
We got the combination to try everything. Honestly didn't think it was anything great. I wish they said beforehand that the ice cream was salty and had corn flakes on it.

This is the best bakery in Charlotte. We love the Chocolate Croissants, biscotti, Napoleons. Everything we've had is delicious. Not to mention, their coffee is some of the best I've had in the city. So happy to have Villani's in the neighborhood.
Patae is by far the best! The Lyonnaise Potatoes are also my favorite! The orange juice is also refreshing.

I had the mint chocolate chip sundae!! I words can't describe! It was amazing and very satisfying. It was so good!! And the chocolate chip cookie was very good as well. It was thick and buttery - melted in your mouth!

Its always a treat getting donuts here. There are so many to choose from. Their glazed are so tasty. I also love their fried cake donuts. I don't go here often simply because their donuts are so wonderful I over indulge. Even their stand at the zoo has wonderful donuts. I had expected donuts there to be slightly stale, being out at the zoo, but they weren't.
I'm from Portland,Or and we have Voodoo Donuts. Donut Bars donuts are creative, great tasting, and a new must when visiting Vegas!

One night, I was on YouTube watching food videos, as one does. I watched a video in which an ice cream expert guesses between cheap vs expensive ice cream & the ice cream expert was so knowledgable and personable, it's obvious ice cream is her passion and she takes it serious. I was delighted to find that one of her ice cream shops stands just minutes from me in Charlotte! I immediately headed to the location the following day and my expectations were exceeded. The sweet smell of the fresh waffles being made wafted over when I was almost two blocks away, making me almost sprint to get there. The building is aesthetically pleasing, immaculate and instagramable. The customer service was top notch, we were welcomed and invited to try as many of the inventive, delicious flavors as we wanted. I settled on the trio scoop for the reasonable price of $6. I got Strawberry, Brambleberry and Gooey Butter Cake with waffle cone on the side. It was stupendous, no flavor was restrained, the ice cream is fatty, creamy, smooth, not overly sweet. The best ice cream I've had. They had more than enough indoor and outdoor seating to choose from although it was small. Also, can't forget the vegan and alcoholic options. A must try!

Mouth watering doughnuts and great service. I ordered a dozen and half various flavors for a work party and it was huge success. They such a hit , i had to lie and tell everyone I made them ( thinking I might get a raise or a promotion) but didn't . My favorite was the red velvet doughnut . It was extremely fresh and the frosting was to die for. The service was excellent. The workers greeted you right when you walked in and were extremely knowledgeable. This place deserves 6 stars. Cheers !

The pastries were pretty good. I had a lobster tail(pastry) and a cannoli that had great flavor, but seemed a little stale. The price was a little high, but not for Vegas standards. The lines were super long, so expect to wait a while. Hope to try the original one one day.

It doesn't matter what time of the day it is this location is always hopping. Thankfully the line moves quick! There's lots of good people watching to be done in south end. If you don't know what you want, ask for a sample. The staff is super patient and they want you to enjoy your decision. There are so many wonderful flavors! I think mine are the bramble berry and the sweet cream biscuits and peach jam. They even have some dairy free flavors I was able to take out for my lactose intolerant mom. Her cold brew coffee ice cream was amazing! They have seasonal and limited time options as well.

Delicious food. The breakfast sandwiches are a 10/10. Great atmosphere. Be careful not to come during peak hours because the line can be very long and you might have a hard time finding a seat, but it's worth it.

Amelie's is the perfect cafe to meet with friends, go on a date, or simply get some work done in a peaceful homey environment. They offer a great selection of sweets, salads, sandwiches, and cold and hot drinks. Their coffees and latte's are very tasty. I had the pumpkin clove latte, and I really enjoyed it. This is my go to place if I need to get out of the house to focus on work. Open 24/7, FREE WIFI, and seating in multiple areas. My life saver Also, the decor is so unique.. Whoever decorated their locations is very talented.

We had Bouchon Bakery for the first time in Napa a couple of years back. It won our heart that day with their baked goodies. However, yesterday we went to the Bouchon Restaurant with some out of town friends, hoping to continue with the great 1st impression, but sadly we were deeply disappointed. Their waffle and chicken dish was mediocre. Their coffee paled in comparision to most coffees out there. I am so embarrassed that I brought my friends there. :( On the upside, their ambiance was perfect! :)

This was my second time at Bouchon for dinner. First time was with my husband and this last time was with my son. My husband had the steak and frites (my son ordered the same thing) and the first time I had pasta. This last time I had the chicken. The first time I went I wasn't familiar with chef Thomas Keller so I had no idea to order the chicken. Since going to his restaurant the first time I did some research and have made his roasted chicken a few times (highly recommend). So it was a real treat to get the chicken the second time around. And wow it's good! Best roasted chicken I have ever had. My son loved his steak and frites (just like his dad) he missed out on the truffle on his frites because he has the pallet of a 8 year but the appetite of a grown man. Don't miss out of the truffle fries. Our waiter was very helpful, I didn't catch his first name but his last name is HernÃ¡ndez. He did a great job taking care of us and helping my son with the menu. The only thing I've heard is better than dinner at Bouchon is brunch at Bouchon. We will be back to experience that menu next!

Umm.... I didn't like it. Apparently I'm the only one? We went to Sweet Republic last night, drove 30 minutes because 141 reviews and a 5 star rating was reason enough. I'm a little perplexed by the rating, I keep thinking I must have ordered the wrong flavors? We tried the salted butter carmel, rocky road and malt with chocolate waffle cone. I didn't really care for any of them. The flavor was so mild that I felt completely unsatisfied. So unsatisfied that we ended up leaving and driving to Yogurtology to do the job of filling our sweet tooth. I won't be back...

Excellent Ice Cream and excellent service by enthusiastic workers who seem to really enjoy what they are doing. When a business says something is homemade, I tend to say, yeah right. but Sweet Republic really does make their ice cream on the premises, what a treat. I wasn't as adventersome as other reviewers having two scoops, one belgian chocolate and the other toffee. MMMM they were great. I'd been wanting to try Sweet Republic for a long time since I live so close by, now I'm kicking myself for waiting so long!

I've been to Amelie's countless times yet I've never written a review. Must be because I was too busy stuffing my face with French delicacies. This next statement is no exaggeration...EVERYTHING HERE IS GOOD. You can't go wrong when the food is as fresh as it is here. All of the pastries and breads are made in house. For everything that they can't make in house they use only the freshest ingredients! One of my favorite things...IT'S ALWAYS OPEN...no literally, they never close so you can wake up in the middle of the night and get a pastry or pull an all nighter studying inside or stumble in for some fancy hangover food. Whatever you want!! My personal faves: Sandwiches: turkey and brie (wiring fresh seasonal compote, chicken salad and Spinach Asiago open faced sandwich Soups: All of them!! They rotate!!! Pastry: I'm not a fan of overly sweet so I prefer the cheese and strawberry and cream cheese croissants Drink: the best, creamiest chai in the world You're welcome...

Why am I sad? Because it's Tuesday and Batch is closed. Oh, the humanity!!! This bakery has so many delicious treats my wallet protests every time I walk down Willy street. The raspberry bars? Delectable! The monkey bread? Heavenly!! The mini pies? Too small to be that tasty! And everyone who works there is so nice! I've been gifted a free loaf or scone on occasion just because and it always makes me smile. Thanks f only they could always be open I'd be happy every day. I'd post pictures but I literally devoured everything too fast. Sorry folks!

This French bakery is not your ordinary place to eat pastries. It is eclectic, fun, and a delight to the visual senses. Food is usually very good and fresh. Tonight's visit, however, was disappointing. Our sandwiches were delivered on VERY stale baguette and one of our sandwiches was the wrong order entirely! Even though it's a very busy atmosphere, the kitchen staff usually gets it right. Not tonight! Would recommend to visitors because this has not been the norm in our experience

Presti's is great for getting some good dessert. The selection of Italian sweets is extensive, and they also sell fresh bread. Their entrees are just ok. Most of them are pre-made, so they just reheat them for you when you order, which can make any pasta dishes taste a little overcooked. As for beverages, I like the fact that they have aranciata and limonata at their beverage counter on the side. Good stuff!
Expensive, but delicious! The honey lavender was great! Small batch means great care, but also high price. I was prepared for it, so make sure you are too. Very delicious.

What a neat and unique spin on my two favorite sweet treats: ice cream and macarrons! I had the Red Velvet and Fruit Loop flavored macarrons with Netflix and Chill (butter flavored with chocolate covered pretzels and peanuts) /cherry pistachio. So good and perfect! The portion size is great for two people while the price is nice ($6). Oh, cannot forget the fact that they top the Cookie Cup with a Fluff It toasted marshmallow! Divine and I will be back!

Hands down the best donuts in Cleveland! They have fantastic specialty donuts like salted caramel, key lime pie, maple bacon, and other seasonal creations. (It's pumpkin season- so yep, they've got pumpkin pie). Don't discount the traditional donuts like glazed- simple and perfect. If you get there early enough you can snag an apple fritter to share with your favorite person. They are huge, delightful and only about $4. Currently they are renovating their original store, so they are in a smaller nearby store. Can't wait to see the new store! Remember to bring CASH!!

Although I've had Sweet Republic ice cream and sorbet in other venues, today (Sweet Republic's 3rd birthday) was the first time I was able to have the ice cream in the store itself. It was nice to be able to sample different flavors - especially since a number of them are quite unique - before choosing the one I had today (salted caramel). Audrey W, who was also there today, told me to get jalapeno avocado but they ran out of that flavor; apparently it's very popular. All the flavors I tried were very good, and after watching my friend and fellow yelper Jacob P. win the toffee banofi sundae eating contest this afternoon (he finished a humongous serving in about 3 minutes), I know I'll need to try that flavor next time!

This is a quaint little cafe and bakery tucked away among a strip of other stores. The staff is welcoming as you walk through the door and a beautiful display of pastries light up the room. This was my first time visiting and it won't be my last. I had a Ham and Honey Dijon sandwich with carmelized onions on a banquette and my husband had a Chicken sandwich with sundried tomatoes and goat cheese. Everything was delicious. Their beverages consist of an array of teas, coffees and canned sodas. The eating area consist of eclectic tables and chairs. Very inviting and comfortable. You seat yourself. Lots of space. I couldn't leave without taking a few pastries home. Delicious. Don't pass this place up if you're in the area.
What a treat. Trios of guac, trios of salsa, phenomenal cocktails, incredible service outstanding happy hour

I actually came by Novel twice, because the first night I tried to stop by I couldn't wait in the crazy long line. The second day luckily had a shorter wait (because who wants icecream at 11am except for me and the few other people there). Awesome cute little shop in a collection of cute shops with a friendly staff and some dank choices. I appreciate all of the cereal offered as toppings. I am not an icecream donuts guy, so I sprung for just a regular scoop. Both the Cookie Monster and the Chocolate were rad, but I do with that they had a little more flavor. The cookie monster assaults you with more blue dye than anything else. I'd be careful if you're wearing white!

Our bike club comes here often year round for evening ice cream cycling excursions from Champaign-Urbana. The staff is always VERY friendly and accommodating. The ice cream is tasty, although I do prefer the fattier taste of custard. All in all, a wonderful place to visit.
Large macaroons the size of your hand! They got the texture and consistency right but the flavors did not stand out. I couldn't taste the raspberry in my raspberry macaroon. =(

Just had the black and white and the chocolate marshmallow. The icing on the black and white was descent, but the cake was dry and not a good flavor. The icing on the chocolate marshmallow wasn't good and again the cake was dry and didn't taste good. I would have given 2 stars, but the service was quick and very friendly, so I'm giving them an extra star. It's too bad the cupcakes look better then they taste.

I've watched his show, so decided to stop by on my next trip to Vegas. I was really excited to try his desserts because they looked so good. I ordered the cannoli and was very disappointed. The cannoli was dry and the filling overly sweet. I would not come here again.

I'm from LA and this was the best ice cream I've ever had. Texture was super smooth and creamy, and taste was absolutely delicious. The prices are crazy low and they give huge portions. If I'm ever in Madison again, definitely will return.

Ramen Review: 0/10 It was in one word, bland. The meat had no flavor, the broth had no flavor and the bowls were half empty leaving us very disappointed with our food plan this evening. Ice Cream Review: 4/10 We've been here a few times for ice cream and the general consensus is the ice cream itself is pretty good but the price is too expensive for what you get. As far as I know, this is the most expensive ice cream in Ohio but certainly not the best.
You'll be in for a great treat. Variety of selections to choose from. Warm staff members.

Amazing bakery. I got the chocolate croissant and it was delicious. The chocolate bouchons were amazing. I came here two days in a row because of how much I liked it! They have sandwich options in a baguette or a croissant. The line goes by quick and the prices are very reasonable for the quality. Service is great and quick. Highly recommend this bakery!

Why should you visit? 1) first and only west coast location 2) besides Toronto (which I regret not visiting while there) they have the fruity pebble flavor soft serve So I've been here twice: once last year and once this year for many visit to Las Vegas. I've had the all the cookies, crack pie, and obviously the cereal milk ice cream (which you'd think is vanilla but with the corn flakes it literally tastes like cereal and milk). If you've never been, there's an option that's around $22 something that lets you try all of their "well known" products. I personally recommend the crack pie and I come here just to buy the corn powder since shipping is terribly expensive and when you're just far away it's hard to find a place to grind your own dehydrated corn, let alone purchase it. Of course momofuku las vegas is right next door so I suggest visiting both. What to expect? Yes, its expensive, but honestly compared to the line in NYC, everyone who's visiting this location should count their freaking blessings how chill this store is. Would you rather wait in the NYC cold, or a casino building warm. I think it's well worth it just because you just won't get desserts that taste like this due to the corn base of everything. Also, hello? You're in a casino on the strip, ya ain't finding cheap eats yo. Also parking is downright terrible now on the strip since they effing charge for everything now :( Gone are the good ol' days. If you can uber, car pool or are willing to pay for parking then do it. I'd rather just walk depending on where you are or uber.

I came here with family. We're so happy we found this place. I tried the Vietnamese Coffee ice cream with caramel sauce. My sister had the peanut butter ice cream with caramel sauce. They were both really good, but if I have to recommend one it would be the peanut butter with caramel. My daughter got the Oh My Affogato float. It's the coffee ice cream, vanilla ice cream, coke and double espresso. It's really good!! There is really nice outdoor seating with misters. Great music!!

Haven't been to the original location in NYC but decided to come here since I've been wanting to try it. My bf & I shared the milk and cereal flavored soft serve. It was super creamy and I also added the corn flakes topping as well. Overall, the ice cream was good, but definitely not good enough to warrant the price. For one small soft serve I paid almost $8!!! The corn flakes topping itself was an extra $1.50 & they didn't even give that much. It was pretty much just fried corn flake crumbles. I would prefer milk & cereal flavored ice cream from afters back home instead of this one, although this one wasn't necessarily bad, it was just way overpriced and not that great.

Eeww! Very hot day and no indoor dining ( even limited due to current COVID guidance). Air conditioning? Outdoor area filthy with trash, birds, and flys. Waaay over priced for the quality of food and a limited selection of patisserie for mid-day - especially for a "French bakery". Rule of thumb in food service industry is that the last person in line should have the same choices as the first person in line. Go ahead and pass this one by. Again... eewww.

Cute ice cream store on Eastern! Loved the swirl specials and the taiyaki! I got the mango honeydew and loved it. Daughter got the ube ice cream and she enjoyed it very much. If you want to cool down and have a little something sweet, stop by somi somi! =)
Super tasty cookie dough shake! About 12 different cupcake choices. I was pleasantly pleased with my choice! Will be back :)

Sprinkles! On the Strip, they are still my favorite cupcake. The Vegan Red Velvet tho...this location doesn't seem to be quite the same as its Bev Hills counter part, but the signature white Sprinkles sugar dot let's you know you're in for a treat.

A bit of a mixed bag from this place. We had one of the lobster tails and it was amazing. Light and crispy with a delicious filling. The cannoli on the other hand was virtually inedible. The cream inside was very grainy and the cannoli shell was far from crisp. We each tried one small bite and threw the rest away. Have had far better cannolis and cheaper ones too.

Amazing. This place is cheap and the proportions are HUGE. It's definitely best to split a sundae because there so big. Unfortunately they don't have a seating area and the parking lot sucks but definitely worth it. The line was super long when i went on a Tuesday night but it went by pretty quickly. Wish I had know about this place sooner! It's great.

My Wife and Kids are fans of Cake Boss, My wife had to stop here and grab some pastries to feel part of the experience. We sat in a not so long line that just took forever 1 hour minimum. The shop located inside the Venetian casino sells several pastries running anywhere from 4 - $15 you can also purchase smaller pastries by the pound. The shop is nicely decorated you can see people preparing items from the window while you stand in line. There is a worker controlling the flow of the line at times she brought out samples to calm people while they wait. This was a nice touch. There are not a lot of choices once you get to the counter. My wife ordered the lobster tail, canolli, pecan chocalate covered cookie, velvet cupcake and some cookies that you could purchase per pound. The lobster tail was good not great not worth the wait, pecan cookie had better, the canolli was very good enjoyed the custard, the rest of the items were meh. I forget the pricing but I know it was expensive for what we received. I did not finish the pecan cookie, the lobster tail was ok but that also was not completely devoured. The only thing we finished was the canolli. I would not be back, Ive been to much better bake shops back home. Extraordinary desserts, Somecrust Bakery, to name a few.

Was here at around noon today. I only waited in line about ten minutes for my number to be called. I ordered a lobster tail, a chocolate cannoli, and a regular cannoli. Waited about another five minutes for the cashier. All of my desserts were in the box when I got home. Tried all of them and they were all very good. Thanks.

I love to stop by this place for a quick cup of tea but I frequently get pulled into staring at the pastries and can't leave without one! I've never had one I didn't like. Their sandwiches are great too for breakfast and lunch! I have seen them run out of croissants though and then the sandwiches are only on the harder bread which I don't love. The atmosphere is perfect to relax or get work done!

We stopped in after dinner at Buddy V's to grab some something sweet for later in the evening...way too stuffed after that amazing meal! I ordered a cannoli and enjoyed it in my hotel room before going to bed - sinful, I know!
Best ice cream ever. The only bad thing is that they close for the winter. Their chocolate peanut butter ice cream and pumpkin ice cream are to die for.

I've been coming to Page's my entire adult life. It's always been a special occasion treat that never disappoints. While they have your staples like chocolate and vanilla soft serve, Arctic swirls (their version of a blizzard), sprinkles, sundaes and such don't be afraid to try something a little out of the ordinary like the Southside Shake. Live a little! While it is cash only there is an ATM on the side of the building. The ice cream is dirt cheap and always excellent. You may have driven by, seen the line and decided not to stop. Rest assured that the line moves very quickly. These kids are hauling a** to get you in and out, so toss them a buck or two. I worked in an ice cream shop when I was a young woman, and it's harder work than you think. Be sure to stop by later in the season for the pumpkin pie arctic swirl. It's one of my favorite things about early fall.

I just came here for macarons. They are a good monetary value but the taste is just meh. Salted Caramel was a sugar bomb, too heavy, too sweet, too meh, 2/5 Pistachio was a little better, 3.5/5 They didn't taste very fresh.

So dissapointed with my last trip there, first I absolutely loved this little place , I love how they are open late and the location and the flavors of the ice cream, so delicious , BUT my last trip learned they discontinued the flights of ice cream !! And it was hot as hell outside and they were out of water ...like wtf !! We're in Arizona why the hell are you out if water , then the guy at the register was kind of dumb or stupid not sure which one but I had a punch card that literally need one more punch to get a free ice cream and he said we don't honor those anymore !!! Excuse me !! So now that I'm the last one you don't honor them anymore smh ,,, bad business move ..if you discontinued it fine but you should still honor the remaining cards people have ...then he offered to still punch the card for shits and giggles I guess ...what a fuckin idiot lol smh ...I'll never go back there !!

There isn't super high reviews on this page about Carlos Bakery however I was very excited to try and I wasn't disappointed. We got cannoli cheesecake, 2 cannolis, and Red Velvet cake. The cannoli cheesecake was good, the cannolis were alright (probably wouldn't go for those again), however that red velvet cake was AMAZING! Both my husband and I loved it. I felt it was one of my favorite cakes I had ever gotten. It was out of this world amazing! The service was pretty quick and friendly! I'd go back to try some more cakes I think the cakes are the way to go here.

Amelie's has been one of my favorites for a long time! The salted caramel brownie is to die for, a must grab for any visit. The napoleon's are delicious, as well as their breakfast sandwiches. It has a quaint and cozy atmosphere, great for small meetings, first dates, & the perfect after dinner dessert spot.

This was our 1st experience at Donut Bar and it will definitely not be our last! We got the creme brulee donut, blueberry cheesecake donut, big poppa tart, a cream donut, Nutella donut and a Halloween themed donut. They were all fantastic! My favorite was the blueberry cheesecake donut. The staff was wonderful, they were friendly and helpful. Highly recommend!
Everyone was very kind here. It was very organized. I loved the strawberries and the cheesecake. The fudge cake was alright though to me as well as the cannoli.

Beautiful deserts! Shameful customer service. I know all of us general public non hipsters are ruining your secret by telling everyone about this place. But you could put a little more effort into a smile, a thank you, a simple you're welcome goes a long way. I shouldn't be the one saying it first. With such an outstanding plethora of deserts you'd think some of that sweetness would rub off on the staff too. Yes the desserts are magazine quality and I'm sure the food is too but the coffee had a lot to be desired. The roast they use is not one I would choose and tastes like a medium roast. Espresso drinks in my opinion should be a dark roast. But maybe that's how they do it in France? I'll pass on the coffee next time. Oh and another tip don't sit in the hallway, the line will overtake you and takes away from the dining experience. Also you'll be bombarded with constant bags and butts brushing your chair.

Passed by this several times while staying at the Venetian. On my last morning there I had to try it. I ordered a blueberry muffin and beignets. The blueberry muffin was my favorite! It has an amazing crumble on the top that gives it a little crunch. The beignets have raspberry filling in them. They were good but not my favorite. I also had to try the hot chocolate. Unfortunately it was cold! Not something i would get again.

Came to try out this place since one of my friends dragged me along because he HAD to come here from being a fan of the show. Went on a weekday night and there wasn't too many people in line. The comments on the service is true though, it is a bit slow. They take your order but they expect you to know exactly what you want when you get to the counter, and then they make you pay while they take time to package everything. While I was there; the selection seemed slim. They had maybe 4 different cupcakes, 3 variety of sugar cookies, and then 4 different regular cookies. They had very limited amounts of Neapolitan and Canonolis. The price is a little expensive, but keep in mind it is Vegas! $3.50~ for cupcakes and cookies each. Fancier desserts around $7-8, and any sort of Cheesecake $15. All of the desserts were pretty good though. I didn't have any complaints. Their cake resembles more of a "butter pound cake" taste versus the cakes you would normally get at the store. **TIP: Check online for their Cake of the Week! Only $20 for a full cake which is a really good deal for this place!**

This is a cute little ice cream shop for atmosphere, but the actual ice cream was kind of just 'ok'. The waffle cone, in particular, was almost inedible from the amount of salt in it. Also, because I have pins in my ankle from a motorcycle accident, I generally like to sit down when I go out to eat, and there wasn't any place to sit comfortably. There are two small benches right outside the shop, but they were right in the blasting sun; the tables outside are for the neighboring coffee shop. So, I wound up walking over to the other side of the street and sitting on the curb in the shade. It was alright for that one time, but I probably won't visit again.
The best milk tea shop love that they have milk alternatives. Top Drinks in my opinion, Iced Matcha w coconut milk or Rose Milk tea w Almond milk

We decided to use the cupcake atm during a vegas trip back in December. You can go into the shop and order your snack, but where's the fun in that? It was one of those things that you have to experience at least once. You place your order, enter your payment and then you can watch the robot arms grab your treat from a computer screen. The machine emphasizes that no charges are made until your dessert is in hand. They come individually packaged in little boxes that have a sprinkles logo on it. My wife ordered a peanut butter cookie and i ordered a cupcake with a spiced butter cream frosting. Both were a good size and the price was reasonable. I hope to see more of these spots pop up in California. You'd have yourselves a regular if you did. They also have tables and chairs right outside which was convenient.

Jarling's is a Champaign staple, and for good reason. My dad grew up in champaign so I grew up visiting my grandma there and then went to school at u of I. My whole life I have been visiting the custard cup for their famous frozen custard. I've probably tried everything on the menu. My favorites are the banana split snowstorm and the fruity custard flavors. Jarling's brings me back to the good old days and is legendary for a reason. Oh and the smell of fresh custard and waffle cones when you walk in......just go and smell for yourself.

Sugar sugar sugar sugar sugar....I can't do it. I got a shock just watching. My sweetie loves this place so I got the red velvet cup cake and handed it over. The smile and the giggles were enough for me to know it's a sugar addict haven. It all looks and smells delish. And the ATM cupcake thingy is so friggin' genius! Make sure you bring your coins because this ain't granny jo's cupcakes. This is like the Beyonce of cupcakes...expensive!
INSANE!!!! So yummy and the best staff!!!!! They were so sweet and let us know all of the best things! Their ice cream is perfect consistency

My husband picked this place for our date night and OMG it was DELICIOUS. I had the Strawberry Shortcake YUM-EE Bun and it was PHENOMENAL. LIKE WOW. I don't know why I never thought to mix ice cream and donuts before but this was SO good. The ice cream is so good and had real strawberries in it and the shortcake crumble... to die for! My husband got the Apple Fritter Sundae and it was really good too! I'll definitely be back to try a milkshake and macaroon ice cream sandwich soon!

Walking up to Jeni's I felt a sense of southern hospitality and charm. In the heart of South End, the location and ambiance is top notch. I was practically knocked over by the amazing smell as I entered the shop. Their homemade waffle cones are to die for! Literally the best I've had (and I love some waffle cones). They offer so many ice cream flavors. Some on the traditional side and some creative and unique. I love the gooey butter cake and the salted peanut with chocolate flecks. Regardless of your taste, there is something for everyone!!

This is a really quaint ice cream shop in Phoenix that's definitely worth a stop if you're in the area. It's a pretty hopping place as the line can sometimes be out the door. I highly recommend trying two flavors if you're getting multiple scoops because their flavors are pretty intense and it can become too much after a while with only one flavor. They also offer a unique pretzel cone and I highly recommend that as the salt really enhances the flavors of the ice cream as well.

Yum. So many choices it is hard to figure out what I wanted. Ended up with the S'more Sundae. While it was good, it was WAY too sweet and rich for me. I only ate a third of it before I had to throw the rest away. I imagine a girl after a crap breakup would be in heaven with that beautiful monstrosity. Next time I'll try something a bit more tame. There will definitely be a next time though :)

I'm so excited to have a matcha place in Charlotte! It's in a nice plaza in the outskirts of Charlotte. I'd recommend going to if you love Matcha and looking for the best in Charlotte! I've been to the one in Hawaii during the summer and loved the shaved ice then. It's a seasonal treat. I'll definitely be back in the summer! Parking: plenty Seating: lots of seating, not busy when I visited Experience: super nice staff and love the aesthetics

It reminds me of a "Mom & Pop" shop. It was a little expensive if you try to make you're own creation, but the ice cream was pretty good. I wouldn't go out of my way to head back there, but if I was in the area, I'd probably stop by.

Fun spot to get soft serve ice cream! We beat the long line but I always see a line here. I got the toasted coconut soft serve on a sugar cone - so yummy! They had bits of toasted coconut. Serving size is large. I got a small cone and went into a delightful food coma after

I got 2 cake slices from the cake vending machine-one chocolate and one red velvet. Awful cake. The chocolate was so sweet and hardly chocolate flavored even though it looks very chocolaty. I couldn't even eat half of the slice. The red velvet was barely better but the cream cheese frosting did taste ok. I was expecting a high end cake slice since he's the Cake Boss. Nope-cheap low quality. Tastes like shortening type frosting. A cake mix or grocery store would have been better. Don't waste your money.

Must get a Churro ice cream sandwich. It's so good! Mocha cookies 'n cream and oatmeal cream pie flavors are so unique and delicious. Love this place. One of the best in Cleveland especially if you're looking for something different.

SOCIAL DISTANCING EDITION: This is one of the few places I feel I don't have to review! Jeni's amazing ice cream speaks for itself! This was my first time visiting Jeni's since the recent changes due to social distancing. They've adjusted, as necessary and I'm quite pleased with the steps they've taken! When you arrive at Jeni's you're prompted to wait in line outside of the establishment. There weren't many people staying 6 feet between each other in line but I don't believe that is something they can necessarily control. There are menus posted outside of the store so you can see what's available and make a decision before you arrive inside. They only allow one party in the store at a time. When you arrive you order and pay for you ice cream as soon as you walk in and then they have a waiting area on the other side where you grab your ice cream. The process was quick and I was in and out within 5 minutes. All of the associates were wearing masks and they have hand sanitizer available for you at the pick up station. I believe their menu is limited (or it may have changed) as my go-to flavor wasn't available. This time I went with the darkest chocolate ice cream and it was incredibly rich! Jeni's has a myriad of flavors and they're all so rich and creative. If you're looking to grab a scoop in a safe and clean environment I recommend going by Jeni's!
Page's ice cream is so good! They have many different concoctions to try! The couple in front of me were ordering cheese steak hoagies. I'll try this on a visit with a sundae for dessert.
Nummy- great service. Try it. You will love it. The ice cream is incredible. The macaroons are amazing too.

Best ice cream shop ever! Adorable building with a awesome paint job might I add. Great staff who knows how to take jokes and are genuinely very cool, down to earth people. Awesome creative flavors... And I love all the cereal ones, really brings you back to your childhood. They put it in a Chinese carry out box and to top it all off, literally, they put a fortune cookie on top .You can't just get that anywhere else! If I lived closer I would be there every day! ....tip: dip your fortune cookie in the ice cream... You will literally melt ;) lol

It's located in the Cosmopolitan on the second floor. I bought a compost cookie and a crunchy cereal shake. They are pretty unique to me. It was delicious and I enjoyed it. I like desserts, but Im pretty bias because Im always looking for desserts that are not so sweet. Which sounds a little ridiculous because most desserts are sweet. I have to say that by my preference, I think the compost cookie and my crunch cereal shake was not so sweet. It was just right. It was a bit challenging for me to find the place in the Cosmopolitan. It should be understandable as I am a tourist and I dont know where the heck im going at times. But it was not a far walk from Cesear's Palace. The Milk Bar was right next to the Momofuku restaurant and that would be a treat to go to next door as well. I would have to say that it would make a good experience to try out Milk Bar as theyve gained world popularity. You should give it a try. Just to even say you tried it. I would like to visit again and try the other stuff on their menu. Truly a great place to try.

Horrible service. I went in with my husband to get a sundae and wanted to use a coupon for Father's Day weekend. It clearly says for the weekend. When I went to use it is only valid Saturday and Sunday. Really it is Friday night and you won't honor it. Their ice cream is not that good and there was maybe 3 people in the store.Customer service is something theu really need to work on.
The food here is insanely good! The tai tea macaron ice cream sandwich is delicious, and the service is nice as well

I was staying at the Palazzo and i saw on yelp there was a highly rated bakery next door at the Venetian. This location is right outside of the Grand Luxe cafe in the Venetian. I ordered the Vanilla Macaron, Almond Croissant, and Blueberry Muffin. The macaron was really big and really bad. It was cold, chewy, and i felt like i was eating something that sat in the refrigerator for a week. I took one bite and threw it in the trash. I eat Macarons all over the United States, and a normal macaron is room temp, not chewy, and usually has a nice soft texture to it. Avoid this Macaron at all costs. On a better note, the Almond Croissant was and Blueberry Muffin were both OK, but nothing to write home about.

When I'm forced to NOT eat at Bouchon, I always manage to grab a little something for the ride home from this little stand in front of the Phantom of the Opera. They are open pretty late, so even if your roaming around after dinner, it would be so great to get a couple of Madeline's or a tart and go outside to people watch or just get some quiet. It is a little piece of Paris right inside Italy!!!!

I'm giving them a 4 for the cap n crunch Icecream. Otherwise totally meh. Sprinkles is so cute and iconic to me. Tasting the cupcakes from the judge of cupcake wars is so cool! I was kinda disappointed the first time I went as the cupcakes were dry. I've tried so many of their cupcakes. Probably 10 flavors in 3 visits. Yes I go back even though they weren't amazing. The stick out flavor is the chocolate peanut butter. It was the best cupcake I've ever had. I like the idea of sprinkles more than I liked their cupcakes. I like how cute it is, how exciting it is to get a box on a special occasion, and how nice the staff is. Their brownies and cookies are super decadent!
Cant say enough about the salted caramel brownies. Would like one now :-)

I was in a nostalgic mood today, I visited mine and my brother's old spots. I highly recommend the Fat Elvis and Bourbon Caramel icecream. INCREDIBLE!!! Definitely want to bring the old friends back and share the experience with new ones.

Presti's is great. I mostly go here for cheap lunch and can't really vouch for their baked goods and desserts, except to say that their cannoli are tasty (cannoli is plural). It's really convenient to come her for lunch if you work at CWRU or UH. For me, it's a ten minute walk, so I only come here when I have some extra time to kill. Ever since I started getting lunch here it has been hard for me to justify paying more for a slice of cardboard pizza in the cafeteria than it costs for a slice of Presti's pizza. By the way, I recommend the artichoke pizza. It's amazing. The have a "take a number" system and they are often busy around lunch time. Even when the place is packed it only takes about ten minutes for your number to be called.

Had some friends come down from Detroit and wanted to get them something exclusively Cleveland And since they love to eat I thought Jack frost right off the bat. I got a dozen and they took pics a loved them. Its a great local spot with ton of different doughnut creations. The only downside was they don't take credit - debit cards.

What a great day it was! After a visit to Batch, that is! First we had croissants, his ham n cheddar, mine a Gruyere......both amazing! Then we split a morning bun that was sinful!! And after dinner, a chocolate coconut tart that was outstanding! Fabulous crust n a filling that was perfect. Thanks guy.....great job!
We have stopped by this place many times. Always pack always good. So many creative and exotic flavors. Also, friendly customer service will be back again.

Owner could not have been nicer and more friendly. There's a reason this place has five stars ... you will not find a better ice cream place in the state of Arizona. We were visiting from Los Angeles, and truth is this place would make profits anywhere in the United States. Highly recommend this spot to any true ice cream aficionados.

The ice cream tasted so-so, I don't see anything special. But for an ice cream place that sells by scoop, I think the $5+ for three scoops is a good deal. Some ice cream parlors we've tried sell a scoop for $5. Anyway, this covid, not a lot of people wear mask inside the restaurant. Probably just 2 families out 50 (masks not required by state at the moment though). The good thing is that there's ample nice space outdoors were you can eat! Even if the waterfront colorful tables are chairs are full, you can sit on the grass or along the "boardwalk". Wasn't able to take a pic of our order because we decided to dine out and they started melting quickly. ROFL! Oh, I wish the container for the 3-scoops were bigger. Parking maybe hard, consider the nearby garage. TIP: Look on the Flavors of the Day before falling in line because it can take a while for you to decide, or the line will start getting long and you'll be rushed to pick just whatever.
The absolute best place to go get ice cream our an amazing milkshake! The Yummy buns are out of this world!!!!! So so good

Christina Tosi is my favorite baker. The treats and desserts you get at Milk Bar are unlike anything you have ever had before. The success of Milk Bar can be summed up by saying it's the perfect combination of science and creativity. Cookies (4-5 stars) All are at least 4 stars but the sure winners are the Cornflake Chocolate Chip Marshmallow Cookie (which tastes like Frosted Flakes had a baby with a chocolate chip cookie) and the Compost Cookie (which incorporates salty treats to the sweet cookie to create a flavor explosion). Crack Pie (4.5 stars) - Don't think of this as pie. If you compare it to traditional pie, you may find it odd. Think of it more as if a butter cookie was fused with pie crust. It's unlike any dessert on the planet. It's equally as buttery as it is sweet and very satisfying. Cereal Milk Milkshake (3 stars) - The first few sips are incredible.
