It really does taste like cereal milk blended with ice cream. BUT it's incredibly sweet. So sweet that my husband and I couldn't even finish TOGETHER their smallest sized shake. If you can handle a ton of sugar, go for it! But if you're a weakling like me... maybe pass or just be OK with throwing some away. Birthday Cake (4.5 stars) - It's visually stunning! The cake is very spongy and light. And there are funfetti cookie dough crumbles throughout. This would be the world's perfect cake if it wasn't for... CHOCOLATE Birthday Cake (5 stars) - I normally don't like chocolate cake that much. I almost always prefer vanilla. But this one, WOW! The cake tastes like an Oreo Cookie in cake form. And the frosting tastes very similar to Oreo Cream. Also... We bought this cake and I totally forgot about it (because I normally don't want Chocolate cake). I ate it a whole WEEK after we bought it and the cake was still soft, spongy, and fresh as if it was just made that day.

We were looking for deserts to take it back to the room because we were so full after dinner and we found this place from Venetian website. Unfortunately it was not what we expected. This is the store inside Venetian. From the look, all their baking products, there was nothing impressive at all. We went ahead and got a slice of chocolate cake that ready packed in a clear plastic container and a white chocolate mousse to take it back to our room. The cake was overwhelmingly sweet like a grocery store bought cake. There was no quality into it. One would expect the store in a nice hotel like this would make high end deserts, not this one though. Go some place else if you want a high end dessert from a Michelin Chef. But if you don't mind just a piece of cake load nothing but sugar, this is for you
BEST ice cream joint in town! I love supporting small local businesses and this one comes with sugar on top!
I love Amelie's every time I go! They never disappoint.

This place is a great place to get some custard around town. Even though there is usually a line, the timeliness of the service isn't too bad. I think that the snowstorms don't really come in smaller sizes and melts pretty quickly. I wish that the snowstorms had more flavor - sometimes I'm not tasting what I got.

The giant macarons are fantastic. We bought the 12 pack and it was expensive, but they were perfectly baked, which is hard to find, even in professional bakeries. The flavors were so delicious. The passion fruit and raspberry macarons were our favorite. We wanted to order raspberry macarons for our 12-pack but they were sold out. =(
Very delicious ice cream with lots of fun flavors to try. Cute atmosphere and back patio.

Sweets were pricey but didn't try. I didn't expect anything out of their savory food because I just wanted a quick bite for dinner but my dad and I got a pizza which was ok/solid, pasta which was good, and the stromboli was amazing!!! It was just presented on the side of the place and we said screw it just microwave it for us but it ended up tasting super good? Meat strombolis are good but for some reason I reallllly liked the veggie one. Highly recommend.

I will start by saying I am glad I live far from this place!, 2 reason: I will be over-weight and have diabetes(Not to offend anyone). But this place is FABULOUS!. Every time I try a different pastry but I ALWAYS get and assorted order of French Macaroons. Their cold drinks are very refreshing and Bistro menu is great and tasty. The negative... space. Because is a very popular place it will usually be crowded. To add to the space problem there is a bunch of unusual item (night stands, mannequins) that don't really add decor but take up space. So the place feels a bit claustrophobic and restraint, well don't let that ruin the experience to enjoy what could be THE best pastries in town.

Very friendly staff, easy to read menu, extremely clean, fast service, and AMAZING CUPCAKES. If the strip wasn't such a pain in the a** to get to, I would go to Sprinkles every single day for their awesome gluten free cupcakes.
BOMB.COM on the Macarons!!! Iv had macarons flown in from Paris at the famous Laduree's bakery but the macaron i had in vegas was by far the best I'v ever had!!! enough said.

Went here twice in April 2014. On a Thursday night, quite a wait, figured I'd get a wide range of their offerings: Oreo tower cake, pretty, but tasted like it had been on the shelf for awhile. Lobster Tail: Unique and tasty, can't get it anywhere else, nice for a pic. Pecan Wedge: Best thing I got, shortbread with pecans/syrup partially dipped in chocolate. On a Sunday morning: Not a long wait, but no lobster tails or pecan wedges available. Seemed like much of the items were holdovers from the previous night.

I eat approximately two donuts a year on average. Not really my thing. Someone brings in a box of donuts to work and I'm not even tempted. Bad for you and I just never find they are really very good. On our trip to Vegas in April I was doing my research on Yelp and saw the rave reviews on Donut Bar. Heather and I decided to grab a coffee and wander over on our first slightly hungover morning in Sin City. Am I ever glad we did. The donuts here are next level. So many tasty, colourful creations to choose from. We decided to share a Mexican Hot Chocolate Donut and a Maple Bacon Cinnamon Roll. Both were out of this world. The Donut was fresh and fluffy like nothing I had tried before. The chocolate and marshmallows were perfect. The Maple Bacon Cinnamon Roll stole the show however. The huge chunks of crispy bacon and the perfect blend of crunchy, chewy, sweet and gooey Cinnamon Roll made for an amazing morning treat I raved about all weekend. A place you must stop in and try just blocks from Fremont Street!

Friendly staff. Flavors are overwhelming. The Basil Lime Sorbet is addictive and the Salted Caramel ice cream is so good. I love the additional toppings - olive oil, sea salt and bacon brittle. Unique and really bring out the flavors in each ice cream.

My little girl and her friends absolutely loved their Unicorn Milkshakes. The ice cream cookies take 2 hands to enjoy! This place is full of good Sugar and is out of sight. Hidden to those that are not looking .... it has been around for years and I never thought to go inside until recently ... we love it

Deliciousness - 3.5/5 Happiness - 3.5/5 I know this is a bit of an institution, but I simply wasn't that impressed. The donuts LOOK great for sure. Indeed, it took me about 5 minutes to finally figure out what I wanted as I marveled at all the options. And you absolutely get a lot of bang for your buck - the prices are very reasonable. But it would have been helpful for them to have names or signs as I basically had to interrogate the employee about what every offering was. But as good as they look, the taste just didn't do much. I have two young children and they didn't even finish their donuts. I felt like they didn't end up having a lot of flavor despite the extreme amount of sugar. I think this is a fun place to visit at least once due to the pure novelty. But ultimately, I'd rather get my calories from something a little tastier.

When at Bouchon Bakery, I'm usually here for one thing, macarons. I just can't resist those delicious giant cookies. These are the best in town. Expensive, but worth the price. Everything is done right here, I love the cookies, whoopie pies and yes, even cupcakes. Pricy, yes, but worth every penny. Most recently I discovered the TKOs and that is precisely what they did, packing quite a punch on my taste buds.
Excellent!!!!! Creative, flavorful and great to have in the neighborhood. Really good customer service as well.

As good as ever...my favorite flavor, Black sesame, is back! A few flavors are way better than the others (in terms of flavor, consistency, sweetness level), namely the black sesame and ube. Egg waffle was a NECESSITY (of course!) and soft + fluffy as always...looking forward to the next time I'll be back, which will be soon ;-)

Voted 'Best of Cleveland' for a reason. I haven't actually been to the bakery, but someone brought these into the office and what a great treat!! These donuts where dense enough to support the incredible toppings. I wont lie - i had more than one and it was soooooo worth it!

Always a treat to pop into Mitchell's for a taste of something new, fresh, and quintessentially Cleveland. Was hoping for the Geagua Maple Ice cream - however it was not on the menu. We tried the Guinness dark chocolate - however it was more Guinness and barely any taste of true chocolate. So we settled on a tasters duo - key lime ice cream & bing cherry dark chocolate. The Key Lime literally tasted like true KL pie - crust bits and all. The Bing Cherry Dark chocolate was purely exquisite. It was the best of both worlds - fruit and dessert...always good service and fun to watch the factory behind the glass.
First time going there and the small batch ice cream is delicious, and customer service is very helpful with explaining toppings. Parking is a little tight but other than that we will be back.

The storefront is easy to miss because it looks like part of the window repair shop (?) next door, but we all know that this is the one place on Willy Street that you do NOT want to pass over! To these folks, baking is an art form - one that they have mastered beautifully. I grabbed a ham&gruyere croissant and a scone (lemon-ginger, I think). I chose the croissant per the recommendation of the girl behind the counter. She mentioned that the head baker had trained in Paris, and since she led with that...I kinda HAD to try a croissant. The croissant is a good effort, but still a far cry from the ones I fell in love with in Paris. The flakiness of the baked dough isn't quite there, but the ham&gruyere filling is a nice touch. Of the two treats that I picked up, the scone was the clear winner. The candied ginger pieces provided a nice overtone and really complemented the citrus-y flavor of the pastry (it is actually filled with a citrus jam - a nice surprise when I cut the scone open!).The ginger also helped to cut the overall sweetness of the scone with a spicy zing. A wonderful, wonderful combination! :9 Batch is truly a must-visit if you are on the east side of town! I can't wait to sample more of their goodies!! Tip: I wasn't looking for anything in particular when I stopped by, but if you are looking for a particular type of bread, check out their daily bread schedule online before you head in!

Ok on a quick whim for ice cream. Sandwiches are super blah and greasy. Service sucks, the young college girl working the day we went could have cared less and her attitude showed it. Nevermind the 4 other guys standing around behind the ice cream counter behind her standing around... talking...staring....akward.
Lobster tails! That's all I gotta say. Haven't had a good one since I left B & W Bakery in NJ. These were perfection. Can't wait to go back.

Pricey but pretty good treats. I've been to the LA location a few times and I probably prefer this location better. I am usually a fan of their cookies and ice cream. The last time I came here was when I stayed at the Cosmo. I do not drink dairy and asked them to make a Milk and Cereal Latte for me with something non dairy. So I guess they couldn't with that option so I went with their regular size Birthday Cake Latte with almond milk instead ($6.50). I didn't think it was anything super special but it was good and I was glad I got it. I also got their Gluten Free Birthday Cake Truffle which I highly recommend ($6). It comes pre-packaged with three truffles inside. The packaging is cute and they were SO GOOD! I definitely recommend them. I do appreciate that they have non-dairy options and gluten free options available when not many dessert places do. I also like that most of their sweets are pretty good but just pretty pricey.

My husband and I just went for the first time tonight! It was delicious and looks like you can't go wrong no matter what you choose. There was a line of about 5 groups of people when we arrived which meant about 15 minutes of waiting. We just moved from Virginia and haven't seen this place when it's warmer, but I can imagine the line wraps around the block considering how delicious the product is.

I've been here for both ice cream during the summer and ramen in the winter. Mason's has a variety of unique flavors, including cardamom and thai tea, that change daily. The outdoor seating is nice for the warmer months. In the winter months, I had the veggie ramen, which is mushroom based. They also have pork and chicken options. The broth and soft boiled egg were super flavorful. The mushrooms themselves were a bit too chewy for my liking. Still a great meal and perfect for a cold winter evening. I went around 6pm on a Saturday and they only had enough of the veggie ramen for two more orders for the day, so keep that in mind if you're wanting the vegetarian option.

This ice cream is delicious. I had the the best caramel sea salt ice cream ever. It almost makes me think I'd like to live in Cleveland. I went back the next day and had the raspberry chocolate chunk. It was amazing. On second thought, it's probably a good thing I don't live in Cleveland. It would be ruinous for my diet.

NoDa has another gem. The relaxed atmosphere and unique decor is spot on and the meal did not disappoint. Sweet fig spread with smoky crisp bacon, paired with rich smooth brie all on top of toasted baguette slices. The staff was very informative and all smiles which seemed to gravitate to the clientele. The next time I have a midnight craving for sweets or a great lunch I know exactly where to go. Oh!!! and this location is pretty much open 24/7.

On every stage is a moment for you to shine, as you glow pass along that love and passion for someone else to cherish and celebrate. If your ever in old town, down town Las Vegas stop in for a donut and some coffee. What goes better than these two phrases coffee and donuts? Great I'm glad that your paying attention. Now this ordinary shop might seem dilapidated because it's "downtown," but just walk through the door and enjoy the beauty. Now make sure and get here before around noon time because when the donuts are done; so are the staff for the day. Could you contemplating waiting for the perfect donut for another day. Perhaps not, so forget not having that conversation and get here early. As you walk in the store it's usual standing room only. It's the post pandemic now, so their are no longer any mask restrictions or standing six feet apart. No longer are there rules for how many to can in the store at one time too. Make sure not to push and shove, await your turn for that perfect moment when you get to pick your favorite donuts. Tap your foot or look up at the menu, the moments tick down till it's your turn to have donuts. Can you feel the urge building inside of you? It's almost go time, all those in front of you have been taken care of. Being GO time. You clam up and don't know what you want. Let's calm down and pick one of everything please, as you drool over the glass! You will have no trouble picking out what you want. My favorite is the maple bar with "real bacon," on top. The friendly staff will waste no time making sure you are happy with your donuts decisions. It was national donut day, yes we need a day to come together and share circular moments among those in our lives. Mark the calendar for next year or be the life of the party and just bring a dozen in to everyone. Donuts please, yes. The donuts here are far beyond a donut. The creative charm and joy that makes them possible is exceptional. As you stare through the glass such choices; once you try one you will be back for the one that you did not try. Let your inhibitions go. Coffee and donuts all in the same place. Happy is here until they lock the doors. Get here early to enjoy the best selections of the day before they are gone. It's always happy even if you have to wait in line. Explore there menu options on your phone. As the line dwindles down it's getting closer to your turn be ready! Oh you were not ready! Did you just get stumped up because of the bombardment of choices. Deep breaths! Now that your on your way to making the day a little more fun and special. Sip your coffee, eat that spectacular donut and make a donut moment.

Original lobster tail all the way! But, everything else seemed like it might just be the hype? Stuff was very pretty/yummy looking but we weren't fans of the cookie we got and the cannoli was just okay. If the wait isn't too bad, I'd say get in on those lobster tails but otherwise, there are so many places to get treats, this one isn't necessarily worth the time or money.
I love this place. The perfect lunch spot. Great bread. Great pastries.
Awesome ice cream chain from Ohio. The staff was so friendly. Kids got huge 2 scoop waffle bowls and I got an extra thick chocolate milk shake!

pleasure of ice cream a treasure on the two five respite of flavor A new feather in the Ohio City neighborhood's cap. Mitchell's Ice Cream opened yesterday in the creepy old Moda space that, previous to that debacle, was a movie theater. The ice cream parlor area in the front starts with a cafeteria style line of ice creams, followed by a freezer full of ice cream cakes and pies, half gallons, and pints. Pints being "convenient single serve containers" in my book. There is a cute train that runs the perimeter of the ceiling. You can get a view of the production area through the glass partition walls. The old building's ceilings and rafters are exposed. And the re-hab of the space was done in a green and environmentally conscious way. With all of the designer ice creams out there, each ostensibly richer and sometimes weirder than the last, this stuff is not that at all. Yes, they focus on using local dairy and fruit products, but the ice cream itself is not soooo rich and fatty that your cholesterol spikes. It does not leave your mouth all slimy with butterfat. It. Is. Perfect. I had the "trio of tastes" in a cup. Banana Cream Pie, GLBC Stout with chocolate, and Rum Bobka, that was made to coincide with the shops Dyngus Day opening. Lord have mercy. I've eaten Mitchell's before, but the Rum Bobka was out of this world. The stout/chocolate had a rich coffee like flavor, and the banana cream pie had some salty bits of shortbread crust through it. Oh man... ...no words... And take note of this. After obviously throwing down hard to revamp the space, and having a live 3 piece trio playing to boot, ALL sales from the opening day are donated to two Ohio City charities, Providence House, and Malachi's. Mitchell's is a class act, and a tremendous addition to the area. Oh yeah. WAFFLE CONES!!! Carry on...
These are the donuts I got! They are so pretty and I had one so far (the cake one) and it was great! Cute place too

We have three on our property. They make AMAZING baguettes that don't have milk powder in them. The grilled cheese is a favorite of mine before work. That and an almond milk latte in winter is the absolute best. The pastries are in a seasonal rotation, I think. Their presentation is charming making it authenticity French. Do nicely done.

Had the Neapolitan and the mini cannoli. I've never heard of this place prior to coming to his place but the baked goods are pretty good. Layers of the Neapolitan were still very crispy, and the cannoli were very tasty.

While visiting Phoenix with family, we stopped at Novel for after lunch ice cream. Brandon, the owner, greeted us immediately and encouraged us to sample as much ice cream as we desired. Between the five of us we all had a Doughmelt which included a warm donut with a generous scoop of ice cream and a topping of our choice. Each flavor we had was excellent, but the experience with Brandon was definitely what made this a five-star location.

Expensive and over rated. The crack pie is good, but not the best thing I ever ate. The bday cake milk quake was just OK. The ice cream texture wasn't my fave - too melty. I guess it didn't meet my expectations.

I have been going to batch bake house first opened in its old location and have never been disappointed. The Fougasse (my favorite) is to die for and the vanilla swirl is deliciously sweet and rich. The atmosphere is beautiful and sunny and the staff is very friendly. Some of the best baked goods I have ever tasted!

Tried this place for the first time ever since I've heard it about it for years but never got the chance to have. 1. The service is SUPER slow. I got a cupcake and the person behind me special ordered something so they passed me to get rung up. They took 10mins while I bought ONE cupcake and stood there waiting to pay. Would have been faster if the next 3 people paid through instead of waiting for these yahoos. 2. In the evening they run out a lot of stuff so get there early if you want a certain kind 3. They wrap a napkin around the top, I pulled it out of the bag and the top half fell off Overall, cupcake was amazing! But service needs to be faster ESP with 3 people working the front.

If you like ice cream, Sloan's ice cream is a must visit. Very different flavors the your usual ice cream parlor: toasted coconut, banana. Sundaes: Kilimanjaro and Tracy's Sink (18 scoops, 4 cookies, 4 brownies, whipped cream and cherries served in a real sink). Flavor reminds me of gelato. There are all kinds of toppings that you can add. The prices are kinda high but what the heck; Vegas is Vegas. Worth a visit or two.

Whoa. End of review. Just kidding. My Cleveland friend brought me here while I was visiting. She described it as a cross between Graeters and Jeni's, the former which I could care less for and the latter which I could almost die for. So my expectations were stagnant right in the middle of Canterbury. Boy, what an impression presence makes though. Walking from the parking lot of the public market appears these giant green leaves and a sparkling white building that looks modern yet retro. Going in through the side door and an explosion of amazing ice cream making smacks you in the face. They have these gigantic mixers that you could use to mix babies and kittens and puppies in, add some sugar and cream and you've got a new flavor. The whole place is pristine and the smells...Seriously nothing beats the smell of a great ice cream shoppe. The line was pretty long, but because it's ice cream, a long line doesn't really mean anything besides deliciousness. We got from the outside end of the line to ice cream scoop central in about 10 minutes and I was trying everything that caught my attention. Fearing holding up the line, I got a kiddie size of the fire roasted sweet corn on a sugar cone. This is the stuff of heaven man, any wacky flavors that can be ice creamed and is on point wins in my book. I'm not sure it beats Jeni's on wackiness, but its even with Jeni's on value for sure (Jeni's is expensive though much more adventurous). I wish I could lie there...

Finally got a chance to try 85C Bakery, however, it was not as good as the hype. I tried two items: Taro bun was too sweet, coffee flavor bread was very average. Haven't tried the pork bun I got yet but it looks oily. To me, their items are not high quality. My friend did not like the milk tea she ordered because it was way too sweet and didn't taste fresh. Disappointed overall. Service was friendly.

I've been to the location in New York City so it was cool to see the same tasty treats in Vegas. Thankfully, everything is exactly the same, as far as the pastries. The bouchons, TKOs and Bittersweet Chocolate Tarts were all great, rich and decadent. The selection was pretty much the same and the customer service was friendly. While I do enjoy the NYC location a bit more since the Vegas location is a bit more hectic (it is in a casino after all!), it's still awesome!

Ramen: waste of plastic and money. I really was SAD. I want to support any business that sells vegan ice cream, but the ramen and ESPECIALLY the RAW DOUGHY vegan corn dog was NOT IT. I feel that I was ripped off by these mushrooms in the ramen alone. I don't know who said they have good ramen, but that is an incorrect assessment. I do, however, recommend their ice cream. I cannot say enough good things about how creative the flavors are and variety. I feel so mean but it needs to be said do not get the ramen please. Get the ice cream!!!! Also the people working here were so kind and there is a nice cat outside. Dress warm because the heaters inside the tent where you sit are not on a lot of the time.
I've been coming here for years, and I will never not love it. Today I got a chocolate mousse cup and a salted caramel brownie torte-- both are fantastic! A must-go every time I'm in Charlotte.

One of the true treasures of the strip. Despite hus talents, thomas keller doesnt let his ego get in the way of providing some of the worlds best pastries, desserts, and even sandwiches, at very reasonable prices. His macarons are the best in vegas, and when i dont have a lot of time, his turkey sandwich on a cranberry baguette with a hot chocolate or latte is perfect. The pastries are as appealing visually as they are delicious. A must try

Hello guys! I decided to pay this bakery a visit due to delicious macarons that they had in the pics. They did not disappoint by the way! But they have a cute little store. You might ride past it if you are going too fast but otherwise you won't miss it. It was my daughters birthday weekend so I wanted to get her some macarons because she loves them. They did not have a big selection but there was a variety to choose from. I then noticed the massive cakes that they had displayed. OMG! They looked so delicious. I wanted a slice of the chocolate cake because that is here favorite, but could not get it because there was actually a fly in the display case. Got to be more aware of the flies! They are sneaky! And we really wanted that cake! But she chose the red velvet instead. Now I am from Georgia so red velvet hits a little different for me. With that being said I did not really like it. I ate some but not all. But the macarons were great! We got the Nutella and the almond. Will definitely go back for those very soon! My daughter also decided to try the some kind of rainbow cookie. She loved it but I did not. I also noticed that they had cheesecake in the fridge as well. I'm definitely interested in return to try their other delectable delights!
Came back, icecream is honestly great. Think I over heard the staff saying it's been the same recipe for years over all the previous locations. Cool history for AZ, good icecream for us.

This is a place I was REALLY looking forward to visiting since it is finally close enough for me to get to it. We ordered the cereal milk, cereal milk soft serve, crack pie, crack pie milkshake, and a corn cookie. The cereal milk and corn cookie were definitely my favorites. The crack pie milkshake was SUPER sweet, and for that reason I didn't have a bite of the pie. The cereal milk soft serve was good, served with lots of cereal piled on top and in the bottom of the cup. I guess my only complaint is that for the price, it wasn't quite as mind blowing as I had hoped. Next time I would like to try the cake bites and will have another cereal milk and some corn cookies.

This place is delicious! The chocolate mousse is amazing! Nice, friendly staff and it moves quickly. I visited twice while I was in Vegas! Love that we can enjoy Carlos Bakery on the west coast! I also love that they support the epilepsy foundation as it personally impacts Buddy's family and my family!

Just stopped by for a snack and I was blown away. First, the theme is great. Second, there is such a huge assortment of options to choose from it's overwhelming. I opted for the spiced chai donut which was $3 and delicious. Very flavorful and the actual donut wasn't greasy, but instead light and airy. We got two coffees which were also on point. I will be back- especially with the awesome and shaded outdoor area perfect for the Vegas weather

I don't get the people who think this is the best bakery in the world. I have tried something here a half-dozen times, and each time, the only thing I ever thought was OK was the coffee. The last 2 times I didn't even bother going in. Instead, my wife and her friend waited in line for an eternity to get small boxes of treats to eat on the way home from the breweries. Although I am always pleased to create a reminder in my google calendar when I can remind my wife of a time I was right - it will also remind of a time when my wife spent my money on overpriced pastries that are dry, and more or less bland. Both times my wife agreed that it was not very good, when her friend asked "why is it so busy then?!?" my wife responded "sheeple." Luckily Abari and Free Range brewing are close enough to where the wife was able to drop me and her friends husband off to drink and play TMNT: the arcade game!

I was very disappointed to see that the lobster tails are twice as small now. I was here two years ago and they were a great size that I didn't care paying seven dollars for it. Now they are very, very small and not worth paying almost six dollars for it at all. They were to hard, the flakes of the pastry were not crunchy, they seemed staled and I had to be careful not to poke the roof of my mouth with every bite. I am so disappointed as I am a huge fan of his show but if they continue to not care for the quality of he product I don't think It will be coming back. I am so sad, I really loved their lobster tail...

More hype for the best ice cream EVER than it really is. It's worth going if you're an ice cream snob, but don't be surprised when you think it's just another cone of ice cream. Unique flavors and friendly service, but nothing for me to jump up and shout about.
Yummy sweet treats. Gotta love it. Not sure that I would come here if i was staying at another hotel but if you are staying at the Venetian or Palazzo its a hit.

Nicely decorated spot for sweets and drinks! Good place to catch up with people or a quick stop to treat yourself. Got Vietnamese Coffee and Tiramisu ice cream and we LOVE the Vietnamese coffee! So good and strong with coffee flavor. Matcha Immuni-Tea: matcha was light but good if you like green tea. Butterfly Rose Lemonade: pretty and a refreshing drink. Would recommend!

I looked up best ice cream places to go in each state, and this one definitely lives up to its title. Very clean and lots of seating to enjoy the richest ice cream you'll ever taste. So good I had to get three scoops! They have vegan flavors and Complimentary water too! If you're in Arizona, you've gotta go!

This place is a nice dessert place at the boardwalk. It was super hot and humid that I needed a fix and they were happy to oblige. I only got one scoop, but the serving was more than satisfactory which is more than what I can say about most places. Absolutely no negative impressions. The place inside looks old and could use a makeover to make it more appealing for people to come in.

We absolutely love honey hut and we would love to come in sometime maybe even on a snowy day, it's so delicious your ice cream is truly the best! my whole family adores your ice cream, the chocolate turtle truffle, the banana split is extremely filling and the size of a party platter to share, the pecan ice cream, the rootbeer floats are refreshing and last all day on perfect afternoons watching a sunset with the love of your life and your kids growing up before your eyes Thank you for showing us the most magnificent tasting food there ever is as a dessert, it is an honor to have tasted such a delicacy.

I am so happy that they finally brought 85° into the Las Vegas area. The pastries and cakes here are so delicious and bring a hint of Asia to our little tourist town. From their jalapeno cream cheese bread to the taro bread to the milk buns and egg tarts, You can't really go wrong when you come here. If you like salt then maybe you want to try the sea salt coffee but I normally go with an iced Americano. What's even better is that they box everything up and put them in individual little bags which allow them to stay fresher and keeps the taste! If you have a birthday coming up they have some pretty sweet cakes too and delicious tiramisu! It's kind of loud and packed here normally because it's so good so I would caution you that you might find all the tables occupied if you're looking to sit down. If you haven't been here you probably should and it's in the new Shanghai plaza with some cool little restaurants nearby. Obviously with what's going on now everything is pretty much take out and you'll still be happy leaving this delicious establishment.

It's right behind churches chicken. It's hidden near the back. Limited seats. Very small inside. Yessssss. Steve urkel picture was everything. Haha I had the red velvet macaroon with mocha java and mint chocolate chip ice cream in between and a square marshmallow on top. Whoooooooo. Bombbbb. Ohh, Try the foot loop and the lucky charm as well.

The pink Milk sign is what caught my eye initially. I was in the mood for something sweet after dinner at the Cosmopolitan Hotel, and decided to grab dessert from Milk. There are a ton of options to chose from but I was personally in the mood for a soft serve so I went ahead with the cereal milk flavor with the corn flakes topping. It's definitely not a typical flavor but it literally does taste exactly like milk and cereal. They had two other flavors one was crack pie and the other was a chocolate something which were a little too sweet in my opinion. I'll go ahead and grab a milkshake next time.
Delicious! Went here last week for the first time and the staff is friendly and their Donut Melts delicious! Recommend to try out :)
This place is amazing. I was lucky enough not to wait for to long to get my deserts! Many options and it was kept stocked. My next stop is the restaurant !

It has been quite a while since I've been wanting to try this bakery for a while, made it here for breakfast, they have really good desserts & the french vanilla coffee came out really good. 3 desserts & 1 coffee did come out to $19 yikes worth every bite though
Nasty and over priced! They served me a crack pie cold! sorry but I think ooey and gooey butter bar should be warm and gooey. No thank you.
If you're needing a treat and some divine coffee, this is your place. The ambience is so unique and it's always filled with people. They're doing something right!

Not worth the money. The cookies were on the border of being pretty stale & hard. They were way too salty & tasted like too much baking soda was added. Out of the corn, blueberry, compost cookies, I guess the blueberry was the better one of the 3. But the flavor of all of them was overpowered by baking soda & salt making your tongue dried out & thirsty afterwards. A very unpleasant experience. The crack pie was just the typical brown sugar butter pie. If you've had something like this before then you don't need to try this one. It was average at best, nothing memorable. You will be disappointed. I didn't try the ice cream, milk shakes or cake so maybe those are Milk's better items. Those cookies were like eating a salt cube, don't do it!
I got a cupcake from here a couple years ago and felt like there was a laxative In the cupcake, made me very sick :( too afraid to go back

I can't say how totally disappointed I was in going to the Vegas location of Carlo's Bakery!! I don't gamble and I'm not into Blue a man Group so for me Vegas is visiting family and getting good grub. I love lobster tails and I'm not talking the fishy kind I'm talking the amazing east coast confection that is slightly crisp on the outside but soft and gooey and filled with a delicious custard.. unfortunately that's not what I got at Carlo's.!! I wished I'd have tasted one before I bought 7 of them to take home to friends.. well I couldn't wait so on the car ride home to AZ I dug in and wished I'd had a trash can to spit it back out.. it was awful hard beyond belief with hardly any filling and tasted so badly of old grease that I could only take that one bite.. I had my husband try another one hoping it was just the one and he couldn't take but one bite either.. the whole batch tasted like four day old leftovers yet we had only gotten them an hour before and we specifically got to the bakery early to get the freshest ones. Well I think we got the oldest ones they had.. not going to go back here maybe when we visit friends in Jersey we will try the original shop.. sorry Buddy this place was terrible!!

Having heard so much about it, and being a complete sugar-head, I REALLY wanted to like this place. It's open 24 hours and the caramel salted brownie is quite good. But, after 3 visits, I have tried several pastries and cakes and they are just ok at best and at worst kind of tasteless and spongy/heavy. The desserts are chilled and for some of them it makes them worse for the wear-- such as anything that is supposed to be flaky. Cute decor does not make up for mediocre sweets. I have yet to try their lunch/breakfast offerings, so maybe this is what keeps other reviewers so enthused.
Still 5 * Star Taste! Got Quarts of Egg Nog and Non Dairt Raspberry Sorbet. Family Loves them!

I saw they had palm sized french macarons and I knew I had to buy a few before leaving Vegas. I've never seen french macarons so large and the price wasn't bad at all for $3.50 a macaron (compared to the normally tiny expensive bites). They didn't have as much cream filling and the outer shell was a bit harder then what I'm used to, but they were still light and chewy. I enjoyed them for their size and flavor, but I didn't enjoy them as much as others I've had.

Unique Charlotte bakery that is a must-visit for anyone coming to the city. The NoDa location is my favorite with its large social area that extends out into the interior of the building. There are always unique characters here. Lots of good people watching If you're into that. Highly recommend the chocolate croissant or any of the macaroons. They also have a great BLT (on baguette) and other food options. Open 24 hours!

Can get hot and cold drinks, baked goods, yogurt parfaits, fruit bowl, and ~$7-10 sandwiches here. Love to get a bunch of bake goods to bring home for the kids. -Americano coffee $4 4.5* -Chocolate chip cookie $3.25. 4.5* -Oatmeal Raisin chewy buttery $3.25. 4* -Fruit Danish $4.25. 4* -Blueberry Muffin is very light with a crumble topping $3.75 4.5* -Chocolate Bouchon is like a mini cake brownie $2 3.5* -Macaron Raspberry: very flavorful but was not chewy $4 3.5** -Macaron Pistachio: flavorful & chewy $4. 4.5* -Macaron Special(Passionfruit): very flavorful & somewhat chewy $4 4* -Oh-Oh is a rolled up dingdong cake (chocolate cake, creamy filling, chocolate coating) Excellent! $5.50 5*+ Location It is under the escalator to the right of the Grand Lux Cafe in the Venetian.

We came here because one of our friends raved about the breads and cakes here. When we arrived early Sunday, we were excited because there was no line snaking outside like there was previously. We picked our breads and ordered our drink and 3 cake slices at the kiosk so the order would be ready by the time we got to the register. Their system of ringing up purchases is horrifically inefficient. The cashiers individually wrap up each item in plastic prior to boxing it. When I asked the cashier why they didn't just package it before it was placed on the display shelves, she stated that it was because there was nobody whose specific job it was prepackage the pastries and that it was only done when it wasn't busy. Wouldn't it be better to package the items beforehand so it's easier on the cashiers, faster for the customers, and ensure that there's no contamination of the breads/pastries that are sitting on the shelves?? Additionally, I think the workers need to be re-educated regarding safe food handling practices. They handle food to package it, but in addition, they handle money, cards, etc., then they go and touch their faces, lips, and I watched one gloved worker place an order in a box, then use said gloved hand to rub her nose. I would recommend ordering any drinks and cakes at the kiosk so that it will be ready by the time you get to the register, but make sure you check your order before you leave. We left without checking because our kids were getting antsy after waiting in the line and they forgot one of the 3 cake slices we ordered. Bad on us for not checking. One more tip: if you don't care to have your pastries packaged individually in plastic, just let the cashier know and save yourself some time and aggravation.

The store is very cute. It's a bit on the small side but has a spacious, shady patio out back. Customer experience was lacking. The employees could've been friendlier. They have a small selection of ice cream to choose from. The mint cookie ice cream was delicious. Not so much a fan of the others. I got a cookie sandwich that was huge! Their prices are very reasonable. I didn't absolutely love my cookie, but it was good.

This place is super kitschy, and honestly that was my favorite thing about it. I loved getting to check out the crazy sculptures and chandeliers and reading how to say 'I love you' in 40 different languages on the banister while waiting in the insanely long line, and had we eaten in I would have loved to have done it underneath some Eiffel Tower-themed monstrosity. Unfortunately the food was disappointing, and it was made worse by their confusing pickup system. They give you different categories of things in different bags in different places, which wasn't made clear, so we drove all the way back to our hotel only to open up the bag and find half our breakfast missing. The best things in our order were the pastries: the almond croissant, cream puff, and pecan tart. The quiche was average and the chai was the worst I've ever had; it tasted like a ton of corn syrup and artificial Christmas cookie flavor fell into some hot water.
Amazing ice cream but they could go easy with the salt on the pretzel cone. The employees were wonderful and entertaining but I wish they were more knowledgeable with the ingredients.

Read the reviews and was pleased to say it exceeded the lofty expectations. Every donut is topped with a mountain of frosting and if loving that is wrong, I don't want to be right. I tried the maple bacon donut, M&M, and Orange Crush. The maple bacon was one of the best maple bacon donuts I have ever had, mainly due to the excellent maple frosting -not to sweet and not too "maple-y". The M&M donut was great. I ordered to Orange Crush mainly for the novelty but was impressed by the quality -it's like a Dreamsicle and was fantastic! Will definitely stop by when I am in Cleveland again.

I wish I could give Bouchon Bakery a better review, especially after our ecstatic meal at Bouchon the night before, but it sorta sucked. I like the cute little stand hidden away from everything else (just enter the Venetian and keep walking back and back from the casino floor), not a fan of the lack of seating (the food court is just upstairs and down a hallway a bit though). We had vanilla and pistachio macarons and some other small pastry. Macarons were hard on the outside and the filling was cloying- they'd been sitting for too long, perhaps? Big, which is nice, but ugh, CHEWY. Not a word I want with my lighter than air cookies. Two stars because I have hopes and I really did enjoy Bouchon. And the other pastries looked like they could be OK or even good.

I came for a get-together with a few friends and I enjoyed the quaint decor and presentation of the sweet treats. There is a surprising amount of seating for the size of the location. Street parking was readily available nearby. I did not have the best experience due to understaffing, there was only one individual working and she was having a difficult time keeping up with the orders. I was also not a fan of my hot chocolate, which as you can see in the photo was served in 3 containers. When I received it it was cold and the staff was unavailable for me to notify her. The icing on my cupcake was incredibly rich that it was difficult to eat the entire thing. The friends I was with had the same issue with the slices of cake that they ordered. I will be giving it another chance, hoping that my disappointment was just based on the understaffing.

Christina Tosi! Love the feel and the cuteness of this dessert stop. Amazing selection of cookies and cakes soft serves and milk shakes. It's a lovely place and there's now an Alice in wonderland themed dining area out in front of Milk Bar and eggslut, super cute picture opportunities! Pro tip: if you don't mind the price get Milk Bar dessert after dining at Momofuku next door - saves time standing in line! The line can get really long.
You my heart boo. Bring back the huckleberry before I ray rice in this beast. Fark yes ice cream all day alll dizay!

Not great - we went here because The PussyCat gelato place was closed (holiday). We had been to the PussyCat gelato place in Old Towne last night and it was amazing. Sorry Fatty Daddy's but your gelato is too sweet - like it's made from a pre-made mix. Toppings didn't help. The skimpy scoop was hollow inside.

OMG! This ice cream was ON POINT! Because I wasn't filled up from Fran's Filling station (see what I did there? corny, I know), I sought out a sweet treat elsewhere. I didn't realize this spot was bookmarked, but I'm glad it's not too far from where I reside. I ordered a brownie milkshake and it was GOOOOOODDD! It wasn't too sweet. It wasn't too milky. Everything tasted homemade. I was offered brownie pieces around the top of the cup. OMG! Wheretheydothatat?!!! Here! It was recommended I only get this if I'm not driving and I was; BUT I will be coming back for that. Someone's birthday is coming uuuuppp... guess what that means!!!! Yup! I'm coming right back to this spot. I don't care, I don't care, I don't care if there are other spots to try out there, I want this one.

It took me many years to get out to Scottsdale to taste the goodness of Sweet Republic and boy am I glad I did!! Delicious ice creams and a cool store!!! Loved the flavors and the fact that they are made in small batches. Writing this review has me wanting to drive 40 minutes to get me some Sweet Republic ice cream :)

The quality/price ratio is pretty low...e.g. $11 for a mini cheese cake 3.5" in diameter, or "genuine italian cannoli" made without fresh ricotta cheese. If you wanna get in you have to queue for almost an hour. There's limited seats and it's not nice to eat your pastries there, you'll have to get it to go...which makes it even more expensive, considering that it's essentially a to go place. The staff is friendly. Overall, you can find much better pastries for that price or even less.

This is quite possibly our FAVORITE dessert places! It's a cute walk up ice cream shop that is often busy because all of the ice cream is home made and to DIE for. The Blondie sundae is...perfect. Graham Central Station is a MUST and their four scoop sampler is probably one of the best values I have ever seen. Patrick, the owner is absolutely awesome really cares about taking care of his customers and it shows! Everything is made with quality ingredients that you can totally taste. It's a MUST STOP!

Growing up in the Valley we would go to Farrell's Ice Cream Parlor or the Sugar Bowl for our ice cream experience. As time went by, many of the old cream shops disappeared. Now many variations of them have been making a comeback. Churn is a regular stop for me and has been around for a few years now. It has made a list of one of the best ice cream spots in the U.S. It has a cool retro ice cream parlor vibe to it and usually always has a line out the door. One of the fun things I like to do it reminisce some of the candies that they have on display while waiting in line. Atomic Fireballs, Old Fashioned Taffy, Big League Chew, Good & Plenty and Astropops are just some of the candies I used to buy as a kid at the store. They have an extensive list of ice cream flavors that rotates in and out quite often. My personal favorites are the Butter Pecan and Vietnamese coffee. Nostalgic cookie sandwiches have also made a comeback and Churn offers a variety of cookies to choose from to make your sandwich. Sundaes include fun creations like the S'Mores and the Fat Elvis (PB and banana). They also have Lil' Freezies on hand (blended sundaes in a cup). Prices here are very reasonable and they open late for the after dinner crowd. They have extra seating in the back if you can't grab a table up front. Churn is located next door to Windsor (their Upward Projects sister restaurant) and down the street from Uptown Plaza.
Friendly, courteous service. The beingets I ordered were great! A little hard to find though since its behind escalators.
The best tiramisu I have ever eaten! Especially when paired with an espresso.

My wife (then fiancee) and I first found Sweet Republic through Phoenix Magazine... I took the day off for my birthday and we decided to hit up a buncha places on their best-of list... How little did we know what we were in store for. First off, everything here is made here, no funny business. From the cookies to the candy parts of the ice cream, the girls behind Sweet Republic WORK HARD to produce the best tasting ice cream I've ever had, not just in the valley but in my lifetime, and Bon Appetit magazine agrees! And speaking of the valley, they also keep everything local, so the ice cream not only tastes good, it feels good too. On to the ice cream: it's so, SO good. It's creamy, it's flavorful, it's delicious. They are always coming up with different flavors for both the ice creams and sorbets, and it seems like every time I visit there is something new to try out. There are some childhood favorites like rocky road, but there are fantastic originals like the salted butter caramel, the Mayan chocolate, the I love bacon (sssh... It's a secret. but candied bacon? in my ice cream? it's more likely than you think) and the PURPLE RAIN! There are also ice cream sandwiches, amazing shakes, terrific ice cream pies, and floats... the list goes on. There is real passion at play here, you can sense it... Do yourself a favor and try it out for yourself!

I was so excited to try Charlotte's first cereal bar and it's black owned so that's a win win . It is located in the downtown area and be prepared to find street parking or they do have a small garage right beside their location that I was able to snag a park at. I got the unicorns breath bowl. It is definitely for someone who has a super sweet tooth. I by the end of it was kinda overwhelmed by the sweetness, but there are frosted animal crackers and two or three other cereals in it so I can't knock the creation. They also have cereal milkshakes which is what I would get next time. You can also try some exotic cereals. In terms of setting there is a few outdoor tables the sitting inside is pretty limited though. I think this would be a fun experience for anyone especially people who have kids as well!

Oh my goodness!!!!! This is the best dessert place I have ever been too. So many options!! The service was superb and had so many recommendations for my first time there. Best part about it is , I work in the service industry/ hospitality and have been for the last 3 years and I KNOW how places get when people come in so close to closing time. My boyfriend and I came in 20-30 minutes before close and the staff was STILL so incredibly friendly and helpful. I would recommend this place to ANYONE! And pray they never close down.

I love their misugaru bingsoo and get them often but recently I noticed that their mochi has changed. It used to be the white ones and so chewy but now they are multicolored and hard and gross. Please change back to the original white mochi - that would be perfect!

Really good ice cream! I actually enjoyed the blue cheese and honey a lot. A little pricey, but all the ice cream is handmade and unique so I think it's worth it. Would definitely go back again! One of the better ice cream places out in Phoenix :-)
I recently went on a Bumble date here and it is the cutest first date location! Nothing too long and if it goes well you can hangout on the cute patio and chat for awhile! And the ice cream is unreal

Have to admit that as a HUGE fan of Cupcake Wars, I've been looking forward to eating cupcakes from here for a couple years. I was immensely disappointed. The flavor that they focus on in the show was not present. Sad. It just didn't meet up to my expectations.

I found Ninety's Ice Cream & Sandwiches through Pinterest. Pictures of their delicious looking milkshakes kept appearing and when I was passing through Charlotte on vacation I made sure we stopped there. I was not disappointed! SO GOOD. The menu is easy to understand and the employees are super helpful. I got the "Bottom of the Cereal Bowl" shake with fruity pebbles and it tasted exactly like fruity pebbles. It was incredible. My husband got the "Shabooya Brownie" shake and it was equally delicious. Some might say it's expensive for ice cream. I say it's 100% worth it.

Absolutely fantastic. Such an approachable vibe, the people are helpful & nice and the donuts are WORTH THE HYPE. I recommend their famous Big Poppa Tart - it has a poptart INSIDE it. Other notable ones: birthday cake with an Oreo inside, blueberry cheesecake, and red velvet. Price is very reasonable for a "gourmet" donut. Also, Chef Jeff is the best Truly the #bestdonutsintheworld !

I love having a Milk Bar outpost in Vegas. So much easier coming to this location than flying to NYC! It's pricey, but for something as unique as cereal milk soft serve, I don't really mind. On my most recent visit, I got the cornflake topping with my soft serve, and it added the perfect crunch. Plus, they add cereal to the bottom of the cup too so every bite had that crunch. We always stock up on cookies to thank my mom for dog sitting. They're individually wrapped and sealed so they travel well. The compost cookie is my first choice, and my mom loves it even though she's not a coffee drinker. If you like boozy shakes, this is a great place to check out. They had a couple specials featuring St. Germain and another that had Glenlivet 12 year.

What a SWEET place! My friends were raving about it and I have finally decided to try it out. This is the NoDa location!The place has so much character and the baked goods are just phenomenal! Can't wait to go back!

Amelie's is not for everyone. This place seems to always stay packed with Hipsters (with a capital H!), students, working professionals, older folks, and the most eccentrically adorned individuals you have ever witnessed. This is primarily due to its location in the North Davidson area (NoDa). The thing that keeps me coming back is the spinach soup. I never go wrong when I order it. The desserts are okay. I tried the sweet potato bread pudding and was not impressed. I think they make the mistake with it being to eggy. As a tip to the chef, leave out the egg white and only use the egg yolk. Also, I have never been served bread pudding without some kind of sweet sauce to be drizzled over it. Mine tasted rather dry and left much to be desired in the "sweet" department. Unfortunately, after my third bite, I begged one of the employees for some icing or agave. She directed me to the coffee bar and suggested honey. As outrageous as that sounds, the honey made it taste better, but definitely not a winner. The creme brulee is also okay. Perhaps a lot better than the bread pudding. I have enjoyed better, but I suppose the lower price coincides with the quality. Seating is alright, outlets are reasonable. The back of the building is quieter than the front which forever has a long line. I will say, the employees do their best to make sure you are not waiting too long though. I come back because it is a place to get work done and is open a whopping 24 hours. If my local Starbucks had the same hours, that is probably where you would find me all the time.
Best ice cream ever! My favorite is the Nutella. We visit Handels every time we are in Vegas.

I love it here! The service is always great and I really love the dairy-free sorbets. I have a dairy allergy but absolutely LOVE ice cream and have to get my fix with almond, cashew, or soy ice creams that I usually buy from the grocery store. Needless to say, the only thing that could use some improvement here is to add more dairy free options! Right now there are only about 3 choices for flavors on the menu, and if they added more dairy free options I would come here all the time!

This was a really good ice cream place with unique flavors. I had the Choco Walnut Oatmeal Cookie and the Brownie Swirl. Both had a great creamy texture with delicious flavor and a good amount of toppings mixed in. The ice cream was great, but the service leaves much to be desired. Luckily the ice cream brought all the happiness I needed so the lack of friendliness and service from the employees did not detract from my experience too much.

I wanted some good French baked goods and I was so disappointed. The croissant and the pain au chocolat had no crunch and honestly seemed like they were a day old. The coffee however was good but I don't recommend any of the baked goods there.

They have a really nice assortment of sweets. I got a birthday cake cupcake and a cinnamon roll cookie. The cupcake was very cute and had a nice flavor. The inside felt like it was slightly undercooked but still very yummy. Not too sweet. I didn't even eat the cookie because it was very doughy and just seemed like it wasn't cooked at all. The little cinnamon bun on the top was good. Again not too sweet.

Just awesome. There are two sizes of donuts. My wife and I each had a small donut, a peanut butter cup and a blueberry meyer lemon, and a large chocolate indulgence donut. She couldn't finish her half. The donuts and two small coffees cost $9 total, tax included. The donuts were all great and the price was far below Vegas standards. Will definitely visit again. Beware, they sell out so you may want to call or order online ahead of time.

Delicious! Creme Brulee was very good. A bit hard to eat due to the crusty top but it was really good. Pumpkin Cream Cheese was sweet but SO good. blueberry with Meyer Lemon was okay but bland compared to the other two. Friendly fast service. Great place!

Such a great selection of toppings, sauces, and fruit on top of really tasty frozen custard. I enjoyed the Coffee Chocolate Chip combo - partially because it was a quick and easy way to choose a perfect mix. Great prices, too.

Located in the Shanghai plaza. Prepare to circle for parking. This place had great stuff but has a steady flow of chaos. The setup is a grab and go, which is simple enough. However the line to pay is always backed up and bleeds into the area where you select your items. The savory items are a must try, especially the potato and curry. Tried lots of different breads, so it's too many to name. The one that stands out is the taro bread, egg tarts, and milk bun

Donuts. On. Steroids. I mean massive! Walked in on Tuesday morning around 11:50 with a friend with the understanding that all the good donuts would be picked over. Wasn't wrong about that one, except that they had what both of us came in for. I was shocked to here that they did sell out 70% or something like that of the flavors... I saw plenty to choose from. The employee helping us was warm and was happy to help us with our selections. I chose the birthday cake donut with sprinkles because, duh. But also because it was of normal donut size. My second choice would have been the homer but I had errands to run and didn't want to leave the donut in my car in warm weather. My friend chose a chocolate donut. The big kind and he got through half. I ordered a glass of milk while he ordered a coffee. In regards to my donut, I wasn't blown away. It isn't the best I've had because I've had really great, moist donuts that taste extremely fresh, but there's no reason I wouldn't return to Donut Bar for more donuts. It's the first donut shop I've tried since I've been out here so my next couple visits will be in comparison to Donut Bar. I do appreciate the uniqueness they bring to something so classic, I was told they had donuts with a pop tart inside. I got cavities just thinking about it, but innovative concept to say the least. Attractive frosting and designs but traditional as far as donuts are concerned. It was a fabulous day out, a cool off after a hot couple of days. We were happy to find we could sit outside where there is a communal patio of the neighboring shops. It's clean and inviting, likely bustling in the warmer weather. I appreciated the art work on the buildings as well. I had intended to eat my donut and go back in to order a couple for others. To our surprise in 20 minutes 90% of their stock we walked into had vanished. No they had not put them away, they sold them! I was told they sell out daily! I think there's benefits to showing up fashionably late around the time they close (1p) - you get a bargain! Selection is sparse though at that point - you've been warned. Shout out to the bathroom - Homer Simpson, Family Guy art, loved it! Also loved the merch though I didn't purchase. Street parking is readily available around the block and you are in super close proximity to Fremont Experience for you tourists. I'll be heading back to try new flavors!
Best ice cream in town! Great service and so many flavors to choose from. I never go anywhere else!!

as a previous resident of c-u, i have not found anything in anywhere to equal the custard at jarling's! they have heavenly vanilla, lemon, chocolate, and strawberry custard you can get in sudaes, cones, waffle baskets, or their version of a concrete. most custards - like ted drewe's in st. louis - have egg in them, giving them a heavier texture. my all-time favorite is a jarling custard cup chocolate almond crackle basket - that's vanilla custard in a waffle cup, topped with hard chocolate shell with almonds, whipped cream, & a cherry. next birthday don't bake - try a jarling's illini pie. or one of their other ice cream pies. i haven't found anything anywhere to beat that!

I feel like 85° could have went for a more spacious store. The layout seemed a bit odd and with the amount of people trying to grab pastries at once, it becomes a little too uncomfortable. I came in 7 pm on a Thursday and most of the displays were empty. There were also mostly repeats at this point, but I did snag the last Guava Cheese Strudel. It was just alright. The saving grace of my tray would be the Strawberry White Chocolate Bun though. I know I popped in on a whim, but all the egg tarts were already gone. Lesson learned. If you want something specific, set a plan and come in way earlier. The only things that were fully stocked were the cake displays where the cash registers are at. Even the line to pay snaked around to where customers were picking up pastries. I cannot imagine the utter insanity grand opening day was. I don't dig long lines and the craze for this place has not cooled down yet. It was nice to give it a go, but I'll hold out for a little while until all the minor issues get resolved.

I have 2 words when it comes to this bakery : TEA CAKES! I've been to this establishment plenty of times and decided to finally leave a review. If you have a sweet tooth, you will be in heaven once you walk through the doors and Feast your eyes on the display case of sweets . I've tried a number of different treats here but my fav are the almond tea cakes! They are light, buttery with a crunchy top filled with almonds , really addicting! Every time I go I buy the WHOLE tray of whatever they have left, along with their BLT on a croissant and a chai tea latte w/ whip cream. The BLT never disappoints, the croissant is flaky and light and the bacon is baked til crispy. The chai tea latte is better than Starbucks, savory and lightly sweet with a hint of cinnamon. This place is the perfect after "date" spot when you don't want to go home just yet

This place is off the chain! The ice cream stuffed doughnuts flavor is nothing short of amazing. There are many unique flavors and toppings to choose from, but forget the donuts we're here to go nuts!

We were in Vegas last weekend at the cosmo and I had researched this place before we got there because I had to try the crack pie and the cake. I was sick so my senses were not my friend so I will not rate the crack pie now named milk bar pie (I think) because I don't think it'll be fair. We ordered a 6 inch cake to bring home with us and their featured flavor was chocolate caramel pretzel and let me tell you, this cake is the f***ing bomb!! It's the perfect balance between salty and sweet and the little pretzel popcorn that comes on top of the cake are worth every damn calorie! The cake is chocolate with chocolate chips and it is super moist and in between is like a pretzel pudding with a thick but not chewy caramel. we went to the milk bar everyday while we were there. I also had the birthday cake truffles which were good but nothing beat that cake! I'm regretting the fact that I didn't bring more home! If you will be there soon I recommend you try the cake! You will not be disappointed.

Today I was transported to Paris and it was delicious. All matter of pastries from tarts, to pies to mini cakes, to cupcakes to macarons and all types of coffee and espresso. The decor transforms you to an eclectic Parisian cafe with mixed match tables and chairs and decor and lighting that makes this place easily a favorite. And did I mention that it's open 24 hours.

People think that the slogan "Cleveland Rocks" revolves around the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame? King James' Cavaliers? Nope. It's Presti's. Throughout C-town's roller coaster existence, the boom and bust from Mistake on the Lake to the Birthplace of Rock and Roll, one neighborhood has enjoyed prosperity: Little Italy, with great restaurants and monster good bakeries. The queen of the leavened, and now, I think, the only big one left, is Presti's. They've added sandwiches and remodeled a couple of times, but they've left the character of the place in-tact. More important, the baked goods are still AMAZING. Over three decades, they have been the saving grace of a bad trip to Cleveland Clinic; the point of discovery for my kids' college hunt summer trip a few years back; and a place of celebration for the youngest who capped off his discovery of how great Case Western Reserve University is with a macaroon and the most light delicious cloud-like tiramisu on the planet, over perfect espresso drinks. To locals, who probably think that such places are the norm, don't take it for granted! They should tag the building with an endangered species tag. Gone are the greats in New York, a few remain in Chicago, and a handful here and there. For the tourist, whether you came to see Elton John's outrageous outfits, a basketball or baseball championship run, or just enjoy watching your NFL team bash the bumbling Browns, you MUST ditch the diet for a day and make Presti's a destination.

Had REALLY HIGH expectations. We tried 4- Lemon Blueberry, Red Velvet (biggest seller), Strawberry and Chocolate Marsh-mellow. The Lemon Blueberry was very good and fresh tasting. Red Velvet was also good-had some subtle hints of oatmeal (or so I think) that gave it a nice aftertaste (in my opinion).The chocolate marshmallow was not good in my opinion. The strawberry one was ok- but Im not a huge strawberry fan in desserts (my best friend on the other hand loved it). Overall I think they all had the right amount of moisture but a little too much frosting so eating one all by itself is pretty hard (too sweet). Highly recommend a glass of water or milk if you plan to dig into one of these.

The frozen custard here is absolutely delicious! My two favorite flavors are the strawberry and orange. Compared to dessert places in the city, Jarling's prices are cheap. I would highly recommend anyone who visits Champaign to stop by here for at least one dip (one scoop). I have tried their snowstorms as well (strawberry custard as the base, with cheesecake mixed in), which is equally tasty. The portions are generous, so sharing shouldn't be a problem. ;]

They could use a line system. The ice cream was delicious! I had the mint avalanche or something like that ice cream. Not mint chip, the other mint ice cream. It had andes, thin mints and chocolate crushed into it, and it was very delicious! Perfect for a hot summer night.

As a big fan of green tea ice cream, this is a must place to check out. I like their cute design inside of the cafe. Their green tea ice cream is so good, not too sweet and very authentic. You can try before you order. Tried their signature matches parfait and it was so good. Each ingredient was all good and after you mix it, you can totally enjoy the mixed flavor of them. I also tried their hot matcha kinako latte and hojicha latte. Specially I like their hojicha latte as it is very unique roasted tea taste. The owner lady was very kind so she explained every question we asked. Definitely we will go back for caffeinated teas other than coffee!
Visited from Cali- it's the only boba place I went to in AZ and I miss it! Really wish they had one here too

I wish they had indoor seating to make this more of a place you can hang out, and I wish they offered smaller whole cakes so that I could come here for birthday cakes without spending $70, but I am giving Villani's a 5 star review because their desserts are simply incredible. My husband and I are obsessed with sweets and have been to every bakery in the city. We have never been so impressed with the taste of our desserts as we were with Villani's. I got the chocolate orange babka and hubs got the pistachio cheesecake. Normally I can't stand cheesecakes, but it was so fluffy and so tasty that I ended up eating half his slice. Plus, the cashier was incredibly nice and gave us good recommendations. Go. Go now.

Wow - thank god for Bruce Webber and co. for salvaging this incredible franchise. Jarlings has incredible frozen custard, and the snowstorms are just an upgraded, perfected ideation of the blizzard. They have seemingly endless additions to their custard, which include German chocolate, Kit Kats, cold fudge, peanut butter, etc. Flavor of the week adds variety throughout the year (and by the way, it's open ALL year). Their custard pies are also delicious and located to the right at the small waiting area. Always friendly service. Definitely a staple in Champaign.

Talk about cute!!!! First time at this place that came highly suggested as I'm addicted to ice cream. You're close to downtown so parking can be a little tricky just make sure to be alert and aware so you don't pass this gem up. With the Covid changes mask are required and we waited outside as they only allowed one group in at a time. The overall establishment is relatively small so these changes make sense to keep everyone safe. There were soooo many options so if this is your first time feel free to rely on the experts. The staff were amazing and walked me through some of their favorite dishes as well as combos they've seen other customers try. In the end I could not decide so I picked two. Ya I said it TWO. my ice cream commitment is strong. Super yummy and creamy I can't wait to try it again.
Such fun unique flavors and a true "local" ice cream vibe with outstanding decor and service. Try the coffee with chocolate chips! To die for...

My expectations were high after seeing all the beautiful Instagram photos of shakes, cookie dough pops and ice cream sandwiches. The presentation did not disappoint. Everyone walking out of the store had photo-worthy creations. I ordered the mint milkshake. While it was tasty, I didn't think it was worth the $6 + extra money I spent to get the cookies on the outside of the cup. I think my mistake was going for something safe like a milkshake. Next time, I would try one of the yum-ee buns or macaroon ice cream sandwiches. There is indoor and outdoor seating. You can also enjoy your ice cream down by the water. It's a great spot for date night. Go paddle boating and then stop in here for a treat! The staff was friendly. Even though the line was long, they were quick at getting people through the line to order. I would suggest having a menu face the direction of the door or have paper menus for people to look at while they are waiting in line. I was slightly annoyed at the wait time for the two milkshakes I ordered. The first one came out about fast after placing my order which was great! The second one didn't come out for about another 10 minutes. There were several people that ordered after us that received their milkshakes before we received the second one. If you're looking to get a lot of likes on your Instagram, order one of their photo-worthy creations!
Amazing ice cream and amazing owners. I really enjoy going here and I don't even like ice cream.

Our stay at The Venetian included a breakfast for two each day and we dined at Bouchon on the 10th floor. The restaurant itself is a lovely bistro setting and the staff was attentive. The food was good if not limited by the promotion (3 choices, which never changed during our stay). My eggs and potatoes were consistently Over-salted and not always hot. If not for the promotion I would probably give it a try and explore more of the menu.

On the Friday before Mother's Day I visited Sinful Sweets and bought a large box of assorted chocolate for my mother. As she was eating some of the chocolate last evening she took a bite and noticed there was a long HAIR in one of the pieces. The hair was not on top of the chocolate but actually embedded IN the piece meaning it had to have come there during the cooking process. I stopped by the store and spoke with the what seemed the owner/manager, very privately to avoid having customers overhear, and to my surprise he did not even offer a refund nor try to do anything else someone in his position would be expected to do in this sort of situation. So of course here I am on the bullhorn, to hopefully warn at least some people about the customer service, and more importantly lack of hygiene at Sinful Sweets.

I wanted ice cream for lunch while passing through AZ and 111 degrees by noon. Phoenix was the next town so I laid my money and time down on finding The Melt. I passed by a place that looked like a bar or restaurant but figured maybe The Melt was inside? Anyway, it was a bit confusing to enter a bar type atmosphere at noon thinking "ice cream parlor...?" but forged forward towards the counter and there was a small ice cream case with nirvana inside. The flavors were fascinating and I settled upon Thai tea and fig/mascarpone and it was served in a take out Chinese carton with a fortune cookie on top! Fun and yes folks worth getting off the highway for! A nice gal named either Erica or Tanya (I am old and my memory is like a sieve) was quite helpful and cheery which of course was what you want when ordering ice cream. The price was a bit high for my liking (just under $8) but it really was good. So go bougie or go home when it comes to these more gourmet experiences. Hats off to you which is what happened to me next as I headed down this great street full of cool shops. I literally bought a hat. I hope you have as much flavor and shopping fun as I did by stopping in to cool off at The Melt.
Flew all the way from Las Vegas to Champaign for the Cononut Choc Almond ice cream. Just too good... I'll be back!

I'm from the Bay Area and my parents just moved to the area. This place popped up and all the drinks and ice cream desserts looked so good! I ordered the Strawberry Matcha Latte and my boyfriend ordered the Butterfly Rose Lemonade. It was pretty packed on a Sunday Night at 7 pm. The staff was very friendly. This place is so cute! Modern and Chic Decor. Definitely a lot of photo ops lol The Strawberry Matcha Latte was delicious and aesthetically pleasing. It tasted just as good and identical as Boba Guys back home. I tried my boyfriends Butterfly Rose Lemonade and it was very refreshing as well. I'm not a fan of Rose flavored items but the Lemonade definitely overpowered the hint of Rose. I'd definitely come back. Everything just looks so appetizing and pretty.

Please please please just ship me one of your red velvet cupcakes when you go to Vegas you have to stop by the Venetian and check this place out. Whoever comes up with some of the pastries, cookies, macaroons, and cupcakes needs like everything at their leisure as long as they keep making the red velvet cupcakes that good lol.

Over sized, over priced and under whelmed. It's donuts. No matter what you do on top of a donut you'd better have a good recipe for the donut to start. Not here.. typical Vegas, inferior starting place topped with everything else and over charged. Couldn't get a simple iced mocha right either. Don't bother.

I hadn't been in before and they graciously answered my questions about what is in the case. The salted Carmel brownie deserves an applause as well as the chocolate eclair. The atmosphere is nice and they keep the line moving. The bathrooms are clean and the art is nice. Headed back!

I've had the opportunity to know this brand and have had their Ice Cream samples at Food Festivals I've attended. The place is cute and bright, very fun looking atmosphere. One person taking orders, filling orders and checking out orders. Quit a line was forming. As we waited, we looked over the flavors offered. Fortunately as we waited, another employee came out and took my order. The young man was very nice. My friend and I shared a 2 scoop cup with Salted Butter Carmel and Brownie Swirl. The ice cream tasted heavenly, sweet and creamy. My only thoughts are, I wished they had more traditional flavors. I would definitely be back to try the ice cream sundae and milk shakes. Atmosphere: bright and fun looking. Service: good. Ice Cream: excellent

Great, great, great!!! First time visiting this place & was very impressed! We had the melt (donut) stuffed with half Bourbon Carmel Toffee Crunch & half Fat Elvis.....Super DELICIOUS!! We will definitely come back again!!
got birthday snacks for my classroom celebration here every grade 1-11! gotta love the family owned place in the heart of clveland's little italy!

I had always wanted to stop by here and I'm so glad I was finally able to! Needed a morning coffee and little nosh before embarking on a day of Vegas, and this Bouchon was located right at the base of the Venetian elevators so I could pass it up. Coffee was good- strong! Ordered the chocolate croissant and cheese danish to share with my boyfriend. The chocolate croissant was fresh and flaky, but OH MAN that cheese danish was just somethin else! So buttery and flaky with a perfectly creamy and sweet cheese filling- I'm drooling just typing this!! Really worth trying and honestly the baked goods are EXTREMELY reasonably priced for such a famous Vegas bakery!

Ice cream flavors are unique and traditional. I have purchased her cookbooks to make the ice cream at home and recipes taste similar to the original. The only disadvantage is there is no convenient public restroom on site.
