I have to say we loved them but we especially loved the lemon, carrot, and the banana cupcakes. The banana cupcake was packed with natural banana and tasted a lot like a moist banana bread which I loved. The lemon was fresh and refreshing flavor not bitter or sour just the perfect balance of lemon and sweet. And the carrot was amazing with bits of carrot in the cake. What I love is you can tell they are putting love in the cupcakes and using real ingredients and not just flavoring. The ambience inside is bright and inviting that draws people in off the promenade. They also have a cupcake ATM which allows customers to not even have to go inside and can in fact receive a cupcake at any hour. The ATM offers the staple flavor like chocolate, vanilla and a few other options, but if you want the flavor of the day you do seem to have to go inside. The staff here is wonderful and helpful. The only reason I didn't give Sprinkles 5 stars is simply due to they are a little expensive for a cupcake. We bought our cupcakes in twos and spent $7-8 making each cupcake between $3-4 which to me is a little expensive but given the quality and the location I was willing to pay that. But it is not a place I would be able to go to all the time due to this. But for a nice treat here and there this is a must.

I adore Milk and all things Christina Tosi, this location at the Cosmopolitan is crucial, the wait time is super short (especially in contrast to their Village locations), if only they had volcanos, it would be perfect. PS: serve volcanos.
Good lord this place is simply heaven. I will stop at every Mitchell's I ever see no questions asked.

I stopped by their stand in the West Side Market for a cupcake, and later came here to get popcorn and buckeyes. The cupcake was amazing--key lime. I'm not usually a fan of dense cupcakes, but this one was moist and tasted great. The frosting was sweet but a little tangy. The popcorn (I tried fruity and got dichotomy) was soooo good. The buckeyes were just so so in my book. (My sister makes better ones!) Overall, definitely worth a stop. :)
The best ice cream. Parking situation is a little rough because of location near west side market. But definitely worth it. Fast paced line, lots of options, and plenty of seating.
Wonderful Custard! Customize your own "snowstorm" or soft serve. Usually pretty busy and parking sucks.

We had Melt on our list to try for a long time.. so long that by the time we decided to try it they had moved from their actual storefront and now have a stand in front of a coffee shop. Hey, rent can be rough, I get that. We still wanted to try the product! I will say, from the pictures of the previous place the flavor selection is far more limited. You can get a single or double scoop and that's really about it. They had some ring pops and candy cigarettes too. The girl working was super nice and took care of us quickly. We tried the peanut butter pretzel and the captain crunch berries. Both had decent flavor but the pretzel chunks and cereal chunks are naturally soggy once in the ice cream and I would have rather just had the flavor without the soggy bits. The consistency was okay. Sadly I don't know that we would return although our flavors were fine. It is sad that they have to just be a cart on the street now instead of what looked like a cool set up before. Perhaps they will find a more permanent location again in the future?

I'll start off this review by saying this place needs to make some adjustments to their staff. I was just in here with my boyfriend and little sister and we were looking at all of the flavors trying to decide what to get (mind you we had only been in here for a few minutes at this point) so I told the man behind us in line that he could go in front of us because we weren't ready yet. The man started to place his order and the staff member (CASEY was his name) said to the man "wow thank you for knowing what you want and not taking a long time, greatly appreciated" in a very sarcastic tone. Clearly Casey was referring to us for taking a few minutes to choose a flavor. If that bothers him so much, he should probably find another place to work because we will not be coming back here.
Great desert! Chi Tea latte was amazing!!!

I'm swooning for the ice cream flights and ice cream filled donuts at this little gem in downtown Phoenix. Brandon, who co-owns NIC with his wife, instantly made anyone that came through the door feel welcome as he dished up hand turned ice cream with half a dozen fun toppings, many of which are playfully named after TV shows. As if that's not enough excitement, I've been told their locally sourced donuts were named one of the 50 best donuts in America and the best donut in Arizona.
I love Mitchell's. The taste is always a consistent high quality. Flavors are delicious

I don't think you understand how excited I am that Vegan Doughnuts finally has it's own place! I first tried their donuts at Night Market a few years ago and since then have sought them out at Night Market, at the Cleveland Flea, pretty much anywhere they popped up. I've tried several of their donuts but my favorite out of all those is, and always will be, the lemon lavender one. If you haven't had it yet, wait no further and go get one. My family hadn't had them before so I picked up two lemon lavender, a Boston cream, a cookie dough, a cookies & cream and a s'mores one. The interior of this place is cute and they're currently open Friday-Sunday during specific hours (checking their Facebook page is your best bet). They have a few standard flavors and then a few they rotate (their Facebook page is your friend to see what they're offering that day). $3 for a donut might seem a bit much but considering the quality, the size and the density (not too dense but you won't want more than one...MAYBE two if it's that sort of day...), it's worth it. I'm excited to come back and try the flavors I haven't had yet!
So good and great service. So cute and aesthetic inside! Great place to find in a cute location!

Today, I had the honor of trying the macarons--chocolate and vanilla!! First bite of vanilla: chewy and SWEET! Second bite of vanilla: mmmm! the outside is crispy and the amount of almond in it is just right. Third bite of vanilla: i guess the buttercream is a little too much for me. Onto the chocolate ... LOVE IT! Definitely not over-the-top sweet like the vanilla flavor.
Great ice cream, reasonable prices, and really helpful staff! Even the vegan flavors were great and I don't do vegan. They're also really generous with samples.

Completely a fan of this place!!! Everyone is complaining about the wait but we got in and out in less than 10 minutes and we went on a wednesday afternoon!!! For sure worth the wait! The lobster tails are mind blowing!! Cannolis delicious and the cupcakes YUM!!! I would for sure go back and I had been waiting awhile to try some of the cake boss goodies and it turned out to be everything I expected and more! Stop with the bad reviews about the wait because on the show there is always a wait as well!!!

I had a creamy goodness overdose! I visited from out of town and my friends really hyped this place up. I was a bit skeptical but they lived up to the hype and then some. I'd have never heard of a 24hr bakery but after trying a few items I understand why. I typically want a greasy burger after a 2am bar night but this place wold give a greasy burger a run for my money. we went all out and spend $70 on creamy goodness. I personally tried about 5 different mini-tarts, a napoleon, a salted brownie (sounded gross but tasted great) and some Tiramisu Creme Brule. This place but 3 pounds on me over the weekend. This place is serious business! Bring your taste buds and leave your diet at home.

I bought a little of most things to bring back to my friend in LA, where we have few good Italian bakeries, and none that I have been to are even half as good as Presti's! I liked everything I got: cannoli, the white cookies with sprinkled, the jam cookies, some cookies with nuts, the cinnamon star sugar cookies, EVERYTHING.

Love the breakfast sandwich with egg, spinach, mushrooms, and cheese! Of course you can't go wrong with any of the pastries, I personally love the fruit tarts. In the summer, the passion fruit lemonade is amazing!

Wasn't expecting this famous bakery to be selling prepackaged cookies and truffles that are no better than your local super market. We were expecting fresh desserts and were given food in wrappers. Not cool...

While planning our trip to AZ, we had to decide on an ice cream shop to go make piggies of ourseves and thanks to Yelp, this was the place! I have to say that their ice cream ranks up there as some of the very best I've had. That's it. Ditto to the other Yelpers who give them 5 stars...

Milk tea had a familiar, proper black milk tea flavor but it was too sugary. Crepes held together, matcha ice cream and red bean had good flavor. Could use more red bean paste in the crepe. Crepe batter was basic but tasty. Service was good and there were a couple tables to sit down at. I would come back for their crepes and try the milk tea at half sugar.

Smaller than the 85 C I'm used to but honestly had a very great selection! There were actually a couple items that I hadn't seen before. Line can be kinda long depending on when you go and I wish they could somehow space the bread display things more effectively so everyone isn't back to back. One of the people I was with had never had it before so we obviously had to get some of my favorites like the Boroh Bun (aka Pineapple Bun) aka a sweet fluffy normal bun topped a cookie like crust that's shaped like a pineapple with the criss crosses. The one filled with cream is also very good. I also like the milk custard bun with the heart on it! The egg tarts are also very good here.
Crack pie lives up to the hype. I didn't try anything else - but the name is fitting. It's amazing.

I know donuts, by god if there's one thing I've accomplished in this world it's a palette for donuts... VooDoo, Dynamo, Bob's (SF) Blue Star & Donut Friend, I've conquered them all & I have to say this place is comfortably in the same stratosphere of its brethren. I hate the word Artisanal especially when it comes to donuts, but this place is pretty fancy as it comes to ingredients and style of donuts. Stump town coffee & yummy selections such as Nuttella donut with chopped hazelnuts on top. Maple bacon bar, the Homer for those of you that remember the Michael Jackson Simpsons episode! We paid $27 for 2 coffees, 1 bottle water & 7 fancy kine doughnuts! Yes, winchells or Krispy Kreme is like $6-8 for a dozen, but why do you hate yourself? Pay up and treat yourself!

This place has the best ice cream that I can find the area. The sitting area and decor were great, is nice and comfortable for some ice cream, snacks, or drinks. I love their ice cream favorites, the default Matcha, Hojicha, and Vanilla. However, the best part is their seasonal favorite, so far they had Sesame, Ube, Mango, Rose, and Thai Tea, each tasted so different and give me something to look forward to each time, I can't wait to see what they will have next, I don't mind if they have Ube all the time.

WoW Excellent ice cream. Chocolate chip mint. Rich & Delicious. My new ice cream place. Way better then the more popular place. And a better price too. The scoops are way bigger here too. A single scoop is like 2 scoops. Try it you'll love it. I promise....
Delicious! Love everything I've ever eaten there! I have ordered for holidays and it's always good. Stollen this Christmas was much enjoyed!

While I'd like to think I'm pretty good at bringing back souvenirs and snacks from my travels, that's definitely not the case when it comes to my trips to Vegas. Perhaps it's because I seem to be there so often, but it never crosses my mind to bring stuff back. Not that there are a ton of good choices anyways - a Fat Tuesday yard stick/cup? Some cheesy t-shirt? A WIFE?! HA. Thank goodness for Milk Bar and all of their cookies! As you could imagine for obvious reasons, this Milk Bar is just SLIGHTLY different than the original one in NY; the second floor of Cosmo versus a tiny shop in the East Village? Yeah, that's different. However, despite being set in very different places, they're essentially the same in the most important way of all - their goodies! Whether it's their cookies, shakes (both regular and boozy), cakes, soft serve, or their famed Crack Pies, you're bound to find something for your sweet tooth! The first time I stopped by Milk Bar, it was strictly to pick up some of their cookies that I found oh so tasty when I had them in NY. The range of choices seemed to be about the same (Confetti, Blueberry & Cream, Corn, Cornflake Chocolate Chip Marshmallow, Chocolate-Chocolate, and their famous Compost cookie), but, more importantly, they tasted just as good. Of the bunch, the Cornflake Chocolate Chip Marshmallow and Compost cookies were my favorites - SO DELICIOUS! Along with getting more of their cookies, I also decided to try their GRASSHOPPER MILKSHAKE the last time I stopped by here. It had never been high on my list of things to get here, but my friend couldn't stop raving about the one he tried (which says something). While I can't say how mine compared to his, I thought my shake was pretty solid. The flavor could've been a little richer, but I liked the texture (not super thick or thin), how great the minty chocolate flavor was, and that it wasn't overly sweet. Even though it lacks the coziness and charm of their original NY spot, I can't say that there's really anything bad about this particular location. In fact, with how well their cookies keep, stopping off here before flying out of Vegas is practically a must! Which hopefully leads to getting a slice of their Crack Pie...or finally trying their Cereal Milk soft serve! Such a fail on my part for still not trying them yet...
I love the Roast beef and manchego croissant! I had it with the crab corn soup and wish I could have ate it 2X.

A classic example of a great Italian bakery that happens to serve very good food too. We stopped by for lunch and it was busy - always a good sign! I got the Italian sandwich which was terrific. Super fresh roll made it delicious. Came with a tremendous homemade coleslaw. Other members of our party had chicken parm sandwich ("good not great"), meatball sandwich, chicken salad and pesto tortalini. Chocolate cannoli was also really good. Very reasonably priced, with drinks came to around $34.
Every time that I've came here it has been a great experience! The workers are wonderful and friendly, and the icecream is delicious!!

Got the cereal milk soft serve with the frosted flakes. I found the frosted flakes too salty and the cereal milk was not sweet enough to balance it out. I was not a big fan of it, and thought that this was very overpriced.

Really great neighborhood ice cream shop! So happy to support a female-owned business, especially with such delicious waffle cones. Very cute shop and the scooper gave me generous portions. The waffle cones pieces are fantastic, such a delicious caramel-y brown butter flavor. Definitely check this place out if you live in Madiso
OMG so good. My friend and I actually begged my mom to pick up danishes for us! I would eat here every morning (and not regret the 20 lbs I'd gain) if I lived in Vegas.

This place is perfect if you love working on your homework, laptop, reading a book, or hanging out with your friends till 6am drinking coffee and eating deliciously hand crafted patties and goodies! It's my favorite hang out spot to get work done and relax. I'd live here if I could. The food is pretty darn awesome too!

Come early in the day if you want more flavor options. We came around 9pm and most of flavors were sold out. Obviously I came for the cute ass Chinese food takeaway box and bomb ice cream! but the girl working the register was in a terrible mood and killed my ice cream buzz

Milk Bar is located inside of the Cosmopolitan in Vegas and is found and owned by Chef Christina Tosi. Milk Bar is located on the 2nd floor of the casino and is next to Momofuku. Milk Bar is not a sit down place. There is a bench on the side, but not a full on table and seating area. There is a menu above the registers and you order, pay, and pick up your food to go eat elsewhere. There's a lot of seating on the actual floor so seating shouldn't be a problem. Depending on the time of day, Milk Bar can get crazy busy with a long line. My bf and I lucked out and showed up at a right time just because there was not a long line and after we ordered, the line grew super long. Milk Bar is more of a dessert place so don't come by thinking you can order a full on meal. Milk Bar offers coffee/espresso drinks, cookies, cakes, soft serve, milkshakes, pies, and yogurt cups. The only gluten-free and dairy-free items that they have are the Life cookies ($4.25 each) and the Life Brekkie Cups ($6.25 each). This is pretty expensive for such small portions, but then again it is Vegas. I did not think that these items were worth the price. They honestly tasted just like regular cookies and yogurt cups that you can get anywhere. The fancy shakes ($12) contain alcohol. My bf ordered the Chocolate Malt Cake Fancy Shake which comes with vodka and kahlua. He enjoyed the alcohol, but thought the drink was overall too sweet. I completely glutened myself and tried the Cereal Milk milk shake ($7.50) just because of all of the great reviews. This milk shake literally tasted like cereal milk, but for some strange reason tasted really good as a milk shake and I can see how it can be quite addicting. Overall, the staff was knowledgeable, quick, and friendly. The only thing that stood out for me was the cereal milk which I don't think I have seen this anywhere before, but other than that, the other items on the menu are pretty basic. I think Milk Bar is overpriced for the basic items that they sell.
Ice cream is always tasty. The staff is always the best. I'd go there anyday...right in the neighborhood. High quality product

Charming little ice cream parlor. Old style decor and vintage toys in the front of store (fun to browse). Very affordable place to take the kids for a quick treat! Not as many ice cream flavors as I might like, but the options are good for a smaller selection. The back patio is a nice little retreat to enjoy your cone. Plenty of misting and umbrella shade for summer time comfort.

Finally got a chance to check this place out today and was pleasantly surprised at how yummy my mini fat daddy was ;) And the 2 gentlemen working were very friendly. I will definitely be back returning!

I wanted to love this place but it was just okay. The ambiance is super cute; I really loved the decorations and how there were so many rooms and nooks to hang out and enjoy your drinks and food or study. I ordered the pan perdu, a lemonade, and macarons. The pan perdu and lemonade were good but I was really disappointed with the macarons. You couldn't really tell what flavor they were (except for the coffee one, which I enjoyed). I've had macarons at a lot of different bakeries and these were pretty underwhelming. They were inconsistent also, as some had a higher rise in the cookie and others didn't have "feet." I do appreciate this cafe opening 24/7, 365 a year and that they have seasonal menus (though they may not be serving everything listed on the menu, as I found out!).
My absolute favorite coffee donut spot in the valley. Always fresh and delicious. Fabulous variety.

Loved the interior design of the place. Very cute. Not a fan of the limited parking space. I actually went here to try it out after getting some pizza at Federal's, which is right across the street. Ice cream was pretty tasty, not incredible. Really friendly and helpful service. I would recommend coming and trying this place for yourself.

Omgosh...the staff was so friendly! It was nice to see how much of Park & Recreation Fans they were..Leslie Knope Ice Cream! Tried about 5 of their homemade flavored ice cream and each were so yummy. It was in a fun corner alongside a coffee/bar, hair salon, and tattoo place. Yup, but the place had a pretty cool outdoor hangout with lights. Come try!

This place is awesome, and I wish there were more like it in Charlotte. Everything I've had here is delicious and you should be able to find something to suit any craving. The only downside is it's always packed because people camp out here all day with their laptops. The decor is whimsical and fun, and it makes for a fun after dinner or middle-of-the-night outing.

I come here to get my dark chocolate ice cream!! they have some serious competition with Godiva. The staff here is super friendly. I love how they give out samples and are willing to help you find what your little heart desires. I always come here whenever I am in the area.

I was very excited to try these donuts. I finally made time to go to this donut shop on my day off. I purchased 4 donuts & was given an additional 4 donuts for free. The customer service was good, but the donuts were not. I was sadly disappointed in these donuts. I will most likely choose another place to buy donuts whenever I get a craving.

When Im asked, what would you last meal on earth be? I respond with whatever restaurant Im feeling, and ice cream from Handels. Im thankful its 60 miles from my home, or I would become a spouse like a house (one of their cleverly named flavors!). I flip out over the flavors they come up with, yesterday I tried pumpkin pecan, and cinnamon roll. Both divine. My go to, banana cream pie, chocolate cake batter, often times they have blueberry cobbler which is amazing, and sometimes I go with a seasonal. This ice cream is, hands down, the best ice cream I have ever eaten. Note, I just saw a sign that they now have lactose free ice cream made with almond milk!!

Located in Shanghai Plaza with a lot of other Asian businesses and eateries. If you like carbs, you'll like this place. I had to summon all my restraint and willpower to not try one of everything. Everything looks delicious behind those glass display containers (and it is as I write this review and eat em!) they serve coffee, tea, and boba, so it's a convenient 1-stop shop for snacking.

Large italian bakery cleveland little italy Went on a Sunday 1130 am..busy as you would expect... but within 5 minutes got my coffee and tiramisu... great choice for brunch! Yum very good plenty of seating .... Great choice for a destination on a Sunday morning I'm sure there are times when lines are out the door? Maybe particularly when it isn't winter and cold! Recommend!
Very popular spot to get your goodies. Service is a little slow but the cannolis are amazing . Next time I'll have to try the cakes.

This is hands down one of the best icecream shops in Pittsburgh. I tried the Yinzer Sundae last summer and thought about it the entire year, waiting for the new season. There's almost always a line but Page's is always staffed very well that the line goes quick. Something about this place puts everyone in a good mood. Never a bad experience!
The shakes look better than they taste. Very disappointing for a $8 milkshake. I got the Cinnamon Toast Crunch milkshake and it literally tasted like melted ice cream. Never again.

Let me just tell you this place ROCKS! Every single thing I ordered was incredible!!! They have perfected every offering, which is very very rare... most bakeries have their go to that they are known for; not this place. Everything is amazing from the pastries to the cheese bread to the chorizo bread is unbelievable! Take it from someone that travels alot searching for the best foods to make my tastebuds sing Don't question it; just go and try it omg soo delicious! I drive an hour from Rockford with two others just to load up and bring back the goods! You guys killed it here! Love it!

I came here because I am a dessert whore and to see what the hype was about. Yes, it's convenient to rely on others' reviews, but I wanted to experience it personally. What the hell, I was there anyways. Luckily, there was no major line when I walked up. There were so many sweets to choose from. After scanning the display cases, something caught my eye... The Mini Tiramisu!!! There were ladyfingers surrounding the entire tiramisu! Although feeling still a bit skeptical, I knew I was going to regret if I were to walk away from it. After paying, I went up to the room to indulge in this still-questionable delight. As I stuck my fork into it, I was pleasantly surprised. The ladyfingers were uber soft!!! I gingerly but carefully forked all the way down to the bottom of the tiramisu and gave the first bite to my girlfriend. Her big eyes went bug eyes! She promised I will LOVE this tiramisu. After giving my husband a bite, he approved of it also. Now, it was my turn to taste this piece of heaven. OMG it was love at first bite! I started squirming screeching from delight! This was the best tiramisu I've ever had! It was made just the way I like it--very soft ladyfingers and a completely soaked bottom with a not-too-overpowering sweetness all around. I was completely sweetly, madly and deeply hypnotized by this too-good-to-be-true tiramisu. Yes, Buddy surely knows desserts! Now I fully know and acknowledge his amazing creations! It's not just a hype, it's an eye-rolling orgasmic explosion in your mouth! Seconds??? YES PLEASE!!!

Fabulous amazing splendid incredible!! I don't know if I love Nicole or hate her for turning me on to this place! I had a PB & J bar, out of this world. My very picky husband had a Boston cream bar and couldn't stop talking about it. The owners Jeff & Joe are sincere men who rely care about the products they are serving. I wish them a long life here in Las Vegas.

Not a Sunday goes by where I don't have coffee at Amelie's French Bakery with my friends. They have the best desserts in Charlotte, so many coffee choices, fresh food, and one of the best atmospheres you'll ever experience. I highly recommend the Le Sombre Chai and a fruit and yogurt parfait with homemade granola! The salted caramel brownie is to die for! The girls and I love grabbing wine and macarons on Thursday nights.

I posted my Yelp review and the owner almost immediately messaged me back. She was very apologetic and even offered gift certificates to come back and try again. When they got returned in the mail, she messaged me again. I am definitely impressed with effort she put in to this. She is obviously a concerned and involved owner. I like to Yelp places and rarely does an owner respond. With that being said, I added another star. Give it try, you might like it

Churn is somewhere you have to go to if you're in Phoenix. The ice cream flavored are all good, my favorites being the Vietnamese coffee, toasted coconut, and the stout (which sounds weird to have a beer ice cream, but it's great). I have been here several times over and will be coming here many more times in the future. As part of the upward projects, its location is conveniently connected to a few different food places and makes for the perfect after-dinner stop. Go to churn, NOW!!

Disappointed with the safety measures. No markings for line control and spacing. With no markings on floor, people are invading my space and is standing too close to me! The help appeared caotic, and did not make any sense! Manager should step in and have some common sense and instruction of the workers taking orders, bagging items, and cashier. The lobster tail is my favorite although a little smaller than usual. Very disappointed w the quality and quantity of work. Do better Carlo!

Overpriced desserts? Check. Celebrity Chef? Check. Popular hotel? Check. But you have to try it right? I ordered a chocolate cereal milkshake. When I saw her put in the fudge and milk, I was like "I hope this $9 shake has something unique" She then put in the soft serve and blended it. Solid shake, definitely tasted like cocoa puffs. A little on the small side, but was delicious.

Went here twice in one week! I lived in Ohio for four years before moving to Las Vegas and never tried this place out! On my first visit I tried the four scoop sampler with Bananas Foster, Blueberry Cobbler, Graham Central Station and Blue Moon. They were all delicious but Graham Central Station was my absolute favorite. It's unique and you can taste the graham crackers/cinnamon as well as the fun toffee texture and crunch. Blueberry cobbler is always delicious with a creamy texture pairing well with sweet blueberry flavor. Blue Moon is hard to find anywhere else in Vegas and is a nice raspberry flavor in a vibrant blue for the summer though not my cup of tea. I could taste the rum in the Bananas Foster which was tasty but not my personal fave. During my second visit I tried the banana cream pie... every bite tasted of real banana as well as the perfect amount of pie crust. It's hard to pick a favorite but for now I'd say Graham Central Station and Banana Cream Pie are tied. I'll have to come back to discover more favorites and expand my ice cream palate!!

This was our first visit. We had some pastries and ' cafe capuchoin' . They were pretty decent. Nice place to catch up with freinds. There were many people with their laptops, kinda like starbucks environment. It is decorated with vintage stuff. Will definitely comeback!

We tried this place out after finding it in yelp. I will definitely be back. I was pleased with the great customer service and overall atmosphere. I had the butter pecan and it was great. I would recommend stopping by.

I come here for their vegan red velvet cupcakes and chocolate chip cookies. Both are egg-free, which is a rare find in commercial bakeries like this. If the wait to get inside is too long, or you're standing in line for In-N-Out and need a sweet treat immediately, there's a cupcake ATM around the corner!
Batch is hands down my favorite bakery in Madison. I LOVE their cinnamon rolls and their Buttermilk Batch loaf is insanely good. Worth the wait - even in the rain! A Madison must.
The milkshake was delicious and the customer service was awesome! Very friendly group in there and explained all the items for us newbies.

On a hot summer day, Jeni's is the best place to be! We were walking around waiting for a restaurant to open (re opened at 5:000pm) and I stumbled upon Jeni's! From the outside the building is super bright and inviting! When we went in and even from outside it smelled amazing! They make their own waffle cones in house and the flavors of ice cream are so original! The decor inside gives you a fun and light environment and the employees are very helpful in flavor selection! The sample spoons are super cute too! We ended up getting a flight to share, which was three mini scoops and a waffle wedge. We got the wild berry lavender, gooey butter cake, and the strawberry buttermilk. My favorite out of the three was the gooey butter cake! It was SO GOOD! I absolutely loved it. Please do yourself a favor and get here and try as many flavors as you can. Yum!
Tasty but need more gluten-free options. Staff is pleasant and all pastry looks amazing.

The treats are tasty and its an obvious place to schedule a meetup if you're in the area. BUT, its often packed and the take a number system can be confusing. People don't realize they need one, then don't hear their number called when they do have one, and, when its me, I'm totally unprepared when my number gets called... I'm stuck staring at the huge display case of goodies thinking I should have browsed the selection first then pulled a #. Sorry vegans, we weren't able to find anything vegan on our most recent trip.

Mitchell's is one of the Greater Cleveland area's greatest staples, and they have a flavor for everyone. Mitchell's is not only delicious, but offers ice cream made with the BEST ingredients, all locally sourced and high quality. They pay their workers a fair wage & those workers are always positive with smiling faces! They are always gracious when I forget to ask for whipped cream (the best whipped cream, btw). And they offer pints and quarts in the store to take home & enjoy on the couch! They also offer water out on the counter for people to self-serve which is SO great...Mitchell's keeps me coming back for more, at least once a week.

Dropped by on Sunday morning just as they opened...was afraid that they wouldn't have all the variety but they certainly did!!! The apple pie cake donut was really good. The cinnamon toast wasn't a soft and chewy consistency as I liked nor expected, but the coffee cream filling was amazing with just the right amount of sweetness. The salted caramel kinda just tasted like a maple bar on a cake donut. They need to label their donuts for the ease of the both the employees and customers though!

I've cream is my down fall, I can never get enough of it, Lol.... Mitchell's has a newer store is Westlake Ohio, awesome place. You can sample the many different varieties of ice cream they have, your taste buds usually sample 2, while your eyes sample the selection of different flavors of ice cream in front of you. Many to choose from! On several occasions even during the holidays we get the black raspberry cake! Yes they make some pretty awesome cakes too! We have tried only a few of the other cake's all just as good! I definitely give them 5 Star's doesn't matter if I'm at South Park mall in Strongsville, or there store by the square, or rocky river store! I give them 5 star's! Thanks Mitchell's!

Very good, quality doughnuts and friendly, patient staff while you decide on the numerous options. I really enjoyed their strawberry split. I went on an early morning Saturday about ten mins before opening and of course there is already a line forming! I've also had their blood orange at First Fridays which was yummy too!
This was my first time at this place. I decided to try the banana putting ice cream and a donut sandwich. the ice cream was great but the donut was not good at all.
Vegan donuts - nuff said! Nice little are out back to sit and nosh.

Service was good. The staff is very friendly. I had a cereal shake, and it was okay. Tasted like a cornflake shake. I wish they had a wider variety of cereal flavors. I have a place back home that makes shakes with Corn Flakes, Captain Crunch, Fruity Pebbles, or Cinnamon Toast Crunch. So I guess that's what I had hoped for.

Oh whoa, there's a new creamery in town, and it's better than the other ones. Despite failing to pick a Scottsdale-friendly name, Fatboy Dadbod's is killing the game. Peanut butter and chocolate were the highlights of our sampling bender, with coffee, pistachio, and mint chip ranking as noteworthy, as well. Across the board, texture was consistently on point. The shtick is a macaron and blow-torched marshmallow atop your ice cream, which is novel AND enjoyable, so I'll toss it two thumbs up. Besides, delivering the goods without an ounce of pretentious nonsense gets my vote over Le Boujii CrÃ©amÃªrÃ­ any day.

I love little bakeries! Things that are handmade fresh and not thawed and stuck in a window. This place is a great bakery with a small town feel:) I love Italian treats, and can be a tad picky! So, as you read, keep in mind I have crazy high standards in reference to Italian desserts! The Napoleon- yum! 4/5, Tiramisu- 3.5/5 :) other desserts I have tried- apple cheddar scone, cherry and apple turnovers, croissant, macaroons, cream puffs, cream horns... all yummy! Definitely a 4/5 overall! Would recommend this place to pick up desserts for any gathering:)

Turn is an amazing establishment that my family and I love to visit together. It's a great family environment is amazing Desert and the kids absolutely love this place. It's an amazing experience and great ambience. I feel like you're walking back in time when we visit this establishment.

I really like how this place is set up. Kind of like a cafeteria of baked goods! When I lived in L.A. they opened one up in Downtown but I never had the chance to go in. My office went here for a co-worker's birthday and I was very impressed! I lived in the SGV for years and a lot of the Asian bakeries have the same setup. I grabbed the egg tarts, cheese dog, matcha cake roll, thai tea & milk pudding tart. Everything was soooo good!! I definitely want to come back!! You should check this place out. Does not disappoint

Went after a Panthers game, great that they're open 24/7. Loooong line and I was excited. Unfortunately it didn't live up to the hype. I ordered a plain croissant, a mini fruit tart, a mini chocolate mousse, and a cafe capuchon (European cappuccino). CafÃ©: 4 stars Chocolate mousse: 4.5 stars Fruit tart: 3 stars Croissant: 1.5 stars I consider a plain croissant to be the litmus test of a French bakery. As such, Amelie comes up short. The croissant was bread-y and limp, exactly like my local grocery store, not flaky and fall apart when you bite into it true French style. Service at the pastry counter was great. The male barista was curt. I'd say I won't return but being it's the only place open at 12:30am I might go for coffee and mousse.

Churn has a cute and lively shop interior. There are outdoor tables in the back to enjoy your dessert and free parking both out front and in the adjacent parking lot. The menu is expansive consisting of ice cream, cookies, floats, shakes, and freezies; you can sample ice cream flavors. However, the prices are high for desert that is comparable in taste to what one can get at a grocery store and not distinct from other parlors.

Worst experience ever! Customer service was terrible. There were 3 of us and only my order was made wrong. I ordered a chocolate milkshake with out whip cream. I asked her if she could scoop off the whip cream... OMG She yelled at me and said SHE had to remake my milkshake, I told her it was ok I'll take it and I'll take off the whip cream myself and she flipped around and Yelled again NO because it wasn't right SHE had to remake it. She was so very rude!

August 2, 2014 Stood in line for over an hour for this? Totally worth it! No matter what it is that you purchase, they pastries are all delicious and not too sweet! My favorite is their Napoleon. Their cheesecake is, according to my mom, better than the ones I brought back from New York. Carlo's is worth the wait and you will not regret it at all! Promise!

While the ice cream looked delicious - there was no frozen yogurt. I was led astray! But this place sure is popular - the line was out the door. I am on a quest for a local yogurt joint - not sure why Yelp lists this as both a yogurt & ice cream shop.

HOLY HEAVEN! Visiting Madison and I searched "Best bakery in Madison" and this came up. Needless to say I can see why! This place is adorable beyond words and the selection is delightful! I got a little carried away and bought about $30 worth of baked goods, then realized I should probably buy some for the people I am visiting. You have got to go here! The women were super sweet and helpful too! If I ever come back to Madison I am 100% coming back here! Just signed up for Yelp so I could review them!!
Well I didn't go but I am sure the food is good. I was not going to wait over an hour in line to be rushed through. If I had known I would not have wasted my time going. Very disappointed.

Not just good, not just great, it is the G.O.D of ice cream. A inner or outer fat girls dream come true, forget marriage and come here to eat your feelings and everyone else's - guilt free. The combinations of flavors are mad scientist, while the thought of combining donuts and ice cream is it's namesake - novel.
Ridiculous! We tried the Lemon donut, Mud Pie, chocolate bacon bar and the maple bacon cinnamon roll.... YUM. The mocha is the best I've ever had. Great coffee!!! Coming back!

Mood- my sweet tooth Upon entering was quickly greeted. The staff was so friendly. Menus are posted on podiums as you enter. They have decadent candy delights on the right, and everything from ice cream to coffee on the left at the counter. There is plenty of seating from tables to counter style with tall chairs. Ordered the sea salt Carmel hot cocoa, and a banana split sundae style. Neither disappointed at all. Would def recommend - also you get a complimentary chocolate when you order something. Location is Linq promenade- parking is either garages or lots

this place is amazing! as long as you like your desserts extremely sweet and unhealthy. i usually go for the donut ice cream sandwiches and man they're impressive!!! they incorporate cereal in everything which is my favorite part about this place you can't go wrong with with some ice cream in between some macaroons either. i don't think there's anything here i wouldn't recommend 10/10

You can't beat a 24/7 bakery. Their macarons are heavenly ( we went there 2 days in a row). It's that delicious.. Thank God we found the wood lawn location.. The drive won't be as bad.. You will not regret the trip..
Omg wow yummy delish love love love their donuts, we go to the one in Las Vegas and everything is so good so everytime we go we get one of each
In the past it was amazing. However today was not the case. Brownies were dry, strawberry shortcake was disgusting. Kitchen was dirty

But sure, let's just say 3.5 stars because it's a fun concept! Our girl gang enjoyed a concert at Planet Hollywood and walked to the Cosmo on a mission to find the cereal soft serve and crack pie. The line was insane, even at 10pm. We ordered exactly what we wanted plus one compost cookie to share. For the cereal soft serve, I've never been and still am not a huge fan of corn flakes; but I get the contrast and whatnot. I do think nostalgia is worth the hype and the pricing is probably more about aesthetics. Who doesn't love the good 'ol simple times? Overall, everything tasted like a straight up spoonful of sugar in every bite. I couldn't finish any single order by myself, my sweetness tolerance is definitely dwindling with age.

Great ice cream but mask policy is non existent. Outside or not there are often a lot of massless customers in line not social distancing. I mostly won't go because it's so unsafe. The owner needs to put a mandate in place and enforce it. No mask no shoes no service.

What a fun place for ice cream!!! I've been here twice already and have sampled quite a few items since I bring my kids here each time. While most places have a variety of combo-ice creams, this place has become a major hub of cereal-infused goodness. Great location situated on the SWC of Ray Rd and the 101. And housed near Poketrition, Firehouse Subs and Culver's. This is a great spot to add a sweet option to this area. We typically stick to their signature items on their menu. Each signature item gives you the option of having it served in a cone, cup or milkshake style. We have done all 3, and really.....it depends what you prefer because they are all SO good!!! My favorite item has been "Thunder Buddy". Such a fun name to begin with if you are a "Ted" fan, but also the ice cream combo is so tasty if you are a peanut butter and banana fan. They have an excellent variety of cereals to choose from if you'd like to create your own cone or milkshake, plus every topping you can imagine. Their menu also boasts a large variety of milk and bubble teas. I haven't tried them yet, but since their menu is so extensive, it may take me a while to try one. Prices are typical for this kind of treat. We usually pay $7 for their signature ice cream combos. Totally worth it when you see how much you get. They are very generous with the infused ingredients as well as the toppings. If you are a fan of places that are insta-worthy, this is one of them. They have a cute vined wall with neon lights for pics as well as some fun tropical wallpaper surrounding the interior. Fun place to visit with friends or to take kids. Looking forward to trying more items off their menu.
I'm surprised this location doesn't have higher reviews compared to the other one in Campustown. This location has a much more peaceful ambiance and a lot more options!

Bruh this my favorite ice cream place. Hot take but I don't think the west coast (yes consider Vegas west coast) has good non-Asian ice cream, but this was a shining beacon of hope for us picky ice cream eaters. Salt & Straw is shaking. I recommend the milk flavor and birthday cake swirl (not sure if I got the verbiage right) with fudge topping and sprinkles. Milk Bar is located in the Cosmopolitan hotel, near the entrance to Marquee, so it's perfect for when you just finished getting yurnt at the dayclub and want something to hold you over until dinner, before you hit the nightclub. The only thing is that the portion is pretty big, so you'll probably want to split with someone. The ice cream was $8 and I had to throw half of it away since I couldn't finish it, and I'll regret this moment for the rest of my life. All I want right now is to go back to the Cosmo for this one lick of frozen heaven.

Can a bakery be sexy? You bet your sweet buttercream it can! I ventured in here one night after a dinner date with my husband, and I fell in love. The Victorian style furniture, the soft candlelight, the decadent desserts...It's all quite romantic. We split a lovely pear tart and a huuuuge slice of chocolate cake with curry chocolate frosting. My husband also had an espresso that he quite enjoyed. I love that they are open late so I can appease both my sweet tooth and my inner night owl. Everything was great and I absolutely don't mind paying $6 for a large slice of delicious gourmet cake. We'll be back for sure!

Seriously my favorite ice cream place in all of Phoenix! The owner is incredibly friendly! Novel has the same affect as Chick-fil-A on a Sunday. I always find myself wanting it on a Monday. The ice cream donut gives me life. Great for a hot night in Phoenix. Great for a cold night in Phoenix. Just great is what I'm trying to get too!

Very cool little place to stop if you're walking the strip to grab a coffee, pasty or some macarons. Located right off the sidewalk in the Venetian, it is pretty convenient. I thought the macarons were pretty great and the place overall actually feels like a regular bakery instead of a place on the vegas strip, which to me is a big plus.

This place is the best ice cream shop and locally owned. They have unique flavors and they change frequently. I love the honey lavender ice cream. You have to eat on the patio, but it is a nice space near Roosevelt. This place is a real treat! I originally found the shop on Yelp! as I wanted a fun, easy treat for my co-workers. We were all raving fans when we were done!

Seriously? Am I really seeing this? I have reached PMS nirvana. This Francophile has found sweet gastronomic heaven. My dear friend/fellow food/shoe/book junkie and I popped our Amelie's cherry(tart) late on Friday night and were pleasantly surprised by the high energy, efficiency of the staff (they kept that line mooooving!), funky decor and sinful eye candy. We had ourselves a little sampling and here's the good, the bad and the ugly: Good: Creme Puffs filled with rich, sweet, thick custard. No wimpy whipped cream here. My toes curled. The Salted Caramel Brownie. If I'd been w/anyone other than her, they would've been gotten stabbed in the hand w/my fork had they tried to sample this gooey confection. There is close to 1/4 inch of caramel atop this chewey brownie and the addition of a pinch of salt saves this from being too sweet. The Tea Cakes are very moist. The raspberry has a stronger flavor than the lemon. The line moves quickly. The bad: Okay, it really wasn't bad, but my hubby and I tried the Petit Gateau and, while the gnache was rich and smooth (just how I like my men, lol) the cake was actually pretty dry. The line moves so fast, you may not have a chance to see all the goodies. I like to weigh my options; calories are precious and I can't waste'em on so-so snacks. Lotsa empty trays. No matter how fast they work, they can't keep up w/demand so it seems like we may have missed some good options. The Ugly: The near cat-fight over the last eclairs and the creepy mannequin that literally leans over your shoulder as you wait in line. I'm a Leo, I like my space and crazy as it sounds, that thing was giving me the heebies. Overall, an instant favorite and a reason to haul our tushies down to Charlotte more often.

Oooohhh. THIS place is so very good. I love ice creams especially a rootbeer float. I did not go here for rootbeer floats but the ice cream is the best. The pumpkin pie ice cream is the best I ever had. You get what you pay for and you are definitely paying for a great tasting awesome ice cream. My new favorite ice cream spot!!!

Great customer service. I feel like their ice cream is better than it was when we first started going, maybe because they have become so popular, the ice cream is turned over so often. Great prices too. We love taking our dog, we can walk right up to the window with him. Perfect on a summer evening.

My daughter loved her shake so much. We loved the old school look of the inside. The staff was friendly and courteous. The only thing I could complain about is the line on a hot day, but that's nitpicking. I would recommend to everyone.

This is one of my favorite ice cream spot in Charlotte.. they have all type of flavors and including gluten free ice cream as well. It's located on south blvd near down town. Sometimes the line can be very long but trust me they will move pretty fast.

Very disappointing. Not that I am a cupcake expert by any means, but I am a cupcake lover to the extreme...so much so I actually began running half marathons just so I can justify eating more cupcakes. That being said, I was SO excited to try Sprinkles. I have to say that the cupcakes at Smith's grocery store are better! I bought the red velvet, coconut chocolate, marshmallow chocolate and the pumpkin cupcakes to split up between my husband and I. The chocolate cupcakes were very dry and stale and tasted like the cocoa in the batter was low quality. The pumpkin and red velvet were a little better to the taste, but not by much. For 1 cupcake it's $3.75 and for a four pack it's $15. I feel thoroughly ripped off. I would've given Sprinkles 1 star except for the store and through staff hospitality were wonderful. Too bad the product stinks worse than my husband's big toe. Will not be returning again!!!!!!

Hong Kong or should I say I think the Asians make the worst deserts unless they're copying the West. The Europeans make the best deserts on the planet: FACT. Still. This bakery isn't any better than the deserts you buy in Little Italy or Commercial Drive or Broadway (Greek area) in Vancouver, BC Canada so it's not worth the wait in the line along with hipsters and those who "don't know".

We stopped by Mitchell's when visiting Cleveland and it did not disappoint. The handmade ice cream shop is in an old theatre. It was very clean and well kept. I had the wild berry crumble and it was top 3 best ice cream I've ever had. I got it in a waffle cone which was fresh and had a great crunch to it. We will definitely be back when visiting Cleveland.

I'm in love!!! Such a cute idea... I love the fish shaped waffle cones! I had the ah-boong with ube ice cream and taro filling with some dried coconut sprinkled on top. The waffle cone was perfectly done where it has a nice crispy outside and it still chewy inside and the ice cream and filling as delicious as well. I'm looking forward to coming back and trying their other flavors!

If you're looking for non-chain, homemade ice cream shop with a little twist stop here. My favorite is their brown butter almond brittle. It's a sweet cream based ice cream with bits of almond brittle in every bite. Another fan favorite, the gooey batter cake. Those are both just the perfect amounts of sweetness without being over baring. What makes it even better is you can get just one flavor or multiple scoops each a different flavor for the same price. One cone not enough? They've got pints of all their flavors to take home and enjoy later too.
Coffee was spectacular and I loved their selection of pasties and cakes. I ended up with the strawberry-cheese danish and it was very good. Cute place!

Sam the manager makes a special effort every time we come in! I recommend the green tea latte, and the star berry honey bread. The sandwiches are perfectly toasted and the meat to bread ratio is ideal.
The fact that this fabulous bakery is open 24/7 is alone reason to appreciate it. (This is not anything like the 24/7 Wendy's.). we had the

This place is so cute whimsical and sweet tooth lovers dream! It was like a real life Candy Land! My daughter was so excited but because I'm the worlds most ok-ist mom I said no to ice cream AND candy...one or the other...she picked ice cream! As for the ice cream there weren't many options but most of the choices were really good. But the coolest part was the homemade fluff that they torched right in front of u!!

We have tried many things here and I just don't get it! They are SO OVERPRICED but I do feel like you're obviously paying for the name. Nothing we have had has been extraordinary. The line moves fairly quickly and the service is pretty decent too! We got (3) cannolis and an eclair yesterday and it was $20. The cheesecake was $10 and the size of the lid of a cup and the slice of cake was $11 and that doesn't seem like a great price!

Love love love Ninety's ice cream. They have so many innovative creations! They're definitely insta-worthy too. Go when it's down time though because it can definitely get packed. They're in a good location but when it's busy there is hardly any parking. You can walk around the boardwalk too where they have paddle boats and a park.

Gelato. Cannoli. Gealato. Let's see, did I leave anything out? The Viennese and the French can bake pretty good pastries, but the Italians, as with all food, they are in a league of their own. I've been to Rome and plied the canals of Venice in a gondola. I've seen St. Peters and The Piata at the Vatican. But it's the food in Italy that makes for some of my fondest memories. The French wouldn't know Spumoni if they had a shoe full of it. Is Presti's the best bakery on planet Earth? Could very well be. Fogetaboutit, it's in Little Italy. Mange.
Must go back soooo good. Pineapple upside down ice cream My family also did the donut ice cream highly recommended.

Thomas Keller has developed quite a name for himself and his restaurant groups. Most people will know him because of the French Laundry in Napa which led to a ton of other restaurants that he eventually opened in NYC. They're famous for a reason as his food is really second to none. Some of my fondest memories of my trip to the French Laundry was definitely the baked goods. Served hot in a basket, we were offered various types of bread multiple times throughout the night. We even got to take home some shortbread cookies at the end of the night! Thinking about all that great food had me nostalgic for some of Keller's cooking. Bouchon Bakery is part of his restaurant group and somehow we bumped into it. We are always looking for that perfect U.S. baguette and a good almond croissant. The fragrance of fresh baked goods drew us over so we had to check them out! Instead of a baguette today, we got an epi (small one) and an almond croissant. The epi was not bad but tough to eat. Had to really work my jaw muscles. Perhaps heating it up would have made a difference. The almond croissant looked perfect on the outside (in fact for those who did enjoy it, you can find a recipe online!) but it didn't hit the spot for me. I felt that the almond paste was not sweet or smooth enough. For me, the perfect almond croissant needs to be buttery to the point you almost lose all the flakiness of the croissant. Then the almond paste should be silky/buttery smooth with tons of sugar but not masking the incredibly rich notes of almond. This paste should fill the pastry so that every bite you got a mouthful. Unfortunately, we did not find what we were looking for here this time. Will always be willing to give a Keller restaurant another try. The baked goods today just didn't quite do it for me.

This is a wonderful ice cream gem! The cookie dough pops are fantastic (I had the Twix) and the peanut butter ice cream sandwich was also super yummy! The staff was super helpful and nice and were really quick with our order. I would definitely check this place out if you like ice cream and fun deserts!
Their pound cake is the best! Pistachio macarons are my go-to and theirs is by far the best! I will def be back.

flamer than lit fire flames, squad. i never thought i would ever enjoy marshmallows, but these guys figured it out. it just works very inventive ice cream flavors, very congenial service, very baller concept macaroon + ice cream + macaroon + burnt marshmallow = bing bang boom strawberry + capn crunch are a happenin' bunch

Came here one night with a friend and I was so impressed!! Brandon was so kind and asked all about ya and where we are from since we just moved here. He let us sample flavors and they all were delicious. He really took his time and we felt like valued customers. Very good with covid protocol. 6ft apart all had masks on and sanitized the desk area. Would def come back for the donut melt!!

The atmosphere is great and the coffee was good. However, the tiramisu was frozen on the inside. In a neighborhood with so many options for great Italian food, go somewhere that actually bakes everything fresh.
Definitely an overrated tourist place. Also I prefer to go the the small businesses in Charlotte that don't charge $6 for 2 scoops.

The food is delicious, however... Spent about $75 on cookies and cannolis and the cannolis were not filled in the center. I've been eating cannolis all of my life and this typically only happens at a grocery store, not a nice bakery. I called the bakery to make a complaint and spoke directly to the owner. She was sharp and accusatory, like I was trying to scam her out of cannolis. She asked question after question and gave excuses instead of taking the feedback. She told me she would send me a check or replace the cannolis, but she was so nasty I just told her to keep it. Really sad not to be going to my favorite bakery, but customer service is everything.

I really really really wanted to like this place. I made a special detour to las Vegas just to try the crack pie and ice cream. I'll confess my expectations were high after watching the Netflix documentary that featured these treats. Sadly it didn't live up to the hype. I'm not sure what happen but the the prices were high compared to the portion sizes and the deserts were nothing to write home about. Where's the love for quality that I saw in the documentary?

When you think about ice cream this is the place you wanna beeee not only do they have amazing items on the menu like the kitchen sink that comes with real display kitchen sink field with scoops of amazing different flavors and toppings of your choosing it has a fun feel to it like your rethinking on how you eat ice cream lol this place is for sure a 5 star place employees were amazing

Great ice cream and they have games for kids to play while you enjoy it. A bunch of board games. I got the hot fudge sundae with cookies and milk flavored ice cream and brownies on top. I really enjoyed it. I'll be coming here again. It's organic too!!!
Day after doughnuts from here are not good. They do not hold up. Pinkbox is forever my favorite!

I stopped by with two friends a couple of weeks ago on a Sat. evening. Given that we were looking to get together later in the evening for hot beverages or dessert, Butterwood fit the bill, so we headed over to L-ville to check it out. Because their specialty is clearly cake and there weren't many other desserts in the case, we each ordered a slice of cake ($6 + tax each). Going against my usual adventurous streak when it comes to edibles, I decided to play it safe and stick with the chocolate cake with chocolate buttercream icing. The cake was velvety in texture, but not quite as most as I was hoping, and it was rather stiff on the iced side. As for the icing, it was definitely the best part of the cake--it was decadently creamy and rich, as buttercream should be. My friends ordered the chocolate pistachio cake and the vanilla poppy seed cake, and I tried bites of both. The cake component of the chocolate pistachio seemed identical to my chocolate cake, but the icing was saltier than mine with a rather muted pistachio taste. The vanilla poppy seed was the most interesting of the bunch, consisting of yellow cake and tangy vanilla icing sprinkled generously with poppy seeds. As others have mentioned, the slices were rather large, such that neither of my friends entirely finished theirs (as usual, I unabashedly housed my entire slice, however). If you visit and don't see a cake that you'd enjoy, I'd recommend waiting a bit and checking back, given that the cakes seem to rotate. By the time that we left, all of the cakes that'd been available when we ordered had been replaced by different types of cakes (hello, Meyer lemon cake!). The atmosphere is quaint, making it an ideal setting in which to relax and catch up over dessert and/or hot beverages. If you're a night owl and/or a fan of dessert, I definitely recommend checking it out--your inner Martha Stewart will definitely be pleased!

Best ice cream in town!!! They always have new and unique flavors every time I stop in. The staff is very friendly and let you try as many flavors as you want! But the cookie cup is by far my favorite! You choose a macaroon bottom as many scoops of delicious ice cream in the middle and another macaroon on top (I usually top mine with a toasted marshmallow) I highly recommend this ice cream shop!!

Loved the atmosphere here! My friend and I can in for ice cream and we were in for a treat. She got a sandwich and said it was amazing and a ice cream drink. I had the Thai tea macaroon ice cream sandwich. It was delicious and a refreshing take on an ice cream sandwich. It was decently busy when we arrived, the staff was great at moving people through the line!
Did you know Cleveland has an Italian neighborhood? It does. And in it is the beautiful and lovely Presti's. Yay donuts!!!

When I was searching for dessert, this place showed up, and you would not believe how excited I was! About a month or two prior, I was in New York and had visited one of their locations twice to try a bit of everything. I fell in love with their cake truffles; especially the birthday cake truffles. This location is in The Cosmopolitan on the second floor with restaurants and shops. It is right in front of a set of escalators. It looks like a location you would see at a food court. It is a walk up counter where you order. There is a big pink sign that says "Milk" right outside, and they have a chalkboard menu above. When my husband and I went in the middle of the day, there wasn't a line (thank goodness), and we knew exactly what we wanted. The employee greeted us, we ordered the birthday cake truffles, paid, and we were on our way. They tasted exactly as I remembered them... delicious, yummy, soft, and sweet. It is a little pricey, but it is comparable to how much they charged in New York.

So I've been here three times now and like a fine wine, it just keeps getting better with every passing day. The Donut Bar has been killing it since day one here in Vegas, by staying true to classic fried delights of my childhood, but also upgrading a few of the sprinkled covered favorites. I've tried good portion of the offerings here, but the real standouts for me are the coconut covered donut, The Old fashioned, the peanut butter chocolate, the Pop-Tart donut, and a classic pink frosted donut simply dubbed, "The Homer". Every bite is soft; flavor packed and melts in your mouth. The icing on all of these gorgeous bakery beauties is made in house along all the donut fillings, no store bought stuff here. This process of making in everything in-house really helps to keep the quality on point; three visits later and the donuts have the same mouthwatering consistency. I will keep traveling here for these amazing donuts all the way from Henderson which wasn't the case for O' Face, R.I.P. Sorry, but a dry donut that's lavender and lemon flavored just wasn't for me, especially when they cost close $6 a piece. If you simply can't decide on what calorie bombs to order, just have the people behind the counter put together a half for you, trust me it will be amazing. Don't forget the coffee, they have Stumptown Nitro Brew on tap along with chocolate and strawberry milk being tapped daily as well. That's enough right there to visit this place. Donuts. Just do it!
The donuts were delicious, we tried the creme brÃ»lÃ©e, the vanilla bean, and the poptart! We will be back before we leave Vegas!

I have been looking for Taho since I moved here in AZ and they have the authentic tasting Taho I can find! They also have other Filipino desserts like ube/taro cake, biko (sweet rice cake), ice cream as well. I like the Abuelita flavored ice cream! This is my new favorite place! They also have other flavored drinks and milk teas!
Having been to many northern Italian bakeries this by far is one of the best. Everything is amazing and fresh. Do yourself a favor and get a slice of their homemade cheesecake... you won't regret it!

There's always a line but it moves super fast and its definitely worth the wait! They have an assortment of unique and tasty flavors that are different from the average ice cream places around town. They also have dairy free options that are delicious as well. They let you sample as many as you want, and they make the waffle cones right in front of you which is a cool touch (and makes the place smell amazing the minute the door opens). Will definitely be back!

Sinful Sweets is beyond amazing! This review is for their kiosk in the Ross Park Mall, but they do have an actual bakery on Liberty Avenue in Pittsburgh too! The Sinful Sweets kiosk is always stocked full of bakery items, especially lots of great flavors of their edible cookie dough! The employees are super friendly and always willing to help and let you try samples to determine which items you like best. So far, my favorites are the Sugar Cookie Edible Cookie Dough and Red Velvet Edible Cookie Dough. The edible cookie doughs taste so fresh and stay good in the fridge for about five months. I would highly recommend this place! I've had an amazing experience every time I've been here, and the kiosk at the mall is so convenient for you to just grab something while you're already out shopping!

Weirdly decorated French Bakery with amazing tasting desserts. Hands down the best salted Carmel brownies. Def my favorite and they have sold over one million of them. You can expect to pay like over $2.50 for everything. Can't go wrong with their macaroons either! Decently sized and never tasted one I didn't like (always have several flavors at least). The tarts are good, several options there. We have tried cake once and wasn't impressed at all, so I recommend sticking to the SCB or macaroons, or tarts. Not the mention the cakes are $5ish. There's usually a long line so be prepared to wait, it usually moves at a decent pace. Giving 4 stars for the lines and the higher price (but worth it ). Place is decently sized but usually so popping can be challenging to find a seat sometimes.

They were okay. I follow them on instagram because i stay wanting to try new gf places. I went twice while in vegas this last time and they had the same option both times for gluten free. Lemon blueberry and red velvet. The red velvet was really sweet, a little spongy but doable. The lemon blueberry was nt what i expected. I got it out of curiosity and expected a blue cake. It was way better, think lemon cake w streusel with little blueberries strategically placed. Sooo good. I also tried the cookie, that was really sweet but good. I like the buttery flavor of the betty crocker box better but these have a similar taste. Overall pretty good. Expensive though.
Such a fun place! Great selection. The pride in their product shows through. Enjoyed a single BIG POPPA and some great fresh brewed coffee. Worth the drive from Henderson.

The sign for a box of 6 assorted flavored macarons said $15. But I got charged $17.50. It's bad business to put up a sign for one price and overcharge it when my card is rung up. That's fraudulent sales practices. I won't be going back to get ripped off again...and no, the sales tax is not 16.67% in Vegas.

Wow. It's a frosty treat that's like ice cream but... creamier? There are approximately two billion ways to make a "snowstorm" (just like a Dairy Queen blizzard). I was advised the lemon version was incredible, but when I ordered it, they were out of lemon. Curse you, Custard Gods! I went with a mint chocolate chip snowstorm and it was the perfect treat. Please question the sanity of anyone who doesn't enjoy the hell out of this cool throwback treat shack.

I am a huge fan of cooking and baking shows and loved watching Cake Boss so when I saw there was a Carlos Bakery here, I knew I had to stop in. After reading he reviews on here, I wasn't so sure it would be worth the stop or the money but I'm glad I came anyways. The bakery is actually a lot smaller than I thought it would be. There was also a long line but it moved fairly quickly. I ordered all 4 lobster tail flavors because that seemed to be very popular amongst the yelp reviews. Of course I got the cannolis, one regular and one chocolate dipped. And one slice of red velvet because that's my favorite flavor. Total was about $45. The staff were all nice and helpful. I had a piece of each cannoli and I don't have much to compare it to so I thought it was really good. I prefer the original over the chocolate dipped one. The lobster tails were good. I wasn't expecting such a crunchy exterior but it definitely added texture to the soft cream inside. The red velvet was great. The cake was moist and the frosting had a nice flavor and consistency. I thought it would be overly sweet but it was very balanced. If I lived in the area, I wouldn't go here often to be honest. But it is definitely worth a stop if you're visiting!

I loved the cereal milk soft serve! Like when I first heard of it I didn't know what to expect, but when I had it, it literally tasted like the milk you'd have right after you finish eating all the cereal in the bowl. Haha I was so happy because I haven't had that taste in my mouth for a while. It was the perfect amount of sweetness (not too sweet which was perfect, like I didn't want to throw it away I just kept going at it) and I bought it with the corn flakes, so the crunch added texture and made it so pleasant to eat! I'm craving this right now tbh, which is why it has taking me so long to give a review, Staff members were super informative and sweet when I was there. So at that time service was 5/5 :)

It's taken forever to write a review for this place. It's a well-known French bakery in Charlotte and gets raves reviews, but not quite sure why. I mean, they got some solid macaroons, eclairs, and lattes and stuff but nothing that really makes crave Amelie's. It's probably because it's one of the few places that are open at all hours, making it a solid hang-out to grab a coffee and treat at anytime. The last time I was here was after catching a movie with some broad. It was a random Wednesday night and the place was bumping. When I first walked in, you can smell all the goodness and the air and baked goods displayed behind the case... and then you walk across the Sahara Desert to stand in line. The line wrapped around to the other room... I'm decent at small-talk and killing time, but hate waiting in lines, especially with some broad on a first date! It's the wait-in-line-for-20-minutes test - If you can't carry or want to engage in a conversation with your date, you should peace out! (Not a real test, but I should've known...) If you're looking for a place to hang out late at night fueled by coffee and French bakery, this place is probably for you. But keep in mind, the lines are long (both times I went), so if you show up with a date, make sure they're interesting! #potcallingkettleblack dmo out.

Why do we have to give a star? As a longtime fan of the show my expectations were pretty high, but sadly completely let down. I had called earlier that day to see if they had the coffee crumb cake and if they could set it aside for me. The girl said yes and when I arrived I was told they didn't have it and there was non in the shop. I told them the situation and they said oh well. So I called my family to see what else they'd want me to grab since they didn't save the coffee Cake. The girl who was helping me had a lot of attitude with me after that and they began snickering with other workers whenever I would ask for something else and then they would say it was out. My experience here was horrible mainly due to customer service and made me not want to even purchase the items... then to top it off I got into the car and tried one of the cannolis. I've had better cannolis at lascaris. So disappointed in the service and pastries...

Delicious & healthy- not an impossible combo! Dairy based and vegan based ice creams with no artificial ingredients. The vegan ice cream is made from cashew milk which gives it a cream-y texture and mouth feel. It is much better than coconut milk which overpowers the ice cream flavor.

I loved the look of this cute little place near downtown Madison. Their baked goods are incredible! They have cookies cakes donuts and tons of German baked goods. If you're driving around the area make sure to stop here and pick up some yummies. I especially liked the scones!

The hot weather in AZ would make me want ice cream for dessert everyday - I mean, what is better than a warm summer night sitting outside with the breeze in your hair, and a spoon in one hand scarfing down a sundae? With all the positive reviews Sweet Republic was getting I knew it had to be one of my stops while I was in Phoenix. I was surprised by the variety in flavors they offered, most of them sweetened with honey. I couldn't help comparing SR to my favorite ice creameries in San Francisco and I would say SR stood up well to them. After standing at the counter and annoyingly asking for 8 samples to try (the guys behind the counter was so patient with us which was super nice) I grew impressed with their local and creative flavors. - Mint chocolate chip had the taste of real mint in the after taste, almost like a mojito - Strawberry - pure strawberry as it should be - Sweet corn - one of my favorite unique flavors, the only thing I wish was the corn bits were not as hard - Salted butter caramel - everyones must order flavor which is exactly what you think it would taste like

At first I was taken with the Ambience. The pastries are works of art. And some of the pastries are delightful in taste. But all in all, I find this place overrated and overpriced. Sure, some pastries warrant a price that reflects the time involved in their making, but I've found myself and my family eating some only because they cost so damned much, there is no way I'm throwing them out. It is, however, a fun place to meet for business or hang with friends. Definitely more eclectic, than luxurious in decor. The primary reason I am not eager to return is the lack of love from the staff. When I am paying top dollar for something, I insist that at least pretend to value my business.
Literally the best soft serve you will ever have in your life. I can't really put into words how good this place is so just go and find out for yourself! You won't regret it.

Happy to hear a new ice cream shop opened up nearby my house with homemade ice cream?! After seeing their flavor choices on yelp once they opened, I admit I was not really excited to try anything because the flavors all sounded basic, nothing unique. I had no urgency to try this place and I am sucker for homemade ice cream. I've tried it and I don't get the hype. 4 scoop sampler- salted caramel truffle, chocolate chocoholic, oreo, peanut butter chocolate something. The ice cream- soft and creamy but not in a good way. In a way that it will melt within a few minutes. We tried to take it home and we live a mile away. As soon as I got into the car I noticed the flavors melting into one another since all 4 scoops were next to eachother in a small plastic container which had ridges. Not to sound too picky but with ridges it melts into the ridges making it harder to eat. I would prefer a styrofoam cup over the plastic with ridges. Flavors are not memorable. They taste is very sweet, very artificial, and not special in any way to make me return. Service: people mentioned 4 windows. I didn't see that. I saw 2 people working. One was cleaning and one was stressed taking orders. There is this window that slides open. It was awkward because the girl working there asked if I wanted a sample. She held the door open while talking to me and had a hard time holding it and writing it down on her little notepad at the same time. Her awkwardness made me feel like helping her. I find that sliding window annoying because it stops the interaction much like a drive through window. If the ice cream was $1 a scoop I can see it being acceptable. But for $3.50 a scoop I would expect to have a place to sit (although there was a bench or two,one family of 4-5 people took over that area) and to be able to interact more with the person giving me the ice cream. Anyway I wanted two samples. She wrote one down halfway and the other she didn't write down. I never saw someone write a sample down. When she went to get it, she forgot the one she did not write down. I thought that was kind of sad. But she must have been overwhelmed because when she went to give me my ice cream I noticed her entire backside of her arm had blue ice cream smeared over it as it was dried on so it was there for a while. Gross! Take some time to wash your hands people. That's not ok. The sliding window showed even more awkwardness as she was unable to get me spoons and my ice cream without it slamming on her while my ice cream would have been thrown aside if she let the sliding glass door go. I just wanted to get out of there but I noticed she didn't give me napkins nor did I see any outside on the counter. I think napkins are a must for customers to have access to in Vegas summer heat.

Always heard about Mitchell's, people raving about it. Whenever I pass it by, I see lines are out the doors. "This must be darn good ice cream/frozen yogurt" I keep saying to myself. Well, I finally got my opportunity to try this high demand ice cream...no lines, straight to the front. I decided to try the taster's duo...my choices? Campfire S'mores and Blue Cosmo. It was definitely a weird combination mashed together, ugh especially when it started to melt. I actually thought I was going to be wowed...kind of like when I have my Cold Stone Creamery Oreo Overload this is so amazing reaction. Nope...didn't happen for me. I was just ice cream...ice cream that I can get at the grocery store. Didn't quite understand what the big deal about this place. I feel that it is extremely overhyped. Price wise...inexpensive, which is a good thing.
