The gooey warm texture with the cold ice cream was a great mix of flavors and it worked perfectly together. I will have to come back here when I'm in the area!

This is by far my favorite donut shop around! If you say you don't like or want to eat a donut, go to this place and tell me if you changed your mind! Ever since I was little I used to get these donuts on the weekends and the employees that work there are always and have always been very friendly and welcoming. Of course, I feel like a kid when I am here because I always want the chocolate sprinkled donuts, definitely my favorite! The jelly filled ones are also very delicious! I go here to splurge because it is all worth it when you eat something that tastes as good as these donuts do!

A very delicious bakery, but I do think it's suited best for people with a certain taste. I like my cakes and icing very sweet and soft, and I find the icing style here to be much more on the butter-y and thick side, less on the sweet side. They have classic flavors and more experimental flavors, but nothing too out of the box and I think everything works really well. The indoor space is beautiful (almost Victorian decorated?) and they have a small back patio you can sit at.

Absolutely AMAZING ice cream, boba and service! We had the pleasure of being service by the owner who did a great job telling us about all the different ice creams and drinks they make! We live in California and will 110% be back for more boba and ice cream!

So happy I found this place on a whim when the bakery I'd initially called (6 days before the special birthday) said they could not accommodate my request for a birthday cake. My continued search brought me to Villani's. I called and from the moment they answered the phone, their warmth, friendly customer service and patience (as I decided what to order), made a major impression and I immediately felt at ease. They guided me through the decision to order the triple chocolate cake. The triple Chocolate cake was everything....beautiful, delicious, moist. Absolutely AMAZING bakery! Best chocolate cake I've EVER had/eaten (and I'm a good home baker). Villani's will be my go to bakery (and my family members based in Charlotte).

They scream there is very good the workers are very friendly there was let you try a sample of ice cream to see if you like it first before you buy it if you don't like about the places there's no place to sit is walk up only and you can take it home to eat it or eat it in your car so but the ice cream is very good there

What I love most about Mason's is every trip is a new adventure. The flavors change as much as the color changing spoons. I have my favorites but this one place where a favorite is a one time try because they always have something new that sparks my interest. Everything is high quality and delicious and I have yet to feel underwhelmed by a flavor or a trip. This is my favorite lesser known place and I love bringing out of towners here.

I wasn't feelin this place quite honestly. It's a little hole in the wall and the employees were more than nice. The ice cream just didn't really set itself apart in anyway if I'm being honest and I know the 4 other adults with me felt same way. Nonetheless, Aaron Goldsmith was in front of us with his family and that was definitely the highlight

The employees were extremely friendly and kind from start to finish. Everything was so fresh and delicious. I'm glad we made a stop here. I'll definitely be coming back in the future and will recommend to my friends if they're ever in the area!

An adorable little local spot who makes delicious homemade ice cream! The staff was super friendly and helpful when myself and 4 other people walked in (pretty much taking up the whole place ) and all ordered and asked for samples. They have different flavors every month to my knowledge, but I tried the Vietnamese coffee flavor and I was in love!
Another great place in the area. this time for desserts. Open late, quiet place good music.

We all but live across the street from this den of iniquities. I am such a regular that if they don't see me for a week, they notice. TERRIBLE! I've been to a few of the local ice cream shops. The Pink Spot, Mary Coyle, Nami, Sweet Republic. I am not counting the froyo joints, that is NOT ice cream. Anyways, they are all great and have their own unique textures, flavors and spins. However, Churn is the hands-down winner for pure, creamy, insane ice cream goodness. Pricing is not bad either, with the Ice Cream Sandwich being the best deal. Hubby adores when the rotating special is PB&J. My signature cup includes two scoops of vanilla atop a red velvet cookie with salted caramel atop. *swoons* I love my neighborhood. :)

I've never had a slice of cake more moist and delicious in my life. Already craving another slice and extremely sad that it's not in arms reach. I tried the funfetti cake and the double chocolate cake and would highly recommend either - along with literally anything in the shop because it all looks (and smells) to die for
Everything we have had here is amazing. The atmosphere is great to have a date night or hang out with some friends. I am also pleasantly surprised by the creative options we find each time we go.
Really good. Got a snicker doodle cookie, they offer to warm it up for you. Also got the vanilla bean ice cream. It was delicious.
After dying to visit his bakery. I'm disappointed, I feel like everything is commercialized. Looks are very much deceiving. Spent over $100 trying to taste a bit of everything it was overrated.

Very glad they opened a matcha place in Charlotte just wish they chose a closer location near Southend or Midwood. Have tried their Matcha Special drinks and all the soft serve flavors (matcha, black sesame, hojicha). Black Sesame needed a stronger sesame taste but no complaints here.

A nice little place hidden in back of a shopping center but worth a visit. Their ice cream and Gelatos are excellent with a large variety. Get it with a macaroon and a toasted marshmallow on top and you won't be disappointed. Very friendly service.

Upon walking into any Mitchell's, the incredible smell of waffle and ice cream is completely overwhelming. I mean seriously this smell will change your life. Beyond that , the choices of ice cream and sorbet are second to none and the fact that you can try before you buy makes it all the better. Each month a new seasonal flavor is presented. My all time favorite is the Birthday Cake. Sometime I'll get a double scoop of a flavor but I highly recommend getting a milkshake made with your favorite flavor. It comes with homemade frosting and chocolate shavings. I suggest getting the Birthday Cake Milkshake. Also the homemade waffle cones are fantastic. I'll continue to visit Mitchell's for as long as I'm in Cleveland.
yummy ice cream, beautiful ceiling, funkier flavors are worth a try (like the strawberry jalapeÃ±o) -Taster trio scoops are very generous

I love the food. The atmosphere and business model is unique in every way and a BADLY needed addition to CLT culture. The spinach artichoke leek soup is the very best soup I have ever tasted and I'm usually twice the age of the average patron...every pastry and sandwich I have had has been great, truly. What holds my rating back is the service, it's consistently off, my order is consistently wrong and the last straw was last weekend I waited 30 min for a sandwich. I like Amelie's a lot but not that much. They cannot handle the crowds with the current staff. That might fly in Paris but here in the good ole US when I'm dropping $45 on lunch and snacks they need to step it up.

This place was so good ! I come here often with my kid after practice before covid hit! This is our first time Coming after covid! What happened!!! So many places taste so different after covid including this place! The guy with long hair serviced us! He was not friendly and seems like he hated his job or had a bad day!!! Didn't appreciate him flinging his hair back then grabbing our desserts! WTH!! This grossed me out!! I am not those type that would confront him or say something! When I saw that, I didn't ordered more! I cancelled Some of The desserts he has not grabbed! If the OWNER IS READING THIS, hair nets please!!! I paid for food that I didn't eat!
Great fun ice cream but sometimes when you come in there the girl at the counter seems to be upset you came in I always feel in a hurry to go because of that
Nice place to go when it hot out. Waffle buckets with custard and candy pieces. About $10.

My family has been patronizing Presti's since shortly after they opened in 1903. (I live in Seattle now, but a stop at Presti's is a must when I'm in town). This is a neighborhood institution. Their pastry displays are jaw-dropping, and they've probably got the best gelato selection in the state. The chocolate cannolis are amazing, and their Americano is the best I've ever had, (Starbucks can take a flying leap). Great variety of pastas and pizza by the slice, and a great neighborhood vibe.

only have one picture because i just can't wait to take the picture before devouring the food presti's have one of the best iced latte i've had in the area. love the baked goods as well - so far i've had their tiramisu, carrot cake, custard puff and coconut bar. I love how they're all perfectly balanced and not overly sweet like most desserts here in the US. The carrot cake i had to go back multiple times because they don't always have them. The coconut bar is by far my favorite - it's similar to lamington: chocolate sponge cake in the middle, coated in chocolate icing with shredded coconuts on top. my complaints: - prices are relatively high and they're not clearly marked so you have to ask - the place gets BUSY and the line moves SLOW. Sometimes you may have to wait for half an hr before getting served - the staff isn't super clear on the ingredients. I wanted to see if the date nut bar is vegan and two of the staff just said, you can reasonably assume there's butter inside

Friends, food, fun that's all a girl ever needs sometimes. That and several CANNOLI. Always wanted to come here because of the whole Cake Boss series. The icing on top were the cannolis! Friends and I were here at around 815 pm on Martin Luther King Jr day. There was a short line of about 5 people in front of us. It was my first time but I had my heart and tummy set, then someone mentioned the lobster tails! The place is pretty small, there's no place to eat and sit, but there's a nice shelf for you to quickly set your box of goodies down and stuff your face or mix your coffee, whatever floats your boat. There's a viewing window of the bakery but I really wasn't paying attention. There was a staff of two serving everyone and the bakery cold cases were fully stocked. Everything looked amazing. I stuck with my gut and got four cannolis- 2 chocolate dipped and 2 original, and an original lobster tail. Polite and quick with service, I would've stayed to ask questions but the line behind me was 10 deep. Got home and scarfed a cannoli down before bed, then ate my awesome lobster tail for breakfast with coffee the next day. I gotta say I will probably be back for more!

Pros: if you never tried their cupcakes... They are super delicious! My classic favorite is red velvet but you almost not go wrong with any flavor to include pumpkin and strawberry. The staff girl there was super cheery and ecstatic about the bakery goods! This is the only sprinkles I know that also has ice cream right next door making it the biggest sprinkles I've seen. Cons: these are definitely high end cupcakes so expect to pay close to $4 for one making them the priciest bakery goods too (but so worth it!) Overall: if you are on this newly developed street, I would highly recommend stopping by!
We love to stop at Page's. They have a huge selection, and prices are good. Staff is always very friendly. It's a Pittsburgh tradition!!

This is my new favorite place around madison! My husband and I have been in about 5 times. Each time we get bread and a selection of 3-4 random bakegoods from the glass case. I have yet to have ANYTHING that I wouldnt try again (and I am usually pretty picky). The bread is perfect - chewy and delicious - and the bakegoods are always a wonderful surprise. This morning I had a tomato pesto bread roll (sorry, dont remember the exact name). It just looked like bread with a bit of cheese on top ... until I bit into it and found the whole center was full of goat cheese, pesto, and dried tomatoes. It was WONDERFUL! We also had a mini raspberry cream cheese thing that was a bit of heaven (or maybe hell as I am sure it was very naughty in terms of calories), and a cheese filled croissant. The only problem with these bakegoods is that they never last until we get home! I am not fat, but I could get that way if this place was any closer to my house...

I am a big fan of Candace Nelson of Cupcake Wars. So when I heard this place was opened, I made a beeline for Sprinkles. The store was very nice & clean. They have this awesome Cupcake ATM on the outside. My daughter got the Vanilla on Vanilla and I got the Red Velvet. The cake was moist but that's where it ends. The red Velvet didn't have any taste whatsoever...NONE...ZERO...The icing was like a hard fondant. Not good. My 13 yr old daughter loved her vanilla. I tasted it after the cashier hyped it up so much. Once again, nothing special. I honestly prefer Nothing Bundt Cakes. Big Let Down! Try it & see if you like it but if not, venture down to CupKate's at Container Park, they are worth the visit.

This place was kinda hard to find but well worth the search. I wish there was good searing in the area but it's off the side of the casino floor, so not. My husband enjoyed the ham egg and cheese croissant and I enjoyed my cheese Danish. We both had coffee which was very good. The sandwich was warmed on request. We also had cookies. My husband had his chocolate cookie warm and I enjoyed my oatmeal raisin cookie room temperature. This was by far the BEST oatmeal raisin cookie I have ever had! Even better than my home made ones! I want another one.

Amazing and unusual flavours are always so mouth-watering. The shop introduces new flavours all the time and it's always fun and exciting to come try new tastes. The staff are super friendly and the atmosphere is relaxing. Highly recommended!
If you haven't been to Mason's Creamery, drop what you're doing and go now. Best ice cream in Cleveland. The employees are cool and fun. Try everything!
Best ice cream on the planet!!!! We often buy it and freeze it too To save it for a rainy day. Love the store too, very welcoming. the location we go to has a train going around the ceiling.

Amazing cakes! They have a lot of variety of desserts. Their cakes are amazing!! They have an AMAZING chocolate cake. Probably the best I've had in my life, I'm not kidding. Also wanted to try the red velvet which looked good. Will definitely come back to this place

Back home on the East Coast, I have been consistently unwilling to wait in the LONG LONG lines that are always present to get into Carlo's Bakery! This time however, was early in the morning, inside of the Venetian Resort and there was NO line. It was a great opportunity to order a coffee and a cannoli and sit in the piazza, under a fake Venetian sky, eating my CB breakfast. Cannoli was solid! Thanks Cake Boss!

Vegan dessert shop with high tea atmosphere. My friends shared some of their unique vegan pastries including a berry tart, a slice of cake, and a cupcake. I just had some tea. I had the apricot vanilla tea from Tazo. Service was friendly.

I love Honey Hut. I've been going since I was a little girl, every time we visited my cousins in Cleveland, from North Carolina. It's been 25 years since I last came to Honey Hut, but it's still the same as I remember. Their ice cream is so rich and creamy. I may be lactose intolerant now, but it was well worth the small cone I got. I also love that a childhood memory got passed onto my own children for them to experience!

Came here in the afternoon on a hot hot summer day. Ordered a large halo halo. Man theres a lot of strange things in here but its soo good. The black sesame ice cream was very creamy as well. Service was a little slow but other than that, will come here again
There was a week where my next door neighbors and I came here every night. Great ice cream, novelties, exotic flavors and floats!! Also the owner and staff are so friendly.

I picked up some desserts to bring to a friend and they were amazing! The peanut butter chocolate ganache cake - holy moly! Italian cream - *chef's kiss.* Macaroons - amazing! Everything I got was delicious.
Sooooo many choices. The line is long. But it moves at a decent pace. Worth the wait. Delicious ice cream.

Wow! Don't waste your time or the calories. Pick up a pack of Nestle Tollhouse cookies and you'll be thanking yourself. I saw this place debuted on Netflix recently. It seemed so fresh and homemade. There is noting homemade or fresh about anything you buy or try here. Mass produces garbage . They chef who created this place should be ashamed of herself. Disgusting, simply put

I've eaten a lot of desserts in my day, and Milk Bar was nothing special. For all the hype they receive, it did not have me craving anything more after a couple bites of several of their cookie flavors. The demand seems high, as the lines were long and this inflates the prices as well. They've done a good job with branding and marketing, but the flavors fall short of expectation. Best, Charlie
Really nice, upbeat staff. Delicious salted caramel cupcake! Chocolate cupcake was delicious. The cupcake ATM is sooooocool. Not a huge fan of their ice cream though.

We've been meaning to get to the Creamery for awhile and today was our chance....such a great experience! Their flavors are fantastic and really unique. Super friendly. The boyfriend loved the different sorbets they had available. We will definitely be back!

You must go to this place! There are 12 different flavors of ice cream! Their specialty is to make a ice cream sandwich using a warm donut. I got a scoop of the German chocolate cake ice cream and scoop of the snickerdoodle cupcake with Cinnamon Toast Crunch topping in a donut! Counting down the days until I go back to try something else!
I love the selection Donut Bar have to offer. It's great for all occasion and especially gifting it. Well, the truth is, they're delicious and sometime just to beautiful to eat.

I have been wanting to try this bakery since I found out they opened one out here. I grabbed a cannoli and lobster tail. Both were good but my only comment was the custard filling in the lobster tail wasn't what I expected - more like alcohol? if that's how it should be then it was good but like I mentioned not what I was expecting and wasn't a fan. Only other issue would be the organization of the lines.

Wow this place was incredible! I'm not usually a fan of ice cream over gelato, but the ice cream here is pretty phenomenal. On top of that the creativity in the dishes they create is amazing. I got both the caramel and the peppermint ice creams in the s'mores cup. This means it got whipped cream, chocolate sauce, and they toast a homemade marshmallow on top right in front of you. The resulting photo is proof of this delectable masterpiece. Tip: S'mores normally comes with two scoops of chocolate ice cream but you can choose whatever kind you want.

I've just recently grown fond of Parisan macarons, so Thomas Keller's little creations were in order. The bakery doesn't provide a sitting area, but it's a great place for a quick grab and go. Showcasing countless selections of morning pastries and snacks, it was difficult choosing only a limited few. Between the 3 of us, we walked away with a slice of pesto, tomato, & feta foccacia bread, pistachio macaron, pear & apricot glazed bread pudding, strawberry croissant, mini chocolate bouchons, and a box of half dozen macarons for the flight home. $48 for everything was a major rapage, but well worth it. The pesto foccacia was very moist and flavorful, but a bit on the greasy side. Appropriate to indulge if you need to recover from a nasty hangover. Bread pudding was a major surprise, but the richness and density in each bite was overwhelmingly filling. I wish I could have stomached more, but at least my left overs lasted 2 days later and still tasted just as amazing. For the box of macarons, we had pistachio, raspberry, vanilla bean, lemon, mocha, & chocolate. Favorites listed that order as well. The texture is much more dense than what I'm used to, but the cream filling won me over. Not sure how many of these babies I can devour over a cup of coffee, but they're certainly a delectable treat. I'm curious to try the beignets and lemon tart during my next visit. The bakery is hidden right next to the Phantom Theater. Again, no seating available, so take your treats upstairs and hang out at the Coffee Bean.

I was very excited to go to Carlos Bakery on my trip to Vegas. I love going to pastry shops when I travel and bring home some goodies as souvenirs. Pastries: Generally, the pastries are pretty good and they have a lot of filling!!! *Cannoli - Pretty dam good *Eclair - So much filling. Yum! *Lobster tails - There were four flavors and I got the hazelnut and one other. *Cheesecake - I didn't try this but my friend said it was average. Cons: - There are no price tags. Don't over order! I ordered six items for a little over $40... - Out of the six items, I was missing one cannoli!! When I opened the box after I got back to my hotel room, there was one missing! - The service wasn't that great. Basically someone on an iPad will follow you around and you tell them what you want and they put it in their iPad. I asked what a couple of items were and the girl seemed so annoyed. Honestly, she was helping me for less than one minute and she seemed like she hated her job. I want to give them more stars because the pastries were pretty good but the service was not great and they forgot an item! If I'm being charged over $5 a pastry and is missing one, I don't know if I want to come back. Vegas has many other bakeries you can go to...
The best possible ice cream. The attention to detail is incredible and the caramel sauce on top is rich and buttery.

Finally was able to stop by, and I'm so happy I did!! They offer a wide variety of different baked goods and drinks. Everything was delicious! Although there's not much seating indoors, during the warmer season they have an outdoor garden in the back.
THE BEST ICE CREAM IN CLEVELAND! Hands down. Be sure to try their seasonal flavors: right now they've got coconut, mint cookies and cream and s'mores. AMAZING!!
Staff and the line was quick. I bought two cream puffs, two buttercream cupcakes and a sprinkled cookie. All were very mediocre. Won't be back. They have cute souvenirs though

Found this place after eating AYCE Sushi. There is always place for desert with me. I'll let you guess how I found this place. It was via Yelp. I was towing a trailer with my car on it so it was a little bit hard to manuver around the side streets GPS was taking me but when I found it, I just parked it right in the front. Their lot was not big enough for my truck and trailer. Plus that evening when I went, it was packed. I got the peanut butter chocolate ice cream sundae with whip cream. Man it was good and rich. I loved every last scoop of it. The pricing here is fantastic. Its not over priced at all. I almost thought the price was wrong for a second but it wasn't. Other then that, I will be coming back here 100% when I'm in Cleveland and want pretty damn good ice cream I've ever had.

I absolutely loved this place. I mean how can you go wrong, there is chocolate, ice cream, and every little caramel and fudge in-between. The chocolate is top notch as you would expect from Ghirardelli. The location for us was really convenient as well since it was just across the street (maybe a 10 min walk) away from the Bellagio where we were staying. The only one complaint I would have, and the reason I knocked off a point from this being a perfect 5 stars, is that I think $11.95 for a fudge brownie sundae no matter what the quality is a bit steep. But I digress, if you have a sweet tooth its most definitely worth a stop here to get your fix.
Super yummy!! I recommend. We got the halo halo. The taro ice cream was amazing. Maybe next time I will just get that! They were very sweet and helpful.

The ice cream is delicious but my review is more for the staff. They come across as rude and snobby.....is it asking to much for a greeting when you walk in the door even a slight smile?!?! The portion size is pathetic......the kid -sized scoops at other locations are bigger than their single scoop.

Big fat MEH. Would not visit again that's for sure. Service is unfriendly at best. Latte is well below average. The only thing saving this place from being 2 stars is the cheese Danish which was marginally better then a grocery store pastry. Line up at your own risk

I have been to both locations in Charlotte, I have never been disappointed by either location. AmÃ©lie's is decorated with a brilliant French touch and plays a pleasant music playlist while you are there. I started off with a cappuccino that was fantastic and perfectly frothy and followed that up with a Raspberry Tart as well as a delicious Macaroon. A must try!

Haven't been here in a while. Was greeted by the friendly pastry guy who was super nice. There was nobody in line and I'm an espresso lover. I asked the cashier about the differences between the espressos and she rolled her eyes and didn't answer my question. I paid tipped anyway cause I'm in the industry. maybe she's having a bad night and stressing over finals like me but a smile or a simple I'm not sure would have done it for me. The lady that called out my coffee to pick up was again super nice just like the pastry guy. Cashier with space buns needs an attitude adjustment but besides that coffee and pastries were delicious as ever! Yummm

Sadly, the hype did not live up to the expectation. I had Milk Bar in NYC before, but having it again in LV reminded me why I don't crave for these expensive sweets that are mediocre. Ordered: 1) Crack Pie: 2/5 Good but SO SMALL for the price! 2) Compost Cookie: 3.5/5 probably my favorite item on this list 3) Corn Cookie, 2.5/5 eh, just okay 4) Confetti Cookie: 2.5/5 a bit too sweet for me 5) Cereal Milk Soft Serve: 3/5 again, if it weren't for the price, I would've given it a much higher rating. Overpriced--bottomline.

Had a creme brulee and a caramel latte. The donuts were great. The creme brulee is a bit overrated. It's essentially a custard donut with a hard caramel coating. Good, but I was expecting something a little more eggy and dense in terms of the filling. The donuts are huge btw. not a bad thing but makes sampling difficult and pricey. Good for sharing. It's a little tight inside but there's plenty of patio seating in the back.

Meh. The desserts were okay. All I could taste was butter with a slight flavoring to the brownies. The macaroons were very chewy/ borderline stale. The mini chocolate- Irish coffee flavored thing was delicious. If I returned, those would be my first and only choice for the options. Everything else looked delicious. I must have gone at a strange time to have the experience I did. I have hopes the other items had a better flavor profile.

stopped at coffee stand for cappuccino. coffee just average. Nothing special. Croissant tasted "day old". Sold out of ham and cheese croissants. Staff was clueless and inefficient. So I went over to restaurant to purchase items to go and stood at the bar for 10 minutes only to be ignored by the bar staff. I went to Bouchon's in Napa and it was wonderful. Won't be back here and I don't recommend either Bouchon's in Vegas. Disappointed!

I heard about this place from a friend and how they have the best Halo Halo in Phoenix. I may not be the best point of reference because I only had Halo Halo once or twice in my life so I don't know if I had the best baseline. Upon walking in the shop, I was warmly greeted by the workers. I was the only one in the shop and get offered to answer any questions I had. They have a vast array of ice cream. They do not make their own ice cream but buys from a local ice cream supplier. If you want options for both traditional and slightly different flavors, I definitely recommend coming here. Additionally, they have shave ice and other specialty desserts, like Halo Halo. I ordered the Halo Halo and eating it was like a party in my mouth. So many textures and flavors in one dessert. No component was too sweet or an odd texture. It all worked together really well. Overall, it was a balanced dessert. The dessert comprises of shave ice, jellies, beans, nuts, and a cookie straw. The best part? The taro ice cream! It was flavorful and rich! I would go back just for the ice cream! I don't even really know all of the ingredients but I just remember it being really good. The dessert was around 6 dollars, which I was totally fine with because it goes to supporting local businesses. I recommend giving them a try because they are good people with a good business!
It looks pretty, but taste alright. It was just a little bit to sweet for me. I got the rocky road ice cream on the red velvet cone and it tasted like diabetes.

I ate here all the time when I used to live in this neighborhood, but now drive all the way from Downtown to get their bread, pre-made foods, and pastries. In addition, it's a very relaxing place to enjoy some coffee while reading the paper. My go-to thank you gift is a box of their cookies - they are truly splendid!

I drove up the street chasing my sweet tooth and glad this is where it brought me. I mean holy baked goodness this place has arguably the best cake in Pittsburgh. Rich, sweet, layered, tasty and real. Sweet baby Jesus, just thinking about it makes me sad I left a bite on the plate. DONT YOU JUDGE ME. Just kidding judge away, after a hefty meal, this slice is a sharer. Taking on a slice on your own is only if you have the room after dinner or whatever. Running you around $7 for a slice, these cakes are clearly made the old-fashion way and with real ingredients- No preservatives, no bullshit. They have vegan options, which offends me because that's food discrimination, but I got over it shortly after my taste-buds simultaneously cried little tears of joy in my mouth. I tasted 3 different cakes but the one I devoured was the Pistachio, creme something something. I forgot the name because I blacked out from a flavor coma. WORTH EVERY PENNY. The place also has plenty of coffee options cold-press, espresso,lattes, mochas etc etc etc. (I had a cold press which was perfect bitter counter to the sweet cake.)The environment is cool but no way of browsing a menu for what you want to drink and if you ask the lady behind the counter she will be smart and snippy with you. A real negative Nancy. Good thing I couldn't remember her after I blacked out from how good the cake she gave me was.

What a perfect way to begin a morning, with Donuts from the Donut Bar!! The staff is always friendly, donuts are amazingly delicious, fresh and I love the creativity in trying new combinations. The Blue Moon is my personal favorite so far, I find myself checking Donut Bar Las Vegas on Facebook to see what tomorrows menu will be since it is always different. Once they are gone they are gone for the day so I recommend getting here early especially on weekend's for best selection and street parking is free before 8am. Enjoy and Happy Yelping!

This is a cute little stand in the Venetian Hotel. We came here at about 8am in the morning specifically for their macarons. My current obsession is this light, chewy little cookie. I ordered the caramel, coffee, red velvet and my friend ordered the vanilla and chocolate. She wanted to see why I was making such a big deal about these cookies. Bouchon's macarons are bigger than the normal macarons and hence the price tag of $3.50. So far, these are the best macarons in the US I've had since returning from Paris. The cookie has a nice consistency and the center has a slight chewiness. It's like a sweet party in your mouth. My friend tried them and her exact words were "oh, now I see what you're talking about, these things are delicious!" I definitely plan to return here to try the other macaron flavors when I return to Vegas!

This place is a must see! We got to freemont looking for some caffiene and ran into this awesome place. We had the Creme Brulee and Twix donuts and they were amazing. The staff was super nice and our coffee hit the spot. There little bar-like seating and a cool fish tank with copies of real donuts in there. Definitely making this stop every visit to Vegas!
Anything I have ever eaten from here has been delicious. The cavatelli & meatballs, pizza, ALL of the bakery!!! You really can't go wrong here.

One out of two of my favorite places to satisfy my sweet tooth cravings at the Las Vegas strip. They have a wide variation of desserts. From macaroons, croissants, Kouign Amann, cookies, pan au chocolate, muffins to cream puffs. The macaroons are my personal favorite. Overall, Bouchon Bakery is the place to go.

You guys, VEGAN DOUGHNUTS...like actual doughnuts. My family and I went on Sunday (my birthday), and we got a dozen of mixed flavors. My favorite was the maple coconut bacon flavor, and my boyfriend's favorite was the blueberry. The lemon lavender was unique and tasty as well. The shop is decorated SO cute - I love all the plants. We traveled from an hour away, and we were not disappointed. =] delish!
We love this place. They got great boba and you can also adjust the sugar level to your liking. Ice cream looks delicious might try it next time. But definitely recommend the Thai tea boba :)

Connect to Page's FB or IG and be sure not to miss the fresh, seasonal blueberry soft serve. It's my absolute favorite soft serve and I look forward to it every season. Blueberry is so popular that they'll only sell it in the small and medium sizes. The ice cream is more on the creamy side and Page's is generous with the toppings. The line is always wrapped around the building but moves quickly. The employees are friendly and efficient. Cash only. Parking is a nightmare but doesn't deter my visits. Happy 70th Birthday Page Dairy Mart!

I love this place! Great customer service, always a friendly and helpful face! Their desserts are to die for! They have so many flavors of macaroons and the cheesecake.. don't get me started! An overall great establishment

Love love love their Napoleon sheet cake. Best I've found in charlotte. It's quite large wish it was a bit smaller. For calorie purpose. Everything is quite pricey but worth it. Also tried the macaroons relish. Also a nice place to hang well if we didn't have the kids.

We came here on a Wednesday as we were leaving Cleveland. There was no line and we got our order pretty quick. We ordered the Smoke Salmon crepe and loved it! Too bad we don't live in the area. Otherwise, we would be returning to try items on the menu! Guy was friendly. Love the place!

"CARROT CAKE WHOOPIE PIE!!!" That's right Michelle T, I'm stealing another one of your openings. Whatcha gonna do about it, punk? This Bouchon Bakery is located at the Venetian Hotel, right underneath an escalator. In reality, this is not really a bakery but more of a small stand that sells Bouchon pastries. It's no bigger than a Starbucks you'd find inside a grocery store. Even though it's small they still have a good amount of baked goods. They have things like macarons, cookies, breads, sandwiches, pain au chocolat, muffins, bread pudding and more. They also sell coffees and other drinks. After our brunch at the Bouchon restaurant upstairs, my wife and I stopped by the bakery to get some goodies to go. Since we ate a big brunch, we only bought a few items. This is what we bought; Carrot Cake Whoopie Pie yelp.com/biz_photos/aT_S¦ Caramel Macaron yelp.com/biz_photos/aT_S¦ Nutter Butter Cookie Sandwich yelp.com/biz_photos/aT_S¦ All three treats were really good, especially the carrot cake whoopee pie, which was one of the best tasting carrot cake treats I've ever tried. The caramel macaron was not the best I've had but it was still really good. The same thing can be said about their nutter butter cookie sandwich. The prices are good and the service is fast and friendly. If you like Bouchon's baked goods, or if you're a Bouchon virgin, then this little stand is worth checking out.

Really good cakes and pastries. The service was quick and the staff were on point! It gets busy there (located in Shanghai Plaza) so it was great that we didn't have to wait too long to get to the cashier. You can sit at one of the tables they have there and eat. Good quality and delicious! And we got a free coffee through their app! Can't wait to visit again :)

I used sprinkles cupcake ATM. The line inside didn't seem to be moving very fast. I purchased a vanilla cupcake for $4.25 a little on the steep side for a cupcake, but then again it is Vegas. I'm not sure how fresh the cupcake was? Seemed a few days old, but it was a basic vanilla cupcake. Not a whole lot to write home about. It had a TON of frosting, had to scrape some off to enjoy the cupcake. Cute, trendy, travel friendly packaging.

I came here one night and tried the butter pecan, it was far too salty. I like butter pecan ice cream but instead of a hint of salt, it tasted like salty ice cream. I also don't like the idea of standing in a line outside during the summer. The service was great and the line move quickly.

4.5 stars... Had to bump this rating up. The caramel brownie is DIVINE! I'm sitting here nibbling on it since its too good to eat all at once and wallow in misery after finishing it. Try at least once, seriously.

We had the lobster tail, cupcake and towers. My littles had the Oreo and strawberry shortcake towers. My son a lobster tail and cupcake. I think you expect so much after watching buddy on tv all these years that no one could ever live up to the hype. We thought they were good and now we have a story to tell. Luckily we waited just a few minutes. We got there around 9:30 am. FYI buddy opened up a restaurant across from bakery. You can order Canolis and a few other deserts there. You might pay a little more but worth it if the line is long. The restaurant Called buddy v's rocks! Best lasagna and meatballs we've ever had! We also loved their calamari best to 2nd best we ever had. Parmesan chicken yummy too. Free Rosemary bread dipped in olive oil and Parmesan good too. We'll definitely go back. They have a lunch express for $22 Appetizer, main dish and Canolis! Gotta try buddy v's his food is so yummy!

I have been wanting to try this place for a few months and today I finally made it in. So happy I did. I had a small scoop of the matcha ice cream with fruity pebbles mixed in and it was DELICIOUS. I didn't get her name but the sweet young lady that helped me was very knowledgeable and suggested I get the matcha coffee. She was even kind enough to Google items that we were unsure had gluten in it. I really appreciated her assistance and I will definitely go back again! Oh yeah and I got two matcha coffees. One for the ride home to Sahuarita and one for tmrw morning.

I did expect better. I've seen the reviews, seen the chef on tv, and even went back twice. But all three items didn't ever call me back. The crack pie made me believe I could easily quit crack. It was forgettable. The birthday cake shake was not the party I was expecting. And the compost cookie was not even as good as Panera's Kitchen sink cookie. Too bad because I really wanted to like this place as it's location is awesome and the help is great there! I'll be back at the Cosmo, and when I do, hopefully, they'll have something new for me too try.

This place is so tasty! Really beautiful presentation and even better taste!! The owners are really friendly and made us feel at home when we went in. I definitely recommend this bakery if you're looking for quality desserts in concord.
The donuts here are beautiful & tasty! Cool atmosphere. Friendly & helpful staff. Bonus, while we were here, some cops came in, so you know it's a kickin' spot!

I had high hopes for this place. When I first entered it was really clean and service folks were really nice. I ended up grabbing the strawberry shortcake (one size only). When I was rung up I thought it was a mistake but it was over $7 (seemed expensive). Once they made my order I dove right in. The fresh fruit was nice and the ice cream it self had a mix of graham crackers inside which gave it a unique crunch. While it tasted ok, I wasn't super impressed and given the price I was less than thrilled. Don't think I'll be returning.

This place use to be good. Their cookie cup was the best. But the new owner decided to change it to a cheaper version; just one macaron instead of two and two sorry scoops of ice cream. But she decided to keep the prices the same. I miss the enthusiastic kids that used to greet you when you walked in. So long fatty daddy's

not the BEST cookies I've had, but for a packaged cookie. YES. really really good and the employee that helped us out was so nice! ( sorry i didn't catch the name), but it was more towards closing time. I know they are famous for the compost cookie, which I wasn't a fan of. it had a very weird acquired taste and I can see why people would like it, but not my type of cookie. I think my favorite had to be the blueberries & cream and confetti. the chocolate on chocolate was good, hint of salt, but too much 'cocoa' for my liking. the marshmallow one was pretty good too! but, it would have to come in 3rd. overall, they were pretty decently fresh tasting for a packaged cookie and to satisfy a craving, or a few. I'm not the one to judge. I also wanted to try the soft serve, the employee gave me a legit sample. wasn't just a small serving, it was pretttty much a large heaping sample. he said 'oops sorry, accidentally overdid it'. hahaha. i'm not complaining. i love samples that aren't on the stingy side. thank you :)

I feel slightly terrible because when I went in here I ordered a cupcake (from Grandma Freda's!) and then proceeded to nosh on free popcorn samples for 15 minutes. It's free popcorn...don't judge me! I have zero complaints about Campbell's. Every flavor I tried, which was EVERY flavor, was delicious. The staff here is really helpful too. Favorite flavors include vanilla butternut and the dichotomy. Everything else is good, but not as good as these two.

I must be honest, I was hesitant at first to try this place. I can't pronounce the name, I was sure that it was a glorified Panera. However, a friend of mine asked me to meet him there, so I obliged. When I first walked in, I loved the eclectic style that was everywhere with the mismatched furniture that all just effortlessly "went" together. The place was packed and so was the pastry display case. My mouth was watering as soon as I walked in. The sweet and savory smells that waft throughout the entire venue are irresistable. I had the portabella and leek soup with a hot chocolate. Incredible! The goat cheese gave it an extra layer of flavor that just made the soup so perfect and the hot chocolate was real chocolate with steamed milk. It is the kind of food you crave when you are looking for comfort after a bad day. Since that first experience, I do try to go back as often as I can. The salted caramel brownies are amazing and they even have the recipe online for people to try. This establishment really shows what true craftsmanship and quality should be like within the food industry and I always feel like their number one customer!
Mmmmmmm icecreammmm... The ice cream was creamy, sweet. Best ice cream I've had in town. I had a ice cream sandwich with a chocolate chip cookie and a brownie. It was a mixture of deliciousness. :)

Overrated and too expensive for what it is. The only thing I enjoyed was the toasted marshmallow and the macaroon. The ice cream was bland and not that creamy. I tasted a number of different options that all tasted like bland soggy cereal. Staff was very patient with me during the tasting.

I went for two buck tuesday at around 3, so there were many kids and their parents in line since they had just gotten off school. Two registers were open. I asked the cashier at mine if I could try a flavor (whatever the monthly special was) and he said "we're not doing taste tests because of the super long line." I hear another customer ask for a sample to the other cashier, and she says yes. I just comply with what my cashier told me and get my usual flavor, salted caramel. I ask for it in a cone but to also give me a cup since salted caramel is usually very melty. He gives me the ice cream, I pay, then walk off. I finally decide to look at the receipt when I get home and find that he charged an extra quarter for the cone. For some reason, I thought cones were included in two buck tuesday. Maybe it's because i asked for it with a cup. Anyhow, i won't be coming back to this handel's on a tuesday because the cashiers seem moody.

Amazing late night snack!!!! My boyfriend and I came here on first Friday last months. The customer service was so pure, I could tell they really cared about their customers. The ice cream itself was rich! I would recommend getting the donut/waffle sandwich.

My friend introduced me to this place a month ago or so, and it is by far my favorite ice cream shop. The employees are always super friendly and efficient, but most importantly their ice cream is the best thing ever. I always order something different and have yet to try anything that didn't love. Y'ALL NEED THIS IN YOUR LIFE.

It's not healthy, and they aren't trying to hide it. The ice cream is actually quite superb. Loses 1 star for the usually dismal service, amount of eye rolling and just general lack of caring by staff. I'm not sure if this a managerial problem, but many times the place will be PACKED and you will have one person tending to customers, and the other one will be making ice cream sandwiches or something equivalently unnecessary (when you can see a refrigerator full of sandwiches that are not being eaten). You can ask to try the ice creams, but don't expect them to be happy about it. I've taken to not getting ice cream anymore and ordering the chocolate covered frozen banana. It's still really tasty and I assume a little bit healthier?

Before going I assumed this place would be overrated, but I was so wrong. It's a great mix of classic and inventive flavors. I'm not a goat cheese fan but I have gotten the goat cheese with red cherries several times! Also do not sleep on the waffle cones - SO worth it. The line looks crazy long most days, but moves fast. Jeni's re-sparked my love of ice cream and continues to change the game while still perfecting classics.

Went on a Friday around 9:30 am. Waited in line for about 30-45 mins. to order then waited about another 15 mins. for them to pack my goodies and pay. I ordered the dark chocolate mousse cake, cannoli, lobster tails, and strawberry cheesecake. If I had to rank the goodies I got in order from my favorite being the first, it would have to be dark chocolate mousse cake, lobster tails, strawberry cheesecake and then the cannoli's. If you like dark chocolate like me, you will definitely love the dark chocolate mousse cake. Wish I had me a piece right now.
Awsome customer service. Love the the french macaroon. They let u try ice cream and r not rude about it.

It was a pleasant surprise to see Sprinkles while walking the Linq Promenade. It was the perfect stop for our dessert. We didn't use the ATM but ordered inside since it wasn't busy. The coconut and sprinkle cupcakes were good but not the best. They actually fall on the average side on the scale of cupcake ratings. The service was quick and friendly though. I'll try the ice cream next time, especially after reading a review about the red velvet waffle cone.

The cookies and pastries are delicious. Prices a little higher than others I have tried. But for great tasting and homemade goodies your going to pay a little more.!!!..... but I love everything that I have tried.
Ice cream is over priced and they advertise macaroons that they rarely have. The location is very hidden so make sure you pay attention. There isn't much signage.
Something hard came out of the milk bread and I see two pieces look like hard unmelted butter! I hope they make their bakeries with more quality!!!!

They have a good selection. I love that theire Macarons are bigger than usual and box of 6 for 17.50! The eclairs was also good, but not super amazing. I also got the chocolate tart and the pecan tart... The only thing awesome here is the macarons just grab at least one!

We stopped in while visiting to get some donuts before we headed out for the day. We had a hard time deciding which ones to try. I tried the peanut butter and jelly donut and it tasted just like a peanut butter and jelly sandwich! It was a bit messy to eat but so totally worth it! My husband got the hot dog donut which looked like a hot dog but tasted like a regular Long John. I would definitely make a stop back here if we lived closer

It was mediocre at best. The chocolate cake tasted very dry, reminded me of a little Debbie devils food cake. We also got a vanilla cookie nothing to write home about. The sugar cookie tasted like the Christmas cookies in a tin from my childhood . We wanted to be fans but sadly no dice! I have two stars because the employees were so very nice and helpful!
So cute you even serve yourself the bread pastries but they give you cold ones so good and tasty though i reccomend 100%

Love love love homemade ice cream! This place really does remind me of a local one back home with the exception you can see the production floor behind the counter when you place your order! How cool is that!?!?! The ice cream is very fresh and very flavorful for sure! I absolutely love the creamy,tasty texture melt in your mouth ice cream Mitchells offers you for sure! Support your local homemade ice cream places where ever you are! There really isn't anything like them! I'm a fan and I'll be back here for sure!

Novel has the best name because that is exactly what it is. It unique and special and like nothing else. The ice cream is really to die for, or kill for if necessary. Then of all things they take the deliciousness and place it between two halves of a warm decadent donut. right? It's a cute tiny shop with a lot to offer. Super customer service the peeps running this show are very cool, and not just cause there is ice cream in there. Don't be a dumb and miss your chance for a mouth pleaser!

Although quite pricey, the cannoli sampler was awesome! It reminded me of this little hole in the wall spot back in Boston that locals kept to themselves about to avoid the touristy hype. The cookie I got was kind of dry and crumbly - I prefer the soft and chewy cookies. Would go back just for the cannolis.

Place is small but the flavors and selections are huge. They use choice ingredients which becomes apparent in your first taste. Good luck trying to figure out which item to get because they are all so good. The crew behind the counter does an excellent job taking and preparing your orders too.
I wish I can eat there every morning. Very delicious pastries and sandwiches, good espresso drinks. Has outside sitting.

Really good food all around. The pastries are to die for, but they also have really good breakfast sandwiches. I love the eclairs and the tarts. The prices are really reasonable and the service is very friendly. My advice is to get there early in the morning when the bread has been freshly baked.

So, when can we get one in Detroit? We stumbled upon this place after going to West Side Market and even though we were both stuffed, we decided to stop for a scoop of ice cream. Best choice ever! They're got a nice selection of ice cream and it's served at the best temperature...slightly melty so you can taste all of the flavors. I had the double chocolate which had massive slices of chocolate in it! In addition to having great ice cream, the shop is super cute and you can even sit and watch people make the ice cream in the back.
They stopped allowing dogs on their patio. Now I have no reason to go because it's just overpriced ice cream.
Great place with awesome ice cream. Everything is fresh and hand made. Staff is super friendly too. Seating outside and unfortunately in direct sun (in the afternoon). A must try place.

This review is short and lacking photos because I ate my dessert too fast to take a photo. The cereal milk ice cream with cornflake really does taste like you're having cereal milk except obviously sweeter and obviously way better because sweeter always equals better in my humble opinion. The milk bar pie. Y'all. If you like pecan pie, you'll love this because it tastes similar to the filling of a pecan pie. Sans pecans. It's so good and I was embarrassed at how quickly I finished it. Also-DONT SLEEP ON THE COOKIES. My husband loves the birthday cake one as do I, I'm just more of a compost cookie kind of gal (graham cracker base, pretzels, potato chips, coffee, oats and butterscotch). I'm originally from NY and used to frequent milk bar when I lived there. There's no difference in taste/quality/service at this one. So if you're in the mood for dessert while you're in Vegas (which for me that's constantly) do yourself a favor and go here!

Great spot for really good milkshakes. Places promise a good shake and we are usually disappointed. Not here, in fact we come here too often because they are so good. They also have baked good, pies etc. Every item has been delicious.

Big portions, cheap price, friendly servers, indulgent flavors---not much more you can ask for from a dessert shop. They have unique ice cream and cookie dough flavors in the shop for you to try, and also many cupcakes and other small treats.
This place is another good desert place with lots of options for ice creams, custards, sundaes!

Cuteeeeeee Cafe. Open 24hours. Visiting in town with some friends , we just weren't ready to go home yet . So we swung by the cafe - adored the pastries and got a few drinks. I tried the French salted Carmel soda. It tasted like cream soda but i wasn't upset. Came back the very next night with some friends. My husband said it was the best blueberry muffin he ever had. He ordered one to take back to the hotel lol

Love this place!!! The flavors are always so unique! I especially love the white rose, lavender, and earl grey. The service is always good. They are one of the only places I have ever been to outside of japan that has good matcha ice cream. I would recommend sweet republic to anyone who's looking for something a little more interesting than your classic vanilla.

When you think of Italian bakery...your first thought should be this place! Probably the best pastries I have had in a very long time and the wait shows how much everyone loves this place too! We ordered the Stromboli and a slice of pizza along with many pastries to go. The service was friendly and quick. The food was delicious!!! I only wish we lived across the street and could go to this place almost everyday!! If in Little Italy this is a place I think everyone must try and take something home for later!
AWE-MAZING!!! Great homemade treats for the whole family. Even the vegan coconut ice cream was incredible. Cookies were fresh and yummy too!

What a hidden treasure! This spot used to be another doughnut shop and closed down. I've tried the churro and original beignets. Omg they are like heaven! So good! Light and airy, it's the perfect amount of dough to sweetness on the outside. I had a chance to meet one of the owners, very very nice! The own staff was nice as well. I'm certain with the desserts they offer and fabulous coffee, they will be here to stay!

Place This place was an order and go kind of deal. The aesthetics of the place was really nice with the neon lights and all. Service The service was pretty good and was patient with my indecisiveness. Food/price $ The ice cream was pretty good! I got the chocolate birthday cake. I heard from my friend that this place was better than blank slate back in Ann Arbor and I have to say I still like blank slate as my number 1 ice cream store! Milk has good quantity and definitely fills you up. Audience Great for everyone! I went with friends. Recommendation/tips? I would get a water cup because it's hard to find water in that hotel. Plus water bottles are $7
Great atmosphere - 24/7 love the food/Dessert

They are not as good as they were a year ago. I didn't see the usual baking crew, and there were no vegan donuts left. When I went the first time over a year ago, the trays were loaded, with more on the way. Several people walked out without buying anything so I followed them.It just didn't have the same lively upscale vibes as before.I imagine the former bakers moved onto a different situation. Still baking, I hope.

Visited this cute ice cream shop that is attached to Windsor. I love the variety of flavors that they have! You are able to sample anything that you'd like. I got a single split scoop of the Almond Joy and the chocolate mint. You can also add toppings like toasted marshmallow fluff as well. The ice cream is delicious and extremely flavorful. I highly recommend coming here especially after having a meal at Windsor.
Came here when I was staying at the cosmo The prices are very fair. The ice cream is pretty good Does really taste like milky flavor I'll be back soon

My family loves this place! Literally the best ice cream and donuts anywhere in the state. The owner is so fudging cool, when you can catch him, he really enjoys taking to his customers and finding out all about your foodie commonalities lol He told me all about his journey to see his business come to life and it was amazing to know how much pride and effort he takes to give us the absolute best of the best! Seriously though don't hesitate to stop by, I know the shop is a little tight and it can be super duper busy most nights but I promise it's like so worth it (:

Tasty, creamy, nutty, and smooth were the words my mom used to describe the Maple Pecan ice cream Creamy, salty, sweet and smooth was how my husband described the Salted Butter Caramel ice cream. Aaaaaaahhhhhh-mazing is how I would describe the basil lime sorbet. Fresh, light, sweet, and just the right amount of sugary goodness. I asked the woman behind the counter for the igredients and she said basil, lime, ice and sugar. I ate it on one of the tiny little spoons and savored every little bite. I know that I will be back during my next visit to AZ to visit mom b/c I still can't stop thinking about that darn sorbet. Kudos to you Sweet Republic. Kudos on creating a solid, additive and preservative free - "whole foods" approach to sweet desserts! YUM!

I'm glad that Sprinkles made its way to Las Vegas. I first tried them in Phoenix and really enjoyed the taste of the cupcake. Each day they carry about a dozen flavors with a couple that rotate. Most of the flavors are standard like vanilla, chocolate, red velvet, lemon, and carrot. The special flavors that are on rotation are more exciting like key lime, meringue, and margarita. The rotating flavors are why I return. The actual cakes are good. The cake part is moist and delicious. I like the flavor of the frosting and the amount of frosting on each cupcake. I also like that they have a standard cupcake design with the simple sugar dot in the middle. This location also has a cupcake ATM. Awesome! I get that they are just filling this from inside the building, but it's a novelty and I am easily amused by this novelty. Of course this is how we opted to have our cupcake dispensed to us last time we visited. It really fits in with the fun, youthful vibe of The Linq.

Came from LA to visit a friend and found this cute Ice Cream shop on yelp. Such a good decision. The ice cream was so good and refreshing. Also the service was so great. Very friendly staff and they really know their ice cream! Definitely will be stopping by again before we head back home! HIGHLY RECOMMEND!

We were referred here by friends, or at least I think they were friends. What a disappointment. Seriously, if you want good ice cream, go to the grocery store and buy some pints of Talenti. It's much better ice cream at a much more reasonable price. And chances are the grocery store clerks will treat you better than the staff at Churn. Mediocre ice cream at high prices with lousy staff and very limited seating. I see that Mikey R. had the same thoughts on 5/16/20, although Mikey was much more generous with his ratings. I had coconut gelato and lemon gelato. I've eaten gelato around the world, and this was the worst gelato I have ever eaten. Never again.

This place is just a window in the wall in South summerlin where you can get pretty great ice cream. There are so many unique flavors here it's hard to choose. But it's ok because you can get the sampler which is a plastic box with your choice of 4 flavors. So far my favorites are strawberry cheesecake, chocolate malt, and coconut cream pie. I was recommended Graham Central station and I didn't really care for it. Monkey business looked good, but it didn't impress me too much because it kinda had a weird aftertaste that bugged me a little. Overall it's a super cool place, nowhere really to sit down, but some pretty amazing ice cream at a pretty amazing price.
Best coconut cupcake I've ever had. Great Strawberry, carrot cake, and chocolate cupcakes as well. Visited their new Orlando, Fl location but couldn't score a cupcake due to the extremely long line.

This is the only place to find matcha soft serve in North Carolina. Trust me I have looked. There are days when the matcha soft serve is grainy but most of the time is nice, creamy and rich! The ube is also a favorite of mine. I also highly recommend the addition of mochi balls (very chewy- the perfect texture to pair with silky soft serve.) The drinks are good but the soft serve is what they're known for. I live in RTP area but every time I visit Charlotte I always make sure to stop by. 10/10 would recommend if you like matcha and/or soft serve.

SOOO WONDERFUL! I am a nursing student so late night cafes with delicious coffee and even better sugary confections are exactly what I need! The atmosphere is really eclectic and homey and I can spend hours there just getting my work done. Made a few study buddy friends and, although it can get PACKED in a hurry, the people are really great about sharing space. If you haven't been there YOU MUST GO!

Finally,was able to try their halo-halo which I was dreaming of for quite a while.. It's a distance from where I live, but since my grandson was in town visiting and wanted halo-halo--- we then drove 30 minutes just to get there. It was not a disappointment! It's a family owned store. Gina and her daughter were very accommodating! Her daughter who was taking orders was very considerate with what my grandson requested for his halo-halo. I also got us gulaman & taho & the frozen pork BBQ (which I found cheaper & fresher than the oriental stores). We took it to go and my grandson was eating his halo-halo on our way home but just kept on saying that it was really the BEST halo-halo he has tasted!!! Definitely will be going back & driving that distance just to get our craving satisfied...

This place was kinda cool and had lots of fancy looking treats. The menu isn't really anywhere you can see while standing in line though. We got the boo berry milkshake with the edible rim and it looked yummy but the shake was pretty bland. Not sure if all the shakes taste that bland but for how much they are they should promote other flavors for shakes beside vanilla. I do love cereal in milkshakes though. It's my favorite!

Date & Time: Monday July 31, 2017 @ 1am Dining Companions: Cousins & Husband Scene: Guys in Fitted Tee's, Shorts & Sneakers & Girls in Crop Tops, Short Denim Cut-Off's, Hermes "H" Belt, Flat Strappy Sandals Decor: Cute Pink & White Ice Cream Stand Service: Friendly, Efficient w/ Awesome Asian Manager Imbibe: Green Juice Devour: Cereal Soft-Serve Total: $20
Delicious doughnuts! Get there early if you want good flavors. Before they only accepted cash but they now accept credit cards.

A Champaign institution! I bring all my out-of-town relatives and friends here when they visit during the spring and summer. It's one of those things that lets you know that summer really is on its way; when Custard Cup opens up in the spring, it gives you a sense of hope that winter may, at some point, end. All the flavors and toppings are delicious. Summer evenings, it's THE place to be, and there always seems to be plenty of outdoor seating despite the crowds.
Creamy and delicious. Sometimes there is a great water park nearby. Highly recommend for families.

I'm 8 weeks and a couple days pregnant, so I thought Vegas would be sort of a bust without the drinking and partying Super Bowl weekend. I was pleasantly surprised when I walked into Sloan's!! On my second night there, my man and I split a sundae. We had great cookies and cream ice cream, but the strawberry was TO DIE FOR. I knew I had to try a shake the next day and boy did it deliver! Literally the best strawberry I've ever had in my life. This store has tons of cute things to buy from socks to candy and they have a TON of different ways to get your ice cream fix. They have regular cones and cups, but also have a ton of different sundae options and if you have a lot of people, they even have an actual kitchen sink full of amazing ice cream! The staff is really sweet and friendly too! Can't wait to go back and try more

People often ask me if my intention is to write about everywhere I eat or if I eye new products as material for my blog, the answer is 'yes,' and 'no.' I write about restaurants that I enjoy that are doing things differently than the pack and I write about products that for one reason or another catch my attention. (I often avoid places and products that are either mass market or who it seems everyone 'else' has written about). That being said, there's a little ice cream shop located in a shopping center at the North West corner of Shea boulevard and 92nd street in Scottsdale called Sweet Republic that has gotten my attention. I've heard quite a bit of buzz from Phoenix foodies, have seen Sweet Republic featured on television and have eaten their creations on several occasions. In all, my experiences have been quite good. There are several flavors including salted caramel and a mint ice cream made with locally sourced ingredients that I enjoy but when I overheard that there was a BACON ice cream on the weekends for those in the know, I had to try it! (my love of bacon and/or butter has been painfully well documented). I dropped by the Republic one Friday night and picked up a pint of 'I Heart Bacon,' and giddily headed home (after a generous spoonful as a taste of course). What to do, what to do? This ice cream wasn't just something to be devoured whilst on the couch watching some sitcom or docu-drama. No 'I Heart Bacon' must be savored...it must be enjoyed, it must be painted onto a canvas which can allow it's salty porkyness, to shine. A stroke of pure genius hit me, I'd combine two of my favorite things in a new way, breakfast and dessert. Bacon ice cream topped Belgian waffles! Why hasn't this been done previously (and if it has, why have I not had the pleasure of eating it?) A friend offered to whip up a batch of waffles whilst I provided the ice cream and what followed was one of the tastiest breakfasts I've had in a while. Hot, fluffy waffles with a big scoop of 'I heart Bacon' ice cream melting in the center, drizzled with maple syrup will melt your heart and make your stomach smile. The combination of sweet cream ice cream, salty bits of chewy bacon and little crunchy mapley surprises went perfectly with each bite of waffle. Each mouthful produced smiles as I enjoyed the contrast between the hot waffle and cold ice cream, the soft, smooth texture of the ice cream and the chewiness of the bacon. I was really blown away by how good it all was. If you're not one to try new things or if you prefer to sit at the table of normalcy then this is not for you. If however, you fancy a little creativity in your mouth, head on over to Sweet Republic for a scoop, cup, cone or pint of something special. If you REALLY want an over the top experience, pull out that waffle iron, grab some 'I heart bacon' ice cream, a little maple syrup and dig in...you won't regret it!

This place was pretty darn awesome. They put your ice cream in a Chinese to go box type deal with a fortune cookie on top. The flavors are different. I got ether pb and j or peanut butter. I don't remember but for some reason I didn't realize there was going to be jelly in there and I didn't like that. I'm not a big fan of jelly though so don't go off of that. Outside of me not liking jelly, it was really good. There store is small and cute. Definitely a different vibe than I'm used to. Everyone should try this place at least once! I tried it while at first Friday in February. It's definitely buzzing during that time!
It makes you want to dance, its sooo goood! The flavors are seriously of this world

First of all, Jarling's custard cup is NOT custard. I assume it used to be custard at one time. It isn't anymore, but they've retained their name. The website clearly states that they serve "Ice Milk". "Our Product is Ice Milk. It has 30% less butterfat and cholesterol than traditional iced cream and contains no eggs." Try to make custard without eggs. Oh wait, you can't because eggs are one of the defining ingredients! If you have had real custard before, then just go to Jarling's knowing it's NOT custard, and it'll be okay. I went thinking it was custard and was disappointed. It all made sense when I found out the truth. I highly recommend the lemon flavor. We're used to lemon tasting artificial. Lemon meringue pie, lemon bars, lemonade, etc. all taste artificially sweet and like, well, lemon flavoring. That's why lemon tastes the best at Jarling's. You are used to and expect the artificial taste. The other flavors taste artificial (because the ingredients are), but they're not satisfying. Personally, I prefer natural strawberry flavor over artificial strawberry syrup. This applies to almost every flavor, except lemon! The waffle cones are generally good. The best part of going here is watching the employees create snowstorms and sundaes. You can see that they are using a freshly opened Snickers candy bar in your treat rather than scooping sitting pieces out of a bucket. TIP: If you don't want to wait in line, go on a rainy day!

Don't let the outside of the shop fool you - these are the best doughnuts I've had in a long time. I'm not a Cleveland local, so I don't know how they measure up to others in the area, but when I was visiting my friend and Jack Frost was honored with the "best doughnut in Cleveland," I knew I had to try it. I apologize for not knowing their true/real names (rather than asking, I just stared at the glass and pointed in awe like an idiot), but here are some of the kinds we got: - Bacon maple. Shut up. I love bacon, I love maple frosting, and this guy took those loves to the next level. Crispy, salty bacon on top of sweet, rich frosting. Awesome. - Salted caramel. My friend's mom and dad fought over it because they both took a bite and were furious we just got one. I didn't get a chance to taste it myself (it was gone in a few minutes), but it was described as incredible. - Cinnamon with apple preserves on top: nuts. My friend's cousin said "I'll just have a bite..." and it was gone in seconds. Some people have said that the doughnuts are small, and it's true that I've had bigger ones, but I feel like if they were any larger, I wouldn't have been able to stop eating and felt gross afterward. Rather, the size was perfect for a quick snack - and left room for you to try more.
Mitchell's is one of the best ice cream places. There is always a wonderful variety of flavors to explore, seasonal or regular. The vegan chocolate is a must-try!

Loved it!! We got the viet coffee and hangover (? forgot but it had whiskey in it) flavors in a cup and added a pretzel cone on top. I've been to my fair share of ice cream places but have never seen a pretzel cone!! Was surprisingly good and the ice cream was creamy and rich. They didn't skimp on the scoops either, which is always a plus. Only thing is our total came out to be close to $7, which is a high price to pay for ice cream.. even good ice cream. Good thing I don't live in the area or else my $$ would def go here.

I have always wanted to try this bakery and finally but the bullet last night. I was not craving for cakes so I i tried the hazelnut cream puff and hazelnut lobster tail. Unfortunately the cream puff was stale. :( so that was a downer. However the lobster tail was good. Not great. Just good. We didn't have to wait too long in line and was checked out less than 5 mins. Two lobster tails and 1 cream puff cost us 16$(rounded up). Would i come back? Maybe for the cake. But not for the ones i have gotten last night.

Okay, wow, yum. My friend and I stopped in for the first time today. I got the Cap'n Crunch and she got the Chocolate Swiss Roll and they are delicious! I tried the Mexican Chocolate and that was amazing too! I will definitely be coming back in the future. Very kind staff that love to joke with us.

You cannot go wrong here! I recently tried the cookie sandwich and WOW. Salted chocolate chunk with the Vietnamese coffee ice cream was a total treat. Summer, winter, rain or high heat, this place is to die for and has a treat everyone will absolutely love.

Can't believe I haven't reviewed them before! I stopped in yesterday during the Ohio City Street Festival and got a tasters trio: pumpkin spice, apple caramel, and caramel sea salt. Yummmmmm! Seriously for $4.95 I got three HUGE scoops of very delicious ice cream. The line is out the door pretty much all of the time, but don't let that deter you. The workers here are on their toes and the line moves very quickly.
Absolutely amazing!! I ordered cupcakes online and they were delivered in 45 minutes!! The cupcakes were decorated beautifully and delicious!! Definitely order again!!

I love this place. It's not the best, but it' s definitely not the worst. What's great about Jarling's is that it's always exactly the same, and that's good. Jarling's cares nothing for trends, for fashion, for progress. You will never go there and see to your dismay that it has gotten a piercing that it thought was cool but is by now completely cliched, a tattoo of something coyly cryptic, or that it prefers only bands that are so pure that they haven't yet been formed. It's Jarling's. It listens to whatever station comes in best on the AM band in the car and it hopes you brought your appetite because there's a lot of stuff to eat. It's beyond cool. It's eternal.

I went back and got the fruit tarts and chocolate cinnamon & pistachio macarons. Friends I shared with said they were all super delicious! I tried a bite of the peach tart and it was good! Loved the crust and almond creamy base. The staff members were definitely more helpful this time. Labor Day must've been an off day.

I think Batch is one of my favorite bakery in Madison. They got me with the Chocolate Croissants and I stayed for... well everything else. You can't go wrong, from their artisanal bread, pies, or pastries. The chocolate croissant will always have a place in my heart. The croissant is so flaky, buttery, and golden and the chocolate inside taste like very high quality chocolate. They do large orders for special events and cater weddings. Check their website for their bread rotations! Closed Mondays.

I've always been a huge fan of this cute little cafe-esque place. Great place to study (in the back away from the long a** line for desserts), and delicious tarts! The decor in the bakery reminds me of a french cafe, but surrounded with random artifacts and pieces of history, like Cracker Barrel does with their franchise. I HIGHLY recommend the fruit tarts (strawberry, blackberry, or both!) and the lemon and strawberry shortcake marcarons! They make them perfectly every single time, and always have different flavors to choose from. Next time though, as a coffee addict, I will definitely try their lattes! Hopefully I can update on that later this year ;)
Today, I came to try this bakery for the first time. The bread is good. The drinks are not good. The service is average. I will go back to buy his bread. The drinks won't

I found this little gem about a year ago on my quest to try as many cool ice cream places as I could find. I bring my four year old with me and she loves it. The flavors ate refreshing and unique and they taste really good. Good enough for a picky four year old to enjoy. She's eating the white chocolate raspberry sorbet right now and has gotten the blueberry frozen yogurt and the the grapefruit lime as well. The I Lu con would be that there's no indoor seating but they have outdoor seating with misters. Cute candy shop ambience.

To start off the ice cream and desserts are all very great hence for 2 stars but the staff and the how the store is run is very disorganized. The last 2 times we came and had to wait about 40+ minutes to get order and today we decided to walk in at 10:20 for them to tell us they are closed and not letting anyone else in. Why advertise that you're open to 11 if you're going to deny people this early. Advertise that you close at 10:30 then not 11. Definitely needs to have more staff on hand to help.

Go to Sweet Republic this week and say, "I support Bake for Hope," and they will donate a portion of their proceeds to Bake for Hope. Bake for Hope is a charity that is raising breast cancer awareness and providing proceeds of nationwide bake sales to local Susan G Komen for the Cure affiliate offices. On this Saturday, Bake for Hope will be there to sell our delicious homemade cupcakes, brownies, and cookies. It is the PERFECT pairing- cake and ice cream!

The rainbow cake is THE BEST item to get! Followed by the cookies and cream lobster tail! I've been here several times and have always had great customer service. Sometimes there can be a line up but they tend to move fast. I Always stop by here when I'm visiting Las Vegas.

We went at 9:30 on a Friday night. The ice cream is good, but flavors are limited-especially for chocolate lovers. There were a lot of cereal flavors, which I found odd. I got a double scoop, which was $5.25. I like the uniqueness of the Chinese takeout box with the fortune cookie.

This place is great! Plaza Midwood doesn't have much in the way of sweet treats/dessert at the moment, so this is definitely a welcome addition. I had a piece of the flourless chocolate cake and my boyfriend had a Smores bar. My cake was rich and creamy, and the Smores bar went down in about 2 bites - my boyfriend said it was "good."
