I'm looking forward to trying the macaroons here, next...as with any bakery in Charlotte, I wish they had more/labelled gluten-free options, but that certainly doesn't discredit the fact that it's wonderful to have a lovely Italian bakery in town. We also had their cold brew coffee and that was nicely sized at 12 ounces (some places give you a bucket of cold brew and that never ends well). I had a lack-of-caffeine headache going on and that knocked it out real quick. We'll be back soon, Villani's!

I love Sprinkle red velvet cupcakes, try it with the ice cream too and its gone in no time :) The next day we went to get a red velvet cupcake from different place, but the taste and texture the cupcake cant beat sprinkle cupcakes. This sprinkle cupcakes location in Vegas open until 1 AM.

I was not impressed. I really wanted to like the ice cream. I am a big fan of cold creamy concoction especially in the summer. It was just too over priced and did not seem like a good quality ice cream. That being said, I will try it at least once more.
Its been a week since ive been here and im still craving their mint chocolate sundae, MMM.

My sister in law watched some food show and saw their milk pie was a must try in Vegas. It's $7 for a pretty small piece. It's basically oat, sugar and butter and that's exactly what you taste... I also tried their double chocolate chip. For some reason I got a strong taste of salt in each bite... kinda weird.

Honestly, I don't understand the hype at all. We went with a large group and had a good selection of all donuts. They were comparable to grocery store donuts. The more simple donuts were dry and almost seemed stale, and the creative flavors were pretty gaggy. The saving grace was the cold brew iced coffee, that was very good. Unfortunately we were going for the donuts not the coffee. Not impressed!

They are open for pickup only when I visited during COVID-19. I got to try one of their specialties, the Cleveland brownie sundae. It was nice and very refreshing. The portion is very generous. The service was good.

I know I'm a little late to the party, but WOW -- I love this bakery! A couple weeks back, someone presented me with a variety box. They all looked tempting, but I finally decided on the matcha bread. I could only taste a hint of matcha, but it was still delicious. The bread was freshly baked, soft, filled with matcha cream, and dusted lightly with powdered sugar. I immediately opened my Yelp app and bookmarked it. On my way home from work, I stopped in to pick up a box for my family. The parking situation is great - plenty to choose from and a couple of 90 min spots up front. They have a large variety of sweet & savory selections. I chose the following: taro filled, strawberry, guava, chocolate/Oreo, egg tarts, garlic bread, cheese, hot dog, and the impossible meat with cheese and jalapeÃ±os. I also got a milk tea, half sweet with boba. I can't say we loved everything, but my favorites were the egg tarts, strawberry, and taro. I put the leftovers in the fridge and they were still good the following day. I used my toaster oven to heat up the savory breads for my kids the next day, and that seemed to work well. Looks like I found another awesome place to pick up some treats! :)
Expect nothing better than an regular American, with worst attitude. No made to go, but warmed to go stuff.
Staff was polite and idea has a lot of potential but I wasn't impressed with the quality of ice cream.

What an amazing local bakery to stop in to. Satisfy your sweet tooth, or get some tasty crusty bread to go with dinner. Their Gruyere croissant is to DIE FOR! So buttery, flaky, and ahhhmazing. What is even better is they have partnered with Square Harvest, and I get this yummy goodness delivered straight to my door! What could be better than that?! Well...their salted caramel brownies, enough said. Every Christmas I always order their homemade Stollen which is a lovely delight to have. This year I also ordered their Bush de Noel (sp?) ohhh mmyyyy goossshhh. It was the most rich and heavenly thing out there. Ok, I've got to stop. I'm getting hungry. I love this place!!!

Solid place to come and get some local, homemade ice cream. I had driven past here many times, but hadn't stopped until recently on a warm day. Very unique options available, the first time here I had Honey Cornbread ice cream. Never having seen this sort of option before, I tried it, and was very satisfied. They do not have as wide of an array of options as Mitchell's, but do have enough varieties to satisfy about any palate. Personally, Mitchell's is still my favorite ice cream place in town,, but this will always be another option when nearby.
Grace staff, delicious Matcha and a great place to meet a friend and relax. The aesthetic of the overall shop is overall a vibe.

The best ice cream I have ever eaten. I've been coming here now for a few weeks thanks to some friends and I regret not coming sooner. I'm actually not really suppose to eat ice cream because of some dairy problems but surprisingly enough, this place doesn't cause any issues. Probably because it's REAL and delicious. I normally get the graham central station (x4) and my boyfriend gets the 4 scoop sampler with all the cheesecake options. WE LOVE THIS PLACE SO MUCH. Now I will say the lines are a bit ridiculous at times but all the aggravation goes away when you take that first scoop and it melts in your mouth. This will now be my go to dessert spot and I've told all my family and friends. If you've seen this place and haven't stopped by yet, DO IT NOW. Especially for the 2 buck Tuesday's.

Great Chocolate and Ice Cream! Terrific place to pick up a "select your own" bag of light or dark Ghiradelli chocolates - We like dark - so it's a real pleasure to go somewhere that you can choose from 40 different flavors of dark. Ice cream also fantastic!

Hmm.I have been hearing about Milk Bar for a long time and finally had the opportunity to try without having to stand in line! I ordered the Gluten free cookie, but unfortunately at least for me, it was nothing quite special and just a mediocre cookie. Perhaps their other items are better?

I have been following Milk Bar on Instagram for months now. Finally trying the cereal milk soft serve with corn flakes was a highlight of my trip to Vegas (yes, I really like ice cream). I also got a few cookies to bring back, cause why not?

How do you give this place a 3 1/2 star? Anyway, this place isn't bad. To me, and this is just my own opinion and taste, this place is like any ordinary donut shop but with certain perks making this donut shop a tad bit different from other places. 1) A few of their donuts are "Vegan" 2) They have clever names that complement the donut 3) They have treats for your furry friends My first time going, I went right before they opened. I was the first in line and lines form fast right before opening. I ordered, which was the day after the news of music icon Prince passing, the Price Donut, CrÃ¨me Brule, Banana Caramel and the Boston Cream. The Prince donut was well decorated with his symbol and filled with raspberry. I liked it. It was okay for me. I did notice that the donuts I ordered, weren't as sweet as some other donut shops (not including frostings). This was a plus for me, the amount of sweetness to the donuts were good for my liking. The CrÃ¨me Brule (Vegan), I wasn't a big fan of the "caramel drizzle" over the donut. Some will like it, but it wasn't my cup of tea. Everything under that topping was okay as well. I love bananas so I tried the Banana Caramel (Vegan), and that was okay too. At first bite, banana runts came to mind. Last, Boston Cream. I love donuts filled with custard, so I couldn't leave a donut shop without getting one. This too was okay. The breading wasn't too sweet, but the sweetness of the frosting complemented this donut well. I really wanted the cinnamon roll with the bacon, but that wasn't ready when I got there. There was a 15 minute wait :( I'm still coming back to try that cinnamon roll with bacon and the french toast donut. :) With that being said, Happy Eatings!!
Best place on the strip. We got great service and vegan options. Would recommend to all

I've never heard of this place but I've heard of the show. It's located inside the Venetian Hotel & Casino on the 2nd floor. I only came here because my wife begged to come. When I saw how long the line was, she had to do some more begging because I couldn't fathom waiting 45 minutes for a small dessert. While standing in line I can over hear ladies conversations bragging about how much they've spent at Carlos bakery, $60, $75, $85 WOW! These things better taste pretty damn good. Some of these ladies had been here multiple times! Once you finally get to the front of the line they will only let a few people go in at a time. Be ALERT know what you want, because you will get skipped or the person behind you is going to eat you alive. They write down your order, then at that point you wait (another 10 min) in one of 5 chairs for your name to be called so that you can pay. WTF? Whatever happened to those bakery or panaderias where you walk up, pick what you want and some Mexican lady, with tongs, puts it in a bag and you go! This place makes you wait while they put your sweets in a fancy white box, with a ribbon tie and charge you up the wazoo! "So that's where all the consumer money goes, into the packaging." I ordered 2 small cannoli's, regular and chocolate. The large cannoli's are $4 while the mini cannoli's are $2.50. They were good, but to ME not out of this world good. Maybe it's all the anticipation built up that didn't live up to my expectations. If the line would have been way shorter and the sweets a little less expensive this rating probably would have been a 4 star.

Never leave yelp reviews but me and my fiancÃ© stopped here for some sandwiches . I got a sandwich that had turkey , bacon, lettuce , tomato, and onion . I asked for no turkey and to add mayonnaise . When out food arrived my sandwich already came with mayonnaise on it without them telling me or having it on the menu while charging us for extra ,they placed ONE single piece of bacon on the sandwich . When I asked if I could possibly have more bacon I was told yes no problem . 1 minute later the lady at the register says that will be $2 meanwhile I already took a meat off the sandwich and they charged me for something it already came with . Won't ever be coming back and don't recommend the sandwiches . Ice cream looks very good but the food is just not good at all and no one seems to be in charge .
Wasn't impressed. Donuts were small and not as flavorful as some have made them out to be. The Boston cream I got I've had better at another donut shop out here in vegas.

Came across this place while walking towards the Linq high roller observation wheel at Las Vegas. We ordered treasure island - warm brownie sundae and were not disappointed! The sundae was generously topped with chocolate sauce and had a warm chocolate brownie and whipped cream! The brownie was baked freshly so it took a while to get our order. The sundae was super amazing and filled our tummies right away! They have a small seating area inside the store and multiple gifting options.

Best ice cream in town and the staff so always helpful and nice. The array of flavors is constantly changing so there's always something new, and delicious, to try. I don't know what took me so long to review this place.

Wow. Fabulous ice cream. The flavors truly are flavorful! Not like some others I've had that promise exciting tastes but never deliver. These are awesome. I've tried ice cream from several other dairy programs at a few notable universities around the country and these measure up! And for $2.60 a HUGE single scoop??? I ordered two flavors and it was almost more than I could eat. But I powered through. Fabulous!! If I were a student here this would be on my weekly rotation all year long! Great place. Quick service. Friendly people.
Cute setup and delicious ice cream! Perfect place to go on a sunny afternoon! Their take out boxes and fortune cookies only add to the charm of the old house in downtown phoenix.

A must stop for fresh (watch them making everything behind the counter) pastries, cakes, macaroons. Don't miss their custom blend coffee; which is roasted locally by Boquete Mountain Coffee. The owners are husband and wife and are always here - very nice people! Such a quaint place inside the Union Square atrium downtown Concord. Sit at a cafe table inside with a great cup of fresh coffee and a delicious dose of sweetness. Support local!

Fugetaboutit... From an Italian and former New Yorker, this place is very overrated. Rainbow cookie was stale with a smear of raspberry jam in it. Save your money. Don't believe the hype and be a sucker for the old "he's got a show on TLC" jig.

My Dad and I were both in Cleveland travelling for work and met up over dinner, but the highlight was walking down the street afterwards to get Mitchell's ice cream. Actually, we picked the restaurant because it was close by. You see, my hotel has a freezer full of Mitchell's so I've been sampling their flavors for a few weeks now. My favorite is the Pistachio, I also haven't been disappointed yet with anything I've tried. If you're around, you should absolutely stop by their location it is worth the trip!

Yummy! We love family owned businesses, so we always use Yelp to find unique places to eat. This place did not disappoint, had no complaints. It was delicious, friendly, & clean environment. We enjoyed the experience!

Fantastic ice cream, some of the best in South End. I love stopping by and grabbing a half scoop (or three!). My go-to favorite is gooey butter cake. Salted peanut butter is also great. Tonight I tried the limited time everything bagel which was slightly gross, but I was still glad I tried it! Just an odd flavor for ice cream. I love the out of the box flavors...I always look forward to trying the newest one!

My boyfriend and I are visiting from Chicago so we have had our fair share of delicious ice cream. This place is definitely a must! I am so happy we stopped by. From the moment you walk in you are greeted with a smile and given a little run down on all the things they have. There are a TON of options. I wish we had more days in AZ to come and try them all. Great mix of flavors, some expected and quite a few unique. I got the Taro and Oatmeal Cookie which were amazing! My boyfriend got the cookies and cream and the Cookie Monster which he loved also. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting and especially too those who live here. What a gem!

Don't get me wrong, this is better than most places in Charlotte in terms of bakeries/cafes for atmosphere, but the food and pastries are good at best. The Croque Monsier was greasy and smelled like it was burnt in a toaster oven. The apple tart crust was so tough that I could barely cut it, and the French macaroon was as hard as a rock. I could do a better job with an Easy Bake Oven. The staff here isn't much better. Everyone treats you as though they're doing them you a favor. It's a cool place in terms of the decor, but the food and staff are truly lacking. The search continues......

If you're going to Vegas you've got to make time for a stop here!! It's not too far off of the main strip but make sure you get here when they first open because the good doughnuts sell out FAST!!! My favorite was the one that had an entire pop tart inside!!! A very neat & yummy experience! There's also a beautiful patio to eat and relax at in the back.

The tastiest cupcake I have consumed was at this place. I wish there was a Sprinkles in Charlotte. It's located in the LINQ Promenade. Very convenient to that hotel and Flamingo. For the best sugar fix, seriously stop here.

Yummm! I have bought sweet republic treats before from Whole Foods but I had never actually stopped in here before. I was craving a sundae but wasn't super hungry so the mini sundae was just right for me! I got it with the brownie swirl ice cream. Next time I'd get it without the whipped cream, but it was delicious! My boyfriend loved his ice cream too, I think he got some sort of caramel flavor? It was all delicious and we will totally come back soon! Good service too, it got a little busy and the two people working behind the counter handled it all well!
I think the best macaroons I've ever had. Fluffy light outer cookie with perfect not-too-sweet flavor. If you're int he Venetian you gotta try this.

Amelie's French Bakery is exactly where it should be, in the art district NoDa. The place is fantastic and I wish I could eat here everyday. The breakfast sandwiches are amazing and priced reasonably. The decor is eclectic and fun. I can't wait until I'm on that side of town so I can drop in and indulge in a delicious pastry.

National Donut Day! Free Birthday Cake donut. I love the price on these awesome donuts. Crime BrÃ»lÃ©e never disappoints. Make sure to stop by here before the free donuts are all gone! All employees wore masks and gloves. Was greeted warmly and received decent and timely service this morning. Thank you all at Donut Bar LV, see you again soon!

What can't this place do?! Their ice cream selection in the summer is insanely delicious, but then when the weather turns they go and make warm and delicious ramen too?! We've been waiting for them to turn back into their winter ramen, and placed an order online to-go and it was such an easy, seamless process. The food...wow! The broth was delicious and all the ingredients were simple, fresh, and so good! A must do for take out!
It was good. I got a single scoop of strawberry cheesecake. It was good and staff was good

I loved going to this little ice cream shop but ever since they changed their location their service and quality have gone downhill. The ice cream is still good but they've always got a low stock. The ice cream isn't as "insta-worthy" as it used to be. I miss the old Melt.

Cookie cup was amazing. I am not a big ice cream fan but this was so good I polished off the whole thing. Will definitely go back again. Place is kinda out of the way so tell all your friends about it, I hope this place is around for the next 50 years. Gentleman running it was so nice allowing you to sample the ice cream flavors before ordering.

Honestly, don't see why this place is so highly rated. The idea is kinda cool and I wanted to like it but I left incredibly disappointed. My boyfriend and I ordered the signature Fatty Daddy's and weren't impressed. We actually didn't like the ice cream and thought it lacked flavor. It also cost over 8 dollars so it definitely wasn't worth it. There is definitely better ice cream shops in the area and I won't be coming back

i'd rate 3.5 stars. It was a cool experience but for the line/wait, it wasn't that good. We ordered the bowls and paying $12.... i could've made this at home for $2. It tasted like a scoop of mayfield vanilla ice cream, hershey's chocolate syrup and some cereal on top. maybe a milkshake would've been the way to go. but either way, i could make these very easily at home

This place is located in the Cosmopolitan Hotel right next to Momofuku. My friend told me about this place and I thought I'd give this a try to see what the hype was all about. This place constantly had a line but the workers move pretty quick. Being my first time here, I referred to yelp to help me decide on what Soft serve/dessert I wanted to try and it seemed like their cereal milk soft serve($6) with Frosted Flakes add-on ($1.50)seems the most popular, so I thought I'd give that a try. The soft serve wasn't the best I've had, but it definitely wasn't the worst. I expected a lot more from the soft serve but it just tasted like milk with salty Frosted Flakes. It was something I would try but I wouldn't go out of my way to get it again.

Keep on keepin on!! I brought my sister in law here for some ice cream, she was a first timer and the guy that helped us was WONDERFUL! He let her taste test 3 flavors so she could make her decision, usually people get annoyed by that request, not Churn!! Our dishes were DELISH and we've been back since! Love this place!!

I don't know where to start. The vibe here is amazing!! I love this little strip of businesses. The tap house looks awesome. Everyone is enjoying their time drinking and sitting around! Beautiful views! We order 3 doughnuts melts 1 with chocolate ice cream and Cookie Crisp 1. Cookie Monster with fruity pebbles, 1 with caramel with Cookie Crisp and a scoop of vanilla ice cream with sprinkles and fruity pebbles. They are all soon good!! I love that the donuts were warm and didn't get hard. We have gone other places that once the ice cream touches it. It's hard as a rock well not here. Ice cream is handmade there and so delicious!! Customer service was amazing! She told us all about the award winning ice cream maker! She greeted us with kindness! Absolutely worth the drive!!
The cupcake was great I chose to get no frosting on mine. The cinnamon flavor was good not over powering like most cupcakes. it was slow when I went in but the service was good and quick

Lived up to the hype! Me: Salted caramel brownie-yeah, just do it. Unreal. Roasted veggie salad-nice side salad with fresh roasted veggies and a delicious feta dressing. My body needed greens and it hit the spot. Half Mushroom Tartine-Favorite thing I ate. Delicious mushrooms covered in melted cheese on crusty buttered bread. Husband had a roast beef and cheese sandwich on a croissant. It was absolutely delicious and the croissant was perfectly flaky and buttery. We will return. What a great little spot!!

Such a disappointment. We are huge cake boss fans and have been to this bakery before...as others have noted, the lines are SLOW; they always seem understaffed. Also, there are no prices posted so you just order and pay (out the nose). The worst part though, they give the illusion of things being baked fresh in the bakery next door which must be a hoax since the eclair we ordered as a part of our large family order was unmistakably FREEZER BURNT. So sad. There's no way we will be back even though some of the desserts are fabulous ($20+ options). Don't you guys taste your products for quality control? Thanks, but no thanks.

Seriously, can I just move in and stay forever?! I LOVE Amelie's. The decor is amazing and the entire layout of the bakery is like a giant maze of cozy little nooks and crannies. And to top it off their pastries are incredible. Swear to god I could live off the salted caramel brownie.

Ice cream is delicious, cookies might be even better I don't know.... ok they tie!! Go to try it can't go wrong with homemade!!! AND on the cheaper side, shocked to pay less than $20 for 4 ice creams with cookies!! Great place!

This place is in such a strange location. It's next to a bike store and a paint supplier, with no other stores sharing the same parking lot. I imagine it would be hard to find at night since they don't have a sign on the building, the only indication being the words on the door, which can't really be seen until you're in the parking lot. Definitely pricey for what you're getting. One scoop of ice cream with one macaron half was about $6, would've been about $7 if I had the marshmallow. And that brings me to another point - they were out of marshmallows, which is strange to me since that's one of their signature things. They had also run out of several flavors of macarons including red velvet and caramel. I had the mini, but the original Fatty Daddy's cookie cup would probably come out to $9 or $10 with tax, which is pretty steep for a few scoops of ice cream. The one guy working was nice and told us about their specialty ice cream. I did like the decorations in the place. The ice cream was just decent, nothing really special, but the macaron was pretty good. I might come by again to try different flavors if they're available next time, but I wouldn't go out of my way to come here.

When you want soft-serve ice cream in Pittsburgh, this is where to go! In addition to the usual vanilla and chocolate you'd find at most places, Page's has a slew of other flavors like orange, mint chocolate chip, amaretto, pumpkin, and many more! You really can't go wrong with any soft serve flavor. It seems that these flavors rotate depending on the season as well; for instance, pumpkin only appears on the menu in the fall. I tend to stick to the simple small cone, but they have a huge variety of sundaes and other ways to enjoy the many soft serve flavors. Not to mention, they have a few savory food items too, which I have yet to try. The lines are long, but don't let that stop you because the wait is worth it. Oh, and it's cash only, but they have an atm to the side of the building!

I think Sprinkles is the best of the cupcake chains. For the most part they are very consistent. This one is no exception and I had a strawberry cupcake and a black and white, just as good as the original location in NYC. I think what makes these cupcakes so special is the cake. The cakes are so flavorful and moist, I feel like they really stand out. The frosting is very basic, not in a bad way, but it makes the cake really shine. I will go out of my way to come here.....then I realized they have an ATM at the airport yum.

I've seen pictures of this soft serve all of Instagram but located on the east coast. I rarely travel in the states let alone across to the east so it would be a long shot before I got to try it. We saw it in our hotel while walking around so we had to get it. The cashier that helped us was very nice. She explained the flavors as well as let us sample them before we decided what we wanted. Crack Pie w Corn Flakes Crunch - The crack pie was different. It was a brown sugar custard taste but kind of salty. It was your salty sweet flavor. The corn flakes were everything on this soft serve! I loved the crunch and they were not plain. They were more like Frosted Flakes by not frosted. Birthday Cake w Sprinkles & Corn Flakes - My husband got this and I actually really enjoyed his. It tasted like legit birthday cake and the sprinkles were fun. Overall, this was great especially on a hot day. Would it be our first choice? Probably not but we would get it again if it was convenient!

hot summer night need a sweet dessert to cap the weekend, what i ate: - coffee ice cream: cool and refreshing. like haagan daaz but more expensive cause it's sprinkles. - red velvet cupcake: delicious as always pros: - cupcake ATM! no need to wait in line - ice cream AND cupcakes - friendly servers - cute menus (really designed well IMO) cons: - always a wait for the hype - no inside seating. when it's 90degrees at night, you want AC. would i go again? probably not, as i'm not a native.
Delish! Ask them what their popular flavors are when you go in... great options! Staff was friendly and knowledgeable on their ice cream!

Came in with a few friends, have never been here before. Hard to spot at night from the street because the sign doesn't light up and the parking lot is dark. Super chill spot, plenty of seating both inside and out. Decent prices, good portions and a nice selection of ice cream/toppings. I love their name and logo, the penguin is awesome so I definitely had to leave with a coffee cup (way to upsell me!). I commented on how slow it seemed when we got there, within five minutes there was a line out the door. Awesome little spot in the heart of South Scottsdale that didn't disappoint!
The best ice cream in Phoenix (At least that I've had). You can even do an ice cream sandwich with some of their fresh cookies, or make a shake! Sugar, waffle, and pretzel cones are available too.

I was waiting for this place to open in Las Vegas because every time I went to California I would stop there and buy a lot of pastries/bread to bring back to Las Vegas. I went to the Grand Opening and understand that there was a line outside the store and not a good variety of bread/pastries yet because after all it was their first few days operating a new business. HOWEVER, a few days later, 47° outside (a VERY COLD EVENING) and a young lady (lacking TOTAL experience in dealing with people) stood at the door and made us wait in the cold. NOT too many people inside, but the wait lasted about 20 (TWENTY minutes). After inside (and waiting in line again to pay I noticed that someone else was standing at the door and letting everyone else in without waiting!! I haven't been back since then and have told all my friends and co-workers about this lack of respect/training in dealing with people. It needs to be addressed because people will not come back to a place where they were mistreated. It NEVER has happened in California (Southern or Northern California stores). It is a local mismanagement! Thank you.

I was upset with the donut bar for not making enough donuts and it was 830am. They ran out of certain flavor donuts and said they were not making anymore. I had to go to another donut shop that had lots of the flavors I was looking for. I am not sure if I will ever go back.

This is a great little place for ice cream and drinks! It's on the corner of McDowell and Miller. It's better to park behind the building and then walk. I loved my salted caramel ice cream! Delicious and not too sweet! Then it was topped with a red velvet macaroon and a toasted marshmallow. I felt that macaroon was too big to be an actual macaroon and didn't taste like a genuine red velvet flavor. I would love to go back and get only the ice cream with a macaroon. So it was good but i would order a different macaroon!
Relaxing tea and pastry spot, with a good selection of sweet little pastries to try (vegan options as well). The atmosphere is quiet and eclectic. The tea was excellent.

Honestly was a little disappointed after seeing all the hype. We got 3 donuts Nutella overload, Creme brÃ»lÃ©e and strawberry cheesecake. The Nutella overload haha it had a dot of Nutella, the strawberry cheesecake only had strawberry filling so not sure what made it cheesecake.

On this most recent trip I ordered a chocolate dipped coconut macaroon, a handful of Pignoli cookies (my absolute favorite cookie), a cinnamon bun and a handful of thumbprint raspberry cookies. This place seems yo have it all! They have savory items that you can eat for lunch and dinner and they have all the delicious pastries/cookies you can think of as well as a well sized selection of gelatos and even an espresso machine to make your favorite coffee drinks.

So this review was a little tough for me to right. I am a HUGE dessert fan and love trying all sorts of different things. I was SO excited to go to Carlo's bake shop and felt that when I actually ate my dessert I was let down. It was no where near as good as I was hoping - especially after I waited 30 minutes to order. First thing - there is almost ALWAYS a long line. I have waited in this line twice for desserts and both times I felt that the line was not worth the wait. The second thing is the price. Don't get me wrong, I know you're in Vegas on the strip in a pricey casino. All of these things mean that items will be slightly (hehe) more expensive than usual. I feel that Carlo's marks up even higher than that - I mean seriously some of their desserts are just too much for what you get. The actual desserts - meh - nothing special. I would think with that with the hype and celebrity chef linked to it the desserts would be out of this world, absolutely divine, die and go to heaven type deal. They just weren't. Maybe this was my fault because I had high expectations but I know going forward when I visit my sister in Vegas this won't be high on my list of priorities.

Love villanis! An excellent little bakery with delicious coffee and pastries. Plenty of parking, outdoor seating is available, and the staff is friendly and knowledgeable about all their sweets. :) Would especially recommend the chocolate cake!

Give me a chocolate eclair that's still a little bit frozen, late at night in the summertime after a movie. A girl next to me one time was asking me if there was anything vegan in the pastry case lol. It pretty much all has butter and pastry cream. But the point is that it's well made according to time-tested real french baking methods, with an occasional modern twist.

First time at Fatty Daddy's and even though it's a 30 minute drive from my house it probably won't be my last. The two girls working were really nice and kept giving me sample after sample of the ice creams they recommended (which all were really good!) then after picking my flavors which were the banana, captain crunch, and morning something ( I forgot the name of the last one) they got my macaroon and marshmallow on top then torch the marshmallow a bit and it was ready! Definitely coming back!

I love coming here once in awhile. They always have different bakery items, so it's never the same every time you come in. Before COVID-19 happened, the bakery items were just out on its own in the display cabinets. They then would package up the bakery items once you paid for them. Due to the pandemic, they have everything already packaged up in the cabinets which is something I actually prefer. They had a milk tea bun with actual boba inside that was SO GOOD! They ended up discontinuing it, but then bringing it back with a different recipe. There's a different kind of filling inside, rather than the actual boba. I wish they didn't change it because the first ones were amazing. My mom loves the brioche bread. It's always nice and fresh whenever we get it. Other favorites include the espresso bun, marble taro, red bean bread, and cinnamon twist. Their boba is actually pretty good too. I had ordered a green tea drink with boba and was pleasantly surprised at how delicious it was.
Mmmm sugar! Pretty cool little spot on a back alley off the strip. They have a cupcake ATM?! Nice! Super sugary desserts and a bit pricy, but you might as well ball out while you're in town LOL.
Coffee is great. Addicted to sea salt coffee. Service is fast and location isn't bad. Parking lot is crowded but I always find parking close by.

Came here because the Halo Halo looked so good. And we were not disappointed! It was far better than the kind we tried in Vegas, and the owner is very enthusiastic about sharing this Filipino dessert. We loved it so much we ordered more of the Ube/Taro ice cream. The owner let us taste several other ice cream flavors. They have several unique flavors and they are all very well made. We'll definitely come back here!

Headed into Hopscotch today on a friend's recommendation, and this place is way too cute! From the awesome crafts you can buy from local talent to the desserts that look too cute to eat, I was overwhelmed with beauty when I stepped in! I can't wait to order treats for my Madison family next time I'm in town!

Love love love this place! Everytime I go there is something new and exciting to try, my most recent favorite was the snickerdoodle cookie dough I got around the holidays as a gift for myself. And during the warmer months, the ice cream is so delicious. I can't wait for it to warm up so I have an excuse to visit more frequently!

YES YES YES! This place was so good. I had heard about it from a news article because of they way the "drill" the ice cream to mix and serve it. We went and I got an ice cream with cinnamon toast mixed in and brownie bites on top. My friends got milkshakes. It was all super tasty and delicious. I felt the portion size to price was affordable for the milkshake but I felt the price was a bit high for the amount of ice cream you got; although it was really tasty. My only complaint about this place, although it would only stop me if there were really long lines, was that the service was kind of slow. After ordering it took about 10 to 15 minutes to get our ice cream and two shakes. There was only one person before us that came in. The people who came in after us had to wait a few minutes before their order was taken. Again, it would not stop me from coming back and the flavor was really good but the wait time, I felt, is an area for improvement and maybe would push me away if there were long lines.

There were no flavors with chocolate when we came. They said they ran out because of a busy weekend. So, I had a scoop of Nutella and a scoop of salted caramel in a waffle cone. Both flavors were mild, and not very different. The waffle cone was soft and mushy, not fully cooked. I would have given it two stars, but my husband found his flavors satisfactory - even though each of his flavors were not very different. He had cookies and cream and salted caramel. His waffle cone was cooked and not soft like mine.
Tasty place with many options for true chocolate lovers... So tasty that I stopped in twice in one day and several times throughout the week. Milkshake happy hours!

So good. While staying in Vegas we had dessert at Sprinkles twice. I had a Sprinkles Sundae (cupcake with ice cream) and a milkshake. Both where delicious and not too much/too sweet. My husband loved their ice cream, and that the pricing was reasonable compared to other dessert places on the strip. I would recommend this to anyone looking to try something different, who has a sweet tooth.
The doughnuts are absolutely delicious.. When compared to Dunkin it's like McDonalds VS Flemings Steak House. No comparison. Just try them.. Your taste buds will thank you
Best destination to reach at any time of the day when u r a little hungry. Love the deserts here. Good place to hangout!

My wife and I had been to the San Diego location so when we're heard that Las Vegas would be getting one we had to make a trip while we were in town. The location wasn't up and running yet but we were still invited in, I believe his name was Dan and Amy. They were both so friendly! Showed us around even gave us a box of delicious donuts to take with us! Mmmmmm maple bacon! If you're looking for a great place run by friendly people this is it!
Shhhhh so good Also what is up with the slight saltiness of the chocolate chip cookie, it kills me

Stopped by the new uptown location- delish as always! I managed to time it just right to be there as everyone was leaving the Panthers Pep Rally, which was note ideal, but the line moved pretty quickly and the staff was very friendly.

Vegans and Non-vegans alike will enjoy these delicious treats. I loved the lemon lavender and the cookies and cream flavors. The dough for the square doughnuts is very unique, it has a great texture and doesn't feel too heavy in your stomach. The sisters running the show are always smiling and super friendly. I've found a new guilty pleasure.

Went here to meet with a study group on a Friday night. It was busy, but not too busy to find a quiet enough table for 5. The food was good and prepared as described. The ambiance was relaxed and welcoming. I would go again.

Handel's Ice Cream is AMAZING!!!! It has to be some of the best ice cream I've ever had!!! Their customer service is great, and they have so many selections of ice cream flavors!!! I highly recommend Handel's to anyone and everyone wanting amazing ice cream!!!

Not the best when it comes to caramel popcorn. It's usually stale and the bags are FULL of crumbs and kernels. For the price I'd expect better quality. Shop is cute but doesn't house many really fresh items.

Churn is a classic that every college student at Grand Canyon University goes to. It is basically a rite of passage. It is fun to grab after you get dinner across the street. The ice cream is just made so well, that no matter what flavor you choose, it is almost guaranteed to taste great. You can sit outside in their back patio under the trees with your friends as you eat it all (and maybe go back inside for seconds)

What a shame. Definitely hasn't lived up to the hype. The cupcakes are extremely dense (almost bagel like) and taste store bought. They were barely average. Also we bought the blue cake with brown polka dots that is shown on the show quite a bit. Just average and kind of chemically in taste. On the bright side, the cream puffs were amazing. Overall, it most certainly wasn't worth the hour wait and was way over-priced. We live near Retro Bakery in the NW part of town. Their cupcakes and cakes are WAY better than C.B.'s desserts.

I came in with the expectation that it was going to be AMAZE-BALLS after being an avid viewer of the TV show. Don't get me wrong it was good, but the long wait and the EXTREMELY sweet pastry did not allow me to finish my entire Lobster Tail (really good but recommend that you split with a friend). The butter crumb cake was pretty good too but definitely SUPER sweet! It also tastes so much better warmed up so make sure you ask for that when you order!
Got the Maiko Special, it was divine!! Each layer was a delicious surprise! 10/10!! Will go again!! The girls behind the counter were super nice and helpful, being it was our first time!
Yummy fresh donuts! Super friendly staff! Clean establishment. Would definitely come back again.
Easy to miss this place but don't. Good ice cream. It reminds me of a street 3 blocks off a beach. Fun place to stop off and relax w a scoop or two on the patio.

This review is only for the cookies. I was excited for milk bar to open in the cosmo, only to find out it takes up only a small area right next to momofuku. Anyway, this review is only for the cookies. We opted to try the corn cookie, blueberry cream cookie, and compost cookie. A little Pricey for cookies, but totally worth it! I loved the corn cookie especially, it tasted a lot like corn bread. I'll be back to try the soft serve the next time I'm in Vegas
Wonderful pastries, so sweet and awesome! odd dining arrangement, but great deserts, be ready to wait when you go late, late and later!!

Went to see what all the hype was about. Only a few flavors available. Got a two scoop of chocolate and "get figgy with it". Cost close to $9.00 for two scoops no toppings. I'm all about supporting local businesses but feel this place is a little over priced for what you get. Quality was okay as was customer service.

All you have to say is "Babcock Hall Ice Cream" The best in the state. This shop is in the Memorial Union in addition to the location near the dairy barns in Babcock Hall. Going to Babcock Hall as a child was always a treat for our family. Glad it's now easier to get to in the Memorial Union. All the flavors are great tasting.

Danish Breakfast omg this blueberry, lemon& thyme Danish for the win. This is a nice refreshing choice for breakfast. It is very tasty and filling. You never can just run in without grabbing a macaroon or two.

The ice cream was very rich, creamy, and full of flavor (I got a single scoop of the Cookie Wasted). In addition, it came in a Chinese take-out container complete with a fortune cookie! My only regret was that I didn't have enough time/stomach space to try everything. Highly recommended.

Great vibe. Did this as an early Fathers Day with the family. Have not eaten ice cream in 2 years and this was a natural and great ice cream! Plus when my kids got their ice cream...ring for my daughter and dinosaurs for the boyz. That was the special touch to make it perfect!

Their macarons are sooooo good. Love the big size of the macarons, the delicate and flaky crust, and chewy inside. It was totally worth the money. Around $3.50 each I believe. My favorites are pistachio, raspberry, and lemon. Pistachio being number one by far.

Located in the Eastern and 215 shopping center, Somi somi has taken over the old Rolled Ice cream space. We went on opening day and it was a little bit of a cluster, as you expect from opening day. But we've been there 4 times since their grand opening, a month ago, and they have definitely smoothed out the kinks and now is like a well oiled machine. Somi Somi is a Korean inspired dessert place. Their signature is the Taiyaki, which is a fish shaped pastry filled with a filling of your choice: cheddar, Nutella, custard, red bean, Taro and Oreo. Taiyakis are 2 for $3.95 or 5 for $7.95. The taiyaki are perfection. Crispy on the outside and chewy and perfect once you bite in. We chose the custard, Nutella, red bean and Oreo fillings. All were really good. The Oreo was a little dry as it's just an Oreo cookie broken in half and placed in the middle. We also ordered the Ahboong $5.95 which is soft serve with a fish cone on top. Soft serve flavors change out as they are seasonal. When we went we tried the matcha, Oreo and ube swirl. The soft serve was thick and creamy. Tasted so rich, like frozen custard. Sooo good! Mashisoyo. You can choose a filling to fill inside the Ahboong as well but we opted not to. Once your order is ready, you go to the pick up counter and can add complimentary toppings like a macaron shell, sprinkles or a fresh strawberry. So incredibly happy to have Somi Somi come down to the Henderson area. A great new and fresh addition to the sea of restaurants on Eastern. Check it out you will not be disappointed. There taiyaki is the best we've ever had.

We ordered the oreo truffle cookies, chocolate puddle cookie and a s'mores brownie. All of it was amazing! Looking forward to our next visit and hopefully, we get to try something with dulce de leche.
Great bakery overall with fantastic cookies. The macaroons were OK but there were so many flavors. This place is popular and the line can sometimes be long.
Great customer service and awesome donuts! Had 4 different ones and took Erica's recommendation. Every single bite was pure joy! I will be back. Thanks Erica for great service!

Only in Las Vegas can you escape the real life dream come true of hanging out by a Venice canal in St. Marks Square to feel like a little kid for a few minutes in a candy store. That happened to me on a staycation evening last week. Both my dad (who flew in from New York) and I appreciate hanging out inside the Venetian's St. Marks Square. It is the next best way to spend time in Venice to the real Venice. To make quality time in this quality Venice meets Vegas resort even better is delicious food. Under the bright blue sky ceiling above St. Mark's Square is Sloan's Ice Cream Parlor. At ground level, it was a short stroll across a pedestrian bridge crossing the Venice Canal. Savoring my time in this dreamscape of Venice themed eye candy it was time for me to savor some real candy: ice cream. Originating in Florida, Sloan's is an ice cream shop chain that produces walls of delectable treats including doughnuts, cookies, and a wall of candy. They sell adorable gifts including stuffed animals. Just walking along the cobblestone Venice walkway, my eyes were drawn from the gandolas and canal to these puppies sleeping in a cage by the entrance. Upon further inspection I saw that they are breathing stuffed animals. The pink color tone creates a carnival midway atmosphere alongside the canal. The main attraction is the ice cream. I am talking a sundry of ice cream flavors that include: Checker Boys Rum Raisin, Coffee & Doughnuts, Mom's Apple Pie, & Scout's Honor. Where the seats are nil inside and far and few outside in the Square, the prices are exorbitant. The prices are so high for a couple of scoops, I would recommend splurging a few more dollars for a sundae. On my leading visit, I ordered the Peanut Butter Cup Sundae. At a price a few cents short of $10 after taxes, it included 3 scoops of peanut butter ice cream, generous amount of small peanut butter cups, hot Fudge, whipped cream, & a cherry in a plastic bowl. It was a high price that was a small price to pay for enjoying a delicious sundae in a Venice dreamscape. It was so delicious that I planned to end the staycation a few days later with the Strawberry Fields Ice Cream Soda. On the second visit that took place on Friday, May 4; I told their employee Elijah to make the ice cream soda with two scoops strawberry and 1 scoop strawberry cheesecake. I thought about ordering it on the first visit, however, they were out of strawberry ice cream. Upon exchanging $9.52 with the cashier, this was my expectation. However, when I stood by a chairless high table taking in the sight of gondolas passing by on the canal, my taste buds took in a disappointing ice cream soda. It started out delicious. The scoops of strawberry ice cream were out of this world delicious. However, when I progressed to the lower levels of the paper cup the Strawberry Fields met the swamp. First off the Strawberry cheesecake ice cream that I ordered was nonexistent. The biggest dunce ice cream soda moment in my life turning it into the crappiest ice cream soda that I ever set my teeth into was that it was made from Diet Pepsi. What ice cream server in their right mind uses Diet Pepsi as a base of an ice cream soda?! Yuck! It's like, "yeah I'll take all the sugary ice cream, maybe whip cream, toppings, Fudge, and a Diet Pepsi." It was absolutely disgusting causing me to throw the rest away along with one star from the rating. What a disappointment! Although I was disappointed in the ice cream soda, there is potential for a return visit. Let's face it, how many ice cream parlors overlook a Venice Canal in Las Vegas? If I do return, I would stick to a sundae. Unlike an ice cream soda, I can visually see the ice cream. Most likely I will return to the Linq Promenade Ghirardelli Ice Parlor before returning here. In reality my dream come true of savoring ice cream overlooking a Venice Canal running through St. Marks Square in Las Vegas is not over. Just postponed indefinitely.

Donuts are the perfect treat in the morning and yesterday was the perfect day for a morning trip to the Donut Bar. This donut shop is located right off of Fremont Street and is awesome from the moment you walk in. As soon as you walk in the front door you are greeted by some extremely friendly employees and a ton of the best looking donuts you'll probably ever lay you're eyes on. They have a huge selection and it was probably about 20-30 different flavours when I showed up around 7:30AM. I ended up giving 3 a try and they were the big birthday cake donut, the little birthday cake/oreo donut with an oreo in the middle of it, and the third donut was the large equivalent to basically a rocky road donut (I think, give me a break here). From the first bite of the big rocky road donut I knew that I had a new favourite donut shop and it wasn't even a contest. Next I ate the stuffed birthday cake donut and it was oh so darn good. The dough here is super soft and the oreo cookie inside made this one a truly special donut. The final donut I consumed (literally 10 minutes ago) was the large birthday cake donut. Not only was this thing large and soft, but the toppings and cream made it the best birthday cake donut I've ever had. Overall, Donut Bar is my new favourite Donut shop, period. The staff was incredibly friendly and talkative, the establishment itself was awesome featuring a fish tank with donut decorations, and the donuts themselves were top of the line tasty and they were absolutely delicious. If you like donuts, this is the place for you!

I really appreciate the staff. They're very patient since I am so indecisive with picking out ice cream flavors all the time. I always sample all of them! I did like the beer flavored (Guinness stout) ice cream and the fruity pebbles flavored ice cream as well. I would give the ice cream 4/5. The idea of the ice cream in the Chinese take out box with the fortune cookies are cute. The service and atmosphere 5/5.

This. Is. The. Best. Vegan. Ice cream. I've. Ever. Had. If you're ever in the area, I would not recommend leaving the area until you get a scoop (or five) here. Walking in, you're greeted with basically the Willy Wonka factory of ice cream shops. They give tours to folks who are interested, but we can here for business. Usually when I go to an ice cream shop, I only get like one or two vegan choices. This spot had a fruit flavor, chocolate, and sea salt caramel. Every single was was so incredible and clearly freshly made. Best part- everything is made with coconut milk so my nut free friends are also happy. I asked for one scoop, but they were so happy to see my job, I got the largest one scoop I've ever seen. My friend with me raved about the blue cosmo so if you don't have any dietary needs, highly recommend trying it. Enjoy!

This is my fave ice cream place in the valley! The flavors are amazing and the specialty flavors are always great! Mexican Chocolate is a must try, I wish they had it more often! The hot fudge sundae with any of the ice creams is fabulous as is the How the Cookie Crumbles! This is a regular for us and we love it!!

From reading other reviews (and my sister's personal experience), I was worried the line would be extremely long but we waited only about 15 minutes on a Friday night around 8:45pm. We ordered LOTS of desserts - chocolate eclair ($3.49), cream puff ($2.09), mixed berry 4" tart ($4.89), lemon raspberry fruit tart ($4.89), mini chocolate ganache cake (?), salted caramel brownies ($2.29), coconut macaroons ($1.59), pistachio flavored petit-four ($2.09), espresso mini mousse cups ($1.59), and every flavor of french macarons they had available ($2.29).. They had many workers restocking, but only 1 person taking orders and 1 person working the cash register. Is this to regulate the flow of the line? It must slow down the line because the person taking the order has to tell the cashier everything in the order, and if the cashier doesn't hear everything, then it's just chaos. Any way, I personally didn't try everything we ordered so I can only give my sweet-tooth loving opinion on some of the items..but the chocolate ganache cake is highly recommendable. Not too rich and I loved the filling. It can be split between two people. The espresso mini mousse cup was not as great as it sounds. Bite-size and not as fluffy as I wanted. The salted caramel brownie is, if not the best (read in many other reviews), one of the most popular items.. but I thought the caramel was way too much. It is what contains the salt of course and the brownie would just be a normal chocolate brownie without it.. because the brownie alone did not taste like any chocolate worth remembering. Lastly, the cream puff is filled with custard which is something I love, but it isn't worth $2. I mean, it's huge, so if you really love cream puffs, have at it. Order it alone or split it with someone and order one other item.

As others have stated, there is no clear sign to let you know your in the right place. It's located inside of something that looks like a warehouse, with terrible parking. I ordered the peach cobbler. Let's just say, if you prefer unseasoned chicken, you might love it. It was luke warm (if that) and it had no taste. If you've have good peach cobbler-you know what I mean. You taste the cinnamon etc. this tasted like nothing. Your better off getting a frozen Mrs. Smith cobbler from food lion. The ice cream is about 2 tablespoons (nothing like the pictures)

Ive been to Masons in the summer several times for ice cream and it's always been good so I decided to head out and try their winter ramen. They have a short list of options all about $12. I opted for the chicken shio and my husband got the tonkotsu. The bowls were a good portion and had veggies and meat, but the star here is their marinated soft boiled eggs, delicious! My chicken ramen was a bit bland compared to the pork, which was a more hearty flavor overall. I would like to see the option for extra veggies or noodles. Good food, good service and ice cream for dessert, what's not to enjoy?

I loved this ice cream place in California and when I saw it here I SCREAMED! I am pretty sure it was a freezing winter night, but that didn't stop me from ordering. The variety here is amazing and every flavor is creamy and delicious. There is something here for everyone! Always get the 4 scoop sampler because it is such a good deal! 4 large scoops for $4.25 If you tried to order 4 scoops at Cold*****, prepare to pay an arm and a leg, #justsayin. You'll want 4 scoops because you won't be able to pick one! If you think you can't finish it, bring it home and freeze it. Your future self will thank you, I promise. Some of my favorites include graham central station, blue monster, and blueberry cobbler. The line may look long but it moves fast. The workers and the way their store is set up are very efficient. They will also let you try samples, so don't be shy.

If you are near The Coffee Bean on the second floor of the Venetian, the Buchon Bakery is definitely worth the walk down the escalator to get a pastry. If you are in your room and are considering walking a bit further for strawberry croissant, it may not be worth the extra walk.

What a treat for the senses! This store brought me back 30 years to No Cal...my Bf's boyfriend's family owned an ice cream and candy shop to which we'd go in after hours and explore all our childhood sweet treat fantasies, it was Epic! It's mesmerizing how places like this bring back that fun filled, exciting vibe...I KNOW YOU get that too! I wouldn't doubt it if sugar vibrates at a high frequency, hmm... Carmel apples was on my list of things to buy here and while they were good, they didn't have that gooey, oozy, chewy carmel that I love! Probably a good thing for my thigh and diabetes sake. They were good and clean eating (not like chicken and broccoli clean), they're not too messy...that is once you cut the apples into slices. I took home one with pecans, one with peanuts and one plain. I get it if you can't wait and want instant gratification, indulge on the spot satisfaction, then that's on you, I'd probably grab extra napkins and a wet wipe!!! I would come back for sure and pick up a few donuts for the family to try and an ice cream cone for the mamma to enjoy! Until then stay sweet...

I was so excited to see this since I always see it on tiktok and boy was I disappointed! I ordered the cake and shake combo and soft serve. The line was long and they had celebrities that came plastered on the fridge. I got the birthday cake and crunchy cereal shake. The taste... was so strange to me? Like sour in a way? Like sour cream and I was so weirded out by the flavor of the ice cream and shake! The shake had crunchy bits of cereal but didn't mask that sour note. The cake was frozen and moist, but the icing was too much and very sweet. I was expecting it to be light a bit? But really it taste like those cheap birthday cakes you get at the grocery store.... The over sweet icing really killed it for me. For their price point? That is nuts! Prob not gonna give in on hype next time.

My wife and I love going there at 4:30-5 am sitting and talking, enjoy a pastry and cup of coffee, it's unique decor and atmosphere are great. Only reason it got a 4 was cleanliness. I know it can sometimes happen when your short staff and real busy, but eveytime we go in there cleanliness is an issue, it's not an exception it's the norm. I do appreciate that they just got a new cushion for our favorite seat.

The line outside is an indicator of the splendidness that awaits you on the inside. Everything you and your grandmama can think of is a flavor here. From Brambleberry to Texas Sheet Cake, to Cold Brew Coffee. Jeni's has you covered. What's better, you can get half scoops to try multiple flavors, if you're like me and want ONE OF EACH. (Someday, someday.) Today I tried the Blueberry Lavender (so so good!), the Biscuits and Peach Jam (so so so so good!!), and the Goat Cheese and Cherry (mmm drool, so so so good!!!). I'll definitely be back. Jeni's is the best ice cream in town!!

Got to love delicious treats and milk bar does a great job of making out of the box desserts. This location is right next to momfuku in the Cosmo on the strip. Great place to get a treat after a nice meal When I went here I was very inspired to try out chef Christina's delicious treats after seeing her on chef table. I heard alot about the corn cookie, all her soft serve and the crack pie, so I needed to try them all! First I started with the soft serve and I tried the cereal milk, crack pie and the fruity pebbles ice cream. All very good in their own way. The basis of the ice cream is the cereal milk ice cream which tasted exactly like corn flakes. Pretty good but definitely not my favorite. The crack pie was awesome tasting like a Carmel butterscotch flavor. Now my favorite was the fruity pebble flavor. Fruity pebbles taste great to eat and the milk is even better which is exactly what this tastes like. So good! I got a slice of crack pie which I don't even know how to explain the taste. All I can say is it is delicious! It's like a oat buttery crust with a custard with brown sugar. It's just flat out delicious! Get this! The corn cookie was nice, soft and delicious. It kind of reminds me of the cereal milk soft serve in a cookie. It's almost tastes like dunking a cookie in milk. Awesome cookie! All around a good place for treats. Fun thing is you can try out the soft serve before you purchase it. Good place to grab some delicious treats!

I am learning to eat as the Wisconsinites do. Ice cream is definitely a thing they eat and I am not complaining. This shop has some amazing flavors and even some delicious soy options (I got the soy coffee oreo, yum!). Blue Moon is a Wisconsin staple, and yes, it does taste like Fruit Loops, and no I did not need to eat more than a taste. While I am visiting the Midwest, I will have had my share of ice creams and frozen custards - hey, remember, this is America's Dairyland! - and by the end of my trip, I will announce my winner!

i had two scoops of ice cream. their mint is really good, but different than the usual mint. and their vanilla is pretty good too. i'll definitely come back again and probably get an ice cream sandwich.

I always rave about this place, just because the product is just so high quality! My first encounter with the Bouchon Bakery, was frustrating because the bakery is so hiden. We walked and walked to look for it, it was like a scavenger hunt, No freakin' lie. But in the end it was all worth it, trust me. So I ended up buying the macarons buy 5 get 1 free! Raspberry macaron: Shell was crisp, middle was nice and chewy. Nice tangy and tart raspberry jam. Soooo good! Pistachio macaron: I can't even, soo delicious I don't have words! Vanilla macaron: Crispy shell, chewy middle. The buttercream was heaven! Chocolate macaron: Perfection, ganache was perfect! Salted caramel: No too salty, not too sweet. Once again perfect! Coffee macaron: my favorite, slightly acidic. Bittersweet butter cream sooo delicious!! I wholly recommend this place to anyone who has a sweet tooth.

Fantastic ice cream that offers everything you would want from an ice cream shop. They have great ice cream, ice cream cones, ice cream sundaes, and great milkshakes. You can get something as simple as vanilla or you can get something more exciting like Matcha or Salted Butter Caramel Swirl. They make WONDERFUL sorbets. The watermelon sorbet was so damn good, I ordered a single on the side of the sundae I got! The staff is also really nice about letting you try a buttload of samples with their chilled, metal spoons. I ultimately got a banoffee sundae, which was banana and toffee with the Salted Butter Caramel Swirl as the base. I would advise you get a second bowl as shifting all the ingredients around can get messy. But damn was it good! Everything was so satisfying and hits the spot as a dessert. The waffle cone bowls only make it better. Im not the biggest fan of the orange wallpaper as the interior design, but the ice cream was more important! Either way, make sure to stop here.

Have driven by this establishment many times when I lived in Pittsburgh and in my visits, but I never pulled over to sample the goods. That is until today and it was really good! Don't be swayed by the lines. The staff is really efficient and move quickly. Prices are reasonable and portions are huge. Although I was really impressed by the different flavors of soft serve and that they are all homemade, I saw the sign for the apple dumpling sundae so I opted for that instead. My aunt went with a classic chocolate shake. The sundae is massive and the ice cream was so good, some of the best vanilla that I've had. Only critique is that the core part of the dessert were canned and were too sweet and sugary(- a star) Even though I don't opt for anything vanilla in life, I think I might squeeze in one more scoop on this trip!

Have always wanted to try the Momofuku milk bar in New York and never got the chance, so I was super excited to find this place in LV. Turned out to be my biggest disappointment in an ice cream, EVER. I got the signature cereal milk soft serve. The ice cream itself lacked richness and taste, felt like a weird middle ground between ice cream and sorbet. The cornflakes were not ordinary cornflakes. They were not flakes first of all; they were crushed and stuck together. They were not as crunchy; it felt like they have been left out for a while. Worst of all, they were SALTY. Who had the ingenious idea of combining salty and sweet?! And the price. The soft serve itself is 6$ and the cornflakes are an extra 1.25$. The whole thing comes out to about 8$ with tax. I have never paid so much for an ice cream and this is the worse ice cream I've ever had (I didn't even finish it... Me! Not finishing an ice cream?!). Perfect combination for a 1-star.

Went here excited thinking sweets would be some of the best and wow were we wrong. This place is super over priced the Cannoli's weren't good. I got enough for my whole family and no one liked them. Won't be going back to this place not worth it at all.

The scoops are bigger at Baskin Robbins, but the flavors are good. They have a coffee and donuts flavor, which is something you don't see everywhere. I imagine their cookies and brownies taste as good as they look

Oh Amelie's! I love you! You are so near and dear, and close to my heart. Shall I write you a poem? Maybe another time. Yeah...seriously, Amelie's is a not just a cafe. It is a cultural phenomenon. Where else can you get yummy homemade soup, tasty desserts, coffee, and excellent people watching in Charlotte at 3 am in the morning? Amelie's is open 24/7. So bring your laptop or book, and prepare for an escape into a magical wonderland where all of the food is good, and you can meet some pretty cool people.

Seriously the best cookies n cream milkshake I've ever had. Removing one star because the place definitely needed cleaned up and the floor was super sticky. I'm sure this is from ice cream spilled throughout the day but it could stand to be cleaned up once or twice a day.

The thought of ice cream in Scottsdale is pretty obvious. We found this little place using Yelp and we had a good experience. No one was there when we arrived and it was just a bit hard to find. You go on Miller Road but the strip mall faces the side street which is like an access road. Fatty Daddy's has 2 scoops of ice cream with one macaroon cookie on the bottom and one on top. Also has a toasted marshmallow on top. It's a good size to split with two people unless your really into your ice cream! We had the Lucky Charms and the Urkel which is chocolate and peanut butter. Both were served in a small cup and the macaroon topping it. The marshmallow is scorched with one of those butane torches and it is a nice finishing touch.

We search high and low for a place worthy to bring a little joy to our heart. Went through the Pepperment Forest, climb over Gumdrop Mountains, stop over Lollipop Woods and finally took a boat to cross Ice Cream Sea to reach our final destination, Candy Castle, Lol. This was reaction when my siblings and I came across Sloan's Ice Cream shop. We actually strolled near the Canal that lead us to St. Marks Square at the Grand Canal Shops to locate Sloan's. Upon entering this bright, colorful and charming shop brings back fond memories of being a kid. Our if your a big kid at heart, this place could easily bring a bit of joy. The friendly staff was very attentive and helpful. Despite being busy they work efficiently to make sure everyone was ok. Ice cream they offered came in various flavor from Circus to Coffee and every common flavor you would expect at an ice cream shop. There is an assortment of ice cream sundae including the outrageous, Tracy's Kitchen Sink, which is 18 scoops of Ice Cream and tons of toppings in a kitchen sink. We ended up getting a Circus Box Sundae; scoop of circus ice cream, hot fudge, gummy bears, whipped cream & cherry with a fun reusable plastic treasure chest. Circus ice cream was sweet but the toppings made it fun to eat. The brownie and candy cookie we got were equally delicious because you have the option to warm them up. They were soft, chewy and quite large for a single serving. Actually alot of the items offered could be shared between 2 or 3 people. Another cool thing that Sloan's make is their Waffle Cones. They are made fresh in house every day. Overall a fun place to take in the scenary and be like a kid again. A cool addition to the Grand Canal shop at Venetian. Will be back to try other items if I'm ever in the area. 2018 Yelp Review #11

Don't be fooled by the look of the building -- there is a beautiful donut wonderland inside waiting for you. It might have been a blessing in disguise that we don't live on the west side, or I may gain some serious weight from going to Jack Frost every day. I am totally willing to drive 40+ minutes just to get a box of donuts. The price is very reasonable, and the staff is very nice. The donuts here are pillowy and light, and you can taste the freshness in every bite. So good. My favorites are the classics -- glazed, sour cream, Boston cream, and don't miss out on the maple bacon -- it's got real bacon on top of creamy maple glaze. Heavenly!

Donut Bar... home of the biggest donuts I've ever seen. They are pretty darned tasty too. I have visited here a few times. The service is always friendly and there is always many choices. My favorite is the chocolate euphoria. Chocolate curls, delicious frosting, and light, fluffy donut. Today's visit I got a mud pie, lemon pistachio, and cake batter. The lemon pistachio was refreshing. The glaze was light and just tart enough. It had a sprinkling of pistachios. Perfect balance. The mud pie was chocolaty deliciousness. I didn't try the cake batter but it did look yummy. I recommend Donut Bar for a sweet treat. Bring your friends though because the size definitely makes them shareable!
$9.95 for 6 small donuts? So sad it's come to this. Must be some expensive whip creme on top of these. Hadn't been here in years before they became designer donuts. Don't think I'll be back.

Fantastic little spot! Raspberry Tart was to die for!!!! Fig, bacon and Brie Tratine was also excellent. Also sampled other pastries all were spot on! Cool funky little spot!!! Staff was super helpful bending to my picky kids and making them happy. Would definitely come again!

Ordered a 6" cake, lobster tails, and cannolis. I don't know if I'd spend so much on a cake again, it was good but probably not gonna be something I'll need to have again. Lobster tails were ok. But the cannolis are very good. Even the next day still delicious.

One of the best ice cream places in the valley. My favorite is a pretzel cone with peanut butter ice cream and some salted Caramel. Their sundaes are really delicious and filling. The only downside to this place is their floats don't have enough ice cream and the soda always seems warm so it melts it too fast. The left over soda in the bottle, because it is warm, you don't really feel like drinking the rest of it.

For us their bakery kiosk was conveniently located near our suite's elevators. Content that I got my macaron fix quelled due to its larger portion size. Their confection is bigger than the average macarons. No complaints from this carber -_0 Plus thanks for the hot water (brought my own oolong in the suite). Upon the initial chomp, the generous raspberry macaron was puffy, chewy, fruity, and creamy. The buttercream oozed out w/each bite - nothing wrong w/that. I actually prefer buttercream over ganache. But to each their own of course. Their espressos are espressos and cupcakes are...you get my point. Hubs just needed a quick shot of caffeine and he's into chocolates. That may be sufficed anywhere. Focus on their puffed pastries and fritters. Next time we're in LV I've gotta try their chocolate croissant. They ran out so that triggered my curiosity. Next time Bouchon...next time. Ã bientÃ´t ^_^

Hadn't been here for a couple if yrs but stopped today & was disappointed. Never found ticket disperser, older lady waited on me was a bit rude. Peanut butter bars tasted like they had canned frosting on them..kinda gross. Not what it used to be. I'll go elsewhere next week.
I thought the only place this was found was inside Disneyland so I was very happy when I bumped into this place in Vegas. Love their ice cream and chocolate!

Friendly staff, & amazing pastries!! I have been looking for rainbow cakes again since I always had them as a kid and I found them here!! I am beyond excited that Prestie's makes these. Their other pastries are amazing too. Thanks for existing!

A hot mess!!! The line was "ridiculously" long for no justifiable reason! They definitely need to figure out an efficient ordering system. PLEASE train your staff behind the scenes! It's so unprofessional & inconsiderate to train staff in front of customers....especially during peak hours! Oh, the pastry review by the way... Mediocre from European standards, Good for American standards. The croissant was divine when reheated and made into a sandwich at home! Next time I'm back, I hope they have their stuff together.

the truth is in the soup. the pastries are AMAZING but the soup, though? the SOUP!?! the Spinach Asparagus Leek is my all time fave, I order that every time I catch it on the menu. and the tomato is delicious from a bowl or a glass (bloody mary anyone?) This is one of the best spots in CLT no matter what time it is. So go... and bring me back some soup?

Best donuts I've ever had and I'm not even vegan or remotely close to, HOWEVER, I'm interested in trying more vegan places if they're all as delish. If the line looks long, don't let that discourage you - it moves pretty fast and it's well worth the wait.

I had high expectations for this place because they have one in ny. I had order cereal milk ice cream and cornflakes. I do not recommend it because it made the ice cream extremely salty. And it was not worth $7, will not be coming back.
You may have to wait in line, but this is the BEST bakery in Little Italy. Their non-bakery is also quite good. There is an area for eating, and the place is popular.
We received exceptional service from Malik. He was attentive to what I was looking for and gave me the perfect chocolate treat. Thanks!

What an eclectic place! Full of mismatched furniture and friendly people, this place is great. I was recommended to come here by many of the locals. They're known for their salted caramel brownie with over 1,270,681 sold! I haven't tried mine yet but I'm sure it will not disappoint. This location is open 24 hours and plays hip music with a variety of places to sit and get work done. I got the yogurt and granola with berries and it was on point. Coffee is delicious. I'd definitely recommend this place.

Our go-to dessert in Phoenix! I can't say enough good things about this place. The service is excellent and the owner is passionate about their quality products. I recommend the dough melt, the artisan ice cream and specially baked donuts make all the difference. I'd had donut ice cream sandwiches before, but nothing this good. They'll let you try all the flavors you want, so you're guaranteed to get something you like!
Great treats and a beautiful display.
Cute little ice cream place! We had the Flight and chose 5 different flavors! They were all delicious. I love how they come in cupcake Tins.

My husband and I made sure to stop in at least three of the five days we were in town. Make sure you go early because once they are gone, your out of luck! My favorite hands down had to be the maple bacon but there are no wrong choices to be made here. Definitely a place not to be missed if you're down in old Vegas!
Donuts are freaking amazing and delicious m! Blueberry donut was soggy though but everything else Devine

I've always wanted to visit the iconic momofuku milk bar ever since I've seen pictures of it on Tumblr and realized that the store was located in New York. I am from California so I never thought I would ever be able to visit. While We were at eggslut, I serendipitously stumbled upon this place and we got the basic order which was the vanilla ice cream with corn flakes (there's an actual name for that but i think it's soft serve) and it was just like eating clouds or air in the best way.

This little place has poor decor and it looks outdated. BUT IT'S FOOD IS AWESOME! !! I'm a bacon, sausage, steak and cheese loving individual. BUT, I love their veggie wrap, and I would have it everyday for lunch if I could. Their wraps and sandwiches are so delicious. I have been going here for over two years, and will continue to go.

I seriously don't get it. The line was out the door. We tried three different flavors, and none were outstanding. They were good, but not wonderful. Maybe I'm just spoiled from the many excellent ice cream places in the greater LA area.

Went out with friends to a local eatery and for dessert we walked around the corner for ice cream! One of my friends had Vanilla Bean ice cream and another had Birthday Cake ice cream. I saw Beer and Pretzel flavored ice cream as well as Cookie Monster ice cream which is blue with chunks of cookies in it! I had a taste of Sweet Corn ice cream and it was very yummy. The ice cream is served in small Chinese take out boxes topped with a fortune cookie, very cute! Court yard seating with picnic benches, it's cozy and friendly. I'll be back with my sister who is looking for an ice cream parlor off the beaten path.

Just a fun place to visit. Really enjoyed the art in the bathroom. They are so friendly and have great donuts. The milk on tap is pretty cool. Would recommend the French toast donut. They are very kid friendly as well. My son loved his Captain America donut. 5/5 would recommend.

Great cupcakes! They are sweet but not too sweet in that they taste sugary. The cake is well baked. Flavor combinations are really good. The icing is not cheap and actually tastes like what you would expect it to. It's a big cupcake so can definitely be split for 2 or I can be dessert for one. And the price is fair.

Awesome little shop downtown. We swung in after lunch for a dessert to take back to the hotel for later. We got two different of there edible cookie dough treats. She picked the sugar cookie and I got the fudge brownie cookie. Both were delicious and eaten very quickly. We also got a deep dish fudge batter chocolate chip cookie to share and a cinnamon bun cupcake and a toffee cupcake. Again everything was amazing and we can't wait to stop in again. The young woman who waited on us was very friendly and offered a lot of suggestions all which were spot on.
