I ordered a half school of mint chip with hazelnut chocolate, topped with a vanilla macaroon and a toasted marshmallow. I have to admit that the toasted marshmallow was so cool! I didn't realize how much of an addition it was until we tried it. It was fun and I would recommend this place to try at least once! There was plenty of seating and the service was nice.

We dropped by during the Feast of Assumption and it was packed! The wait was well with the delicate and delicious pastry! The fresh fruit cheesecake is very fluffy and semi-sweet -- which is how I like my cheesecake. The cannoli had a nice crunch and deliciously sweet filling! I'll definitely be back to the everything else! Price is reasonable for sure. Just make sure you take a number and listen for it when they call it out :)

This is my husband's favorite ice cream shop. Since it's quite a drive from our house, we don't get to go that often, but the times we do, Sweet Republic never disappoints. They have such a great variety of uncommon flavors. The hubs always buys a scoop or two there and then purchases a pint of their lime basil sorbet to-go every single time. I'm not going to lie, I'm a pretty boring ice-cream eater, so I always just eat the Madagascar vanilla bean ice-cream. I figure, if it ain't broke, don't fix it! :)

Downtown Vegas. I love you and I hate you. Easy to get around for pedestrians but it's sort of like walking thru a zombie minefield of people asking for money, people talking to themselves or wondering if you're going to get mugged right around the corner. Yeah, not pretty. Perseverance is the key. My main tip for you is Donut Bar's storefront is actually on Carson Avenue & not on 6th Street. I planned on getting 2 donuts but everything looked so alluring I settled for 3 & dealt with the consequences later. This was my breakfast & snack for later. Hmm. Taste was okay. For me it was very sweet but the aim to a donut's success is the texture of the dough & unfortunately all 3 of my choices were on the dry side. Maybe it was an off day? Because look at all the 4-5 Star reviews here. I am like, huh? I dunno. Creme BrÃ»lÃ©e Donut - Their specialty. The hard, crunchy brÃ»lÃ©e'd exterior sticks to your teeth. The creme inside was good. Blueberry Cheesecake Donut-Yeast donut with comstock blueberry filling & iced cream cheese frosting was very sweet & not very cheesecake-like. Oreo Birthday Cake Donut- Yeast donut stuffed with an Oreo cookie inside. Although the Oreo was soggy if I had to choose, I liked this donut out of my 3 picks. I was also bummed to see they no longer had the cartons of Stump Town coffee and only a bottled version of cold brew which brought my bummer level down further. In my eyes I prefer Mr. Donut & Donut King so for Oahuans don't fret too much if you can't get to Donut Bar on your next trip to the 9th Island. You have very good options at home.

I walked in with all three of my children as usual mask required sticker marker on the floor for social distancing. The people who work their are super friendly. Vegan donuts bomb AF. They have vegan options for iced coffee too. Sit down dining is outside only. They have chocolate milk for the kids. I forgot to take pictures but we liked the vegan strawberry one the most

Extremely scrumptious and decadent French pasties! I came out of town after finding this bakery online and seeing the decor. Such a vibrant bakery with eclectic and cute decor that made it feel both homey yet chic. Got a assortment of desserts to try such a the macarons (flavored meringue cookie), elephant ears (sugared phyllo pastry), salted Carmel brownie, pecan pie tarts and entremet (nut layered cake. Everything was delicious and it was my first time having a honey macaron which was beautifully decorated with edible gold foil.

One of Cleveland's best and most well-known food brands, Mitchell's Ice Cream has a reputation that far exceeds this Ohio City flagship, if its numerous outlets throughout Northeast Ohio are any indication. Here in Ohio City, they occupy what appears to be a former theatre space, judging by the prominent marquee outside, which has been constantly busy every time I've walked by. With good reason. There are dozens of ice cream flavors to choose from. The several I tried most recently - wildberry crumble, peanut butter chocolate chunk, and toasted pistachio - were super creamy and super delicious. Almost on par with Bi-Rite and Humphry Slocombe of the Bay Area or Toscanini's of Boston, but I'll have to do side-by-side taste tests just to be sure. To handle the crowds, there was an army of staff behind the counter operating smoothly, efficiently, and quickly. The line kept moving steadily and I didn't have to wait long even though I was stuck behind a large party that positively dithered their way through the flavor selection and checkout process. Folks, if you're already waiting in line, then instead of chitchatting idly and posing for ugly duckface instaselfies, it helps to take a peek at the flavors before you get to the counter, whether by spying what's clearly on offer inside the cases or by looking at prominently displayed menus. Otherwise, if you know what you want, you can treat yourself to views of their production and lab areas, visible through a large windowed wall behind the counter. Or pound out some reviews on your Yelp app. Also, I have to give Mitchell's a shout out. Having moved here recently, I was apprehensive about leaving the Bay Area for a red state. I've gotten more than my share of nasty stares from folks all around the region who look like sleeper-cell domestic terrorists, and I've also been cut off many times by otherwise super-slow drivers who suddenly get ultra-triggered when they see my out-of-state license plates. But I've also been heartened by how Ohio City is *somewhat* inclusive, diverse, and welcoming - at least performatively so - judging by how many businesses decked themselves in rainbow colors for Pride Month recently. Mitchell's was one of these. Thanks for demonstrating your support!

What a cute place! The woman in the store was very friendly and offered to let me try samples! They have some odd flavors like cucumber and cantaloupe,which were both very refreshing! I can't wait to bring my sister here.
The flavors are so good here. I had the honey lavender and chocolate brownie swirl. Their ice cream is so soft and creamy.

So this is what you call sweet and savory heaven. I am visiting a friend in town and he introduced me to the "next level" of donuts and a trip to the gym following it. I was extremely pleased by the array of options and flavors. The donuts are huge. Well worth the extra run afterwards. And this bar had the nerve to have a grilled cheese donut! I went two times. It would have been three times in 4 days, but I drove by around noon one day and they were already sold out! What a bummer. But I learned quickly, if I'm craving a donut, I need to get to Donut Bar ASAP!

Worth the wait! I've been dying to try Batch House ever since they opened. Went on Halloween and even though the line was long I would do it all over again. The draft tres leche iced latte was AMAZING (I only wish they'd sold more sizes so I could've gotten even more)! I got 2 types of brownies, a cookie, and an apple pie. Everything was delicious and didn't last long in my home. The employees were friendly and very conscious of COVID safety!

Stopped in for some cupcakes with bae and friends. My friends actually weren't feeling rich cupcakes at the moment so luckily they also have a gourmet ice cream bar inside. I sampled the bubblegum ice cream and while it was crazily delectable (and in season) I still opted for my original intent and ordered the red velvet cupcake. I find it odd that they give you something so potentially messy without a fork or napkins, so I went back and asked for some. To my shock, they handed me a very interesting thin, wooden fork. It was odd in a cute/unique way, but didn't slide off the lips smoothly like a plastic or metal fork. Enough about the fork though - my cupcake was so good. The texture of the cupcake bread itself is very moist, and spongey. That's great cause there's nothing more disappointing than a dried out cupcake. The frosting is intensely sweet and rich. I find myself having to cut back a little on it to even out the frosting to cupcake ratio. The cupcakes are good - but they don't come cheap. Me and my boyfriend only ordered 2 cupcakes (sans beverage) and the bill was almost 8 dollars. They were sweet enough to give our cheap asses a free cup of water to quench the thirst that comes with eating cupcakes. Love Sprinkles Cupcakes for a once in a blue moon indulgence. PS, Neither of our cupcakes had sprinkles on them lol.

The place was crazy crowded with people not understanding the whole deal about taking a number and then calling numbers. They had taken numbers but then they felt that there was some reason that they still needed to put their nose against the glass. Whatever. I got my number and took a seat. Presti's isn't just a bakery but that's why I was here. They still have a big deli counter of sandwiches and salads and other ready-to-eat delicious looking things. Lasagna? Pasta salad? Tomato mozzarella salad? Fruit salad? All looked delicious. But I was here for the baked treats. So many to choose from. Brownies (coconut, peanut butter and regular chocolate), cream puffs, eclairs, almond horns, all sort of tastiness! I went with a simple canoli and a handful of Linzers (apricot and raspberry). Heavenly!
Place is amazing. Can't say enough about how great the bread is. The almond croissant is a fast sellout so get there early!

Came here for a quick ice cream snack! This place did not disappoint! The inside decor is awesome and gives you that hip ice cream parlor feel. The lady taking orders was exceptionally nice and we felt welcomed as if we were regulars! I ordered the cookie mint with a waffle cone and it was delicious! They even have seating in the back to enjoy your treat! Forget about Dairy Queen down the street this is my new spot!
Omg their ice cream here is amazing!!! Their biscotti and strawberry cheesecake ice cream are sooo good.

For some reason I really liked the look of this bakery. The customer area is pretty small (no tables, etc), leaving a lot of room for the actual baking area. The display case is quite attractive, although I would have appreciated if more of the items in it were labeled (the chalkboard says what they all are, but it's not always immediately evident which is which!) We focused on savory items here. The ham & cheese croissant was tasty but a bit too greasy for me - on the other hand, it's a ham and *cheese croissant*, so that's not too surprising. I liked that it had plenty of good quality ham inside. Overall I probably preferred the sausage roll, which was a roll filled with good Italian sausage and caramelized onions. The onions were a bit too sweet for me, but I really liked the dough for the roll. Finally, we tried the monkey bread. I was surprised it was made with croissant dough, and it was a little dry for my taste - the dough was not moist and there was not a hint of a syrupy component. Instead, it was crispy at the edges. However I really liked how cinnamony it was. Clearly an excellent bakery.

So, the first time I visited I was amazed with the ice cream. The second time I wasn't as happy with my pick. However, the waffle cones are incredibly good - I'm definitely happy I tried one even since I usually just opt for a cup.
Great coffee actually!! Of course huge variety of delicious donuts -but coffee lovers rest assured, good spot.

We went to restaurant for lunch on Sat, around 1:30 pm, every table was dirty and not wiped, our waitress actually seemed annoyed that we asked for our table to be cleaned before she puts the food on it, she said they have been busy and she doesn't have time! Hmm, isn't restaurants supposed to pay attention to cleanliness? Also, I ordered a vegetarian sandwich and it came with eggs on it, what's that about? Bad service, over price and. It that good of food!

Yes the desserts are awesome! But THE COFFEE SUCKS. I always come back for desserts but never coffee. Tonight I gave the coffee a chance again at their new location. & they BURNED ALL OF MY INSIDES. Stay away from the lattes unless you enjoy burning coffee.

I've always wanted to try his pastries since I've heard so many things about it but I've always been to lazy to try to find it lol. Embarrassed to say this cause I've always stayed at palazzo/Venetian as a visitor to resident. I had to wait in line but they had an efficient system going on so the wait wasn't too bad. Let me just start by saying EVERYTHING LOOKS GOOD! Like I wanted to get everything but I knew it was going to be very expensive as no prices were marked, it's like order what looks good then surprise! I ended up getting 2 lobster tails, 2 cannolis, and a strawberry cheesecake. The lobster tails were AMAZING. They were crispy and perfect, even when I ate it around 5 hours after buying them. I liked that they weren't too sweet and even my mom loved them. I am definitely going to buy more of those when I go back. The cannolis on the other hand weren't that good. I ended up only eating half of one and gave the other one away. I was disappointed in them and wish I had ordered more lobster tails instead. The cheesecake was expensive like almost $12 and it was so small. It was pretty good though, there's not much crust or anything like Cheesecake Factory ones but more like just the cheesecake part. If you're a cheesecake fan I definitely recommend. Overall I'd definitely go back for more lobster tails. I'd highly recommend you get some if you stop by! The bakery is pretty pricey but if it's good, it's worth it!

The ice cream, marshmallow and cookie thing is a pretty good combination. Unfortunately this place is so dirty that I wouldn't want to come back. Dirty floors, dirty walls, dirty tables, trash overflowing. It was just gross to sit there and eat.

I woke up at 5:00am to get on the Bouchon Bakery line because I had been dreaming of their raspberry macaroons ever since I tasted one on our last visit to Vegas. At 6:00 am, the line was about 15 people deep and I happily waited. The macaroons were just as heavenly as I had remembered and the chocolate croissants were equally so! I only wish they shipped their full menu nationwide. I was thrilled to find out that they do ship the macaroons through the goldbelly website. I know what I'm asking for on my birthday, lol.

I had heard a lot about this place and was eager to get my hands on a macaron. The location is a bakery and there's another restaurant on the other side of the hotel... I got the chocolate one which was bigger than your average macaron and was very eager to bite into it...the macaron is good but i still prefer bottega louie. I think my expectations were too high coupled with my amusement of holding an oversized macaron. I'll be back to try their other bakery items which will hopefully be better.

We stopped by here on the way home to satisfy my special lady wife's need for sweets after two stops indulging my own beer needs. i was surprised at the crowd just before 9 o'clock on a Thursday night. i really had not read anything about this place and had driven by countless times having no clue it even existed. The cluster of ooglers and droolers deciding what to order wasn't ideal, but some dude took our order and moved us along. i just told him i wanted something chocolate and chocolate with some chocolate. Whatever he picked out was perfect. The chocolate mousse-stuff went nicely with my Abita Jockamo IPA and the latest episode of Big Brother. All in all, our order was like $13 for 2 little bites and two bigger treats. Thanks be to the Entertainment Book for $5 off, bringing the total to $8.

LV Sprinkles is always a hit with my kids. We first visited the one in La Jolla a couple years ago and when we heard there was one here when we moved to LV a couple years ago, my kids were beyond thrilled. Personally, I love the cute marketing they do, simple clean wooden displays and bright coloring makes it attractive to the eye. The flavors they have each day such as red velvet or vanilla are popular, but they have a couple new ones each month or different days of the week, as well. Flavors like chai or chocolate-peanut butter, lemon meringue or smores are some of the interesting varieties. I don't always get one, but my daughters adore the red velvet, I have tried the lemon meringue which was a little dry in my opinion, but the lemon curd and burnt marshmallow top was a nice touch. It's a fun outing if you're looking for something to do by the Linq and there's cute stores like Kitson and nice restaurants located all around.

I've always been a huge Jack Frost fan. Their donuts are delicious and beautiful. Unfortunately, my recent experience was not a good one. Last weekend I attempted to purchase donuts for two events. The first was a order of cannoli donuts for a birthday party and the second was a donut cake. I attempted to place these orders several times. My repeated phone calls went unanswered and when I'd stop in to place the order, the shop would be sold out and closed. When I finally went there and found them open, I was told that I could not place a cake order. The manager would have to call me. I did place the order for the cannoli donuts and paid for them in advance. Several hours later the manager called me and I placed the cake order, paying for it over the phone as required. When I arrived a few days later, they gave me the cake and informed me that I had never placed the order for the cannoli donuts. The woman who had told me this was the same one who had taken my order in person and who I had paid. She attempted to text the manager who was once again not in the shop. The manager did not answer. She then found the order and told me they weren't made. She gave me two dozen donuts, which were not the type I wanted, and told me the manager would call me. I've waited an entire week to write this review, hoping that Jack Frost would correct this issue, that I'd at least get a call from the manager and that they'd offer to make me the cannoli donuts. They have not contacted me and at this point, I doubt they will. While Jack Frost's donuts are beautiful and delicious, I don't see myself returning. Their customer service is terrible. I'm truly disappointed in them.

I visited as part of my search for my perfect French macaron locally. Bouchon macarons are about 3 times the size of a normal macaron but are also about 3x the price at $3+ a piece. But buy 5 and get 1 free. They do have the perfect texture, thin, crispy outer shell over the perfectly chewy center. The filling was just the right amount, but it was the filling that accounts for the 4 stars vs 5. It is good but it's a sweet buttercream type filing even in the raspberry. I prefer a real fruit filling with a little tart to it. Overall, they are delicious and I would recommend. If you prefer the fruit filling tart as well I'd recommend checking out La Belle Terre bakery on W. Sahara.
It is loud in there but clean and unique. They have lots of options with great tasting ice cream. What a perfect location.

Best Ice cream that has ever graced my tastebuds!!!! My favorite is Almond Butter Brittle and Goey Butter Cake!!! Try it!!! Even if the line is long, it's worth it!!!.. Oh and they do offer Vegan flavors that my vegan friends LOVE!!

Best coffee flavored ice-cream I've ever had. I had the Vietnamese coffee ice cream on the pretzel cone. The saltiness of the pretzel cone mixed with the sweet coffee ice cream was amazing! It was hard to get a bite with ice cream and cone though.

Ah - a non franchise fresh ice cream palour just like the days of old. There's a bit of a nostalgic air to this classic ice creamery. They may not have 31 flavors but they have plenty of traditional and less popular but equally delectable choices. I love coconut and dark chocolate and they have it. If you love fresh, creamy hand scooped ice cream don't miss this little spot across the street from Joyride Tacos which is a good place for a meal before you finish here with dessert.

My husband and I stopped in to redeem a Groupon I purchased today for $15.00 in donuts. I read a few weeks back that this donut shop received an award for Best of Las Vegas and was featured in the magazine that was inside the Las Vegas Review-Journal. We arrived after 11:30 am and paid for parking outside the establishment. Upon entering the store, it was reasonably busy as they close at 2:00 pm. A pleasant and helpful young lady greeted us. I informed her we were redeeming a Groupon. I explained that this was our first time visiting their store. She graciously explained the various donuts they had from regular size to very large. She let me know which ones were their bestsellers. She described some as being very light and fluffy. She was very patient as we made our selections. She let me know when I reached $15.00. She took us to the register and told me to wait a minute. She returned shortly with another box of various donuts, including some of the enormous donuts. I redeemed my Groupon and thanked her. Due to the beautiful customer service and the delightful donuts my family and I indulged in when we returned to Henderson; we will be repeat customers as these are some of the best donuts we've eaten and we have tried many donut shops over the 45+ years. This is the place to come and worth the drive. It's outstanding!
love it. i have been comming here with the rents since i was little, so its nostolgic for me. i still get the same thing, a scoop of lemon on top of a scoop of chocolate in a waffle cone.

I am so sorry Christina Tosi, your dessert bar is just . . .not that great! Christina is one of my favorite celebrity chefs and I love seeing her on tv as well as watching her cooking, her style, pastries, etc just her being a chef! I really wanted to try her place and we came by after lunch for something light for dessert. I saw all the cookie flavors and wanted to try a few but then my eyes caught the spiked milkshakes! So, I opted for the cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie and the White-Russian-Cereal-Milk Shake. The cookie was nothing special . . .and actually, nothing making me want to order it again or try another type of cookie. It was chewy but not a good chewy, and it seems over baked as it was pretty tough. The cornflakes have a very subtle crispness and saltiness, the marshmallow just seems to add sweetness, and the chocolate chips are almost nonexistent. It was just not a great cookie and I expected so much more. As for the milkshake, this was pretty good. The cereal milk flavor is interesting, unique, and pretty tasty! Spiked with the alcohol it becomes a great blend of sweet and . . . umami? Is that the best way to describe a boozy milkshake? I don't know, but it was good! I won't mind trying Milk Bar again, but definitely not the cookies next time.

Ice cream with cornflakes on it, that tastes like a bowl of corn flakes, but many times more expensive. What is the point? I did really like the crack pie, which was gooey and buttery, and husband enjoyed the birthday cake truffles. Wouldn't make a special effort to return, though.

Every time I step inside Cosmopolitan, I always gaze upon the delicious menu at Milk Bar. This store hails from New York City and the cakes really are THAT GOOD. While you may find a select few items at your local Target, they have a much wider variety of cake pops, ice cream, and other delectable goods at this storefront. We weren't looking to gorge on the items so we simply left with a few cake pops with us. If you happen to have an Identity account, make sure to provide it so you can get points for your purchase. I appreciate the fact that this place is also open relatively late so you can satisfy that late night craving! (35/100--2022)

Baked goods are good considering other bakeries available in the area. I wouldn't say it's great, but definitely worth a stop if you're nearby since they are open 24 hours daily. Sandwiches are tasty but somewhat smallish. The salted caramel brownie is a favorite and baguettes are perfect. Ambiance & Atmosphere: kitschy bordering on trying too hard, noisy, & the layout leaves the ordering line blocking the display cases so it can be difficult to have time to shop the offerings when the counter help is asking for your order right when you first see the contents du jour. I'll be back when nearby but doubt I'd make a special trip to Amelie's.
Amazing service! Charming location! Delicious ice cream.

So glad this New York staple has made its way to Vegas. I'd never had it before, but have heard about how awesome it is. My love for this place is all in the birthday cake truffles and crack pie. You'll never get anything that tastes like it does here. The actual birthday cake is also worth the $60 if you're splurging. The soft serve is good, but definitely not what I expected. It's super cool that it's made from cereal milk, but the corn flake ice cream isn't as sweet as I expected it to be.

I'm new to the city so I didn't know where to go for a cupcake. This was the closet place to me and I'm glad I went! They have so many cupcake options, truffles, and chocolate covered pretzels! I will come back

I found this bakery highly overrated. We bought three items and each was beyond stale. Gave an extra as they refunded our money with no hesitation. They had to realize how stale they were when we bought them.

Hands down some of the best ice cream I've had the delight to taste. It was like a bountiful piece from heaven. I had the coffee and donuts and I also had the moms apple pie. My boyfriend had the coconut, banana, and strawberry. All these flavors were amazing! The staff was courteous and kind and willing to let us enjoy some samples so we could make our choices easier. I was disappointed by the waffle cone quality, but the ice cream honestly was well worth the walk. I didn't even care for the waffle cone after the first bite. Will definitely return on our next visit

It's ice cream. Definetly ice cream. Same stuff that comes out of the carton at any supermarket. Great place to grab a malt, float, or shake, but with all the places serving home-made signature recipe ice cream in Cleveland Honey Hut just doesn't top the list.

Since I live in the south now I don't get to enjoy the ethnic bakeries like I did when I was a kid growing up in Cleveland. I was literally a big kid in a candy store except the candy store was an Italian bakery and deli! Got a nice variety of cookies and a small antipasto. Kolachy's and macaroons were my favs. We arrived at 3pm in a Saturday and there was no wait. Parking wasn't too bad, just found a spot in a side street. Staff was very friendly. Will be back!!

The ice cream is great and they offer a lot choices. The marshmallows are the best, I like how they sell them too. I plan on buying marshmallows once hot chocolate season is here. This was a good place to bring our young family. The kids sat at a little table and we played, Connect Four and other board game that is provided here. I hope they open a closer store, but it was worth the drive.

One of the first places I tried when I came to Champaign and it did not disappoint. I loved the texture of the custard with the chocolate filling and some nuts mixed in. I wish it were open longer--I don't even know when it closes but I am craving some right now. It's so delicious! It's great for the summer days definitely.

Love it. It's an odd place to put a bakery at the back of an escalator. Line wasn't that long and it moves fast. Strawberry Croissant: pretty sweet and jammy. Love the top crumbs on the top. It's interesting and not a lot of places sell strawberry croissant. Chocolate Croissant: Very buttery and flaky. It was so delicious and flakes were everywhere. Chocolate wasn't overwhelming. Bacon, Egg Croissant: Such a good to-go breakfast. The egg's texture was pretty off and rubbery though. Macarons: Bigger than the usual size but the price matches it. No extraordinary flavors, just the basics: vanilla, chocolate, caramel, espresso, pistachio, and strawberry. Each were good and had the right texture.
Nice place to chill, good bakery. Enjoyed my time there.

Melttttttttttttttttt my heart :)))) I love it here, cute hole in the wall. I got the mint chocolate chip in a Chinese to go box :) with a fortune cookie. we sat outside, people watching. I like it here.

I will keep this short and to the point. The 2 stars is for their seemingly complete disregard for customer safety. No masks, no gloves and zero physical distance between employees inside the space. And while I cannot comment on their cleaning practices when they open and close, it was clear to me when we picked up a pint they they need to improve their interaction practices with the customers. I wore a mask, it would be simple for the owner to provide them for his employees. I implore the owner to reach out to me and let me know that they are working to improve. On the plus side, the ice cream was spectacular. Now if they can only improve the safety.

My favorite French bakery! I always stop by for a breakfast sandwich on croissant and grab a latte or espresso. Can't beat their coffee prices! Other coffee shops in the area overcharge for their watered down coffee and I think Amelie's does the opposite. I love seeing what pastries are in stock and it's always a treat to splurge on one (or four). Def recommend for a local cafe and bakery.

We're happy to have found this little place that's in the middle of downtown Phoenix! We were walking around and happened to see a small street sign that pointed us to Melt. It wasn't too late yet so there was no wait when we walked into the small establishment. The staff promptly greeted us and offered us samples. We had never been here before so we gave a couple a try! Each flavor was unique and really delicious. I decided to get the mango sorbet which was really fluffy and just melted in my mouth. Also really unique is that they serve ice-cream in little Chinese take-out containers and also give a fortune cookie! There's some seating outside but not much. Like I said previously, it wasn't too crowded when we got there so we were able to find a seat, however it got much busier by the time we were done enjoying our ice-cream. I definitely recommend giving this place a try!

By far the most amazing cupcakes ever! Love this place! The location is fun and you can walk around and enjoy people watching while enjoying your little piece of heaven! I also placed a very large wedding order over the phone and it seriously took all of 5 minutes, I scheduled my pick up date and they were all ready for me and packaged perfectly! If you want to taste something Amazing, and you've never had Sprinkles Don't wait! You and your belly will be glad you went!

Hard to find and not too many choices. I ended up getting red velvet, cinnamon sugar, vanilla, and coconut cupcakes. $15 for 4 cupcakes, pricey in my opinion. Don't get the cinnamon sugar or red velvet, nothing special. Tasted like I could've gotten them from Albertsons. The cinnamon sugar doesn't even have frosting, it's just a muffin rolled around in cinnamon which I thought was disappointing. The coconut and vanilla were decent, the cake was moist and the flavors were stronger. All in all, I wouldn't come back to this place.

Lovely little local place with locally-made fresh frozen desserts. I got blueberry sorbet and vegan banana (as I am lactose-intolerant. boo.) Sister got Lucky Charms (lucky!) and a butter finger sort of ice cream. She said they were very good. My blueberry sorbet was outstanding, but the banana tasted like something I could make at home with a yonana maker. Should have sampled it first. OH well. It was a lovely evening, so the outdoor seating was on point. Worth a drive or walk to try if you're in the area visiting or after a baseball game.
Wow! This place is great! The whole vibe and atmosphere is really fun and exciting. Everyone there seemed happy to help. Try the Vietnamese coffee flavor!

They have the BEST carrot cake EVER. Like fucking ever. It's amazing. The end. Not the end. It took us forever to find this tiny bakery. But, it was well worth it. The carrot cake was delicious. I also got this chocolate cookie thing with vanilla creme in it. That was good, but man, the carrot cake was AMAZING.

My first time coming here and I like it! Little cute shop and they have cream infused ice cream serving premium matcha sourced straight from Japan featuring layered drinks plus boba, but optional. If you grew up and loved cereals and now you're tired eating cereals or simply because you don't have time to eat in the morning for breakfast and you have a favorite childhood cereals, this is the place to go! They have cereal shakes such as Fruity Pebbles, Cinnamon Toast Crunch or Oreos mixed together with super premium 16% butter fat ice cream and topped off with one of these choices like graham cracker crumbs, gummy bears, chocolate or caramel drizzle and teddy grahams. I ordered their brown sugar milk tea with boba and matcha latte. The price is right for the size, I wished they could put more matcha on my latte. The boba is a bit firm, but it works. Their other desserts look delicious too and I will come back to try their other yummy items in their menu.

Big name, but disappointed in product. My friend and I are local, came down about 7:30 am and was first customer in store. One thing we noticed was the floors looked dirty, especially since the store if fairly new. I realize they are known for their cakes, but I wanted a light buttery croissant, and sadly what I received was a dense dinner roll shaped as a croissant. We had a conoli also, and the filling was quite good but the shell was thick and tasted like it was frozen or stale. We ordered some cashew butter cookies and was hard like a biscotti, maybe it is supposed to be that way. The staff was nice and I'm glad I checked it out, but it was nothing special and didn't WOW me.

Holy Moly - I went here twice in five days. My family first came here during lunch time and convinced me that I needed to eat ice cream before dinner (still can't decide if that was a bad or good idea). We each got the miniature cones with one heaping scoop of ice cream. Don't try to walk around eating this ice cream, because you will get it all over your hand and face and look ridiculous. You should just sit down for the 10 minutes it takes to eat the ice cream and enjoy the people watching. If you need to use the restroom, there are keys to let you in.
Delicious milk shakes. Very unique. Jayne walked us through the options and gave us some samples to taste. A little pricey but what do you expect for Vegas.

This is a fun, family-friendly to take your kids. I recently popped in to get some ice cream for my son after he got some shots. The cotton candy ice cream cheered him right up! The dessert menu is extensive, I will definitely come back with the rest of my family!
I really love this place! Especially since it's so close to home! Only thing is I wish they were open a little later especially on weekends.

I'm a huge Thomas Keller fan and was excited to find a Bouchon bakery by the elevators in the Venetian. The pastries are to die for!! Incredible croissants, muffins, cookies and more. Sadly, the coffee was terrible!! I ordered Anericanos two days in a row and was disappointed. They use one of those automated coffee machines vs. a traditional espresso machine, so the coffee tasted like drip. Needless to say, I won't be going back tomorrow. Go for the baked goods, but get your coffee elsewhere!

If I'm going to burn calories, it should be worth my sweat. The place is in a remote area and the ice cream was a hair shy above fry's. I'm all for promoting local businesses yet; it seems like they just wheeled in a few coolers, purchase art work with a Fat Albert look alike decor to spice up the location and this makes this place awesome? Invest in your products, order enough macaroons to fulfill your weekend crowd and make your ice cream taste less frost bitten and then we can speak awesome!

If you are looking for baked goods similar to your local grocery chain look no further. Service is excellent and the staff all helpful with recommendations and attentiveness. I appreciate the care all the staff give to patrons, but unfortunately I didn't stop by for the service, rather the food. The croissants are not worth the space they occupy in the belly. I tried both regular and almond, both bland, boring and unsatisfying. I left disappointed and waited the following day to hit Bouchon for a tasty almond croissant. If Bouchon is open, I'd suggest going there for pastries.
Great service and as always, amazing ice cream. Everything they seem to churn out is amazing. The 16th St location is much closer to me which is great but not so close that I eat there every day.

Pretty decent ice cream, it's no salt and straw from PDX but for Phoenix, it was good. The flavors are somewhat limited, about 10 flavors or so and you can sample 1 or 2 before deciding. They also have something called a pretzel cone, think waffle cone but with a hard pretzel instead. The price was $3.50 for a single scoop and a waffle cone was an additional $.75. I'd probably stick to a regular sugar cone as they don't make their waffle cones from scratch. Try the Vietnamese coffee ice cream, it was yummy. Oh and here's a tip we learned from the folks in front of us, you can do a single scoop but pick two flavors, so think of it as a half scoop of one flavor and a half scoop of another flavor for only $3.50.

My favorite ice cream in town. You can smell the cones from a mile away. A little pricy but it's worth it. I recommend the brambleberry crisp and the brown butter almond brittle. My friend got Millie at chocolate but he didn't think it was a religious experience like I usually do so id skip that one.

I loooooove Melt!!! It is such a fun and classic downtown Phoenix spot and an absolute can't miss on first Fridays! What's great about melt is their selection of flavors - it's ever-changing and totally takes advantage of seasonal produce. My favorite is the Cookie Monster, which is a blue cookie batter ice cream with Oreos, mills wafers, and chips ahoy! Their sorbets are also delicious - I love the lavender strawberry when they have it! Today I got the green tea, which was new to me but probably one of the best flavors I've had there. You can get your scoop in a cute Chinese takeout box complete with a fortune cookie, or on a come (sometimes they can even shape it into a flower!) They have other toppings as well. They also have candies and other snacks so be sure to bring your sweet tooth and your appetite when you stop by!

We were looking for real ice cream. My daughter has all kinds of reactions to the nasty stuff they put in most foods. Enter Churn. All real ingredients. Refreshing! Downsides: The line out the door was not refreshing and the service was not warm. I did not eat ice cream but it looked great! Also loved all the old time candy displayed for sale.

Who doesn't love a fun donut, well Donut bar has them! Wonder women, fidget spinner donut, homer donuts they got it! Now their Texas size donuts. Not bad. I got the green tea. The green tea donut batch was a bit over cooked & lacked some flavor. Maybe I should have gotten something else. Their not bad donuts, jus iG worthy and hipster donut vibe. Friend got the wonder women huge donut. 2-3$ donuts. Cool fast service. Coffee. Nitro. Milk. Parking on St. located right off the strip.

I have been lived in Cleveland for more than my year but have not been to Presti until yesterday. It was awesome. No wonder so many of friends highly recommended it to me. I and my friends orders something to go. It was a nice brunch at home. Having the cheesecake and the coffee together makes me so relaxed and happy. The Italian cheesecake is perfect. it is not expensive at all. The cannoli is not as amazing as the cheesecake but it is ok too. I was so amazed by the food itself that I even forgot to take some pictures. I am so glad I finally try Presti's bakery before I leave Cleveland. Highly recommend it.

My son and I ordered a key lime and a chocolate marshmallow. Each were uniquely delicious. The lime was fresh and the chocolate was rich. The girls working were very organized, sweet and friendly. If I had anything to complain about, it would be the size of the store. Pretty crowded for the location.

There are times my wife and I need to finish our night with a treat. One place we love to either get a treat to end our night or to have with our morning coffee is batchmaker. This place has great homemade baked goods and the owner and staff are such nice and friendly people. We have had the pop tarts (both apple cinnamon and strawberry), the oatmeal cream pie, their brownies, cereal killer muffins with cereal cooked inside. We have loved everything. My wife's favorite is the oatmeal cream pie and mine is the pop tart. They also serve coffee from my favorite local coffee shop, Hex/stable hand. So, two great local spots collaborating is also a big win for us all. Good people, great food and great drinks is what local shopping is all about. I would recommend this place to all sweet connoisseurs.

This was the redeeming grace of our night at the cosmopolitan after our diner at DOCG was a train wreck. We had the crack pie milk shake that tasted like a vanilla shake on steroids. So delicious. We also grabed the tin of 6 cookies to give to some friends at work. Some really interesting flavors for the cookies, I think the one that stood out the most was the corn flake cookie. Ow so good.

I'm so glad that this place opened up in the Linq! Such a wonderful cupcake joint which as stirred up a lot of buzz since the grand opening. Since it's opened, I've been to this place 4 times. That says a lot as I'm not a sweets type of person. Here's what I thought: The set up: I love the set up! When you enter the place, you'll notice the ice cream shop to the right and the cupcakes to the left. If the joint is busy, no worries! Make your way outside to the cupcake ATM! What an awesome device :) Give you the power to eat cupcakes at any time. Service: The staff is a younger crowd for sure. For the most part they are super personable and really accommodating. On one of my visits though, I was super turned off by how immature some of them were acting. We understand as customers, that the cupcakes run out. It was kind of unprofessional for two employees to be fighting over the last cupcake for their customer. Prices: I'm not sure about the ice cream prices, but if you choose to go to the cupcake side, they have 2 prices: $3.75 for large cupcakes and $2.00 for small cupcakes. Selection: The selection is on point! There are a lot of different flavors. Over the course of 4 visits, I've tried a few different flavors. Here's what I thought: -Triple Cinnamon: By far, my absolute favorite! The cake was light, the cream cheese frosting was not dense and filled with the cinnamon flavor and topped with cinnamon sugar. So delicious! Watch out, they go fast! -Red Velvet: Their best seller for sure. The cake was a little more dense than I expected but I can see why it's a best seller! - Smores: Cool cupcake! The frosting is a marshmallow texture, chocolate cake with a graham cracker bottom. All the elements are there and well received! -Peanut Butter Chip: Super dense cake with an intense peanut butter taste. I like the chocolate chips throughout the cupcake and the peanut butter frosting reinforced the flavor. -Dark Chocolate: WOW, lots of chocolate going on! Super rich and decadent. If you're a chocolate lover, this cupcake is perfect for you! - Mini chocolate marshmallow: Rich chocolate ganache frosting, chocolate cake with marshmallow filling. Nice combination of flavors :) Sprinkles has taken an American classic and took it to the next level. The prices might be a little steep but man, I think it's super worth it! When a place put a lot of time and effort in making each dessert, you can't help but overlook the bill. I will be the first one to admit that I will not only return, I will also admit that I will be enjoying more than one cupcake each and every time. Thanks so much for deciding to open in Las Vegas!

The struggle between keeping your new favorite dessert place a secret and posting a 5-star review on Yelp that it deserves! I choose the 5-star review! There have been so many photos of the cookie cup from Fatty Daddy's floating around Yelp, Instagram, & Facebook that I had to go in to try one as soon as possible. First and foremost, their ice-cream! When we were there, we were told that they invent their own flavors and work with a local dairy to bring all their creations to life. This is why they have unique flavors like fruit loops, cap n crunch, blueberry muffin, Netflix & chill (popcorn flavored infused ice-cream with a bunch of stuff it), etc. Next, the cookie cup! To make one, they take up to two ice-cream flavors of your choice and make a sandwich with a macaron. The flavors of the macarons vary but the time we went they had fruity pebbles, red velvet, and vanilla. They also toast up a marshmallow right in front of you and add any toppings to the cup that you may want! My order was for a fruity pebbles macaron with blueberry muffin ice-cream and a toasted marshmallow. The best part about this whole dessert was that everything was put together in layers so there were bits of all three parts in every bite! The macaron was soft and chewy with a smooth outer shell, the blueberry muffin ice-cream was packed with delicious blueberry flavor, and the toasted marshmallow added another unique layer of flavor with a gooey texture. Yum!! Lastly, the service was spot on! We were welcomed in right when we walked in and offered samples of ice-cream. They were great in making recommendations and were happy to give us the time we needed to make a decision even as it was getting busy. I can't wait for the next time to get another cookie cup!

Came to Handel's with my sisters and waited 20 minutes for what should've been 5. This is what my milkshake looked like when it came out, then I had to wait additional time until they realized they forgot part of my order. Very disappointing.

Last weekend my boyfriend and I visited. We got two single scoops ice cream and they were very good! There was a great assortment of flavors to choose from and the dining area was air-conditioned and clean. Will definitely come back this summer!

My mom raves so highly about this place. Everytime she makes a visit to SoCal, she always stop by 85C Bakery just to get a full box of fresh bread and pastries to take home to Vegas. Now that we have one here in Shanghai Plaza, my friend and I decided to meet early on Sunday morning. For a moment I thought Yes! We are gonna beat traffic. No wait time and no line, right? Wrong! The line was already there and curving by 9 am. Initially I had no idea how this work. Then I saw a sign that says grab a tray and a tong. I was watching how the pros were doing this which helped alot! You find what you like, pop open the cover, it slides in, you grab the item with your tong, then place it on your glossy tray. It's also good they have clear labels that way you know exactly what you're getting. I got one or two of everything, sweet and savory, and when my tray was getting full they keep calling out "Fresh Bread!" Oh good! Get them while they're hot. They'll even add one on your tray. By the time we stood in line, the wait can take 20 minutes or so before you reach the register. They will ring up individual items and package each one in plastic. You can opt for a carry out bag or a box. I end up getting two full box and also purchased a big red bag for $2 to carry these box. Cakes and drinks are ordered using the kiosk or at the register. There's a few table seatings to dine in. I was able to enjoy a delicious sea salt caramel coffee and a yummy grapefruit green tea! Fresh bread and pastries are soft and fluffy. I love the tiramisu and black forest cake, it had the perfect amount of sweet. Nothing was dry, brittle, or underwhelming. Service staff are super nice and everything I had was perfect!
This is probably why they only have one star reason to stay open they should reconsider opening up there little cafÃ©

Freakishly good donuts. Walked in the first time with the intention of ordering 1 of each, then realised it would be three dozen easily. Every donut of the 12 I got were simply amazing. I am going to miss it dearly, and have only just found it. The fried donuts are needless to say- wicked awesome. Maple and sprinkles and creme filled oh my. It is a little gem, and if you are in Cleveland go check it out!

Friendly service, great selection of treats, easy parking, and everything was delicious. This was the fourth place I went to looking for decaf espresso and the first to finally have it. As someone who loves coffee but can't have caffeine I was happy to finally find somewhere in Charlotte that carried decaf options.

Sprinkles! Aside from the fabulous name this place does not disappoint. It can get a little crowded but the line moves fairly quickly. I tried the captain crunch ice cream and it was SO GOOD. Between the ice cream, cup cakes and cookies they have a little something for everyone including mini cupcakes (so cute). Try it if you're in the area!

So, with this place receiving so much fanfare I had to stop in and see what all the fuss was about. I arrived when almost all the donuts were gone but still managed to score a dozen with the help of my good friend. We walked right in and were greeted by the friendly and fun staff. We viewed the menu for the day and could not believe the variety of donuts. There were at least 20+ flavors to choose from and this included vegan choices which I can totally get behind. These aren't just donuts, some were like mini cakes and were almost big enough to cover your whole face (No Joke)! I had never seen such large donuts before and could not believe how creative these people are with the large variety of choices. We managed to score some delicious options, such as the Strawberry Split, Mexican Hot Chocolate, Blood Orange, Boston Creme, The Oreo Donut (with an Oreo inside) and a couple of creme brÃ»lÃ©e'. My favorite donut from this batch was the Boston Creme. The creme oozes with flavor and tasted heavenly. The donut itself was moist and fresh. The creme was so rich that I found it a little overwhelming to eat in one sitting so I ate half the first day and finished it off the second day. Yeah, it was rough.... The Strawberry Split was layered with fresh strawberries and whipped creme in the middle of a large sugar donut. A different take on the strawberry short cake and perhaps a step up. I almost added a small drizzle of chocolate since I had it for dessert that night. I shared the other donuts with my staff and family and they were all very complimentary. My daughter really liked the Oreo Donut and was surprised when she found the cookie in the middle. The service was outstanding and so friendly. The shop is quaint and very clean with not a whole lot of room and it makes this place nice and cozy. They also have a new t- shirt for advertising that is available for purchase. It has a great color scheme and it gives a shout out to our city! I can hardly wait to go back early in the morning when the donuts are fresh out of the fryer. I think I can hear a Homer donut calling my name.

Their coffee was good and their simple creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut @ $2 was a decent introduction to this place. I walked in on a Saturday morning to find the place alive and buzzing with several excited families seeking donuts for breakfast. Their regular donut options seemed overwhelmingly huge for $5/piece so when I asked them for their smallest donut they pointed me over to the creme brÃ»lÃ©e near the end. Americano took a few mins but was delicious and complex. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was yummy with a sugar topping that shatters when you bite into it and that custard that's to die for. Worth the random wander off the downtown area but others may find the area too quiet for their own comfort on an early Saturday morning in Feb. Bonus: the driverless shuttle they are piloting has the Donut Bar as a stop!

Went there on a Sunday afternoon after work. At that time they were not too busy. I tried several times before in the evening but the long line always stopped me and I turned around. Anyway we got the hot fudge brownie Sunday my friend with vanilla ice cream and myself with strawberry cheesecake ice cream. Before ordering I asked if the brownie was homemade and the employee said yes. Well I don't know which kind of chocolate they use, probably cheap stuff because even though the ice-cream was not too bad the brownie was terrible ! My friend thought same. So I guess if you go there just get ice-cream but I'm not even sure if it's worth to wait that long... it's nothing special just average.

Allow me to start out by expressing just how much I love this place. I happened to discover this quaint little bakery on a sunny Sunday after church. And I've returned several times with friends and sometimes even alone! Every cake I've tried thus far has been moist, not too sweet with just the right amount of icing! What makes the cakes even better is that they're vegan so they're constructed with all natural ingredients. For example, they use olive oil instead of butter. The fruit and flowers on the cakes are always fresh. The dining atmosphere is an absolute delight filled with old-fashioned charm. There is just one thing that bothers me about this place. Whenever slicing your cake and transferring it to the plate, the baristas use their ungloved hands to pick up and balance the cake slices. Today, I watched one of the baristas pick up a brownie and just hand it to a customer then mess with her hair bun. This screams unsanitary to me. Other than this, the place is amazing. I just hope one day they'll actually use gloves or serving utensils.

The cannolis were outstanding as I thought they would be. The huge disappointment was not being able to sit down and have coffee and a cannoli. It was just not what I expected. If your going to have a bakery in Vegas put seating nearby or maybe let people sit out front at your restaurant. I still love your bakery and your family.
One of the best pieces of foccacia I've ever had in my life and good coffee. Everything else they offered looked equally delicious. YUM!

I've been hearing about the amazing sweets served in this establishment in New York and Los Angeles. Since we wee near the area showing out of towners around, we thought "Why not?" Located in Cosmopolitan Hotel in between Momofoku and Eggslut, the establishment is pretty small and only has one bench for a couple of people to sit on. There is a bright pink neon sign that signals you have reached your destination. The menu is shown above the cash registers. They offer various things, from soft serves, milkshakes, prepackaged cookies, and different sweets. Thankful there was no line, we decided to try a cereal soft serve with corn flakes. After ordering and paying at the cashier, you wait by the window on the right for them to serve you your order. Orders came quick, but I would hope so considering they are basically just preparing ice cream in a cup/prepackaged desserts in the front. The soft serve was very underwhelming. Yes. It tasted like cereal milk. That was the whole point. However, for $10+? Not worth it. The portion was very small and the corn flakes tasted bland and somewhat gross. If you like them, however, you would be very thankful that probably 1/3 of the cup is filled with corn flakes in the bottom, as well as topped on the soft serve. For all the hype for this establishment, I was honestly expecting way more. Maybe I would try the prepackaged pastries and cookies if they were offered to me. However, I would not be returning. Very disappointing.

Ok, the staff is great. The food is amazing. I love the cake pops. You must get the red velvet, salted caramel or dark chocolate raspberry cake pop. Chocolate covered bacon is so amazing. Try everything there.
Holy Cannoli! While visiting the Venetian Casino we decided to grab a sweet and since Cake Boss is a staple we decided why not. It was pretty amazing!

This is a really cool concept and their selections are definitely Instagram worthy. I tried this after seeing it in one of our online newsletters here in Charlotte but it wasn't quite so enticing that I've ever made an effort to try it again.
It would be dangerous to live in Pittsburgh having such delicious chocolate around. Great customer service and delicious goodies! Can't wait to be back!

Hands down the best French bakery I've ever been to. The atmosphere when you walk in is so inviting! All of the decor seemed to have a hand made touch to it. There is tons of seating and perfect for meetings or even a cool place to study. There are several pastry cases full of homemade pastries, croissants, tarts, and baguettes! And by home made I mean they hold make everything! Try the pumpkin pie tarts!! Oh and the barista (black guy) SO nice! Definitely made our experience that much better!! Can't WAIT to go back! :))

My go-to ice cream place in the summer! The lines are usually long and you have to wait a while, but they have some delicious snowstorms! They also have a drive-thru, which I have never used, but that is because I like to sit out front at the tables in the parking lot. Perfect place to go with friends on a beautiful summer night for a yummy treat!

Definitely one of the best ice cream shops in the area! What makes them unique is they specialize in hand crafted Filipino desserts! The owners are the most genuine people! Make sure to get a karaoke song in before you leave! A must go!

Amelie's is an amazing French bakery with a vast assortment of pastries, breakfast items, and coffee. They easily beat out any French bakery in Raleigh, and I knew I had to bring home as many treats as I could. For breakfast, I had the twice baked almond croissant. It was so crunchy on the outside, yet so buttery and soft on the inside; it was twice baked perfectly and easily one of the best croissants I've had. I also got a latte, and it was very strong. I love the design they put on top of it as well, a very elegant presentation. I also tried the apple and strawberry kiwi fruit tarts. Both were really good and the French cream was so smooth. The salted caramel brownie was also amazing. Salty and sweet, gooey and crunchy, everything you would want in a dessert. The chocolate filled Ã©clair and cream puffs were also classics, can't go wrong with either. The chocolate mousse torte was also decadently smooth and rich with cocoa flavor. Overall, everything I tried was really good. You can't go wrong with any of their pastries and desserts. Amelie's is an absolute must every time I go to Charlotte now.

I give 5 star for their bread, always a big fan. A cashier named Kaitlin was rude to me. I will attached my receipt for the proof. We were at the store around 8:22pm of 1/5/2022. I bought almost $100 worth of pastries with drinks. 35 pastries to be exact, she gave me only 2 boxes and a bag. She stuffed 14 pastries on each box and 7 loose in a bag. I asked for another box, she refused she said minimum 9 for boxes and I only have 7. I asked her to move some from the other boxes since they have 14 each. I told her I'll pay for it if it cost something. She said she still can't do it. I asked another cashier to give me a box and he gave it to me with no questions asked. This kind of employee is bad for business who work for customer service field. I don't want her to lose her job but this need to be addressed.

I went there two days in a row to get cupcakes. I had the coconut and black and white cupcake and my boyfriend had the red velvet and cinnamon ones. I must say these were the best cupcakes I have ever had!!! Love the plates and silver wear too!

I've been meaning to come by for the last few Vegas trips and finally had some time! We grabbed a compost cookie, milk cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow cookie, birthday cake soft serve, cereal milk soft serve, and a slice of birthday cake. YES it finally comes in (super expensive) slices which I was hyped about because part of me was considering buying an entire cake if they had it just because I wanted to try. The cookies were just okay, they're all pre-packaged and def taste a day or two old. Not sure if that's the case but they didn't have the right chew/fresh cookie taste to them. The soft serve is AWESOME, especially the birthday cake. Beautifully cream-cheesy and none of the food colouring taste a lot of "birthday cake" products tend to have. I also enjoyed the cereal milk that comes with crunch, sweet cornflake bits. A more subtle flavour but still really good. Now, the famed birthday cake, unfortunately is overhyped. I really wanted to love it, but it was overly crumbly(maybe too long in the fridge?) and just kind of average tasting. It did have some delightful crunchy bits in between the icing layers, but I def wouldn't pay $14 for another slice. 3 stars just because the only thing I feel is worthwhile is the soft serve, and I'll def go back for it!
With what looks like small serving sizes when you first enter. Fatty Daddy's is pretty heavy handed with their two scoops. The ice cream is great. This place is a great hidden gem in Scottsdale.

The staffs were taking their time. After they've scooped out my ice cream, they were still helping out the people in front of us (very slowly). I waited at least 3 minutes before they gave me my ice cream (it's been sitting on their countertop), by the time they handed it to me it was already melting. They also got my order wrong, which they provided a refund, but by the time I finally got what I wanted, I've already lost my interest of having ice cream. First time walking out of an ice cream store with such disappointment.
Awesome donuts, with so many to choose from! From Maple Bacon to Smores and Turtle donuts, they have just about any kind you might want..

I love this place! I don't have a huge sweet tooth but I'd never pass up Amelie's. I love the fact that they're open 24/7 and you can literally go at any time of the day. The atmosphere can vary depending on what time of the day you catch them at. The pastries are always freshly made and are not too sweet. The wait staff is always fantastic and take care of customers in a timely manner.

There is not one bad thing to be said about Churn, except that I wish I could get ice cream there every single day. The staff is really bubbly and friendly, the ice cream is to die for, and if you don't get one of their ice cream sandwiches made with homemade ice cream AND homemade cookies, you're completely insane.

Don't waste your time or money coming here..cookies are pre packaged, the slice of cake I got was dry, and the milkshake lacked flavor..honestly a milkshake from McDonald's or Jack in the box would of been better Wasted over $40

This place is fantastic. The perfect place to come to relax, read a book, get some work done, etc... Best part about it is that they have amazing baked goods, drinks and sandwiches. I've never been to a bakery in which everything they offer is absolutely delicious. The dÃ©cor here is funky, but that's what makes this place unique. This place is a must for anyone in the Charlotte area.

This place is awesome. The macarons are perfect and with wide variety (love the key lime and mint chocolate chip especially) the muffin is basically perfect. The tiramisu is cocoa mascarpone cream deliciousness. They wait to fill the cannoli until ordered, making them even better. The coffee is solid and smooth. We can't stop going here.

This place has been hyped up because of it's delicious well presented donuts. I Took my boys there to try out some of their creations. My one son decided on the donut "cone" with vanilla Ice cream, I decided on the apple fritter and my younger son got the birthday cake donut. Here's where the review goes south: My son tried and ate the cone with ice cream and said that the cone tasted like pre made pilsbury pastry dough, the apple fritter I was expecting to taste full of apple and moist was VERY DRY, over cooked and had not much Apple to find in it and as for my younger sons birthday cake donut it too was very dry and made Dunkin look like the king of the cake donuts. The 3 donuts total were $11.00, yes that was for 3 donuts. So for them to claim they are #bestdonutsintheworld not in the eyes of this consumer. Pink box donuts can easily out do donut bar on quality, taste and price.

This is a great location to get your fix that only craft ice cream can provide. The staff is super friendly and helpful, the place is clean, and the outdoor seating is quite convenient (and plentiful). I've only tried one flavor so far (Darkest Chocolate) and I'm hooked! The waffle cone is delicious and didn't taste overly sweet which is a win-win! Looking forward to checking out more of their flavors. They all sound so good!

This is my go to spot for ice cream. Well one of them. If you are a person that hashtags on Instagram and searches for cool looking desserts that also taste good this is the spot for you. I got a macaron sand-which with vanilla ice cream and lucky charms cereal on top. What is a macaron? Glad you asked it's a small piece of heaven ! No seriously it is like a French cookie. They put just the amount of ice cream in between and Cereal so it didn't make a mess but I didn't feel cheated for paying $5 for an ice cream sand which. They also have a variety of other different sandwhiches my husband got a brownie sand-which. There are shakes as well. If you are hungry and it's not lunch time you better eat before you go. All they serve is the desserts unless it's lunch time then they have sandwhiches and wraps.
Love the Ice Cream here. It's a cute little spot and there is places to sit outside. Just down the street from where I live.
Lived up to my expectations after watching Cake Boss all those years. Went back three times during our visit! Definitely recommend finding and their Restaurant across the way is awesome too!

Best Ice Cream in Arizona! The mango margarita sorbet and salted butter carmel are my favorites. They constantly have fun thing new to try. Don't forget the they have scooped and pre packed pints at whole foods around the valley also.

I've been to the Bouchon restaurants in Beverly Hills and Las Vegas. Both experiences were okay but nothing particularly exceptional. I've read a lot of good things about the Bouchon Bakery though so I was still eager to give it a try. Bouchon Bakery is conveniently located near the guest elevators on the casino floor. The bakery is a simple open storefront. They have glass display counters showcasing the many attractive pastries and desserts while coffee is made/assembled in the background. I went three times and it was busy on each visit; still, lines moved quickly each time because service was organized. I had a good sampling of their offerings and most of what I had was good. Here is the rundown. (Pain Au Raisin) This was nice croissant dough that was mixed with golden and dark raisins. The pastry was good. It had a good crispness on the outside, but it still had a nice flakiness and softness at the center. It was nicely sweet but not overpowering. The raisins were plump and flavorful--too often raisins are overly shriveled in these types of pastries. (Chocolate Bouchon) This was a chocolate brownie shaped like a wine cork. The bouchon I had was dusted with powdered sugar. It also had a little bit of fudgy chocolate ganache in the center, which may not have been the intention (a later bouchon I had seemed to lack this fudge). The brownie was good. Good, rich chocolate flavor and the appropriate texture of a brownie. I have noticed that a lot of bakeries will alter the brownie recipe to create a moister brownie with a longer shelf life, which results in a fudgy brownie that is not really a brownie. I like how the brownie here was baked as it should have been. Because of that, the Bouchon here may not have been the moistest brownie, but it was still satisfying and thankfully still a brownie. (Macarons) I had three here--caramel, vanilla and coffee. All the flavors were good, but if I had to pick, I would probably say the caramel was the best. Good and smooth cream centers that were flavorful. The macarons' outside shells had a light crispness while the inside was soft and chewy. The macarons here were larger than most macarons I've had (priced higher too at a little over $3 a piece). (Chocolate Croissant) This (or maybe the apple croissant) was probably my least favorite thing here and it may have a lot to do with how I am not the biggest fan of chocolate croissants. I think part of it has to do with how I don't like how big and soft they tend to be. The croissant was light, crispy and flaky. The croissant featured a thick and generous chocolate bar at the center. The croissant was fine though it was very similar to the other good chocolate croissants I've had (and it did not really stand out). (Apple Croissant) This pastry was not your typical apple pastry. The bottom was a flat puff pastry base. It was topped with apples and then a slightly crunchy and sweet cinnamon streusel-like topping (similar to a Dutch apple pie). It tasted fine, but it was not as good as other apple pastries I've had. The pastry base was a little firm and thick. It lacked the light crispness and flakiness of a good croissant. The apple flavor was not as prominent as I would have liked, which was mainly due to the generous portion of the cinnamon streusel (kind of overwhelmed the apple flavor). Service was good and pleasant on all of my visits. Pricing was about what you would expect with most of the options in the $3-$4 range. I would imagine that most bakeries/pastry shops in Las Vegas (even bad ones) would be charging similar prices. The quality at Bouchon Bakery was high and because the prices were reasonable enough, this one might be worth the extra walk or the extra casino hop if you get a hankering for a good pastry during your stay. The Venetian offers complimentary valet parking. Like other major casinos, I imagine they would have complimentary self-parking as well.

Well, it's Bouchon. Do I really need to say more? My girlfriends and I had brunch in the morning at Bouchon, and knew of the bakery. It was a must on the way out, on our way home from Vegas. We had chocolate croissant, brioche, sticky bun and cheese danish already as part of our breakfast pastry plate while in the restuarant, but I wanted to get some macaroons. I got the variety pack - I've completedly devoured the strawberry one, and parts of the chocolate and pistachio so far. OH MY GOODNESS! So good. Next time while in Vegas, if I don't have the good fortune of heading to Bouchon for some brunch and only want a pastry or two, with some coffee, I'm definitely heading here!
The best ice cream ever. I highly recommend the flavor called Fat Elvis. The customer service was also second to none. We loved it and will be back soon.

I haven't been here since my last review which was about 4 years ago. I stopped in today with a friend of mine who's a regular, and it was as good as I remember. Decent selection of flavors, lots to taste, and prices were great. It was a great treat after a nice lunch to stop in here and get a scoop of real ice cream. We were entertained by some of the people who were here while we ate, and it was fun to interact with other patrons while we visited. There was a guy outside trying to train his dog and give his wife directions to the store while we sat outside and ate our ice cream..that was quite a bit of fun to watch, and we had a good laugh. Overall, I still like sweet republic and should probably stop here more often when I'm in the area.

Chicken Salad Sandwich and pumpkin bisque were both on point. Both surprisingly super delicious. I wish I had gotten full sizes of both instead of the half. I also went nuts and tried their salted caramel brownie, lemon puff pastry, sticky bun, lemon macaron, mini versions of the smores, lemon, and pumpkin tart. Of all of them, I really liked the lemon tart and the sticky bun. After reading all the hype the Salted caramel brownie was okay... It's more caramel than brownie though. Felt like I was eating spoonfuls of caramel, and I LOVE me some salted caramel. So what I did is take the salted caramel and put it on my sticky pecan bun. After 20 seconds in the microwave, it perfectly warm and epic.

I accidentally muttered "I need some alone time with this ice cream" when I took my first bite of this ice cream. And if that doesn't define how good Mitchell's is I don't know how else to! For real, the ice cream here is rich and dense. I was flabbergasted at how they could have the flavors be so good but not overwhelming. My friends had a good laugh at my statement but I truly meant it. It was a delight to have the caramel fudge brownie flavor melt In my mouth and I haven't tasted anything like it. Will be back in Cleveland in the next year and can't wait to try more of their flavors!

You wouldn't know it from the previous three reviews, but this place actually makes more than donuts! Gasp all you want, but it's true. When the sun has not yet gone to sleep, and people have had fewer than two martinis for the day, Presti's Bakery serves sandwiches, paninis (okay, that's Italian for sandwich), pizzas, flatbreads, and other lunch-able items during the day. And, on a beautiful day like today, sitting at one of the bistro tables along the sidewalk makes one feel like they actually live in an urban city envrionment. It's pretty great.

I was looking forward to trying their macaroon ice cream and when I got there, they ran out of the ones I wanted! I opted for a random one and I didn't think it was really worth the price. The staff was okay, the guy seemed annoyed that I couldn't decide what I wanted right off the bat, but there was no one else in line or marked what they did or didn't have! I think next time if I can, I would come earlier to try it. My boyfriend got the fruity pebble milkshake and it really did taste like fruity pebbles but it was way too sweet. It was hard to finish it but nonetheless it was good.

Cereal milk soft serve with cornflakes. Get it. It's not too sweet. Hit the spot after dinner. They also brew Stumptown coffee, so don't waste your time and money on other crappy expensive coffee on the strip. They have the cold brew too!

11/19/18 Fast forward to now... yes, it's been that long since I've been to Las Vegas! Bouchon Bakery closed st the Montage in Beverly Hills a while ago so it's been a while since I've had a Bouchon kouign amann. It was time. On our way to the airport I had the uber driver stop at the Venetian. It's great that the app allow you to do that! To be sure they had the kouign amanns, ordered them the day before and paid for them using my credit cared ( they require payment in advance). Valerie was really nice taking my order and set the pickup time perfectly Now I had "gifts" for my kids. On to the airport... I have one to our uber driver since he knew nothing about them. I hope he liked it. All in all, a good day!

As easily impressed I am with little things, this shop did not meet my expectations. At all.. From all the hype this bakery was receiving, I thought I would give it a try as the assortment of cupcake flavors extended beyond my imagination. Plus CUPCAKE ATM. Who doesn't love to get cupcake's dispensed through a machine?! I would say the design of the cupcakes and the store impressed me far more than the taste aspect of this sad food adventure. As I took a bite of my dark chocolate cupcake, all I was expecting was a sea of pleasure and unimaginable bliss. Yet all I got was crumbly (somewhat moist) textured cake, and an overly sweet cupcake for one that defined itself a 'dark chocolate'. If you have a sweet tooth, than by all means, this cupcake is for you. Although I like my food to taste how it is labeled...Definitely disappointed with the taste aspect of this place. Although, it is worth the try at the very least.

Oh I love love love love this place my favorite ice cream in the world is the raspberry sorbet goodness gracious and the place is so clean the employees are so nice and so friendly and the prices are very reasonable
Omg!!! Delicious flavors. Ice cream was delicious, added some extra toppings too. Staff was very nice and patient.

Love this downtown hot spot! My kids like getting these as a treat and we've had them at parties and work gathering. Staff is always super nice and friendly. Easy location to walk to from Fremont st and container park. Close to life is beautiful and year round street art.

I have dreamed about the Birthday Cake for years after seeing it on TV. The actual taste did not disappoint. It was just the right texture and the icing was amazing. Just the perfect combination. We also had the crack pie, crack pie ice cream, and cereal milk ice cream all amazing just not as good as the cake. It was life changing both for me and my brother in law!! A must try and near so many great restaurants so skip dessert and head there!

Cake Lovers, do NOT forget Villani's!! My best friend had his wedding this past weekend. I was in charge of the wedding cake. Due to covid I was in a little bit of a crunch. They didn't want to provide guests with cake slices, so the bride suggested mini cakes. I met with Amanda (twice) to discuss what the best option would be during covid. First off Amanda is AMAZING. She emailed me, met me twice, and even texted me the day of the wedding. When we met for the cake testing, she let me try many different options which also included different icing. uh it was beyond delicious! We discussed options and finally decided on three cakes. One for the wedding, one for the bride, and one for the groom. We also decided on macaroons. Second off Amanda is AMAZING! I basically let her do whatever design process she thought was best. I trusted her and she did not disappoint. The cakes looked fantastic, even with the creativity, and covid Amanda was still 12/10! Both her and her husband delivered the cake on the wedding day. She made the cakes the SAME DAY because she wanted them to be fresh AND boy were they! Everything was so amazing, from the colors, the designs, to the actual cakes. They all tasted as good as they looked!! From her sweet personality, overall cake knowledge, the amazing design skills, and the flavor of the cakes I don't think I'll go anywhere else for cakes! I couldn't recommend this bakery more!! Don't miss out

Mmmmm... cupcakes, cookies and ice cream who doesn't love them?!? Well, I do! I am a sweet lover and proud of it! Sprinkles is this cute little bakery right outside the High Roller. They have cupcakes, cookies, ice cream, all that can hit your sweet tooth plus treats for your doggy (no one ever seems to have cat treats).. moving on! There's a few window bar seats inside and several table umbrella seats outside. I grabbed a black and white chocolate cupcake, chocolate chip and snicker doodle cookie.
